They will reply, "If we had received the Guidance of God, we should have given it to you: to us it makes no difference (now) whether we rage, or bear (these torments) with patience: for ourselves there is no way of escape."
text_en_pickthall: They all come forth unto their Lord. Then those who were despised say unto those who were scornful: We were unto you a following, can ye then avert from us aught of Allah’s doom ? They say: Had Allah guided us, we should have guided you. Whether we rage or patiently endure is (now) all one for us; we have no place of refuge.
text_en_arberry: They sally forth unto God, all together; then say the weak to those who waxed proud, ’We were your followers; will you avail us against the chastisement of God anything?’ They say, ’If God had guided us, we would have guided you. Alike it is for us whether we cannot endure, or whether we are patient; we have no asylum.’

text_ar: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: And Satan will say ˹to his followers˺ after the judgment has been passed, “Indeed, Allah has made you a true promise. I too made you a promise, but I failed you. I did not have any authority over you. I only called you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; blame yourselves. I cannot save you, nor can you save me. Indeed, I denounce your previous association of me with Allah ˹in loyalty˺. Surely the wrongdoers will suffer a painful punishment.”
text_en_yusufali: And Satan will say when the matter is decided: "It was God Who gave you a promise of Truth: I too promised, but I failed in my promise to you. I had no authority over you except to call you but ye listened to me: then reproach not me, but reproach your own souls. I cannot listen to your cries, nor can ye listen to mine. I reject your former act in associating me with God. For wrong-doers there must be a grievous penalty."
text_en_pickthall: And Satan saith, when the matter hath been decided: Lo! Allah promised you a promise of truth; and I promised you, then failed you. And I had no power over you save that I called unto you and ye obeyed me. So blame not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can ye help me, Lo! I disbelieved in that which ye before ascribed to me. Lo! for wrong- doers is a painful doom.
text_en_arberry: And Satan says, when the issue is decided, ’God surely promised you a true promise; and I promised you, then I failed you, for I had no authority over you, but that I called you, and you answered me. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves; I cannot aid you, neither can you aid me. I disbelieved in your associating me with God aforetime.’ As for the evildoers, for them awaits a painful chastisement;

text_ar: وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ
text_en_primary: Those who believe and do good will be admitted into Gardens, under which rivers flow—to stay there forever by the Will of their Lord—where they will be greeted with “Peace!”
text_en_yusufali: But those who believe and work righteousness will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow,- to dwell therein for aye with the leave of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be: "Peace!"
text_en_pickthall: And those who believed and did good works are made to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein abiding by permission of their Lord, their greeting therein: Peace!
text_en_arberry: but as for those who believe, and do deeds of righteousness, they shall be admitted to gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein dwelling forever, by the leave of their Lord, their greeting therein: ’Peace!’

text_ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا كَلِمَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ كَشَجَرَةٍۢ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌۭ وَفَرْعُهَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
text_en_primary: Do you not see how Allah compares a good word to a good tree? Its root is firm and its branches reach the sky,
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou not how God sets forth a parable? - A goodly word like a goodly tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and its branches (reach) to the heavens,- of its Lord. So God sets forth parables for men, in order that they may receive admonition.
text_en_pickthall: Seest thou not how Allah coineth a similitude: A goodly saying, as a goodly tree, its root set firm, its branches reaching into heaven,
text_en_arberry: Hast thou not seen how God has struck a similitude? A good word is as a good tree -- its roots are firm, and its branches are in heaven;

text_ar: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹always˺ yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord. This is how Allah sets forth parables for the people, so perhaps they will be mindful.
text_en_yusufali: It brings forth its fruit at all times, by the leave of its Lord. So God sets forth parables for men, in order that they may receive admonition.
text_en_pickthall: Giving its fruit at every season by permission of its Lord ? Allah coineth the similitudes for mankind in order that they may reflect.
text_en_arberry: it gives its produce every season by the leave of its Lord. So God strikes similitudes for men; haply they will remember.

text_ar: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍۢ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍۢ
text_en_primary: And the parable of an evil word is that of an evil tree, uprooted from the earth, having no stability.
text_en_yusufali: And the parable of an evil Word is that of an evil tree: It is torn up by the root from the surface of the earth: it has no stability.
text_en_pickthall: And the similitude of a bad saying is as a bad tree, uprooted from upon the earth, possessing no stability.
text_en_arberry: And the likeness of a corrupt word is as a corrupt tree -- uprooted from the earth, having no stablishment.

text_ar: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْقَوْلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ۚ وَيَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ
text_en_primary: Allah makes the believers steadfast with the firm Word ˹of faith˺ in this worldly life and the Hereafter. And Allah leaves the wrongdoers to stray. For Allah does what He wills.
text_en_yusufali: God will establish in strength those who believe, with the word that stands firm, in this world and in the Hereafter; but God will leave, to stray, those who do wrong: God doeth what He willeth.
text_en_pickthall: Allah confirmeth those who believe by a firm saying in the life of the world and in the Hereafter, and Allah sendeth wrong-doers astray. And Allah doeth what He will.
text_en_arberry: God confirms those who believe with the firm word, in the present life and in the world to come; and God leads astray the evildoers; and God does what He will.

text_ar: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفْرًۭا وَأَحَلُّوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ ٱلْبَوَارِ
text_en_primary: Have you not seen those ˹disbelievers˺ who meet Allah’s favours with ingratitude and lead their own people to their doom?
text_en_yusufali: Hast thou not turned thy vision to those who have changed the favour of God. Into blasphemy and caused their people to descend to the House of Perdition?-
text_en_pickthall: Hast thou not seen those who gave the grace of Allah in exchange for thanklessness and led their people down to the Abode of Loss,
text_en_arberry: Hast thou not seen those who exchanged the bounty of God with unthankfulness, and caused their people to dwell in the abode of ruin? --

text_ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
text_en_primary: In Hell they will burn. What an evil place for settlement.
text_en_yusufali: Into Hell? They will burn therein,- an evil place to stay in!
text_en_pickthall: (Even to) hell ? They are exposed thereto. A hapless end!
text_en_arberry: Gehenna, wherein they are roasted; an evil stablishment!

text_ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
text_en_primary: They set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy yourselves! Surely your destination is the Fire.”
text_en_yusufali: And they set up (idols) as equal to God, to mislead (men) from the Path! Say: "Enjoy (your brief power)! But verily ye are making straightway for Hell!"
text_en_pickthall: And they set up rivals to Allah that they may mislead (men) from His way. Say: Enjoy life (while ye may) for lo! your journey’s end will be the Fire.
text_en_arberry: And they set up compeers to God, that they might lead astray from His way. Say: ’Take your joy! Your homecoming shall be -- the Fire!’

text_ar: قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا بَيْعٌۭ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ
text_en_primary: Tell My believing servants to establish prayer and donate from what We have provided for them—openly and secretly—before the arrival of a Day in which there will be no ransom or friendly connections.
text_en_yusufali: Speak to my servants who have believed, that they may establish regular prayers, and spend (in charity) out of the sustenance we have given them, secretly and openly, before the coming of a Day in which there will be neither mutual bargaining nor befriending.
text_en_pickthall: Tell My bondmen who believe to establish worship and spend of that which We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a day cometh wherein there will be neither traffick nor befriending.
text_en_arberry: Say to My servants who believe, that they perform the prayer, and expend of that We have provided them, secretly and in public, before a day comes wherein shall be neither bargaining nor befriending.

text_ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ
text_en_primary: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and sends down rain from the sky, causing fruits to grow as a provision for you. He has subjected the ships for your service, sailing through the sea by His command, and has subjected the rivers for you.
text_en_yusufali: It is God Who hath created the heavens and the earth and sendeth down rain from the skies, and with it bringeth out fruits wherewith to feed you; it is He Who hath made the ships subject to you, that they may sail through the sea by His command; and the rivers (also) hath He made subject to you.
text_en_pickthall: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and causeth water to descend from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you, and maketh the ships to be of service unto you, that they may run upon the sea at His command, and hath made of service unto you the rivers;
text_en_arberry: It is God who created the heavens and the earth, and sent down out of heaven water wherewith He brought forth fruits to be your sustenance. And He subjected to you the ships to run upon the sea at His commandment; and He subjected to you the rivers

text_ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
text_en_primary: He has ˹also˺ subjected for you the sun and the moon, both constantly orbiting, and has subjected the day and night for you.
text_en_yusufali: And He hath made subject to you the sun and the moon, both diligently pursuing their courses; and the night and the day hath he (also) made subject to you.
text_en_pickthall: And maketh the sun and the moon, constant in their courses, to be of service unto you, and hath made of service unto you the night and the day.
text_en_arberry: and He subjected to you the sun and moon constant upon their courses, and He subjected to you the night and day,

text_ar: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
text_en_primary: And He has granted you all that you asked Him for. If you tried to count Allah’s blessings, you would never be able to number them. Indeed humankind is truly unfair, ˹totally˺ ungrateful.
text_en_yusufali: And He giveth you of all that ye ask for. But if ye count the favours of God, never will ye be able to number them. Verily, man is given up to injustice and ingratitude.
text_en_pickthall: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.
text_en_arberry: and gave you of all you asked Him. If you count God’s blessing, you will never number it; surely man is sinful, unthankful!

text_ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًۭا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ
text_en_primary: ˹Remember˺ when Abraham prayed, “My Lord! Make this city ˹of Mecca˺ secure, and keep me and my children away from the worship of idols.
text_en_yusufali: Remember Abraham said: "O my Lord! make this city one of peace and security: and preserve me and my sons from worshipping idols.
text_en_pickthall: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.
text_en_arberry: And when Abraham said, ’My Lord, make this land secure, and turn me and my sons away from serving idols;

text_ar: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. So whoever follows me is with me, and whoever disobeys me—then surely You are ˹still˺ All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: "O my Lord! they have indeed led astray many among mankind; He then who follows my (ways) is of me, and he that disobeys me,- but Thou art indeed Oft- forgiving, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful.
text_en_arberry: my Lord, they have led astray many men. Then whoso follows me belongs to me; and whoso rebels against me, surely Thou art All-forgiving, All-compassionate.

text_ar: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
text_en_primary: Our Lord! I have settled some of my offspring in a barren valley, near Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may establish prayer. So make the hearts of ˹believing˺ people incline towards them and provide them with fruits, so perhaps they will be thankful.
text_en_yusufali: "O our Lord! I have made some of my offspring to dwell in a valley without cultivation, by Thy Sacred House; in order, O our Lord, that they may establish regular Prayer: so fill the hearts of some among men with love towards them, and feed them with fruits: so that they may give thanks.
text_en_pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.
text_en_arberry: Our Lord, I have made some of my seed to dwell in a valley where is no sown land by Thy Holy House; Our Lord, let them perform the prayer, and make hearts of men yearn towards them, and provide them with fruits; haply they will be thankful.

text_ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
text_en_primary: Our Lord! You certainly know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from Allah.
text_en_yusufali: "O our Lord! truly Thou dost know what we conceal and what we reveal: for nothing whatever is hidden from God, whether on earth or in heaven.
text_en_pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
text_en_arberry: Our Lord, Thou knowest what we keep secret and what we publish; from God nothing whatever is hidden in earth and heaven.

text_ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
text_en_primary: All praise is for Allah who has blessed me with Ishmael and Isaac in my old age. My Lord is indeed the Hearer of ˹all˺ prayers.
text_en_yusufali: "Praise be to God, Who hath granted unto me in old age Isma’il and Isaac: for truly my Lord is He, the Hearer of Prayer!
text_en_pickthall: Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer.
text_en_arberry: Praise be to God, who has given me, though I am old, Ishmael and Isaac; surely my Lord hears the petition.

text_ar: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
text_en_primary: My Lord! Make me and those ˹believers˺ of my descendants keep up prayer. Our Lord! Accept my prayers.
text_en_yusufali: O my Lord! make me one who establishes regular Prayer, and also (raise such) among my offspring O our Lord! and accept Thou my Prayer.
text_en_pickthall: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.
text_en_arberry: My Lord, make me a performer of the prayer, and of my seed. Our Lord, and receive my petition.

text_ar: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
text_en_primary: Our Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the judgment will come to pass.”
text_en_yusufali: "O our Lord! cover (us) with Thy Forgiveness - me, my parents, and (all) Believers, on the Day that the Reckoning will be established!
text_en_pickthall: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.
text_en_arberry: Our Lord, forgive Thou me and my parents, and the believers, upon the day when the reckoning shall come to pass.

text_ar: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
text_en_primary: Do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them until a Day when ˹their˺ eyes will stare in horror—
text_en_yusufali: Think not that God doth not heed the deeds of those who do wrong. He but giveth them respite against a Day when the eyes will fixedly stare in horror,-
text_en_pickthall: Deem not that Allah is unaware of what the wicked do. He but giveth them a respite till a day when eyes will stare (in terror),
text_en_arberry: Deem not that God is heedless of what the evildoers work; He is only deferring them to a day when eyes shall stare,

text_ar: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌۭ
text_en_primary: rushing forth, heads raised, never blinking, hearts void.
text_en_yusufali: They running forward with necks outstretched, their heads uplifted, their gaze returning not towards them, and their hearts a (gaping) void!
text_en_pickthall: As they come hurrying on in fear, their heads upraised, their gaze returning not to them, and their hearts as air.
text_en_arberry: when they shall run with necks outstretched and heads erect, their glances never returned on themselves, their hearts void.

text_ar: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ ۗ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍۢ
text_en_primary: And warn the people of the Day when the punishment will overtake ˹the wicked among˺ them, and the wrongdoers will cry, “Our Lord! Delay us for a little while. We will respond to Your call and follow the messengers!” ˹It will be said,˺ “Did you not swear before that you would never be removed ˹to the next life˺?”
text_en_yusufali: So warn mankind of the Day when the Wrath will reach them: then will the wrong-doers say: "Our Lord! respite us (if only) for a short term: we will answer Thy call, and follow the apostles!" "What! were ye not wont to swear aforetime that ye should suffer no decline?
text_en_pickthall: And warn mankind of a day when the doom will come upon them, and those who did wrong will say: Our Lord! Reprieve us for a little while. We will obey Thy call and will follow the messengers. (It will be answered): Did ye not swear before that there would be no end for you ?
text_en_arberry: And warn mankind of the day when the chastisement comes on them, And those who did evil shall say, ’Our Lord, defer us to a near term, and we will answer Thy call, and follow the Messengers.’ ’Ah, but did you not swear aforetime there should be no removing for you?

text_ar: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ
text_en_primary: You passed by the ruins of those ˹destroyed peoples˺ who had wronged themselves. It was made clear to you how We dealt with them, and We gave you ˹many˺ examples.
text_en_yusufali: "And ye dwelt in the dwellings of men who wronged their own souls; ye were clearly shown how We dealt with them; and We put forth (many) parables in your behoof!"
text_en_pickthall: And (have ye not) dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves (of old) and (hath it not) become plain to you how We dealt with them and made examples for you ?
text_en_arberry: And you dwelt in the dwelling-places of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We did with them, and how We struck similitudes for you.

text_ar: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ
text_en_primary: They devised every plot, which was fully known to Allah, but their plotting was not enough to ˹even˺ overpower mountains ˹let alone Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: Mighty indeed were the plots which they made, but their plots were (well) within the sight of God, even though they were such as to shake the hills!
text_en_pickthall: Verily they have plotted their plot, and their plot is with Allah, though their plot were one whereby the mountains should be moved.
text_en_arberry: They devised their devising, and their devising is known to God; though their devising were such as to remove mountains.’

text_ar: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍۢ
text_en_primary: So do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Allah is indeed Almighty, capable of punishment.
text_en_yusufali: Never think that God would fail his apostles in His promise: for God is Exalted in power, - the Lord of Retribution.
text_en_pickthall: So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).
text_en_arberry: So do not deem that God will fail in His promise to His Messengers; surely God is All-mighty, Vengeful.

text_ar: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
text_en_primary: ˹Watch for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the earth will be changed into a different earth and the heavens as well, and all will appear before Allah—the One, the Supreme.
text_en_yusufali: One day the earth will be changed to a different earth, and so will be the heavens, and (men) will be marshalled forth, before God, the One, the Irresistible;
text_en_pickthall: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,
text_en_arberry: Upon the day the earth shall be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens and they sally forth unto God, the One, the Omnipotent.

text_ar: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
text_en_primary: On that Day you will see the wicked bound together in chains,
text_en_yusufali: And thou wilt see the sinners that day bound together in fetters;-
text_en_pickthall: Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains,
text_en_arberry: And thou shalt see the sinners that day coupled in fetters,

text_ar: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍۢ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
text_en_primary: with garments of tar, and their faces covered with flames.
text_en_yusufali: Their garments of liquid pitch, and their faces covered with Fire;
text_en_pickthall: Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces,
text_en_arberry: of pitch their shirts, their faces enveloped by the Fire,

text_ar: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
text_en_primary: As such, Allah will reward every soul for what it has committed. Surely Allah is swift in reckoning.
text_en_yusufali: That God may requite each soul according to its deserts; and verily God is swift in calling to account.
text_en_pickthall: That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.
text_en_arberry: that God may recompense every soul for its earnings; surely God is swift at the reckoning.

text_ar: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
text_en_primary: This ˹Quran˺ is a ˹sufficient˺ message for humanity so that they may take it as a warning and know that there is only One God, and so that people of reason may be mindful.
text_en_yusufali: Here is a Message for mankind: Let them take warning therefrom, and let them know that He is (no other than) One God: let men of understanding take heed.
text_en_pickthall: This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One God, and that men of understanding may take heed.
text_en_arberry: This is a Message to be delivered to mankind that they may be warned by it, and that they may know that He is One God, and that all possessed of minds may remember.

text_ar: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran.
text_en_yusufali: A. L. R. These are the Ayats of Revelation,- of a Qur’an that makes things clear.
text_en_pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.
text_en_arberry: Alif Lam Ra. Those are the signs of the Book and of a manifest Koran.

text_ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: Again and again will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed (to God’s will) in Islam.
text_en_pickthall: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.
text_en_arberry: Perchance the unbelievers will wish that they had surrendered:

text_ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know.
text_en_yusufali: Leave them alone, to enjoy (the good things of this life) and to please themselves: let (false) hope amuse them: soon will knowledge (undeceive them).
text_en_pickthall: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!
text_en_arberry: leave them to eat, and to take their joy, and to be bemused by hope; certainly they will soon know!

text_ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
text_en_primary: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term.
text_en_yusufali: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand.
text_en_pickthall: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.
text_en_arberry: Never a city have We destroyed, but it had a known decree,

text_ar: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
text_en_primary: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it.
text_en_yusufali: Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it.
text_en_pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.
text_en_arberry: and no nation outstrips its term, nor do they put it back.

text_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
text_en_primary: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane!
text_en_yusufali: They say: "O thou to whom the Message is being revealed! truly thou art mad (or possessed)!
text_en_pickthall: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!
text_en_arberry: They say: ’Thou, upon whom the Remembrance is sent down, thou art assuredly possessed!

text_ar: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
text_en_primary: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”
text_en_yusufali: "Why bringest thou not angels to us if it be that thou hast the Truth?"
text_en_pickthall: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful ?
text_en_arberry: Why dost thou not bring the angels unto us, if thou speakest truly?’

text_ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ
text_en_primary: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed.
text_en_yusufali: We send not the angels down except for just cause: if they came (to the ungodly), behold! no respite would they have!
text_en_pickthall: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.
text_en_arberry: We send not down the angels, save with truth;

text_ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
text_en_primary: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it.
text_en_yusufali: We have, without doubt, sent down the Message; and We will assuredly guard it (from corruption).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.
text_en_arberry: then they would not be respited. It is We who have sent down the Remembrance, and We watch over it.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples,
text_en_yusufali: We did send apostles before thee amongst the religious sects of old:
text_en_pickthall: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.
text_en_arberry: Indeed, We sent Messengers before thee, among the factions of the ancients,

text_ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
text_en_primary: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked.
text_en_yusufali: But never came an apostle to them but they mocked him.
text_en_pickthall: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.
text_en_arberry: and not a single Messenger came to them, but they mocked at him;

text_ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
text_en_primary: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked.
text_en_yusufali: Even so do we let it creep into the hearts of the sinners -
text_en_pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:
text_en_arberry: even so We cause it to enter into the hearts of the sinners --

text_ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before.
text_en_yusufali: That they should not believe in the (Message); but the ways of the ancients have passed away.
text_en_pickthall: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.
text_en_arberry: they believe not in it, though the wont of the ancients is already gone.

text_ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
text_en_primary: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend,
text_en_yusufali: Even if We opened out to them a gate from heaven, and they were to continue (all day) ascending therein,
text_en_pickthall: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,
text_en_arberry: Though We opened to them a gate in heaven, and still they mounted through it,

text_ar: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ
text_en_primary: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”
text_en_yusufali: They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery."
text_en_pickthall: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.
text_en_arberry: yet would they say, ’Our eyes have been dazzled; nay, we are a people bewitched!’

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see.
text_en_yusufali: It is We Who have set out the zodiacal signs in the heavens, and made them fair-seeming to (all) beholders;
text_en_pickthall: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.
text_en_arberry: We have set in heaven constellations and decked them out fair to the beholders,

text_ar: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ
text_en_primary: And We protected it from every accursed devil,
text_en_yusufali: And (moreover) We have guarded them from every evil spirit accursed:
text_en_pickthall: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,
text_en_arberry: and guarded them from every accursed Satan

text_ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare.
text_en_yusufali: But any that gains a hearing by stealth, is pursued by a flaming fire, bright (to see).
text_en_pickthall: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
text_en_arberry: excepting such as listens by stealth -- and he is pursued by a manifest flame.

text_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance.
text_en_yusufali: And the earth We have spread out (like a carpet); set thereon mountains firm and immovable; and produced therein all kinds of things in due balance.
text_en_pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.
text_en_arberry: And the earth -- We stretched it forth, and cast on it firm mountains, and We caused to grow therein of every thing justly weighed,

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
text_en_primary: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for.
text_en_yusufali: And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible.
text_en_pickthall: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.
text_en_arberry: and there appointed for you livelihood, and for those you provide not for.

text_ar: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
text_en_primary: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure.
text_en_yusufali: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures.
text_en_pickthall: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.
text_en_arberry: Naught is there, but its treasuries are with Us, and We send it not down but in a known measure.

text_ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
text_en_primary: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves.
text_en_yusufali: And We send the fecundating winds, then cause the rain to descend from the sky, therewith providing you with water (in abundance), though ye are not the guardians of its stores.
text_en_pickthall: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.
text_en_arberry: And We loose the winds fertilising, and We send down out of heaven water, then We give it to you to drink, and you are not its treasurers.

text_ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
text_en_primary: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor.
text_en_yusufali: And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give death: it is We Who remain inheritors (after all else passes away).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.
text_en_arberry: It is We who give life, and make to die, and it is We who are the inheritors.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
text_en_primary: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺.
text_en_yusufali: To Us are known those of you who hasten forward, and those who lag behind.
text_en_pickthall: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.
text_en_arberry: We know the ones of you who press forward, and We know the laggards;

text_ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing.
text_en_yusufali: Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together: for He is perfect in Wisdom and Knowledge.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.
text_en_arberry: and it is thy Lord shall muster them, and He is All-wise, All-knowing.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud.
text_en_yusufali: We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape;
text_en_pickthall: Verily We created man of potter’s clay of black mud altered,
text_en_arberry: Surely We created man of a clay of mud moulded,

text_ar: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
text_en_primary: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire.
text_en_yusufali: And the Jinn race, We had created before, from the fire of a scorching wind.
text_en_pickthall: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.
text_en_arberry: and the jinn created We before of fire flaming.

text_ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹Remember, O  Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud.
text_en_yusufali: Behold! thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man, from sounding clay from mud moulded into shape;
text_en_pickthall: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter’s clay of black mud altered,
text_en_arberry: And when thy Lord said to the angels, ’See, I am creating a mortal of a clay of mud moulded.

text_ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
text_en_primary: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
text_en_yusufali: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
text_en_pickthall: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.
text_en_arberry: When I have shaped him, and breathed My spirit in him, fall you down, bowing before him!’

text_ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
text_en_primary: So the angels prostrated all together—
text_en_yusufali: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
text_en_pickthall: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together
text_en_arberry: Then the angels bowed themselves all together,

text_ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
text_en_primary: but not Iblis, who refused to prostrate with the others.
text_en_yusufali: Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
text_en_pickthall: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.
text_en_arberry: save Iblis; he refused to be among those bowing.

text_ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
text_en_primary: Allah asked, “O Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”
text_en_yusufali: (God) said: "O Iblis! what is your reason for not being among those who prostrated themselves?"
text_en_pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate ?
text_en_arberry: Said He, ’What ails thee, Iblis, that thou art not among those bowing?’

text_ar: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”
text_en_yusufali: (Iblis) said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to man, whom Thou didst create from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape."
text_en_pickthall: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter’s clay of black mud altered!
text_en_arberry: Said he, ’I would never bow myself before a mortal whom Thou hast created of a clay of mud moulded.’

text_ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed.
text_en_yusufali: (God) said: "Then get thee out from here; for thou art rejected, accursed.
text_en_pickthall: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.
text_en_arberry: Said He, ’Then go thou forth hence; thou art accursed.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”
text_en_yusufali: "And the curse shall be on thee till the day of Judgment."
text_en_pickthall: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.
text_en_arberry: Upon thee shall rest the curse, till the Day of Doom.’

text_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
text_en_primary: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
text_en_yusufali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
text_en_pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
text_en_arberry: Said he, ’My Lord, respite me till the day they shall be raised.’

text_ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
text_en_primary: Allah said, “You will be delayed
text_en_yusufali: (God) said: "Respite is granted thee
text_en_pickthall: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved
text_en_arberry: Said He, ’Thou art among the ones that are respited

text_ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
text_en_primary: until the appointed Day.”
text_en_yusufali: "Till the Day of the Time appointed."
text_en_pickthall: Till the Day of appointed time.
text_en_arberry: unto the day of a known time.’

text_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
text_en_primary: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together,
text_en_yusufali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! because Thou hast put me in the wrong, I will make (wrong) fair-seeming to them on the earth, and I will put them all in the wrong,-
text_en_pickthall: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,
text_en_arberry: Said he, ’My Lord, for Thy perverting me I shall deck all fair to them in the earth, and I shall pervert them, all together,

text_ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
text_en_primary: except Your chosen servants among them.”
text_en_yusufali: "Except Thy servants among them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
text_en_pickthall: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.
text_en_arberry: excepting those Thy servants among them that are devoted.

text_ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
text_en_primary: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me:
text_en_yusufali: (God) said: "This (way of My sincere servants) is indeed a way that leads straight to Me.
text_en_pickthall: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:
text_en_arberry: Said He, ’This is for Me a straight path:

text_ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
text_en_primary: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you,
text_en_yusufali: "For over My servants no authority shalt thou have, except such as put themselves in the wrong and follow thee."
text_en_pickthall: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,
text_en_arberry: over My servants thou shalt have no authority, except those that follow thee,

text_ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
text_en_primary: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together.
text_en_yusufali: And verily, Hell is the promised abode for them all!
text_en_pickthall: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.
text_en_arberry: being perverse; Gehenna shall be their promised land all together.

text_ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
text_en_primary: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”
text_en_yusufali: To it are seven gates: for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.
text_en_pickthall: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.
text_en_arberry: Seven gates it has, and unto each gate a set portion of them belongs.’

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs.
text_en_yusufali: The righteous (will be) amid gardens and fountains (of clear-flowing water).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.
text_en_arberry: But the godfearing shall be amidst gardens and fountains:

text_ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”
text_en_yusufali: (Their greeting will be): "Enter ye here in peace and security."
text_en_pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.
text_en_arberry: ’Enter you them, in peace and security!’

text_ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
text_en_primary: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another.
text_en_yusufali: And We shall remove from their hearts any lurking sense of injury: (they will be) brothers (joyfully) facing each other on thrones (of dignity).
text_en_pickthall: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.
text_en_arberry: We shall strip away all rancour that is in their breasts; as brothers they shall be upon couches set face to face;

text_ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
text_en_primary: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave.
text_en_yusufali: There no sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave.
text_en_pickthall: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.
text_en_arberry: no fatigue there shall smite them, neither shall they ever be driven forth from there.

text_ar: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
text_en_primary: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful,
text_en_yusufali: Tell My servants that I am indeed the Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful;
text_en_pickthall: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
text_en_arberry: Tell My servants I am the All-forgiving, the All-compassionate,

text_ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
text_en_primary: and that My torment is indeed the most painful.
text_en_yusufali: And that My Penalty will be indeed the most grievous Penalty.
text_en_pickthall: And that My doom is the dolorous doom.
text_en_arberry: and that My chastisement is the painful chastisement.

text_ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
text_en_primary: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests
text_en_yusufali: Tell them about the guests of Abraham.
text_en_pickthall: And tell them of Abraham’s guests,
text_en_arberry: And tell them of the guests of Abraham,

text_ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
text_en_primary: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”
text_en_yusufali: When they entered his presence and said, "Peace!" He said, "We feel afraid of you!"
text_en_pickthall: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.
text_en_arberry: when they entered unto him, saying, ’Peace!’ He said, ’Behold, we are afraid of you.’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Fear not! We give thee glad tidings of a son endowed with wisdom."
text_en_pickthall: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Be not afraid; behold, we give thee good tidings of a cunning boy.’

text_ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
text_en_primary: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”
text_en_yusufali: He said: "Do ye give me glad tidings that old age has seized me? Of what, then, is your good news?"
text_en_pickthall: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me ? Of what then can ye bring good tidings ?
text_en_arberry: He said, ’What, do you give me good tidings, though old age has smitten me? Of what do you

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
text_en_primary: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”
text_en_yusufali: They said: "We give thee glad tidings in truth: be not then in despair!"
text_en_pickthall: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.
text_en_arberry: give me good tidings?’ They said, ’We give thee good tidings of truth. Be not of those that despair.’

text_ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
text_en_primary: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”
text_en_yusufali: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, but such as go astray?"
text_en_pickthall: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray ?
text_en_arberry: He said, ’And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, excepting those that are astray?’

text_ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
text_en_primary: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O  messenger-angels?”
text_en_yusufali: Abraham said: "What then is the business on which ye (have come), O ye messengers (of God)?"
text_en_pickthall: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah) ?
text_en_arberry: He said, ’And what is your business, envoys?’

text_ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
text_en_primary: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people.
text_en_yusufali: They said: "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin,
text_en_pickthall: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,
text_en_arberry: They said, ’We have been sent unto a people of sinners,

text_ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
text_en_primary: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all,
text_en_yusufali: "Excepting the adherents of Lut: them we are certainly (charged) to save (from harm),- All -
text_en_pickthall: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,
text_en_arberry: excepting the folk of Lot; them we shall deliver

text_ar: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
text_en_primary: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”
text_en_yusufali: "Except his wife, who, We have ascertained, will be among those who will lag behind."
text_en_pickthall: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.
text_en_arberry: all together, excepting his wife -- we have decreed, she shall surely be of those that tarry.’

text_ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
text_en_primary: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
text_en_yusufali: At length when the messengers arrived among the adherents of Lut,
text_en_pickthall: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,
text_en_arberry: So, when the envoys came to the folk of Lot,

text_ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
text_en_primary: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”
text_en_yusufali: He said: "Ye appear to be uncommon folk."
text_en_pickthall: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).
text_en_arberry: he said, ’Surely you are a people unknown to me!’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
text_en_primary: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted.
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Yea, we have come to thee to accomplish that of which they doubt.
text_en_pickthall: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Nay, but we have brought thee that concerning which they were doubting.

text_ar: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
text_en_primary: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.
text_en_yusufali: "We have brought to thee that which is inevitably due, and assuredly we tell the truth.
text_en_pickthall: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.
text_en_arberry: We have come to thee with the truth, and assuredly we speak truly.

text_ar: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
text_en_primary: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”
text_en_yusufali: "Then travel by night with thy household, when a portion of the night (yet remains), and do thou bring up the rear: let no one amongst you look back, but pass on whither ye are ordered."
text_en_pickthall: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.
text_en_arberry: So set forth, thou with thy family, in a watch of the night, and follow after the backs of them, and let not any one of you turn round; and depart unto the place you are commanded.’

text_ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
text_en_primary: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”
text_en_yusufali: And We made known this decree to him, that the last remnants of those (sinners) should be cut off by the morning.
text_en_pickthall: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.
text_en_arberry: And We decreed for him that commandment, that the last remnant of those should be cut off in the morning.

text_ar: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
text_en_primary: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing.
text_en_yusufali: The inhabitants of the city came in (mad) joy (at news of the young men).
text_en_pickthall: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).
text_en_arberry: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

text_ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
text_en_primary: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me.
text_en_yusufali: Lut said: "These are my guests: disgrace me not:
text_en_pickthall: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!
text_en_arberry: He said, ’These are my guests; put me not to shame,

text_ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
text_en_primary: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”
text_en_yusufali: "But fear God, and shame me not."
text_en_pickthall: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!
text_en_arberry: and fear God, and do not degrade me.’

text_ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Did we not forbid thee (to speak) for all and sundry?"
text_en_pickthall: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone ?
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Have we not forbidden thee all beings?’

text_ar: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
text_en_primary: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”
text_en_yusufali: He said: "There are my daughters (to marry), if ye must act (so)."
text_en_pickthall: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).
text_en_arberry: He said, ’These are my daughters, if you would be doing.’

text_ar: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
text_en_primary: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, by thy life (O Prophet), in their wild intoxication, they wander in distraction, to and fro.
text_en_pickthall: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.
text_en_arberry: By thy life, they wandered blindly in their dazzlement,

text_ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
text_en_primary: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise.
text_en_yusufali: But the (mighty) Blast overtook them before morning,
text_en_pickthall: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.
text_en_arberry: and the Cry seized them at the sunrise,

text_ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
text_en_primary: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay.
text_en_yusufali: And We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay.
text_en_pickthall: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.
text_en_arberry: and We turned it uppermost nethermost and rained on it stones of baked clay.

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate.
text_en_yusufali: Behold! in this are Signs for those who by tokens do understand.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.
text_en_arberry: Surely in that are signs for such as mark;

text_ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
text_en_primary: Their ruins still lie along a known route.
text_en_yusufali: And the (cities were) right on the high-road.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.
text_en_arberry: surely it is on a way yet remaining;

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe.
text_en_yusufali: Behold! in this is a sign for those who believed.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.
text_en_arberry: surely in that is a sign for believers.

text_ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers,
text_en_yusufali: And the Companions of the Wood were also wrong-doers;
text_en_pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.
text_en_arberry: Certainly the dwellers in the Thicket were evildoers,

text_ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road.
text_en_yusufali: So We exacted retribution from them. They were both on an open highway, plain to see.
text_en_pickthall: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.
text_en_arberry: and We took vengeance on them. The two of them were upon a roadway manifest.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers.
text_en_yusufali: The Companions of the Rocky Tract also rejected the apostles:
text_en_pickthall: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.
text_en_arberry: The dwellers in El-Hijr cried lies to the Envoys.

text_ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
text_en_primary: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them.
text_en_yusufali: We sent them Our Sings, but they persisted in turning away from them.
text_en_pickthall: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.
text_en_arberry: We brought them. Our signs, and they turned away from them.

text_ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
text_en_primary: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure.
text_en_yusufali: Out of the mountains did they hew (their) edifices, (feeling themselves) secure.
text_en_pickthall: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.
text_en_arberry: They were hewing the mountains into houses, therein dwelling securely;

text_ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
text_en_primary: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning,
text_en_yusufali: But the (mighty) Blast seized them of a morning,
text_en_pickthall: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,
text_en_arberry: and the Cry seized them in the morning;

text_ar: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
text_en_primary: and all they achieved was of no help to them.
text_en_yusufali: And of no avail to them was all that they did (with such art and care)!
text_en_pickthall: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.
text_en_arberry: that they earned did not avail them.

text_ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
text_en_primary: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously.
text_en_yusufali: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, but for just ends. And the Hour is surely coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) with gracious forgiveness.
text_en_pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.
text_en_arberry: We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, save in truth. Surely the Hour is coming; so pardon thou, with a gracious pardoning.

text_ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
text_en_primary: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing.
text_en_yusufali: For verily it is thy Lord who is the Master-Creator, knowing all things.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.
text_en_arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-creator, the All-knowing.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
text_en_primary: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran.
text_en_yusufali: And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur’an.
text_en_pickthall: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur’an.
text_en_arberry: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated, and the mighty Koran.

text_ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers.
text_en_yusufali: Strain not thine eyes. (Wistfully) at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them, nor grieve over them: but lower thy wing (in gentleness) to the believers.
text_en_pickthall: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.
text_en_arberry: Stretch not thine eyes to that We have given pairs of them to enjoy; and do not sorrow for them, and lower thy wing unto the believers,

text_ar: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
text_en_primary: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—
text_en_yusufali: And say: "I am indeed he that warneth openly and without ambiguity,"-
text_en_pickthall: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,
text_en_arberry: and say, ’Surely, I am the manifest warner.’

text_ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺,
text_en_yusufali: (Of just such wrath) as We sent down on those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts),-
text_en_pickthall: Such as We send down for those who make division,
text_en_arberry: So We sent it down to the partitioners,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
text_en_primary: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others.
text_en_yusufali: (So also on such) as have made Qur’an into shreds (as they please).
text_en_pickthall: Those who break the Qur’an into parts.
text_en_arberry: who have broken the Koran into fragments.

text_ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
text_en_primary: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all
text_en_yusufali: Therefore, by the Lord, We will, of a surety, call them to account,
text_en_pickthall: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,
text_en_arberry: Now by thy Lord, We shall surely question them all together

text_ar: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: about what they used to do.
text_en_yusufali: For all their deeds.
text_en_pickthall: Of what they used to do.
text_en_arberry: concerning that they were doing.

text_ar: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
text_en_primary: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with God.
text_en_pickthall: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.
text_en_arberry: So shout that thou art commanded and turn thou away from the idolaters.

text_ar: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers,
text_en_yusufali: For sufficient are We unto thee against those who scoff,-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,
text_en_arberry: We suffice thee against the mockers,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know.
text_en_yusufali: Those who adopt, with God, another god: but soon will they come to know.
text_en_pickthall: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.
text_en_arberry: even against those who set up with God another god. Certainly they will soon know!

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
text_en_primary: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say.
text_en_yusufali: We do indeed know how thy heart is distressed at what they say.
text_en_pickthall: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,
text_en_arberry: We know indeed thy breast is straitened by the things they say.

text_ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
text_en_primary: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray,
text_en_yusufali: But celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves in adoration.
text_en_pickthall: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).
text_en_arberry: Proclaim thy Lord’s praise, and be of those that bow,

text_ar: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
text_en_primary: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way.
text_en_yusufali: And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain.
text_en_pickthall: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.
text_en_arberry: and serve thy Lord, until the Certain comes to thee.

text_ar: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
text_en_primary: The command of Allah is at hand, so do not hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him in worship˺!
text_en_yusufali: (Inevitable) cometh (to pass) the Command of God: seek ye not then to hasten it: Glory to Him, and far is He above having the partners they ascribe unto Him!
text_en_pickthall: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).
text_en_arberry: God’s command comes; so seek not to hasten it. Glory be to Him! High be He exalted above that they associate with Him!

text_ar: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
text_en_primary: He sends down the angels with revelation by His command to whoever He wills of His servants, ˹stating:˺ “Warn ˹humanity˺ that there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so be mindful of Me ˹alone˺.”
text_en_yusufali: He doth send down His angels with inspiration of His Command, to such of His servants as He pleaseth, (saying): "Warn (Man) that there is no god but I: so do your duty unto Me."
text_en_pickthall: He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no God save Me, so keep your duty unto Me.
text_en_arberry: He sends down the angels with the Spirit of His command upon whomsoever He will among His servants, saying: Give you warning that there is no God hut I; so fear you Me!

text_ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
text_en_primary: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. Exalted is He above what they associate with Him ˹in worship˺!
text_en_yusufali: He has created the heavens and the earth for just ends: Far is He above having the partners they ascribe to Him!
text_en_pickthall: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him).
text_en_arberry: He created the heavens and the earth in truth; high be He exalted above that they associate With Him!

text_ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: He created humans from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Him˺.
text_en_yusufali: He has created man from a sperm-drop; and behold this same (man) becomes an open disputer!
text_en_pickthall: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.
text_en_arberry: He created man of a sperm-drop; and, behold, he is a manifest adversary.

text_ar: وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
text_en_primary: And He created the cattle for you as a source of warmth, food, and ˹many other˺ benefits.
text_en_yusufali: And cattle He has created for you (men): from them ye derive warmth, and numerous benefits, and of their (meat) ye eat.
text_en_pickthall: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat;
text_en_arberry: And the cattle -- He created them for you; in them is warmth, and uses various, and of them you eat,

text_ar: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
text_en_primary: They are also pleasing to you when you bring them home and when you take them out to graze.
text_en_yusufali: And ye have a sense of pride and beauty in them as ye drive them home in the evening, and as ye lead them forth to pasture in the morning.
text_en_pickthall: And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture.
text_en_arberry: and there is beauty in them for you, when you bring them home to rest and when you drive them forth abroad to pasture;

text_ar: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: And they carry your loads to ˹distant˺ lands which you could not otherwise reach without great hardship. Surely your Lord is Ever Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: And they carry your heavy loads to lands that ye could not (otherwise) reach except with souls distressed: for your Lord is indeed Most Kind, Most Merciful,
text_en_pickthall: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.
text_en_arberry: and they bear your loads unto a land that you never would reach, excepting with great distress. Surely your Lord is All-clement, All-compassionate.

text_ar: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةًۭ ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹He also created˺ horses, mules, and donkeys for your transportation and adornment. And He creates what you do not know.
text_en_yusufali: And (He has created) horses, mules, and donkeys, for you to ride and use for show; and He has created (other) things of which ye have no knowledge.
text_en_pickthall: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.
text_en_arberry: And horses, and mules, and asses, for you to ride, and as an adornment; and He creates what you know not.

text_ar: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌۭ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
text_en_primary: It is upon Allah ˹alone˺ to ˹clearly˺ show the Straight Way. Other ways are deviant. Had He willed, He would have easily imposed guidance upon all of you.
text_en_yusufali: And unto God leads straight the Way, but there are ways that turn aside: if God had willed, He could have guided all of you.
text_en_pickthall: And Allah’s is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright.
text_en_arberry: God’s it is to show the way; and some do swerve from it. If He willed, He would have guided you all together.

text_ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌۭ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌۭ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
text_en_primary: He is the One Who sends down rain from the sky, from which you drink and by which plants grow for your cattle to graze.
text_en_yusufali: It is He who sends down rain from the sky: from it ye drink, and out of it (grows) the vegetation on which ye feed your cattle.
text_en_pickthall: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture.
text_en_arberry: It is He who sends down to you out of heaven water of which you have to drink, and of which trees, for you to pasture your herds,

text_ar: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: With it He produces for you ˹various˺ crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and every type of fruit. Surely in this is a sign for those who reflect.
text_en_yusufali: With it He produces for you corn, olives, date-palms, grapes and every kind of fruit: verily in this is a sign for those who give thought.
text_en_pickthall: Therewith He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.
text_en_arberry: and thereby He brings forth for you crops, and olives, and palms, and vines, and all manner of fruit. Surely in that is a sign for a people who reflect.

text_ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
text_en_primary: And He has subjected for your benefit the day and the night, the sun and the moon. And the stars have been subjected by His command. Surely in this are signs for those who understand.
text_en_yusufali: He has made subject to you the Night and the Day; the sun and the moon; and the stars are in subjection by His Command: verily in this are Signs for men who are wise.
text_en_pickthall: And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you, and the stars are made subservient by His command. Lo! herein indeed are portents for people who have sense.
text_en_arberry: And He subjected to you the night and day, and the sun and moon; and the stars are subjected by His command. Surely in that are signs for a people who understand.

text_ar: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: And ˹He subjected˺ for you whatever He has created on earth of varying colours. Surely in this is a sign for those who are mindful.
text_en_yusufali: And the things on this earth which He has multiplied in varying colours (and qualities): verily in this is a sign for men who celebrate the praises of God (in gratitude).
