text_ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًۭا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍۢ
text_en_primary: Yet they worship besides Allah that for which He has sent down no authority, and of which they have no knowledge. The wrongdoers will have no helper.
text_en_yusufali: Yet they worship, besides God, things for which no authority has been sent down to them, and of which they have (really) no knowledge: for those that do wrong there is no helper.
text_en_pickthall: And they worship instead of Allah that for which He hath sent down no warrant, and that whereof they have no knowledge. For evil-doers there is no helper.
text_en_arberry: They serve, apart from God, that whereon He has sent down never authority and that whereof they have no knowledge; and for the evildoers there shall be no helper.

text_ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
text_en_primary: Whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, you ˹O Prophet˺ recognize rage on the faces of the disbelievers, as if they are going to snap at those who recite Our revelations to them. Say, “Shall I inform you of something far more enraging than that? ˹It is˺ the Fire with which Allah has threatened those who disbelieve. What an evil destination!”
text_en_yusufali: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, thou wilt notice a denial on the faces of the Unbelievers! they nearly attack with violence those who rehearse Our Signs to them. Say, "Shall I tell you of something (far) worse than these Signs? It is the Fire (of Hell)! God has promised it to the Unbelievers! and evil is that destination!"
text_en_pickthall: And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that ? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey’s end!
text_en_arberry: And when Our signs are recited to them, clear signs, thou recognisest in the faces of the unbelievers denial; wellnigh they rush upon those who recite to them Our signs. Say: ’Shall I tell you of something worse than that? The Fire -- God has promised it to the unbelievers -- an evil homecoming!’

text_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌۭ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًۭا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًۭٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
text_en_primary: O humanity! A lesson is set forth, so listen to it ˹carefully˺: those ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah can never create ˹so much as˺ a fly, even if they ˹all˺ were to come together for that. And if a fly were to snatch anything away from them, they cannot ˹even˺ retrieve it from the fly. How powerless are those who invoke and those invoked!
text_en_yusufali: O men! Here is a parable set forth! listen to it! Those on whom, besides God, ye call, cannot create (even) a fly, if they all met together for the purpose! and if the fly should snatch away anything from them, they would have no power to release it from the fly. Feeble are those who petition and those whom they petition!
text_en_pickthall: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought!
text_en_arberry: O men, a similitude is struck; so give you ear to it. Surely those upon whom you call, apart from God, shall never create a fly, though they banded together to do it; and if a fly should rob them of aught, they would never rescue it from him. Feeble indeed alike are the seeker and the sought!

text_ar: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
text_en_primary: They have not shown Allah the reverence He deserves. Surely Allah is All-Powerful, Almighty.
text_en_yusufali: No just estimate have they made of God: for God is He Who is strong and able to Carry out His Will.
text_en_pickthall: They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
text_en_arberry: They measure not God with His true measure; surely God is All-strong, All-mighty.

text_ar: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
text_en_primary: Allah selects messengers from both angels and people, for Allah is truly All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
text_en_yusufali: God chooses messengers from angels and from men for God is He Who hears and sees (all things).
text_en_pickthall: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer.
text_en_arberry: God chooses of the angels Messengers and of mankind; surely God is All-hearing, All-seeing.

text_ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
text_en_primary: He knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them. And to Allah ˹all˺ matters will be returned ˹for judgment˺.
text_en_yusufali: He knows what is before them and what is behind them: and to God go back all questions (for decision).
text_en_pickthall: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned.
text_en_arberry: He knows whatsoever is before them and behind them, and unto God all matters are returned.’

text_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩
text_en_primary: O believers! Bow down, prostrate yourselves, worship your Lord, and do ˹what is˺ good so that you may be successful.
text_en_yusufali: O ye who believe! bow down, prostrate yourselves, and adore your Lord; and do good; that ye may prosper.
text_en_pickthall: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper.
text_en_arberry: O men, bow you down and prostrate yourselves, and serve your Lord, and do good; haply so you shall prosper;

text_ar: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ ۚ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍۢ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
text_en_primary: Strive for ˹the cause of˺ Allah in the way He deserves, for ˹it is˺ He ˹Who˺ has chosen you, and laid upon you no hardship in the religion—the way of your forefather Abraham. ˹It is Allah˺ Who named you ‘the ones who submit’ ˹in the˺ earlier ˹Scriptures˺ and in this ˹Quran˺, so that the Messenger may be a witness over you, and that you may be witnesses over humanity. So establish prayer, pay alms-tax, and hold fast to Allah. He ˹alone˺ is your Guardian. What an excellent Guardian, and what an excellent Helper!
text_en_yusufali: And strive in His cause as ye ought to strive, (with sincerity and under discipline). He has chosen you, and has imposed no difficulties on you in religion; it is the cult of your father Abraham. It is He Who has named you Muslims, both before and in this (Revelation); that the Apostle may be a witness for you, and ye be witnesses for mankind! So establish regular Prayer, give regular Charity, and hold fast to God! He is your Protector - the Best to protect and the Best to help!
text_en_pickthall: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!
text_en_arberry: and struggle for God as is His due, for He has chosen you, and has laid on you no impediment in your religion, being the creed of your father Abraham; He named you Muslims aforetime and in this, that the Messenger might be a witness against you, and that you might be witnesses against mankind. So perform the prayer, and pay the alms, and hold you fast to God; He is your Protector -- an excellent Protector, an excellent Helper.

text_ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: Successful indeed are the believers:
text_en_yusufali: The believers must (eventually) win through,-
text_en_pickthall: Successful indeed are the believers
text_en_arberry: Prosperous are the believers

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ
text_en_primary: those who humble themselves in prayer;
text_en_yusufali: Those who humble themselves in their prayers;
text_en_pickthall: Who are humble in their prayers,
text_en_arberry: who in their prayers are humble

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
text_en_primary: those who avoid idle talk;
text_en_yusufali: Who avoid vain talk;
text_en_pickthall: And who shun vain conversation,
text_en_arberry: and from idle talk turn away

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
text_en_primary: those who pay alms-tax;
text_en_yusufali: Who are active in deeds of charity;
text_en_pickthall: And who are payers of the poor-due;
text_en_arberry: and at almsgiving are active

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
text_en_primary: those who guard their chastity
text_en_yusufali: Who abstain from sex,
text_en_pickthall: And who guard their modesty -
text_en_arberry: and guard their private parts

text_ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
text_en_primary: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame,
text_en_yusufali: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame,
text_en_pickthall: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,
text_en_arberry: save from their wives and what their right hands own then being not blameworthy

text_ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
text_en_primary: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors;
text_en_yusufali: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors;-
text_en_pickthall: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -
text_en_arberry: but whosoever seeks after more than that, those are the transgressors)

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹the believers are also˺ those who are true to their trusts and covenants;
text_en_yusufali: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants;
text_en_pickthall: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,
text_en_arberry: and who preserve their trusts and their covenant

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
text_en_primary: and those who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers.
text_en_yusufali: And who (strictly) guard their prayers;-
text_en_pickthall: And who pay heed to their prayers.
text_en_arberry: and who observe their prayers.

text_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
text_en_primary: These are the ones who will be awarded
text_en_yusufali: These will be the heirs,
text_en_pickthall: These are the heirs
text_en_arberry: Those are the inheritors

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
text_en_primary: Paradise as their own. They will be there forever.
text_en_yusufali: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
text_en_pickthall: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.
text_en_arberry: who shall inherit Paradise therein dwelling forever.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: And indeed, We created humankind from an extract of clay,
text_en_yusufali: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
text_en_pickthall: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
text_en_arberry: We created man of an extraction of clay,

text_ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: then placed each ˹human˺ as a sperm-drop in a secure place,
text_en_yusufali: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
text_en_pickthall: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;
text_en_arberry: then We set him, a drop, in a receptacle secure,

text_ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
text_en_primary: then We developed the drop into a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then developed the clot into a lump ˹of flesh˺, then developed the lump into bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, then We brought it into being as a new creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.
text_en_yusufali: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be God, the best to create!
text_en_pickthall: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!
text_en_arberry: then We created of the drop a clot then We created of the clot a tissue then We created of the tissue bones then We garmented the bones in flesh; thereafter We produced him as another creature. So blessed be God, the fairest of creators!

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
text_en_primary: After that you will surely die,
text_en_yusufali: After that, at length ye will die
text_en_pickthall: Then lo! after that ye surely die.
text_en_arberry: Then after that you shall surely die,

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
text_en_primary: then on the Day of Judgment you will be resurrected.
text_en_yusufali: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up.
text_en_pickthall: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).
text_en_arberry: then on the Day of Resurrection you shall surely be raised up.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
text_en_primary: And indeed, We created above you seven levels ˹of heaven˺. We are never unmindful of ˹Our˺ creation.
text_en_yusufali: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation.
text_en_pickthall: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.
text_en_arberry: And We created above you seven ways, and We were not heedless of creation.

text_ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
text_en_primary: We send down rain from the sky in perfect measure, causing it to soak into the earth. And We are surely able to take it away.
text_en_yusufali: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease).
text_en_pickthall: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.
text_en_arberry: And We sent down out of heaven water in measure and lodged it in the earth; and We are able to take it away.

text_ar: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
text_en_primary: With it We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are abundant fruits, and from which you may eat,
text_en_yusufali: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment),-
text_en_pickthall: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;
text_en_arberry: Then We produced for you therewith gardens of palms and vines wherein are many fruits for you, and of them you eat,

text_ar: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ
text_en_primary: as well as ˹olive˺ trees which grow at Mount Sinai, providing oil and a condiment to eat.
text_en_yusufali: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food.
text_en_pickthall: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.
text_en_arberry: and a tree issuing from the Mount of Sinai that bears oil and seasoning for all to eat.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
text_en_primary: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle, from whose bellies We give you ˹milk˺ to drink, and in them are many other benefits for you, and from them you may eat.
text_en_yusufali: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat;
text_en_pickthall: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;
text_en_arberry: And surely in the cattle there is a lesson for you; We give you to drink of what is in their bellies, and many uses there are in them for you, and of them you eat;

text_ar: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships.
text_en_yusufali: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride.
text_en_pickthall: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.
text_en_arberry: and upon them, and on the ships, you are borne.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people. He declared, “O my people! Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
text_en_yusufali: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship God! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
text_en_pickthall: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other God save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil) ?
text_en_arberry: And We sent Noah to his people; and he, said, ’O my people, serve God! You have no god other than He. Will you not be godfearing?"

text_ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: But the disbelieving chiefs of his people said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you, who wants to be superior to you. Had Allah willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. We have never heard of this in ˹the history of˺ our forefathers.
text_en_yusufali: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if God had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old."
text_en_pickthall: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.
text_en_arberry: Said the Council of the unbelievers of his people, ’This is naught but a mortal like yourselves, who desires to gain superiority over you. And if God willed, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of this among, our fathers, the ancients.

text_ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: He is simply insane, so bear with him for a while.”
text_en_yusufali: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time."
text_en_pickthall: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.
text_en_arberry: He is naught but a man bedevilled; so wait on him for a time.

text_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
text_en_primary: Noah prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”
text_en_yusufali: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood!"
text_en_pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
text_en_arberry: He said, ’O my Lord, help me, for that they cry me lies.’

text_ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
text_en_primary: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts ˹with water˺, take on board a pair from every species along with your family—except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed. And do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
text_en_yusufali: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood).
text_en_pickthall: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.
text_en_arberry: Then We said to him, ’Make thou the Ark under Our eyes and as We reveal, and then, when Our command comes and the Oven boils, insert in it two of every kind and thy, family -- except for him against whom the word already has been spoken; and address Me not concerning those who have done evil; they shall be drowned.

text_ar: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: Then when you and those with you have settled in the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
text_en_yusufali: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to God, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong."
text_en_pickthall: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
text_en_arberry: Then, when thou art seated in the Ark and those with thee, say, "Praise belongs to God, who has delivered us from the people of the evildoers."

text_ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
text_en_primary: And pray, “My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”
text_en_yusufali: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
text_en_pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
text_en_arberry: And say, "’O my Lord, do Thou harbour me in a blessed harbour, for Thou art the best of harbourers."

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely in this are lessons. And We ˹always˺ put ˹people˺ to the test.
text_en_yusufali: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.
text_en_arberry: Surely in that are signs, and surely We put to the test.

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
text_en_primary: Then We raised another generation after them,
text_en_yusufali: Then We raised after them another generation.
text_en_pickthall: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
text_en_arberry: Thereafter, after them, We produced another generation,

text_ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
text_en_primary: and sent to them a messenger from among themselves, ˹declaring,˺ “Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
text_en_yusufali: And We sent to them an apostle from among themselves, (saying), "Worship God! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
text_en_pickthall: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other God save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil) ?
text_en_arberry: and We sent amongst them a Messenger of themselves, saying, ’Serve God! You have no god other than He. Will you not be godfearing?’

text_ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
text_en_primary: But the chiefs of his people—who disbelieved, denied the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, and were spoiled by the worldly luxuries We had provided for them—said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you. He eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink.
text_en_yusufali: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink.
text_en_pickthall: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
text_en_arberry: Said the Council of the unbelievers of his people, who cried lies to the encounter of the world to come, and to whom We had given ease in the present’ life, ’This is naught but a mortal like yourselves, who eats of what you eat and drinks of what you drink.

text_ar: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
text_en_primary: And if you ˹ever˺ obey a human like yourselves, then you would certainly be losers.
text_en_yusufali: "If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost.
text_en_pickthall: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.
text_en_arberry: If you obey a mortal like yourselves, then you will be losers.

text_ar: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
text_en_primary: Does he promise you that once you are dead and reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth ˹alive˺?
text_en_yusufali: "Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)?
text_en_pickthall: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth ?
text_en_arberry: What, does he promise you that when you are dead, and become dust and bones, you shall be brought forth?

text_ar: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
text_en_primary: Impossible, simply impossible is what you are promised!
text_en_yusufali: "Far, very far is that which ye are promised!
text_en_pickthall: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!
text_en_arberry: Away, away with that you are promised!

text_ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
text_en_primary: There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.
text_en_yusufali: "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
text_en_pickthall: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
text_en_arberry: There is nothing but our present life; we die, and we live, and we shall not be raised up.

text_ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: He is no more than a man who has fabricated a lie about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”
text_en_yusufali: "He is only a man who invents a lie against God, but we are not the ones to believe in him!"
text_en_pickthall: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.
text_en_arberry: He is naught but a man who has forged against God a lie, and we will not believe him.’

text_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
text_en_primary: The messenger prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”
text_en_yusufali: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."
text_en_pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
text_en_arberry: He said, ’O my Lord, help me, for that they cry me lies.’

text_ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
text_en_primary: Allah responded, “Soon they will be truly regretful.”
text_en_yusufali: (God) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry!"
text_en_pickthall: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.
text_en_arberry: He said, ’In a little they will be remorseful.’

text_ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: Then the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them with justice, and We reduced them to rubble. So away with the wrongdoing people!
text_en_yusufali: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong!
text_en_pickthall: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!
text_en_arberry: And the Cry seized them justly, and We made them as scum; so away with the people of the evildoers!

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
text_en_primary: Then We raised other generations after them.
text_en_yusufali: Then We raised after them other generations.
text_en_pickthall: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
text_en_arberry: Thereafter, after them, We produced other generations;

text_ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
text_en_primary: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it.
text_en_yusufali: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it).
text_en_pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.
text_en_arberry: no nation outstrips its term, nor do they put it back.

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to his people, they denied him. So We destroyed them, one after the other, reducing them to ˹cautionary˺ tales. So away with the people who refuse to believe!
text_en_yusufali: Then sent We our apostles in succession: every time there came to a people their apostle, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe!
text_en_pickthall: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
text_en_arberry: Then sent We Our Messengers successively; whenever its Messenger came to a nation they cried him lies, so We caused some of them to follow others, and We made them as but tales; so away with a people who do not believe!

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
text_en_primary: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and compelling proof
text_en_yusufali: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest,
text_en_pickthall: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant
text_en_arberry: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a manifest authority

text_ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
text_en_primary: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a tyrannical people.
text_en_yusufali: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people.
text_en_pickthall: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.
text_en_arberry: unto Pharaoh and his Council; but they waxed proud, and they were a lofty people,

text_ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
text_en_primary: They argued, “Will we believe in two humans, like ourselves, whose people are slaves to us?”
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
text_en_pickthall: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us ?
text_en_arberry: and they said, ’What, shall we believe two mortals like ourselves, whose people are our servants?’

text_ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
text_en_primary: So they rejected them both, and ˹so˺ were among those destroyed.
text_en_yusufali: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed.
text_en_pickthall: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.
text_en_arberry: So they cried them lies, and they were among the destroyed.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
text_en_primary: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so perhaps his people would be ˹rightly˺ guided.
text_en_yusufali: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance.
text_en_pickthall: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.
text_en_arberry: And We gave Moses the Book, that haply they would be guided;

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them refuge on high ground—a ˹suitable˺ place for rest with flowing water.
text_en_yusufali: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.
text_en_pickthall: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.
text_en_arberry: and We made Mary’s son, and his mother, to be a sign, and gave them refuge upon a height, where was a hollow and a spring:

text_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: O messengers! Eat from what is good and lawful, and act righteously. Indeed, I fully know what you do.
text_en_yusufali: O ye apostles! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
text_en_pickthall: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.
text_en_arberry: ’O Messengers, eat of the good things and do righteousness; surely I know the things you do.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
text_en_primary: Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺.
text_en_yusufali: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other).
text_en_pickthall: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.
text_en_arberry: Surely this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord; so fear Me.’

text_ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
text_en_primary: Yet the people have divided it into different sects, each rejoicing in what they have.
text_en_yusufali: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself.
text_en_pickthall: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.
text_en_arberry: But they split in their affair between them into sects, each party rejoicing in what is with them.

text_ar: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
text_en_primary: So leave them ˹O Prophet˺ in their heedlessness for a while.
text_en_yusufali: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time.
text_en_pickthall: So leave them in their error till a time.
text_en_arberry: So leave thou them in their perplexity for a time.

text_ar: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
text_en_primary: Do they think, since We provide them with wealth and children,
text_en_yusufali: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons,
text_en_pickthall: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them
text_en_arberry: What, do they think that We succour them with of wealth and children,

text_ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
text_en_primary: that We hasten to ˹honour˺ them ˹with˺ all kinds of good? No! They are not aware.
text_en_yusufali: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand.
text_en_pickthall: We hasten unto them with good things ? Nay, but they perceive not.
text_en_arberry: We vie in good works for them? Nay, but they are not aware.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
text_en_primary: Surely those who tremble in awe of their Lord,
text_en_yusufali: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.
text_en_arberry: Surely those who tremble in fear of their Lord

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: and who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
text_en_yusufali: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord;
text_en_pickthall: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
text_en_arberry: and those who believe in the signs of their Lord

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
text_en_primary: and who associate none with their Lord,
text_en_yusufali: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord;
text_en_pickthall: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,
text_en_arberry: and those who associate naught with their Lord

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
text_en_primary: and who do whatever ˹good˺ they do with their hearts fearful, ˹knowing˺ that they will return to their Lord—
text_en_yusufali: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord;-
text_en_pickthall: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,
text_en_arberry: and those who give what they give, their hearts quaking that they are returning to their Lord --

text_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
text_en_primary: it is they who race to do good deeds, always taking the lead.
text_en_yusufali: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them.
text_en_pickthall: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.
text_en_arberry: those vie in good works, outracing to them.

text_ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: We never require of any soul more than what it can afford. And with Us is a record which speaks the truth. None will be wronged.
text_en_yusufali: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
text_en_pickthall: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
text_en_arberry: We charge not any soul save to its capacity, and with Us is a Book speaking truth, and they shall not be wronged.

text_ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
text_en_primary: But the hearts of those ˹who disbelieve˺ are oblivious to ˹all of˺ this, and they have other ˹evil˺ deeds, opposite to this, in which they are engrossed.
text_en_yusufali: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do,-
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur’an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;
text_en_arberry: Nay, but their hearts are in perplexity as to this, and they have deeds besides that that they are doing.

text_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
text_en_primary: But as soon as We seize their elite with torment, they start to cry for help.
text_en_yusufali: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication!
text_en_pickthall: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.
text_en_arberry: Till, when We seize with the chastisement the ones of them that live at ease, behold, they groan.

text_ar: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry for help today. Surely you will never be saved from Us.
text_en_yusufali: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us.
text_en_pickthall: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.
text_en_arberry: ’Groan not today; surely you shall not be helped from Us.

text_ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, My revelations were recited to you, but you used to back away ˹in disgust˺,
text_en_yusufali: "My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels-
text_en_pickthall: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,
text_en_arberry: My signs were recited to you, but upon your heels you withdrew,

text_ar: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ
text_en_primary: boasting of the Sacred House, and babbling ˹nonsense about the Quran˺ by night.”
text_en_yusufali: "In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur’an), like one telling fables by night."
text_en_pickthall: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.
text_en_arberry: waxing proud against it, talking foolish talk by night.’

text_ar: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: Is it because they have never contemplated the Word ˹of Allah˺? Or ˹because˺ there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers?
text_en_yusufali: Do they not ponder over the Word (of God), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
text_en_pickthall: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old ?
text_en_arberry: Have they not pondered the saying, or came there upon them that which came not upon their fathers, the ancients?

text_ar: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Or ˹because˺ they failed to recognize their Messenger, and so they denied him?
text_en_yusufali: Or do they not recognise their Apostle, that they deny him?
text_en_pickthall: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him ?
text_en_arberry: Or did they not recognise their Messenger and so denied him?

text_ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
text_en_primary: Or ˹because˺ they say, “He is insane?” In fact, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are resentful of the truth.
text_en_yusufali: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
text_en_pickthall: Or say they: There is a madness in him ? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.
text_en_arberry: Or do they say, ’He is bedevilled’? Nay, he has brought them the truth, but most of them are averse from the truth.

text_ar: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
text_en_primary: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and all those in them would have certainly been corrupted. In fact, We have brought them ˹the means to˺ their glory, but they turn away from it.
text_en_yusufali: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition.
text_en_pickthall: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.
text_en_arberry: Had the truth followed their caprices, the heavens and the earth and whosoever in them is had surely corrupted. Nay, We brought them their Remembrance, but from their Remembrance they turned.

text_ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
text_en_primary: Or ˹is it because˺ you ˹O Prophet˺ are asking them for tribute? But the reward of your Lord is best, for He is the Best Provider.
text_en_yusufali: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
text_en_pickthall: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute ? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.
text_en_arberry: Or dost thou ask them for tribute? Yet the tribute of thy Lord is better, and He is the best of providers.

text_ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: And surely you are calling them to the Straight Path,
text_en_yusufali: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way;
text_en_pickthall: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.
text_en_arberry: Assuredly thou art calling them to a straight path;

text_ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
text_en_primary: but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from that Path.
text_en_yusufali: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.
text_en_arberry: and surely they that believe not in the world to come are deviating from the path.

text_ar: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Even˺ if We had mercy on them and removed their affliction, they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
text_en_yusufali: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro.
text_en_pickthall: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.
text_en_arberry: Did We have mercy on them, and remove the affliction that is upon them, they would persist in their insolence wandering blindly.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
text_en_primary: And We have already seized them with torment, but they never humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they ˹submissively˺ appeal ˹to Him˺.
text_en_yusufali: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)!-
text_en_pickthall: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,
text_en_arberry: We already seized them with the chastisement, yet they abased not themselves to their Lord nor were they humble;

text_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
text_en_primary: But as soon as We open for them a gate of severe punishment, they will be utterly desperate.
text_en_yusufali: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein!
text_en_pickthall: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.
text_en_arberry: until, when We open against them a door of terrible chastisement, lo, they are sore confounded at it.

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
text_en_primary: He is the One Who created for you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks.
text_en_yusufali: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
text_en_pickthall: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
text_en_arberry: It is He who produced for you hearing, and eyes, and hearts; little thanks you show.

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
text_en_primary: And He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered.
text_en_yusufali: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back.
text_en_pickthall: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.
text_en_arberry: It is He who scattered you in the earth, and to Him you shall be mustered.

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
text_en_primary: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the day and night. Will you not then understand?
text_en_yusufali: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand?
text_en_pickthall: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense ?
text_en_arberry: It is He who gives life, and makes to die, and to Him belongs the alternation of night and day; what, will you not understand?

text_ar: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
text_en_primary: But they ˹just˺ say what their predecessors said.
text_en_yusufali: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said.
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;
text_en_arberry: Nay, but they said the like of what the ancients said.

text_ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
text_en_primary: They said, “Once we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?
text_en_yusufali: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
text_en_pickthall: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again ?
text_en_arberry: They said, ’What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be indeed raised up?

text_ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”
text_en_yusufali: "Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients!"
text_en_pickthall: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.
text_en_arberry: We and our fathers have been promised this before; this is naught but the fairy-tales of the ancients.’

text_ar: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: Ask ˹them, O  Prophet˺, “To whom belong the earth and all those on it, if you ˹really˺ know?”
text_en_yusufali: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein? (say) if ye know!"
text_en_pickthall: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge ?
text_en_arberry: Say: ’Whose is the earth, and whoso is in it, if you have knowledge?’

text_ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: They will reply, “To Allah!” Say, “Why are you not then mindful?”
text_en_yusufali: They will say, "To God!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition?"
text_en_pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember ?
text_en_arberry: They will say, God’s.’ Say: ’Will you not then remember?’

text_ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
text_en_primary: ˹And˺ ask ˹them˺, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”
text_en_yusufali: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme?"
text_en_pickthall: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne ?
text_en_arberry: Say: ’Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the mighty Throne?’

text_ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
text_en_primary: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
text_en_yusufali: They will say, "(They belong) to God." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe?"
text_en_pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him) ?
text_en_arberry: They will say, ’God’s.’ Say: ’Will you not then be godfearing?’

text_ar: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: Ask ˹them also,˺ “In Whose Hands is the authority over all things, protecting ˹all˺ while none can protect against Him, if you ˹really˺ know?”
text_en_yusufali: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects (all), but is not protected (of any)? (say) if ye know."
text_en_pickthall: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge ?
text_en_arberry: Say: ’In whose hand is the dominion of everything, protecting and Himself unprotected, if you have knowledge?’

text_ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
text_en_primary: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “How are you then so deluded?”
text_en_yusufali: They will say, "(It belongs) to God." Say: "Then how are ye deluded?"
text_en_pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched ?
text_en_arberry: They will say, ’God’s.’ Say: ’How then are you bewitched?

text_ar: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
text_en_primary: In fact, We have brought them the truth, and they are certainly liars.
text_en_yusufali: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.
text_en_arberry: Nay, but We brought them the truth and they are truly liars.

text_ar: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
text_en_primary: Allah has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he created, and they would have tried to dominate one another. Glorified is Allah above what they claim!
text_en_yusufali: No son did God beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to God! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him!
text_en_pickthall: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.
text_en_arberry: God has not taken to Himself any son, nor is there any god with Him; for then each god would have taken off that he created and some of them would have risen up over others; glory to be God, beyond that they describe,

text_ar: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen. Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺.
text_en_yusufali: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him!
text_en_pickthall: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!
text_en_arberry: who has knowledge of the Unseen and the Visible; high exalted be He, above that they associate!

text_ar: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Should You show me what they are threatened with,
text_en_yusufali: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me (in my lifetime) that which they are warned against,-
text_en_pickthall: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’O my Lord, if Thou shouldst show me that they are promised,

text_ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: then, my Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”
text_en_yusufali: "Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong!"
text_en_pickthall: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.
text_en_arberry: O my Lord, put me not among the people of the evildoers.’

text_ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
text_en_primary: We are indeed able to show you what We have threatened them with.
text_en_yusufali: And We are certainly able to show thee (in fulfilment) that against which they are warned.
text_en_pickthall: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.
text_en_arberry: Assuredly, We are able to show thee that We promise them.

text_ar: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
text_en_primary: Respond to evil with what is best. We know well what they claim.
text_en_yusufali: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say.
text_en_pickthall: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.
text_en_arberry: Repel thou the evil with that which is fairer. We Ourselves know very well that they describe.

text_ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
text_en_primary: And say, “My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils.
text_en_yusufali: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones.
text_en_pickthall: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,
text_en_arberry: And say: ’O my Lord, I take refuge in Thee from the evil suggestions of the Satans,

text_ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
text_en_primary: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, that they ˹even˺ come near me.”
text_en_yusufali: "And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me."
text_en_pickthall: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,
text_en_arberry: and I take refuge in Thee, O my Lord, lest they attend me.’

text_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
text_en_primary: When death approaches any of them, they cry, “My Lord! Let me go back,
text_en_yusufali: (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back (to life),-
text_en_pickthall: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,
text_en_arberry: Till, when death comes to one of them, he says, ’My Lord, return me;

text_ar: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
text_en_primary: so I may do good in what I left behind.” Never! It is only a ˹useless˺ appeal they make. And there is a barrier behind them until the Day they are resurrected.
text_en_yusufali: "In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up.
text_en_pickthall: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.
text_en_arberry: haply I shall do righteousness in that I forsook.’ Nay, it is but a word he speaks; and there; behind them, is a barrier until the day that they shall be raised up.

text_ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
text_en_primary: Then, when the Trumpet will be blown,
text_en_yusufali: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another!
text_en_pickthall: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.
text_en_arberry: For when the Trumpet is blown, that day there shall be no kinship any more between them, neither will they question one another.

text_ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
text_en_primary: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful.
text_en_yusufali: Then those whose balance (of good deeds) is heavy,- they will attain salvation:
text_en_pickthall: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.
text_en_arberry: Then he whose scales are heavy -- they are the prosperers,

text_ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
text_en_primary: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever.
text_en_yusufali: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide.
text_en_pickthall: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.
text_en_arberry: and he whose scales are light -- they have lost their souls in Gehenna dwelling forever,

text_ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
text_en_primary: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed.
text_en_yusufali: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced.
text_en_pickthall: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.
text_en_arberry: the Fire smiting their faces the while they glower there.

text_ar: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”
text_en_yusufali: "Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood?"
text_en_pickthall: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them ?
text_en_arberry: ’What, were My signs not recited to you, and you cried them lies?’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ
text_en_primary: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people.
text_en_yusufali: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray!
text_en_pickthall: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.
text_en_arberry: They shall say, ’Our Lord, our adversity prevailed over us; we were an erring people.

text_ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
text_en_primary: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”
text_en_yusufali: "Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return (to Evil), then shall we be wrong-doers indeed!"
text_en_pickthall: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.
text_en_arberry: Our Lord, bring us forth out of it! Then, if we revert, we shall be evildoers indeed.’

text_ar: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
text_en_primary: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺!
text_en_yusufali: He will say: "Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me!
text_en_pickthall: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.
text_en_arberry: ’Slink you into it,’ He shall say, ’and do not speak to Me.

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’
text_en_yusufali: "A part of My servants there was, who used to pray ’our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
text_en_pickthall: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;
text_en_arberry: There is a party of My servants who said, "Our Lord, we believe; therefore forgive us, and have mercy on us, for Thou art the best of the merciful."

text_ar: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
text_en_primary: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them.
text_en_yusufali: "But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them!
text_en_pickthall: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.
text_en_arberry: But you took them for a laughing-stock, till they made you forget My remembrance, mocking at them.

text_ar: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
text_en_primary: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”
text_en_yusufali: "I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss..."
text_en_pickthall: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.
text_en_arberry: Now today I have recompensed them for their patient endurance; they are the triumphant.’

text_ar: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
text_en_primary: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”
text_en_yusufali: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth?"
text_en_pickthall: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years ?
text_en_arberry: He shall say, ’How long have you tarried in the earth, by number of years?’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
text_en_primary: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”
text_en_yusufali: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account."
text_en_pickthall: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!
text_en_arberry: They shall say, ’We have tarried a day, or part of a day; ask the numberers!’

text_ar: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew.
text_en_yusufali: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known!
text_en_pickthall: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.
text_en_arberry: He shall say, ’You have tarried but a little, did you know.

text_ar: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
text_en_primary: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”
text_en_yusufali: "Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us (for account)?"
text_en_pickthall: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us ?
text_en_arberry: What, did you think that We created you only for sport, and that you would not be returned to Us?’

text_ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
text_en_primary: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore exalted be God, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour!
text_en_pickthall: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no God save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.
text_en_arberry: Then high exalted be God, the King, the True! There is no god but He? the Lord of the noble Throne.

text_ar: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed.
text_en_yusufali: If anyone invokes, besides God, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through!
text_en_pickthall: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.
text_en_arberry: And whosoever calls upon another god with God, whereof he has no proof, his reckoning is with his Lord; surely the unbelievers shall not prosper.

text_ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”
text_en_yusufali: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
text_en_pickthall: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
text_en_arberry: And say: ’My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for Thou art the best of the merciful.’

text_ar: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹This is˺ a sûrah which We have revealed and made ˹its rulings˺ obligatory, and revealed in it clear commandments so that you may be mindful.
text_en_yusufali: A sura which We have sent down and which We have ordained in it have We sent down Clear Signs, in order that ye may receive admonition.
text_en_pickthall: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.
text_en_arberry: A sura that We have sent down and appointed; and We have sent down in it signs, clear signs, that haply you will remember.

text_ar: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍۢ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌۭ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: As for female and male fornicators, give each of them one hundred lashes, and do not let pity for them make you lenient in ˹enforcing˺ the law of Allah, if you ˹truly˺ believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a number of believers witness their punishment.
text_en_yusufali: The woman and the man guilty of adultery or fornication,- flog each of them with a hundred stripes: Let not compassion move you in their case, in a matter prescribed by God, if ye believe in God and the Last Day: and let a party of the Believers witness their punishment.
text_en_pickthall: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment.
text_en_arberry: The fornicatress and the fornicator -- scourge each one of them a hundred stripes, and in the matter of God’s religion let no tenderness for them seize you if you believe in God and the Last Day; and let a party of the believers witness their chastisement.

text_ar: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةًۭ وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌۭ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: A male fornicator would only marry a female fornicator or idolatress. And a female fornicator would only be married to a fornicator or idolater. This is ˹all˺ forbidden to the believers.
text_en_yusufali: Let no man guilty of adultery or fornication marry and but a woman similarly guilty, or an Unbeliever: nor let any but such a man or an Unbeliever marry such a woman: to the Believers such a thing is forbidden.
text_en_pickthall: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers.
text_en_arberry: The fornicator shall marry none but a fornicatress or an idolatress, and the fornicatress -- none shall marry her but a fornicator or an idolator; that is forbidden to the believers.

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلْدَةًۭ وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدًۭا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
text_en_primary: Those who accuse chaste women ˹of adultery˺ and fail to produce four witnesses, give them eighty lashes ˹each˺. And do not ever accept any testimony from them—for they are indeed the rebellious—
text_en_yusufali: And those who launch a charge against chaste women, and produce not four witnesses (to support their allegations),- flog them with eighty stripes; and reject their evidence ever after: for such men are wicked transgressors;-
text_en_pickthall: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -
text_en_arberry: And those who cast it up on women in wedlock, and then bring not four witnesses, scourge them with eighty stripes, and do not accept any testimony of theirs ever; those -- they are the ungodly,

text_ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: except those who repent afterwards and mend their ways, then surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: Unless they repent thereafter and mend (their conduct); for God is Oft- Forgiving, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
text_en_arberry: save such as repent thereafter and make amends; surely God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
text_en_primary: And those who accuse their wives ˹of adultery˺ but have no witness except themselves, the accuser must testify, swearing four times by Allah that he is telling the truth,
text_en_yusufali: And for those who launch a charge against their spouses, and have (in support) no evidence but their own,- their solitary evidence (can be received) if they bear witness four times (with an oath) by God that they are solemnly telling the truth;
text_en_pickthall: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth;
text_en_arberry: And those who cast it up on their wives having no witnesses except themselves, the testimony of one of them shall be to testify by God four times that he is of the truthful,

text_ar: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
text_en_primary: and a fifth oath that Allah may condemn him if he is lying.
text_en_yusufali: And the fifth (oath) (should be) that they solemnly invoke the curse of God on themselves if they tell a lie.
text_en_pickthall: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie.
text_en_arberry: and a fifth time, that the curse of God shall be upon him, if he should be of the liars.

text_ar: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
text_en_primary: For her to be spared the punishment, she must swear four times by Allah that he is telling a lie,
text_en_yusufali: But it would avert the punishment from the wife, if she bears witness four times (with an oath) By God, that (her husband) is telling a lie;
text_en_pickthall: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false,
text_en_arberry: It shall avert from her the chastisement if she testify by God four times that he is of the liars,

text_ar: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
text_en_primary: and a fifth oath that Allah may be displeased with her if he is telling the truth.
