text_en_primary: Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “If only the angels were sent down to us, or we could see our Lord!” They have certainly been carried away by their arrogance and have entirely exceeded all limits.
text_en_yusufali: Such as fear not the meeting with Us (for Judgment) say: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or (why) do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they have an arrogant conceit of themselves, and mighty is the insolence of their impiety!
text_en_pickthall: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride.
text_en_arberry: Say those who look not to encounter Us, ’Why have the angels not been sent down on us, or why see we not our Lord?’ Waxed proud they have within them, and become greatly disdainful.

text_ar: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ on the Day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the wicked, who will cry, “Keep away! Away ˹from us˺!”
text_en_yusufali: The Day they see the angels,- no joy will there be to the sinners that Day: The (angels) will say: "There is a barrier forbidden (to you) altogether!"
text_en_pickthall: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!
text_en_arberry: Upon the day that they see the angels, no good tidings that day for the sinners; they shall say, ’A ban forbidden!’

text_ar: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍۢ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هَبَآءًۭ مَّنثُورًا
text_en_primary: Then We will turn to whatever ˹good˺ deeds they did, reducing them to scattered dust.
text_en_yusufali: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they did (in this life), and We shall make such deeds as floating dust scattered about.
text_en_pickthall: And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes.
text_en_arberry: We shall advance upon what work they have done, and make it a scattered dust.

text_ar: أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌۭ مُّسْتَقَرًّۭا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ on that Day the residents of Paradise will have the best settlement and the finest place to rest.
text_en_yusufali: The Companions of the Garden will be well, that Day, in their abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.
text_en_pickthall: Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest;
text_en_arberry: The inhabitants of Paradise that day, better shall be their lodging, fairer their resting-place.

text_ar: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
text_en_primary: ˹Watch for˺ the Day the heavens will burst with clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive ranks.
text_en_yusufali: The Day the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and angels shall be sent down, descending (in ranks),-
text_en_pickthall: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.
text_en_arberry: Upon the day that heaven is split asunder with the clouds and the angels are sent down in majesty,

text_ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: True authority on that Day will belong ˹only˺ to the Most Compassionate. And it will be a hard day for the disbelievers.
text_en_yusufali: That Day, the dominion as of right and truth, shall be (wholly) for (God) Most Merciful: it will be a Day of dire difficulty for the Misbelievers.
text_en_pickthall: The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers.
text_en_arberry: the Kingdom that day, the true Kingdom, shall belong to the All-merciful and it shall be a day harsh for the unbelievers.

text_ar: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: And ˹beware of˺ the Day the wrongdoer will bite his nails ˹in regret˺ and say, “Oh! I wish I had followed the Way along with the Messenger!
text_en_yusufali: The Day that the wrong-doer will bite at his hands, he will say, "Oh! would that I had taken a (straight) path with the Apostle!
text_en_pickthall: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)!
text_en_arberry: Upon the day the evildoer shall bite his hands, saying, ’Would that I had taken a way along with the Messenger!

text_ar: يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Woe to me! I wish I had never taken so-and-so as a close friend.
text_en_yusufali: "Ah! woe is me! Would that I had never taken such a one for a friend!
text_en_pickthall: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!
text_en_arberry: Alas, would that I had not taken So-and-so for a friend!

text_ar: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولًۭا
text_en_primary: It was he who truly made me stray from the Reminder after it had reached me.” And Satan has always betrayed humanity.
text_en_yusufali: "He did lead me astray from the Message (of God) after it had come to me! Ah! the Evil One is but a traitor to man!" Then the Apostle will say:
text_en_pickthall: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man’s deserter in the hour of need.
text_en_arberry: He indeed led me astray from the Remembrance, after it had come to me; Satan is ever a forsaker of men.’

text_ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًۭا
text_en_primary: The Messenger has cried, “O my Lord! My people have indeed received this Quran with neglect.”
text_en_yusufali: "O my Lord! Truly my people took this Qur’an for just foolish nonsense."
text_en_pickthall: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur’an of no account.
text_en_arberry: The Messenger says, ’O my Lord, behold, my people have taken this Koran as a thing to be shunned.’

text_ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًۭا وَنَصِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: Similarly, We made enemies for every prophet from among the wicked, but sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper.
text_en_yusufali: Thus have We made for every prophet an enemy among the sinners: but enough is thy Lord to guide and to help.
text_en_pickthall: Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper.
text_en_arberry: Even so We have appointed to every Prophet an enemy among the sinners; but thy Lord suffices as a guide and as a helper.

text_ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَٰهُ تَرْتِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: The disbelievers say, “If only the Quran had been sent down to him all at once!” ˹We have sent it˺ as such ˹in stages˺ so We may reassure your heart with it. And We have revealed it at a deliberate pace.
text_en_yusufali: Those who reject Faith say: "Why is not the Qur’an revealed to him all at once? Thus (is it revealed), that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have rehearsed it to thee in slow, well-arranged stages, gradually.
text_en_pickthall: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur’an not revealed unto him all at once ? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.
text_en_arberry: The unbelievers say, ’Why has the Koran not been sent down upon him all at once?’ Even so, that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have chanted it very distinctly.

text_ar: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
text_en_primary: Whenever they bring you an argument, We come to you with the right refutation and the best explanation.
text_en_yusufali: And no question do they bring to thee but We reveal to thee the truth and the best explanation (thereof).
text_en_pickthall: And they bring thee no similitude but We bring thee the Truth (as against it), and better (than their similitude) as argument.
text_en_arberry: They bring not to thee any similitude but that We bring thee the truth, and better in exposition.

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Those who will be dragged into Hell on their faces will be in the worst place, and are ˹now˺ farthest from the ˹Right˺ Way.
text_en_yusufali: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces,- they will be in an evil plight, and, as to Path, most astray.
text_en_pickthall: Those who will be gathered on their faces unto hell: such are worse in plight and further from the right road.
text_en_arberry: Those who shall be mustered to Gehenna upon their faces -- they shall be worse in place, and gone further astray from the way.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: We certainly gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron as his helper.
text_en_yusufali: (Before this,) We sent Moses The Book, and appointed his brother Aaron with him as minister;
text_en_pickthall: We verily gave Moses the Scripture and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman.
text_en_arberry: We gave Moses the Book, and appointed with him his brother Aaron as minister

text_ar: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: We had ordered ˹them˺, “Go to the people who would deny Our signs.” Then We annihilated the deniers entirely.
text_en_yusufali: And We command: "Go ye both, to the people who have rejected our Signs:" And those (people) We destroyed with utter destruction.
text_en_pickthall: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction.
text_en_arberry: and We said, ’Go to the people who have cried lies to Our signs’; then We destroyed them utterly.

text_ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
text_en_primary: And when the people of Noah rejected the messengers, We drowned them, making them an example to humanity. And We have prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers.
text_en_yusufali: And the people of Noah,- when they rejected the apostles, We drowned them, and We made them as a Sign for mankind; and We have prepared for (all) wrong-doers a grievous Penalty;-
text_en_pickthall: And Noah’s folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers.
text_en_arberry: And the people of Noah, when they cried lies to the Messengers, We drowned them, and made them to be a sign to mankind; and We have prepared for the evildoers a painful chastisement.

text_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: Also ˹We destroyed˺ ’Ȃd, Thamûd, and the people of the Water-pit, as well as many peoples in between.
text_en_yusufali: As also ’Ad and Thamud, and the Companions of the Rass, and many a generation between them.
text_en_pickthall: And (the tribes of) A’ad and Thamud, and the dwellers in Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.
text_en_arberry: And Ad, and Thamood, and the men of Er-Rass, and between that generations a many,

text_ar: وَكُلًّۭا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: For each We set forth ˹various˺ lessons, and We ultimately destroyed each.
text_en_yusufali: To each one We set forth Parables and examples; and each one We broke to utter annihilation (for their sins).
text_en_pickthall: Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin.
text_en_arberry: for each We struck similitudes, and each We ruined utterly.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًۭا
text_en_primary: They have certainly passed by the city ˹of Sodom˺, which had been showered with a dreadful rain ˹of stones˺. Have they not seen its ruins? But they do not expect to be resurrected.
text_en_yusufali: And the (Unbelievers) must indeed have passed by the town on which was rained a shower of evil: did they not then see it (with their own eyes)? But they fear not the Resurrection.
text_en_pickthall: And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it ? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection.
text_en_arberry: Surely they have come by the city that was rained on by an evil rain; what, have they not seen it? Nay, but they look for no upraising.

text_ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
text_en_primary: When they see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one that Allah has sent as a messenger?
text_en_yusufali: When they see thee, they treat thee no otherwise than in mockery: "Is this the one whom God has sent as an apostle?"
text_en_pickthall: And when they see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest (saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger ?
text_en_arberry: And when they see thee, they take thee in mockery only: ’What, is this he whom God sent forth as a Messenger?

text_ar: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
text_en_primary: He would have almost tricked us away from our gods, had we not been so devoted to them.” ˹But˺ soon they will know, when they face the punishment, who is far astray from the ˹Right˺ Way.
text_en_yusufali: "He indeed would well-nigh have misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were constant to them!" - Soon will they know, when they see the Penalty, who it is that is most misled in Path!
text_en_pickthall: He would have led us far away from our gods if we had not been staunch to them. They will know, when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road.
text_en_arberry: Wellnigh he had led us astray from our gods, but that we kept steadfast to them.’ Assuredly they shall know, when they see the chastisement, who is further astray from the way.

text_ar: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
text_en_primary: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who has taken their own desires as their god? Will you then be a keeper over them?
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou such a one as taketh for his god his own passion (or impulse)? Couldst thou be a disposer of affairs for him?
text_en_pickthall: Hast thou seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust ? Wouldst thou then be guardian over him ?
text_en_arberry: Hast thou seen him who has taken his caprice to be his god? Wilt thou be a guardian over them?

text_ar: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
text_en_primary: Or do you think that most of them listen or understand?
text_en_yusufali: Or thinkest thou that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle;- nay, they are worse astray in Path.
text_en_pickthall: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand ? They are but as the cattle - nay, but they are farther astray ?
text_en_arberry: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle; nay, they are further astray from the way.

text_ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًۭا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Have you not seen how your Lord extends the shade—He could have simply made it ˹remain˺ still if He so willed—then We make the sun its guide,
text_en_yusufali: Hast thou not turned thy vision to thy Lord?- How He doth prolong the shadow! If He willed, He could make it stationary! then do We make the sun its guide;
text_en_pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot;
text_en_arberry: Hast thou not regarded thy Lord, how He has stretched out the shadow? Had He willed, He would have made it still. Then We appointed the sun, to be a guide to it;

text_ar: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: causing the shade to retreat gradually?
text_en_yusufali: Then We draw it in towards Ourselves,- a contraction by easy stages.
text_en_pickthall: Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal ?
text_en_arberry: thereafter We seize it to Ourselves, drawing it gently.

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًۭا
text_en_primary: He is the One Who has made the night for you as a cover, and ˹made˺ sleep for resting, and the day for rising.
text_en_yusufali: And He it is Who makes the Night as a Robe for you, and Sleep as Repose, and makes the Day (as it were) a Resurrection.
text_en_pickthall: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection.
text_en_arberry: It is He who appointed the night for you to be a garment and sleep for a rest, and day He appointed for a rising.

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ طَهُورًۭا
text_en_primary: And He is the One Who sends the winds ushering in His mercy, and We send down pure rain from the sky,
text_en_yusufali: And He it is Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy, and We send down pure water from the sky,-
text_en_pickthall: And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy, and We send down purifying water from the sky,
text_en_arberry: And it is He who has loosed the winds, bearing good tidings before His mercy; and We sent down from heaven pure water

text_ar: لِّنُحْۦِىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: giving life to a lifeless land, and providing water for countless animals and humans of Our Own creation.
text_en_yusufali: That with it We may give life to a dead land, and slake the thirst of things We have created,- cattle and men in great numbers.
text_en_pickthall: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.
text_en_arberry: so that We might revive a dead land, and give to drink of it, of that We created, cattle and men a many.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
text_en_primary: We certainly disperse it among them so they may be mindful, but most people persist in ungratefulness.
text_en_yusufali: And We have distributed the (water) amongst them, in order that they may celebrate (our) praises, but most men are averse (to aught) but (rank) ingratitude.
text_en_pickthall: And verily We have repeated it among them that they may remember, but most of mankind begrudge aught save ingratitude.
text_en_arberry: We have indeed turned it about amongst them, so that they may remember; yet most men refuse all but unbelief.

text_ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍۢ نَّذِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: Had We willed, We could have easily sent a warner to every society.
text_en_yusufali: Had it been Our Will, We could have sent a warner to every centre of population.
text_en_pickthall: If We willed, We could raise up a warner in every village.
text_en_arberry: If We had willed, We would have raised up in every city a warner.

text_ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: So do not yield to the disbelievers, but strive diligently against them with this ˹Quran˺.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore listen not to the Unbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost strenuousness, with the (Qur’an).
text_en_pickthall: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them herewith with a great endeavour.
text_en_arberry: So obey not the unbelievers, but struggle with them thereby mightily.

text_ar: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًۭا وَحِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
text_en_primary: And He is the One Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, placing between them a barrier they cannot cross.
text_en_yusufali: It is He Who has let free the two bodies of flowing water: One palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; yet has He made a barrier between them, a partition that is forbidden to be passed.
text_en_pickthall: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them.
text_en_arberry: And it is He who let forth the two seas, this one Sweet, grateful to taste, and this salt, bitter to the tongue, and He set between them a barrier, and a ban forbidden.

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًۭا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًۭا وَصِهْرًۭا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: And He is the One Who creates human beings from a ˹humble˺ liquid, then establishes for them bonds of kinship and marriage. For your Lord is Most Capable.
text_en_yusufali: It is He Who has created man from water: then has He established relationships of lineage and marriage: for thy Lord has power (over all things).
text_en_pickthall: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful.
text_en_arberry: And it is He who created of water a mortal, and made him kindred of blood and marriage; thy Lord is All-powerful.

text_ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: Yet they worship besides Allah what can neither benefit nor harm them. And the disbeliever always collaborates against their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: Yet do they worship, besides God, things that can neither profit them nor harm them: and the Misbeliever is a helper (of Evil), against his own Lord!
text_en_pickthall: Yet they worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them nor hurt them. The disbeliever was ever a partisan against his Lord.
text_en_arberry: And they serve, apart from God, what neither profits them nor hurts them; and the unbeliever is ever a partisan against his Lord.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: And We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a deliverer of good news and a warner.
text_en_yusufali: But thee We only sent to give glad tidings and admonition.
text_en_pickthall: And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
text_en_arberry: We have sent thee not, except good tidings to bear, and warning.

text_ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺, but whoever wishes, let them pursue the Way to their Lord.”
text_en_yusufali: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for it but this: that each one who will may take a (straight) Path to his Lord."
text_en_pickthall: Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’I do not ask of you a wage for this, except for him who wishes to take to his Lord a way.’

text_ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
text_en_primary: Put your trust in the Ever-Living, Who never dies, and glorify His praises. Sufficient is He as All-Aware of the sins of His servants.
text_en_yusufali: And put thy trust in Him Who lives and dies not; and celebrate his praise; and enough is He to be acquainted with the faults of His servants;-
text_en_pickthall: And trust thou in the Living One Who dieth not, and hymn His praise. He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen’s sins,
text_en_arberry: Put thy trust in the Living God, the Undying, and proclaim His praise. Sufficiently is He aware of His servants sins

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹He is˺ the One Who created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. ˹He is˺ the Most Compassionate! Ask ˹none other than˺ the All-Knowledgeable about Himself.
text_en_yusufali: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between, in six days, and is firmly established on the Throne (of Authority): God Most Gracious: ask thou, then, about Him of any acquainted (with such things).
text_en_pickthall: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him!
text_en_arberry: who created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, then sat Himself upon the Throne, the All-compassionate: ask any informed of Him!

text_ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًۭا ۩
text_en_primary: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they ask ˹in disgust˺, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate’? Will we prostrate to whatever you order us to?” And it only drives them farther away.
text_en_yusufali: When it is said to them, "Adore ye (God) Most Gracious!", they say, "And what is (God) Most Gracious? Shall we adore that which thou commandest us?" And it increases their flight (from the Truth).
text_en_pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Adore the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent ? Are we to adore whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us ? And it increaseth aversion in them.
text_en_arberry: But when they are told, ’Bow yourselves to the All-merciful,’ they say, ’And what is the All-merciful? Shall we bow ourselves to what thou biddest us?’ And it increases them in aversion.

text_ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًۭا وَقَمَرًۭا مُّنِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: Blessed is the One Who has placed constellations in the sky, as well as a ˹radiant˺ lamp and a luminous moon.
text_en_yusufali: Blessed is He Who made constellations in the skies, and placed therein a Lamp and a Moon giving light;
text_en_pickthall: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light!
text_en_arberry: Blessed be He who has set in heaven constellations, and has set among them a lamp, and an illuminating moon.

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةًۭ لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًۭا
text_en_primary: And He is the One Who causes the day and the night to alternate, ˹as a sign˺ for whoever desires to be mindful or to be grateful.
text_en_yusufali: And it is He Who made the Night and the Day to follow each other: for such as have the will to celebrate His praises or to show their gratitude.
text_en_pickthall: And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness.
text_en_arberry: And it is He who made the night and day a succession for whom He desires to remember or He desires to be thankful.

text_ar: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًۭا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا
text_en_primary: The ˹true˺ servants of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the foolish address them ˹improperly˺, they only respond with peace.
text_en_yusufali: And the servants of (God) Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, "Peace!";
text_en_pickthall: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;
text_en_arberry: The servants of the All-merciful are those who walk in the earth modestly and who, when the ignorant address them, say, ’Peace’;

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًۭا وَقِيَٰمًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹They are˺ those who spend ˹a good portion of˺ the night, prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: Those who spend the night in adoration of their Lord prostrate and standing;
text_en_pickthall: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,
text_en_arberry: who pass the night prostrate to their Lord and standing;

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
text_en_primary: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Keep the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is indeed unrelenting.
text_en_yusufali: Those who say, "Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,-
text_en_pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;
text_en_arberry: who say, ’Our Lord, turn Thou from us the chastisement of Gehenna; surely its chastisement is torment most terrible;

text_ar: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
text_en_primary: It is certainly an evil place to settle and reside.”
text_en_yusufali: "Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in";
text_en_pickthall: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;
text_en_arberry: evil it is as a lodging-place and an abode’;

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹They are˺ those who spend neither wastefully nor stingily, but moderately in between.
text_en_yusufali: Those who, when they spend, are not extravagant and not niggardly, but hold a just (balance) between those (extremes);
text_en_pickthall: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;
text_en_arberry: who, when they expend, are neither prodigal nor parsimonious, but between that is a just stand;

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹They are˺ those who do not invoke any other god besides Allah, nor take a ˹human˺ life—made sacred by Allah—except with ˹legal˺ right, nor commit fornication. And whoever does ˹any of˺ this will face the penalty.
text_en_yusufali: Those who invoke not, with God, any other god, nor slay such life as God has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit fornication; - and any that does this (not only) meets punishment.
text_en_pickthall: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;
text_en_arberry: who call not upon another god with God, nor slay the soul God has forbidden except by right, neither fornicate, for whosoever does that shall meet the price

text_ar: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
text_en_primary: Their punishment will be multiplied on the Day of Judgment, and they will remain in it forever, in disgrace.
text_en_yusufali: (But) the Penalty on the Day of Judgment will be doubled to him, and he will dwell therein in ignominy,-
text_en_pickthall: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;
text_en_arberry: of sin-doubled shall be the chastisement for him on the Resurrection Day, and he shall dwell therein humbled,

text_ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
text_en_primary: As for those who repent, believe, and do good deeds, they are the ones whose evil deeds Allah will change into good deeds. For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: Unless he repents, believes, and works righteous deeds, for God will change the evil of such persons into good, and God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful,
text_en_pickthall: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
text_en_arberry: save him who repents, and believes, and does righteous work -- those, God will change their evil deeds into good deeds, for God is ever All-forgiving, All-compassionate;

text_ar: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا
text_en_primary: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah properly.
text_en_yusufali: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to God with an (acceptable) conversion;-
text_en_pickthall: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -
text_en_arberry: and whosoever repents, and does righteousness, he truly turns to God in repentance.

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹They are˺ those who do not bear false witness, and when they come across falsehood, they pass ˹it˺ by with dignity.
text_en_yusufali: Those who witness no falsehood, and, if they pass by futility, they pass by it with honourable (avoidance);
text_en_pickthall: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.
text_en_arberry: And those who bear not false witness and, when they pass by idle talk, pass by with dignity;

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹They are˺ those who, when reminded of the revelation of their Lord, do not turn a blind eye or a deaf ear to it.
text_en_yusufali: Those who, when they are admonished with the Signs of their Lord, droop not down at them as if they were deaf or blind;
text_en_pickthall: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
text_en_arberry: who, when they are reminded of the signs of their Lord, fall not down thereat deaf and blind;

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
text_en_primary: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Bless us with ˹pious˺ spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.”
text_en_yusufali: And those who pray, "Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous."
text_en_pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
text_en_arberry: who say, ’Our Lord, give us refreshment of our wives and seed, and make us a model to the godfearing.’

text_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَٰمًا
text_en_primary: It is they who will be rewarded with ˹elevated˺ mansions ˹in Paradise˺ for their perseverance, and will be received with salutations and ˹greetings of˺ peace,
text_en_yusufali: Those are the ones who will be rewarded with the highest place in heaven, because of their patient constancy: therein shall they be met with salutations and peace,
text_en_pickthall: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,
text_en_arberry: Those shall be recompensed with the highest heaven, for that they endured patiently, and they shall receive therein a greeting and --’ Peace!’

text_ar: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
text_en_primary: staying there forever. What an excellent place to settle and reside!
text_en_yusufali: Dwelling therein;- how beautiful an abode and place of rest!
text_en_pickthall: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!
text_en_arberry: Therein they shall dwell forever; fair it is as a lodging-place and an abode.

text_ar: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You ˹all˺ would not ˹even˺ matter to my Lord were it not for your faith ˹in Him˺. But now you ˹disbelievers˺ have denied ˹the truth˺, so the torment is bound to come.”
text_en_yusufali: Say (to the Rejecters): "My Lord is not uneasy because of you if ye call not on Him: But ye have indeed rejected (Him), and soon will come the inevitable (punishment)!"
text_en_pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’My Lord esteems you not at all were it not for your prayer, for you have cried lies, and it shall surely be fastened.’

text_ar: طسٓمٓ
text_en_primary: Ṭa-Sĩn-Mĩm.
text_en_yusufali: Ta. Sin. Mim.
text_en_pickthall: Ta. Sin. Mim.
text_en_arberry: Ta Sin Mim

text_ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
text_en_primary: These are the verses of the clear Book.
text_en_yusufali: These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
text_en_pickthall: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
text_en_arberry: Those are the signs of the Manifest Book.

text_ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their disbelief.
text_en_yusufali: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers.
text_en_pickthall: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
text_en_arberry: Perchance thou consumest thyself that they are not believers.

text_ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
text_en_primary: If We willed, We could send down upon them a ˹compelling˺ sign from the heavens, leaving their necks bent in ˹utter˺ submission to it.
text_en_yusufali: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
text_en_pickthall: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
text_en_arberry: If We will, We shall send down on them out of heaven a sign, so their necks will stay humbled to it.

text_ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
text_en_primary: Whatever new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate, they always turn away from it.
text_en_yusufali: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (God) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom.
text_en_pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
text_en_arberry: But never fresh remembrance comes to them from the All-merciful, except they turn away from it.

text_ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
text_en_primary: They have certainly denied ˹the truth˺, so they will soon face the consequences of their ridicule.
text_en_yusufali: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at!
text_en_pickthall: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
text_en_arberry: So they have cried lies; therefore assuredly tidings will come to them of that they mocked at.

text_ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
text_en_primary: Have they failed to look at the earth, ˹to see˺ how many types of fine plants We have caused to grow in it?
text_en_yusufali: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein?
text_en_pickthall: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein ?
text_en_arberry: What, have they not regarded the earth, how many therein We have caused to grow of every generous kind?

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
text_en_arberry: Surely in that is a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
text_en_primary: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
text_en_arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.

text_ar: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹Remember˺ when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people—
text_en_yusufali: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity,-
text_en_pickthall: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,
text_en_arberry: And when thy Lord called to Moses, ’Go to the people of the evildoers,

text_ar: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
text_en_primary: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear ˹Allah˺?”
text_en_yusufali: "The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear God?"
text_en_pickthall: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil) ?
text_en_arberry: the people of Pharaoh; will they not be godfearing?’

text_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
text_en_primary: He replied, “My Lord! I fear that they will reject me.
text_en_yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood:
text_en_pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
text_en_arberry: He said, ’My Lord, I fear they will cry me lies,

text_ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
text_en_primary: And ˹so˺ my heart will be broken and my tongue will be tied. So send Aaron along ˹as a messenger˺.
text_en_yusufali: "My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron.
text_en_pickthall: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).
text_en_arberry: and my breast will be straitened, and my tongue will not be loosed; so send to Aaron.

text_ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
text_en_primary: Also, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me.”
text_en_yusufali: "And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me."
text_en_pickthall: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
text_en_arberry: They also have a sin against me, and I fear they will slay me.’

text_ar: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
text_en_primary: Allah responded, “Certainly not! So go, both of you, with Our signs. We will be with you, listening.
text_en_yusufali: God said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call).
text_en_pickthall: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
text_en_arberry: Said He, ’No indeed; but go, both of you, with Our signs, and We assuredly shall be with you, listening.

text_ar: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are messengers from the Lord of all worlds,
text_en_yusufali: "So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: ’We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds;
text_en_pickthall: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,

text_ar: وَكُنُوزٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: treasures, and splendid residences.
text_en_yusufali: So We expelled them from gardens, springs,
text_en_pickthall: And treasures and a fair estate.
text_en_arberry: and treasures and a noble station;

text_ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
text_en_primary: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to the Children of Israel.
text_en_yusufali: Treasures, and every kind of honourable position;
text_en_pickthall: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.
text_en_arberry: even so, and We bequeathed them upon the Children of Israel.

text_ar: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
text_en_primary: And so they pursued them at sunrise.
text_en_yusufali: Thus it was, but We made the Children of Israel inheritors of such things.
text_en_pickthall: And they overtook them at sunrise.
text_en_arberry: Then they followed them at the sunrise;

text_ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
text_en_primary: When the two groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out, “We are overtaken for sure.”
text_en_yusufali: So they pursued them at sunrise.
text_en_pickthall: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.
text_en_arberry: and, when the two hosts sighted each other, the companions of Moses said, ’We are overtaken!’

text_ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
text_en_primary: Moses reassured ˹them˺, “Absolutely not! My Lord is certainly with me—He will guide me.”
text_en_yusufali: And when the two bodies saw each other, the people of Moses said: "We are sure to be overtaken."
text_en_pickthall: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
text_en_arberry: Said he, ’No indeed; surely my Lord is with me; He will guide me.’

text_ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
text_en_primary: So We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff,” and the sea was split, each part was like a huge mountain.
text_en_yusufali: (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me!"
text_en_pickthall: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.
text_en_arberry: Then We revealed to Moses, ’Strike with thy staff the sea’; and it clave, and each part was as a mighty mount.

text_ar: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
text_en_primary: We drew the pursuers to that place,
text_en_yusufali: Then We told Moses by inspiration: "Strike the sea with thy rod." So it divided, and each separate part became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain.
text_en_pickthall: Then brought We near the others to that place.
text_en_arberry: And there We brought the others on,

text_ar: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
text_en_primary: and delivered Moses and those with him all together.
text_en_yusufali: And We made the other party approach thither.
text_en_pickthall: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;
text_en_arberry: and We delivered Moses and those with him all together;

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
text_en_primary: Then We drowned the others.
text_en_yusufali: We delivered Moses and all who were with him;
text_en_pickthall: And We drowned the others.
text_en_arberry: then We drowned the others.

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.
text_en_yusufali: But We drowned the others.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
text_en_arberry: Surely in that is a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
text_en_primary: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
text_en_pickthall: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
text_en_arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.

text_ar: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
text_en_primary: Relate to them ˹O Prophet˺ the story of Abraham,
text_en_yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:
text_en_arberry: And recite to them the tiding of Abraham

text_ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
text_en_primary: when he questioned his father and his people, “What is that you worship ˹besides Allah˺?”
text_en_yusufali: And rehearse to them (something of) Abraham’s story.
text_en_pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye ?
text_en_arberry: when he said to his father and his people, ’What do you serve?’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
text_en_primary: They replied, “We worship idols, to which we are fully devoted.”
text_en_yusufali: Behold, he said to his father and his people: "What worship ye?"
text_en_pickthall: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.
text_en_arberry: They said, ’We serve idols, and continue cleaving to them.

text_ar: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
text_en_primary: Abraham asked, “Can they hear you when you call upon them?
text_en_yusufali: They said: "We worship idols, and we remain constantly in attendance on them."
text_en_pickthall: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry ?
text_en_arberry: He said, ’Do they hear you when you call,

text_ar: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
text_en_primary: Or can they benefit or harm you?”
text_en_yusufali: He said: "Do they listen to you when ye call (on them), or do you good or harm?"
text_en_pickthall: Or do they benefit or harm you ?
text_en_arberry: or do they profit you, or harm?’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
text_en_primary: They replied, “No! But we found our forefathers doing the same.”
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing thus (what we do)."
text_en_pickthall: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Nay, but we found our fathers so doing.’

text_ar: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
text_en_primary: Abraham responded, “Have you ˹really˺ considered what you have been worshipping—
text_en_yusufali: He said: "Do ye then see whom ye have been worshipping,-
text_en_pickthall: He said: See now that which ye worship,
text_en_arberry: He said, ’And have you considered what you have been serving,

text_ar: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
text_en_primary: you and your ancestors?
text_en_yusufali: "Ye and your fathers before you?-
text_en_pickthall: Ye and your forefathers!
text_en_arberry: you and your fathers, the elders?

text_ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: They are ˹all˺ enemies to me, except the Lord of all worlds.
text_en_yusufali: "For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,
text_en_arberry: They are an enemy to me, except the Lord of all Being

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
text_en_primary: ˹He is˺ the One Who created me, and He ˹alone˺ guides me.
text_en_yusufali: "Who created me, and it is He Who guides me;
text_en_pickthall: Who created me, and He doth guide me,
text_en_arberry: who created me, and Himself guides me,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
text_en_primary: ˹He is˺ the One Who provides me with food and drink.
text_en_yusufali: "Who gives me food and drink,
text_en_pickthall: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.
text_en_arberry: and Himself gives me to eat and drink,

text_ar: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
text_en_primary: And He ˹alone˺ heals me when I am sick.
text_en_yusufali: "And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me;
text_en_pickthall: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,
text_en_arberry: and, whenever I am sick, heals me,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
text_en_primary: And He ˹is the One Who˺ will cause me to die, and then bring me back to life.
text_en_yusufali: "Who will cause me to die, and then to life (again);
text_en_pickthall: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),
text_en_arberry: who makes me to die, then gives me life,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: And He is ˹the One˺ Who, I hope, will forgive my flaws on Judgment Day.”
text_en_yusufali: "And who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the day of Judgment.
text_en_pickthall: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.
text_en_arberry: and who I am eager shall forgive me my offence on the Day of Doom.

text_ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
text_en_primary: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and join me with the righteous.
text_en_yusufali: "O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous;
text_en_pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.
text_en_arberry: My Lord, give me Judgment, and join me with the righteous,

text_ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
text_en_primary: Bless me with honourable mention among later generations.
text_en_yusufali: "Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations);
text_en_pickthall: And give unto me a good report in later generations.
text_en_arberry: and appoint me a tongue of truthfulness among the others.

text_ar: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
text_en_primary: Make me one of those awarded the Garden of Bliss.
text_en_yusufali: "Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss;
text_en_pickthall: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,
text_en_arberry: Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss

text_ar: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
text_en_primary: Forgive my father, for he is certainly one of the misguided.
text_en_yusufali: "Forgive my father, for that he is among those astray;
text_en_pickthall: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.
text_en_arberry: and forgive my father, for he is one of those astray.

text_ar: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
text_en_primary: And do not disgrace me on the Day all will be resurrected—
text_en_yusufali: "And let me not be in disgrace on the Day when (men) will be raised up;-
text_en_pickthall: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,
text_en_arberry: Degrade me not upon the day when they are raised up,

text_ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
text_en_primary: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any benefit.
text_en_yusufali: "The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,
text_en_pickthall: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)
text_en_arberry: the day when neither wealth nor sons shall profit

text_ar: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: Only those who come before Allah with a pure heart ˹will be saved˺.”
text_en_yusufali: "But only he (will prosper) that brings to God a sound heart;
text_en_pickthall: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.
text_en_arberry: except for him who comes to God with a pure heart.

text_ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹On that Day˺ Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing,
text_en_yusufali: "To the righteous, the Garden will be brought near,
text_en_pickthall: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).
text_en_arberry: And Paradise shall be brought forward for the godfearing,

text_ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
text_en_primary: and the Hellfire will be displayed to the deviant.
text_en_yusufali: "And to those straying in Evil, the Fire will be placed in full view;
text_en_pickthall: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.
text_en_arberry: and Hell advanced for the perverse.

text_ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
text_en_primary: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship
text_en_yusufali: "And it shall be said to them: ’Where are the (gods) ye worshipped-
text_en_pickthall: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship
text_en_arberry: It shall be said to them, ’Where is that you were serving

text_ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
text_en_primary: besides Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”
text_en_yusufali: "’Besides God? Can they help you or help themselves?’
text_en_pickthall: Instead of Allah ? Can they help you or help themselves ?
text_en_arberry: apart from God? Do they help you or help themselves?’

text_ar: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
text_en_primary: Then the idols will be hurled headlong into Hell, along with the deviant
text_en_yusufali: "Then they will be thrown headlong into the (Fire),- they and those straying in Evil,
text_en_pickthall: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers
text_en_arberry: Then they shall be pitched into it, they and the perverse

text_ar: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
text_en_primary: and the soldiers of Iblis, all together.
text_en_yusufali: "And the whole hosts of Iblis together.
text_en_pickthall: And the hosts of Iblis, together.
text_en_arberry: and the hosts of Iblis, all together.

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
text_en_primary: There the deviant will cry while disputing with their idols,
text_en_yusufali: "They will say there in their mutual bickerings:
text_en_pickthall: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:
text_en_arberry: They shall say, as they dispute there one with another,

text_ar: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
text_en_primary: “By Allah! We were clearly mistaken,
text_en_yusufali: "’By God, we were truly in an error manifest,
text_en_pickthall: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
text_en_arberry: ’By God, we were certainly in manifest error

text_ar: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: when we made you equal to the Lord of all worlds.
text_en_yusufali: "’When we held you as equals with the Lord of the Worlds;
text_en_pickthall: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_arberry: when we made you equal with the Lord of all Being.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
text_en_primary: And none led us astray other than the wicked.
text_en_yusufali: "’And our seducers were only those who were steeped in guilt.
text_en_pickthall: It was but the guilty who misled us.
text_en_arberry: It was naught but the sinners that led us astray;

text_ar: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
text_en_primary: Now we have none to intercede for us,
text_en_yusufali: "’Now, then, we have none to intercede (for us),
text_en_pickthall: Now we have no intercessors
text_en_arberry: so now we have no intercessors,

text_ar: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: nor a close friend.
text_en_yusufali: "’Nor a single friend to feel (for us).
text_en_pickthall: Nor any loving friend.
text_en_arberry: no loyal friend.

text_ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: If only we could have a second chance, then we would be believers.”
text_en_yusufali: "’Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe!’"
text_en_pickthall: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!
text_en_arberry: O that we might return again, and be among the believers!’

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.
text_en_yusufali: Verily in this is a Sign but most of them do not believe.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!
text_en_arberry: Surely in that is a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
text_en_primary: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
text_en_arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.

text_ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
text_en_primary: The people of Noah rejected the messengers
text_en_yusufali: The people of Noah rejected the apostles.
text_en_pickthall: Noah’s folk denied the messengers (of Allah),
text_en_arberry: The people of Noah cried lies to the Envoys

text_ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
text_en_primary: when their brother Noah said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺?
text_en_yusufali: Behold, their brother Noah said to them: "Will ye not fear (God)?
text_en_pickthall: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil) ?
text_en_arberry: when their brother Noah said to them, ’Will you not be godfearing?

text_ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you.
text_en_yusufali: "I am to you an apostle worthy of all trust:
text_en_pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
text_en_arberry: I am for you a faithful Messenger,

text_ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
text_en_primary: So fear Allah, and obey me.
text_en_yusufali: "So fear God, and obey me.
text_en_pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
text_en_arberry: so serve you God, and obey you me.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds.
text_en_yusufali: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds:
text_en_pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_arberry: I ask of you no wage for this; my wage falls only upon the Lord of all Being;

text_ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
text_en_primary: So fear Allah, and obey me.”
text_en_yusufali: "So fear God, and obey me."
text_en_pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
text_en_arberry: so fear you God, and obey you me.’

text_ar: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
text_en_primary: They argued, “How can we believe in you, when you are followed ˹only˺ by the lowest of the low?”
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Shall we believe in thee when it is the meanest that follow thee?"
text_en_pickthall: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee ?
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Shall we believe thee, whom the vilest follow?’

text_ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: He responded, “And what knowledge do I have of what they do?
text_en_yusufali: He said: "And what do I know as to what they do?
text_en_pickthall: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past) ?
text_en_arberry: He said, ’What knowledge have I of that they have been doing?

text_ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
text_en_primary: Their judgment is with my Lord, if you had any sense!
text_en_yusufali: "Their account is only with my Lord, if ye could (but) understand.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord’s concern, if ye but knew;
text_en_arberry: Their account falls only upon my Lord, were you but aware.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: I am not going to expel the believers.
text_en_yusufali: "I am not one to drive away those who believe.
text_en_pickthall: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.
text_en_arberry: I would not drive away the believers;

text_ar: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: I am only sent with a clear warning.”
text_en_yusufali: "I am sent only to warn plainly in public."
text_en_pickthall: I am only a plain warner.
text_en_arberry: ’I am naught but a plain warner.’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
text_en_primary: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O  Noah, you will surely be stoned ˹to death˺.”
text_en_yusufali: They said: "If thou desist not, O Noah! thou shalt be stoned (to death)."
text_en_pickthall: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).
text_en_arberry: They said, ’If thou givest not over, Noah, thou shalt assuredly be one of the stoned.’

text_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
text_en_primary: Noah prayed, “My Lord! My people have truly rejected me.
text_en_yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! truly my people have rejected me.
text_en_pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.
text_en_arberry: He said, ’My Lord, my people have cried me lies,

text_ar: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers with me.”
text_en_yusufali: "Judge Thou, then, between me and them openly, and deliver me and those of the Believers who are with me."
text_en_pickthall: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.
text_en_arberry: so give true deliverance between me and them, and deliver me and the believers that are with me.

text_ar: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
text_en_primary: So We saved him and those with him in the fully loaded Ark.
text_en_yusufali: So We delivered him and those with him, in the Ark filled (with all creatures).
text_en_pickthall: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
text_en_arberry: So We delivered him, and those with him, in the laden ship,

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
text_en_primary: Then afterwards We drowned the rest.
text_en_yusufali: Thereafter We drowned those who remained behind.
text_en_pickthall: Then afterward We drowned the others.
text_en_arberry: then afterwards We drowned the rest.

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.
text_en_yusufali: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
text_en_arberry: Surely in that is a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
text_en_primary: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
text_en_arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.

text_ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
text_en_primary: The people of ’ad rejected the messengers
text_en_yusufali: The ’Ad (people) rejected the apostles.
text_en_pickthall: (The tribe of) A’ad denied the messengers (of Allah).
text_en_arberry: Ad cried lies to the Envoys

text_ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
text_en_primary: when their brother Hûd said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺?
text_en_yusufali: Behold, their brother Hud said to them: "Will ye not fear (God)?
text_en_pickthall: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil) ?
text_en_arberry: when their brother Hood said to them, ’Will you not be godfearing?

text_ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you.
text_en_yusufali: "I am to you an apostle worthy of all trust:
text_en_pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
text_en_arberry: I am for you a faithful Messenger,

text_ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
text_en_primary: So fear Allah, and obey me.
text_en_yusufali: "So fear God and obey me.
text_en_pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
text_en_arberry: so fear you God, and obey you me.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds.
text_en_yusufali: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_arberry: I ask of you no wage for this; my wage falls only upon the Lord of all Being.

text_ar: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةًۭ تَعْبَثُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Why˺ do you build a landmark on every high place in vanity,
text_en_yusufali: "Do ye build a landmark on every high place to amuse yourselves?
text_en_pickthall: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight ?
text_en_arberry: What, do you build on every prominence a sign, sporting,

text_ar: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
text_en_primary: and construct castles, as if you are going to live forever,
text_en_yusufali: "And do ye get for yourselves fine buildings in the hope of living therein (for ever)?
text_en_pickthall: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever ?
text_en_arberry: and do you take to you castles, haply to dwell forever?

text_ar: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
text_en_primary: and act so viciously when you attack ˹others˺?
text_en_yusufali: "And when ye exert your strong hand, do ye do it like men of absolute power?
text_en_pickthall: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants ?
text_en_arberry: When you assault, you assault like tyrants!

text_ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
text_en_primary: So fear Allah, and obey me.
text_en_yusufali: "Now fear God, and obey me.
text_en_pickthall: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
text_en_arberry: So fear you God, and obey you me;

text_ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: Fear the One Who has provided you with ˹the good˺ things you know:
text_en_yusufali: "Yea, fear Him Who has bestowed on you freely all that ye know.
text_en_pickthall: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,
text_en_arberry: and fear Him who has succoured you with what you know,

text_ar: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَٰمٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
text_en_primary: He provided you with cattle, and children,
text_en_yusufali: "Freely has He bestowed on you cattle and sons,-
text_en_pickthall: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.
text_en_arberry: succoured you with flocks and sons,

text_ar: وَجَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
text_en_primary: and gardens, and springs.
text_en_yusufali: "And Gardens and Springs.
text_en_pickthall: And gardens and watersprings.
text_en_arberry: gardens and fountains.

text_ar: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: I truly fear for you the torment of a tremendous day.”
text_en_yusufali: "Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Great Day."
text_en_pickthall: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.
text_en_arberry: ’Indeed, I fear for you the chastisement of a dreadful day.’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
text_en_primary: They responded, “It is all the same to us whether you warn ˹us˺ or not.
text_en_yusufali: They said: "It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or be not among (our) admonishers!
text_en_pickthall: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Alike it is to us, whether thou admonishest, or art not one of the admonishers;

text_ar: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: This is simply the tradition of our predecessors.
text_en_yusufali: "This is no other than a customary device of the ancients,
text_en_pickthall: This is but a fable of the men of old,
text_en_arberry: this is nothing but the habit of the ancients,

text_ar: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
text_en_primary: And we will never be punished.”
text_en_yusufali: "And we are not the ones to receive Pains and Penalties!"
text_en_pickthall: And we shall not be doomed.
text_en_arberry: and we shall not be chastised.’

text_ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.
text_en_yusufali: So they rejected him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
text_en_pickthall: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
text_en_arberry: So they cried him lies; then We destroyed them. Surely in that is a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
text_en_primary: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
text_en_arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.

text_ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
text_en_primary: The people of Thamûd rejected the messengers
text_en_yusufali: The Thamud (people) rejected the apostles.
text_en_pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)
text_en_arberry: Thamood cried lies to the Envoys

text_en_primary: when their brother salih said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺?
text_en_yusufali: Behold, their brother Salih said to them: "Will you not fear (God)?
text_en_pickthall: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil) ?
text_en_arberry: when their brother Salih said to them, ’Will you not be godfearing?

text_en_primary: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you.
text_en_yusufali: "I am to you an apostle worthy of all trust.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
text_en_arberry: am for you a faithful Messenger,

text_ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
text_en_primary: So fear Allah, and obey me.
text_en_yusufali: "So fear God, and obey me.
text_en_pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
text_en_arberry: so fear you God, and obey you me.’

text_ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds.
text_en_yusufali: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_arberry: ’I ask of you no wage for this; my wage falls only upon the Lord of all Being.

text_ar: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Do you think you will be ˹forever˺ left secure in what you have here:
text_en_yusufali: "Will ye be left secure, in (the enjoyment of) all that ye have here?-
text_en_pickthall: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,
text_en_arberry: Will you be left secure in this here,

text_ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: amid gardens and springs,
text_en_yusufali: "Gardens and Springs,
text_en_pickthall: In gardens and watersprings.
text_en_arberry: among gardens and fountains,

text_ar: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَنَخْلٍۢ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: and ˹various˺ crops, and palm trees ˹loaded˺ with tender fruit;
text_en_yusufali: "And corn-fields and date-palms with spathes near breaking (with the weight of fruit)?
text_en_pickthall: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,
text_en_arberry: sown fields, and palms with slender spathes?

text_ar: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا فَٰرِهِينَ
text_en_primary: to carve homes in the mountains with great skill?
text_en_yusufali: "And ye carve houses out of (rocky) mountains with great skill.
text_en_pickthall: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful ?
text_en_arberry: Will you still skilfully hew houses out of the mountains?

text_ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
text_en_primary: So fear Allah, and obey me.
text_en_yusufali: "But fear God and obey me;
text_en_pickthall: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,
text_en_arberry: So fear you God, and obey you me;

text_ar: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
text_en_primary: And do not follow the command of the transgressors,
text_en_yusufali: "And follow not the bidding of those who are extravagant,-
text_en_pickthall: And obey not the command of the prodigal,
text_en_arberry: and obey not the commandment of the prodigal

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
text_en_primary: who spread corruption throughout the land, never setting things right.”
text_en_yusufali: "Who make mischief in the land, and mend not (their ways)."
text_en_pickthall: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.
text_en_arberry: who do corruption in the earth, and set not things aright.’

text_ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
text_en_primary: They replied, “You are simply bewitched!
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
text_en_pickthall: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Thou art merely one of those that are bewitched;

text_ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
text_en_primary: You are only a human being like us, so bring forth a sign if what you say is true.”
text_en_yusufali: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us: then bring us a Sign, if thou tellest the truth!"
text_en_pickthall: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.
text_en_arberry: thou art naught but a mortal, like us; then produce a sign, if thou art one of the truthful.’

text_ar: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
text_en_primary: salih said, “Here is a camel. She will have her turn to drink as you have yours, each on an appointed day.
text_en_yusufali: He said: "Here is a she-camel: she has a right of watering, and ye have a right of watering, (severally) on a day appointed.
text_en_pickthall: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.
text_en_arberry: He said, ’This is a she-camel; to her a draught and to you a draught, on a day appointed,

text_ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: And do not ever touch her with harm, or you will be overtaken by the torment of a tremendous day.”
text_en_yusufali: "Touch her not with harm, lest the Penalty of a Great Day seize you."
