text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ يَرْجُونَ تِجَٰرَةًۭ لَّن تَبُورَ
text_en_primary: Surely those who recite the Book of Allah, establish prayer, and donate from what We have provided for them—secretly and openly—˹can˺ hope for an exchange that will never fail,
text_en_yusufali: Those who rehearse the Book of God, establish regular Prayer, and spend (in Charity) out of what We have provided for them, secretly and openly, hope for a commerce that will never fail:
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who read the Scripture of Allah, and establish worship, and spend of that which We have bestowed on them secretly and openly, they look forward to imperishable gain,
text_en_arberry: Surely those who recite the Book of God and perform the prayer, and expend of that We have provided them, secretly and in public, look for a commerce that comes not to naught,

text_ar: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌۭ
text_en_primary: so that He will reward them in full and increase them out of His grace. He is truly All-Forgiving, Most Appreciative.
text_en_yusufali: For He will pay them their meed, nay, He will give them (even) more out of His Bounty: for He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate (service).
text_en_pickthall: That He will pay them their wages and increase them of His grace. Lo! He is Forgiving, Responsive.
text_en_arberry: that He may pay them in full their wages and enrich them of His bounty; surely He is All-forgiving, All-thankful.

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
text_en_primary: The Book We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ is the truth, confirming what came before it. Surely Allah is All-Aware, All-Seeing of His servants.
text_en_yusufali: That which We have revealed to thee of the Book is the Truth,- confirming what was (revealed) before it: for God is assuredly- with respect to His Servants - well acquainted and Fully Observant.
text_en_pickthall: As for that which We inspire in thee of the Scripture, it is the Truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it. Lo! Allah is indeed Observer, Seer of His slaves.
text_en_arberry: And that We have revealed to thee of the Book is the truth, confirming what is before it; God is aware of and sees His servants.

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
text_en_primary: Then We granted the Book to those We have chosen from Our servants. Some of them wrong themselves, some follow a middle course, and some are foremost in good deeds by Allah’s Will. That is ˹truly˺ the greatest bounty.
text_en_yusufali: Then We have given the Book for inheritance to such of Our Servants as We have chosen: but there are among them some who wrong their own souls; some who follow a middle course; and some who are, by God’s leave, foremost in good deeds; that is the highest Grace.
text_en_pickthall: Then We gave the Scripture as inheritance unto those whom We elected of Our bondmen. But of them are some who wrong themselves and of them are some who are lukewarm, and of them are some who outstrip (others) through good deeds, by Allah’s leave. That is the great favour!
text_en_arberry: Then We bequeathed the Book on those of Our servants We chose; but of them some wrong themselves, some of them are lukewarm, and some are outstrippers in good works by the leave of God; that is the great bounty.

text_ar: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ
text_en_primary: They will enter the Gardens of Eternity, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their clothing will be silk.
text_en_yusufali: Gardens of Eternity will they enter: therein will they be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls; and their garments there will be of silk.
text_en_pickthall: Gardens of Eden! They enter them wearing armlets of gold and pearl and their raiment therein is silk.
text_en_arberry: Gardens of Eden they shall enter; therein they shall be adorned with bracelets of gold and with pearls, and their apparel there shall be of silk.

text_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌ
text_en_primary: And they will say, “Praise be to Allah, Who has kept away from us all ˹causes of˺ sorrow. Our Lord is indeed All-Forgiving, Most Appreciative.
text_en_yusufali: And they will say: "Praise be to God, Who has removed from us (all) sorrow: for our Lord is indeed Oft-Forgiving Ready to appreciate (service):
text_en_pickthall: And they say: Praise be to Allah Who hath put grief away from us. Lo! Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful,
text_en_arberry: And they shall say, ’Praise belongs to God who has put away all sorrow from us. Surely our Lord is All-forgiving, All-thankful,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌۭ
text_en_primary: ˹He is the One˺ Who—out of His grace—has settled us in the Home of Everlasting Stay, where we will be touched by neither fatigue nor weariness.”
text_en_yusufali: "Who has, out of His Bounty, settled us in a Home that will last: no toil nor sense of weariness shall touch us therein."
text_en_pickthall: Who, of His grace, hath installed us in the mansion of eternity, where toil toucheth us not nor can weariness affect us.
text_en_arberry: who of His bounty has made us to dwell in the abode of everlasting life wherein no weariness assails us neither fatigue.’

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍۢ
text_en_primary: As for the disbelievers, they will have the Fire of Hell, where they will not be ˹allowed to be˺ finished by death, nor will its torment be lightened for them. This is how We reward every ˹stubborn˺ disbeliever.
text_en_yusufali: But those who reject (God) - for them will be the Fire of Hell: No term shall be determined for them, so they should die, nor shall its Penalty be lightened for them. Thus do We reward every ungrateful one!
text_en_pickthall: But as for those who disbelieve, for them is fire of hell; it taketh not complete effect upon them so that they can die, nor is its torment lightened for them. Thus We punish every ingrate.
text_en_arberry: As for the unbelievers, theirs shall be the fire of Gehenna; they shall neither be done with and die, nor shall its chastisement be lightened for them. Even so We recompense every ungrateful one.

text_ar: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
text_en_primary: There they will be ˹fervently˺ screaming, “Our Lord! Take us out ˹and send us back˺. We will do good, unlike what we used to do.” ˹They will be told,˺ “Did We not give you lives long enough so that whoever wanted to be mindful could have done so? And the warner came to you. So taste ˹the punishment˺, for the wrongdoers have no helper.”
text_en_yusufali: Therein will they cry aloud (for assistance): "Our Lord! Bring us out: we shall work righteousness, not the (deeds) we used to do!" - "Did We not give you long enough life so that he that would should receive admonition? and (moreover) the warner came to you. So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds): for the wrong-doers there is no helper."
text_en_pickthall: And they cry for help there, (saying): Our Lord! Release us; we will do right, not (the wrong) that we used to do. Did not We grant you a life long enough for him who reflected to reflect therein ? And the warner came unto you. Now taste (the flavour of your deeds), for evil-doers have no helper.
text_en_arberry: Therein they shall shout, ’Our Lord, bring us forth, and we will do righteousness, other than what we have done.’ ’What, did We not give you long life, enough to remember in for him who would remember? To you the warner came; taste you now! The evildoers shall have no helper.’

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, Allah is the Knower of the unseen of the heavens and the earth. He surely knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart.
text_en_yusufali: Verily God knows (all) the hidden things of the heavens and the earth: verily He has full knowledge of all that is in (men’s) hearts.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! Allah is the Knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Lo! He is Aware of the secret of (men’s) breasts.
text_en_arberry: God knows the Unseen in the heavens and the earth; He knows the thoughts within the breasts.

text_ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًۭا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
text_en_primary: He is the One Who has placed you as successors on earth. So whoever disbelieves will bear ˹the burden of˺ their own disbelief. The disbelievers’ denial only increases them in contempt in the sight of their Lord, and it will only contribute to their loss.
text_en_yusufali: He it is That has made you inheritors in the earth: if, then, any do reject (God), their rejection (works) against themselves: their rejection but adds to the odium for the Unbelievers in the sight of their Lord: their rejection but adds to (their own) undoing.
text_en_pickthall: He it is Who hath made you regents in the earth; so he who disbelieveth, his disbelief be on his own head. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers, in their Lord’s sight, naught save abhorrence. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers naught save loss.
text_en_arberry: It is He who appointed you viceroys in the earth. So whosoever disbelieves, his unbelief shall be charged against him; their unbelief increases the disbelievers only in hate in God’s sight; their unbelief increases the disbelievers only in loss.

text_ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
text_en_primary: Ask ˹them, O  Prophet˺, “Have you considered your associate-gods which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created on earth! Or do they have a share in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens? Or have We given the polytheists a Book, which serves as a clear proof for them? In fact, the wrongdoers promise each other nothing but delusion.”
text_en_yusufali: Say: "Have ye seen (these) ’Partners’ of yours whom ye call upon besides God? Show Me what it is they have created in the (wide) earth. Or have they a share in the heavens? Or have We given them a Book from which they (can derive) clear (evidence)?- Nay, the wrong-doers promise each other nothing but delusions.
text_en_pickthall: Say: Have ye seen your partner-gods to whom ye pray beside Allah ? Show me what they created of the earth! Or have they any portion in the heavens ? Or have We given them a scripture so they act on clear proof therefrom ? Nay, the evil-doers promise one another only to deceive.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’Have you considered your associates on whom you call, apart from God? Show me what they have created in the earth; or have they a partnership in the heavens?’ Or have We given them a Book, so that they are upon a clear sign from it? Nay, but the evildoers promise one another naught but delusion.

text_ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًۭا
text_en_primary: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ keeps the heavens and the earth from falling apart. If they were to fall apart, none but Him could hold them up. He is truly Most Forbearing, All-Forgiving.
text_en_yusufali: It is God Who sustains the heavens and the earth, lest they cease (to function): and if they should fail, there is none - not one - can sustain them thereafter: Verily He is Most Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not, and if they were to deviate there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.
text_en_arberry: God holds the heavens and the earth, lest they remove; did they remove, none would hold them after Him. Surely He is All-clement, All-forgiving.

text_ar: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
text_en_primary: They swore by Allah their most solemn oaths that if a warner were to come to them, they would certainly be better guided than any other community. Yet when a warner did come to them, it only drove them farther away—
text_en_yusufali: They swore their strongest oaths by God that if a warner came to them, they would follow his guidance better than any (other) of the Peoples: But when a warner came to them, it has only increased their flight (from righteousness),-
text_en_pickthall: And they swore by Allah, their most binding oath, that if a warner came unto them they would be more tractable than any of the nations; yet, when a warner came unto them it aroused in them naught save repugnance,
text_en_arberry: They have sworn by God the most earnest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more rightly guided than any one of the nations; but when a warner came to them, it increased them only in aversion,

text_ar: ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
text_en_primary: behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil. But evil plotting only backfires on those who plot. Are they awaiting anything but the fate of those ˹destroyed˺ before? You will find no change in the way of Allah, nor will you find it diverted ˹to someone else˺.
text_en_yusufali: On account of their arrogance in the land and their plotting of Evil, but the plotting of Evil will hem in only the authors thereof. Now are they but looking for the way the ancients were dealt with? But no change wilt thou find in God’s way (of dealing): no turning off wilt thou find in God’s way (of dealing).
text_en_pickthall: (Shown in their) behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil; and the evil plot encloseth but the men who make it. Then, can they expect aught save the treatment of the folk of old ? Thou wilt not find for Allah’s way of treatment any substitute, nor wilt thou find for Allah’s way of treatment aught of power to change.
text_en_arberry: waxing proud in the land, and devising evil; but evil devising encompasses only those who do it; So do they expect anything but the wont of the ancients? And thou shalt never find any changing the Wont of God, and thou shalt never find any altering the wont of God.

text_ar: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًۭا قَدِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might. But there is nothing that can escape Allah in the heavens or the earth. He is certainly All-Knowing, Most Capable.
text_en_yusufali: Do they not travel through the earth, and see what was the End of those before them,- though they were superior to them in strength? Nor is God to be frustrated by anything whatever in the heavens or on earth: for He is All-Knowing. All-Powerful.
text_en_pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power ? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty.
text_en_arberry: What, have they not journeyed in the land and beheld how was the end of those before them? They were stronger than themselves in might; but God -- there is naught in the heavens or the earth that can frustrate Him. Surely He is All-knowing, All-powerful.

text_ar: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
text_en_primary: If Allah were to punish people ˹immediately˺ for what they have committed, He would not have left a single living being on earth. But He delays them for an appointed term. And when their time arrives, then surely Allah is All-Seeing of His servants.
text_en_yusufali: If God were to punish men according to what they deserve. He would not leave on the back of the (earth) a single living creature: but He gives them respite for a stated Term: when their Term expires, verily God has in His sight all His Servants.
text_en_pickthall: If Allah took mankind to task by that which they deserve, He would not leave a living creature on the surface of the earth; but He reprieveth them unto an appointed term, and when their term cometh - then verily (they will know that) Allah is ever Seer of His slaves.
text_en_arberry: If God should take men to task for what they have earned He would not leave upon the face of the earth one creature that crawls; but He is deferring them to a stated term. But when their term is come -- surely God sees His servants.

text_ar: يسٓ
text_en_primary: Ya-Sĩn.
text_en_yusufali: Ya Sin.
text_en_pickthall: Ya Sin.
text_en_arberry: Ya Sin

text_ar: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
text_en_primary: By the Quran, rich in wisdom!
text_en_yusufali: By the Qur’an, full of Wisdom,-
text_en_pickthall: By the wise Qur’an,
text_en_arberry: By the Wise Koran,

text_ar: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
text_en_primary: You ˹O Prophet˺ are truly one of the messengers
text_en_yusufali: Thou art indeed one of the apostles,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! thou art of those sent
text_en_arberry: thou art truly among the Envoys

text_ar: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: upon the Straight Path.
text_en_yusufali: On a Straight Way.
text_en_pickthall: On a straight path,
text_en_arberry: on a straight path;

text_ar: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
text_en_primary: ˹This is˺ a revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful,
text_en_yusufali: It is a Revelation sent down by (Him), the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,
text_en_arberry: the sending down of the All-mighty, the All-wise,

text_ar: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
text_en_primary: so that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so are heedless.
text_en_yusufali: In order that thou mayest admonish a people, whose fathers had received no admonition, and who therefore remain heedless (of the Signs of God).
text_en_pickthall: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
text_en_arberry: that thou mayest warn a people whose fathers were never warned, so they are heedless.

text_ar: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: The decree ˹of torment˺ has already been justified against most of them, for they will never believe.
text_en_yusufali: The Word is proved true against the greater part of them: for they do not believe.
text_en_pickthall: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.
text_en_arberry: The Word has been realised against most of them, yet they do not believe.

text_ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹It is as if˺ We have put shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced up,
text_en_yusufali: We have put yokes round their necks right up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up (and they cannot see).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.
text_en_arberry: Surely We have put on their necks fetters up to the chin, so their heads are raised;

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
text_en_primary: and have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them ˹all˺ up, so they fail to see ˹the truth˺.
text_en_yusufali: And We have put a bar in front of them and a bar behind them, and further, We have covered them up; so that they cannot see.
text_en_pickthall: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.
text_en_arberry: and We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier; and We have covered them, so they do not see.

text_ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: It is the same whether you warn them or not—they will never believe.
text_en_yusufali: The same is it to them whether thou admonish them or thou do not admonish them: they will not believe.
text_en_pickthall: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.
text_en_arberry: Alike it is to them whether thou hast warned them or thou hast not warned them, they do not believe.

text_ar: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
text_en_primary: You can only warn those who follow the Reminder So give them good news of forgiveness and an honourable reward.
text_en_yusufali: Thou canst but admonish such a one as follows the Message and fears the (Lord) Most Gracious, unseen: give such a one, therefore, good tidings, of Forgiveness and a Reward most generous.
text_en_pickthall: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.
text_en_arberry: Thou only warnest him who follows the Remembrance and who fears the All-merciful in the Unseen; so give him the good tidings of forgiveness and a generous wage.

text_ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: It is certainly We Who resurrect the dead, and write what they send forth and what they leave behind. Everything is listed by Us in a perfect Record.
text_en_yusufali: Verily We shall give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before and that which they leave behind, and of all things have We taken account in a clear Book (of evidence).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.
text_en_arberry: Surely it is We who bring the dead to life and write down what they have forwarded and what they have left behind; everything We have numbered in a clear register.

text_ar: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
text_en_primary: Give them an example ˹O Prophet˺ of the residents of a town, when the messengers came to them.
text_en_yusufali: Set forth to them, by way of a parable, the (story of) the Companions of the City. Behold!, there came apostles to it.
text_en_pickthall: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;
text_en_arberry: Strike for them a similitude -- the inhabitants of the city, when the Envoys came to it;

text_ar: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
text_en_primary: We sent them two messengers, but they rejected both. So We reinforced ˹the two˺ with a third, and they declared, “We have indeed been sent to you ˹as messengers˺.”
text_en_yusufali: When We (first) sent to them two apostles, they rejected them: But We strengthened them with a third: they said, "Truly, we have been sent on a mission to you."
text_en_pickthall: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
text_en_arberry: when We sent unto them two men, but they cried them lies, so We sent a third as reinforcement. They said, ’We are assuredly Envoys unto you.

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
text_en_primary: The people replied, “You are only humans like us, and the Most Compassionate has not revealed anything. You are simply lying!”
text_en_yusufali: The (people) said: "Ye are only men like ourselves; and (God) Most Gracious sends no sort of revelation: ye do nothing but lie."
text_en_pickthall: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!
text_en_arberry: They said, ’You are naught but mortals like us; the All-merciful has not sent down anything. You are speaking only lies.’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
text_en_primary: The messengers responded, “Our Lord knows that we have truly been sent to you.
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Our Lord doth know that we have been sent on a mission to you:
text_en_pickthall: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Our Lord knows we are Envoys unto you;

text_ar: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
text_en_primary: And our duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.”
text_en_yusufali: "And our duty is only to proclaim the clear Message."
text_en_pickthall: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).
text_en_arberry: and it is only for us to deliver the Manifest Message.’

text_ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: The people replied, “We definitely see you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you ˹to death˺ and you will be touched with a painful punishment from us.”
text_en_yusufali: The (people) said: "for us, we augur an evil omen from you: if ye desist not, we will certainly stone you. And a grievous punishment indeed will be inflicted on you by us."
text_en_pickthall: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.
text_en_arberry: They said, ’We augur ill of you. If you give not over, we will stone you and there shall visit you from us a painful chastisement.’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
text_en_primary: The messengers said, “Your bad omen lies within yourselves. Are you saying this because you are reminded ˹of the truth˺? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”
text_en_yusufali: They said: "Your evil omens are with yourselves: (deem ye this an evil omen). If ye are admonished? Nay, but ye are a people transgressing all bounds!"
text_en_pickthall: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth) ? Nay, but ye are froward folk!
text_en_arberry: They said, ’Your augury is with you; if you are reminded? But you are a prodigal people.’

text_ar: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
text_en_primary: Then from the farthest end of the city a man came, rushing. He advised, “O my people! Follow the messengers.
text_en_yusufali: Then there came running, from the farthest part of the City, a man, saying, "O my people! Obey the apostles:
text_en_pickthall: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!
text_en_arberry: Then came a man from the furthest part of the city, running; he said, ’My people, follow the Envoys!

text_ar: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
text_en_primary: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and are ˹rightly˺ guided.
text_en_yusufali: "Obey those who ask no reward of you (for themselves), and who have themselves received Guidance.
text_en_pickthall: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.
text_en_arberry: Follow such as ask no wage of you, that are right-guided.

text_ar: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
text_en_primary: And why should I not worship the One Who has originated me, and to Whom you will be returned.
text_en_yusufali: "It would not be reasonable in me if I did not serve Him Who created me, and to Whom ye shall (all) be brought back.
text_en_pickthall: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back ?
text_en_arberry: And why should I not serve Him who originated me, and unto whom you shall be returned?

text_ar: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
text_en_primary: How could I take besides Him other gods whose intercession would not be of any benefit to me, nor could they save me if the Most Compassionate intended to harm me?
text_en_yusufali: "Shall I take (other) gods besides Him? If (God) Most Gracious should intend some adversity for me, of no use whatever will be their intercession for me, nor can they deliver me.
text_en_pickthall: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save ?
text_en_arberry: What, shall I take, apart from Him, gods whose intercession, if the All-merciful desires affliction for me, shall not avail me anything, and who will never deliver me?

text_ar: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
text_en_primary: Indeed, I would then be clearly astray.
text_en_yusufali: "I would indeed, if I were to do so, be in manifest Error.
text_en_pickthall: Then truly I should be in error manifest.
text_en_arberry: Surely in that case I should be in manifest error.

text_ar: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
text_en_primary: I do believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”
text_en_yusufali: "For me, I have faith in the Lord of you (all): listen, then, to me!"
text_en_pickthall: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!
text_en_arberry: Behold, I believe in your Lord; therefore hear me!’

text_ar: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹But they killed him, then˺ he was told ˹by the angels˺, “Enter Paradise!” He said, “If only my people knew
text_en_yusufali: It was said: "Enter thou the Garden." He said: "Ah me! Would that my People knew (what I know)!-
text_en_pickthall: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew
text_en_arberry: It was said, ’Enter Paradise!’ He said, ’Ah, would that my people had knowledge

text_ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
text_en_primary: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honourable.”
text_en_yusufali: "For that my Lord has granted me Forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour!"
text_en_pickthall: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!
text_en_arberry: that my Lord has forgiven me and that He has placed me among the honoured.’

text_ar: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
text_en_primary: We did not send any soldiers from the heavens against his people after his death, nor did We need to.
text_en_yusufali: And We sent not down against his People, after him, any hosts from heaven, nor was it needful for Us so to do.
text_en_pickthall: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.
text_en_arberry: And We sent not down upon his people, after him, any host out of heaven; neither would We send any down.

text_ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
text_en_primary: All it took was one ˹mighty˺ blast, and they were extinguished at once.
text_en_yusufali: It was no more than a single mighty Blast, and behold! they were (like ashes) quenched and silent.
text_en_pickthall: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.
text_en_arberry: It was only one Cry and lo, they were silent and still.

text_ar: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
text_en_primary: Oh pity, such beings! No messenger ever came to them without being mocked.
text_en_yusufali: Ah! Alas for (My) Servants! There comes not an apostle to them but they mock him!
text_en_pickthall: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!
text_en_arberry: Ah, woe for those servants! Never comes unto them a Messenger, but they mock at him.

text_ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
text_en_primary: Have the deniers not considered how many peoples We destroyed before them who never came back to life again?
text_en_yusufali: See they not how many generations before them we destroyed? Not to them will they return:
text_en_pickthall: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;
text_en_arberry: What, have they not seen how many generations We have destroyed before them, and that it is not unto them that they return?

text_ar: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
text_en_primary: Yet they will all be brought before Us.
text_en_yusufali: But each one of them all - will be brought before Us (for judgment).
text_en_pickthall: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.
text_en_arberry: They shall every one of them be arraigned before Us.

text_ar: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
text_en_primary: There is a sign for them in the dead earth: We give it life, producing grain from it for them to eat.
text_en_yusufali: A Sign for them is the earth that is dead: We do give it life, and produce grain therefrom, of which ye do eat.
text_en_pickthall: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;
text_en_arberry: And a sign for them is the dead land, that We quickened and brought forth from it grain, whereof they eat;

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
text_en_primary: And We have placed in it gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth in it,
text_en_yusufali: And We produce therein orchard with date-palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth therein:
text_en_pickthall: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,
text_en_arberry: and We made therein gardens of palms and vines, and therein We caused fountains to gush forth,

text_ar: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
text_en_primary: so that they may eat from its fruit, which they had no hand in making. Will they not then give thanks?
text_en_yusufali: That they may enjoy the fruits of this (artistry): It was not their hands that made this: will they not then give thanks?
text_en_pickthall: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks ?
text_en_arberry: that they might eat of its fruits and their hands’ labour. What, will they not be thankful?

text_ar: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: Glory be to the One Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs—˹be it˺ what the earth produces, their genders, or what they do not know!
text_en_yusufali: Glory to God, Who created in pairs all things that the earth produces, as well as their own (human) kind and (other) things of which they have no knowledge.
text_en_pickthall: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!
text_en_arberry: Glory be to Him, who created all the pairs of what the earth produces, and of themselves, and of what they know not.

text_ar: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
text_en_primary: There is also a sign for them in the night: We strip from it daylight, then—behold!—they are in darkness.
text_en_yusufali: And a Sign for them is the Night: We withdraw therefrom the Day, and behold they are plunged in darkness;
text_en_pickthall: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.
text_en_arberry: And a sign for them is the night; We strip it of the day and lo, they are in darkness.

text_ar: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
text_en_primary: The sun travels for its fixed term. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing.
text_en_yusufali: And the sun runs his course for a period determined for him: that is the decree of (Him), the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing.
text_en_pickthall: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
text_en_arberry: And the sun -- it runs to a fixed resting-place; that is the ordaining of the All-mighty, the All-knowing.

text_ar: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
text_en_primary: As for the moon, We have ordained ˹precise˺ phases for it, until it ends up like an old, curved palm stalk.
text_en_yusufali: And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk.
text_en_pickthall: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
text_en_arberry: And the moon -- We have determined it by stations, till it returns like an aged palm-bough.

text_ar: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
text_en_primary: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor does the night outrun the day. Each is travelling in an orbit of their own.
text_en_yusufali: It is not permitted to the Sun to catch up the Moon, nor can the Night outstrip the Day: Each (just) swims along in (its own) orbit (according to Law).
text_en_pickthall: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
text_en_arberry: It behoves not the sun to overtake the moon, neither does the night outstrip the day, each swimming in a sky.

text_ar: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
text_en_primary: Another sign for them is that We carried their ancestors ˹with Noah˺ in the fully loaded Ark,
text_en_yusufali: And a Sign for them is that We bore their race (through the Flood) in the loaded Ark;
text_en_pickthall: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,
text_en_arberry: And a sign for them is that We carried their seed in the laden ship,

text_ar: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
text_en_primary: and created for them similar things to ride in.
text_en_yusufali: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride.
text_en_pickthall: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
text_en_arberry: and We have created for them the like of it whereon they ride;

text_ar: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
text_en_primary: If We willed, We could drown them: then no one would respond to their cries, nor would they be rescued—
text_en_yusufali: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered,
text_en_pickthall: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
text_en_arberry: and if We will, We drown them, then none have they to cry to, neither are they delivered,

text_ar: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: except by mercy from Us, allowing them enjoyment for a ˹little˺ while.
text_en_yusufali: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time.
text_en_pickthall: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
text_en_arberry: save as a mercy from Us, and enjoyment for a while.

text_ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Still they turn away˺ when it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you ˹in the Hereafter˺ and what is behind you ˹of destroyed nations˺ so you may be shown mercy.”
text_en_yusufali: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back).
text_en_pickthall: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
text_en_arberry: And when it is said to them, ’Fear what is before you and what is behind you; haply you will find mercy’ --

text_ar: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
text_en_primary: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it.
text_en_yusufali: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom.
text_en_pickthall: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!
text_en_arberry: yet never any sign of the signs of their Lord comes to them, but they are turning away from it.

text_ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: And when it is said to them, “Donate from what Allah has provided for you,” the disbelievers say to the believers, “Why should we feed those whom Allah could have fed if He wanted to? You are clearly astray!”
text_en_yusufali: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which God has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if God had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error."
text_en_pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed ? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
text_en_arberry: And when it is said to them, ’Expend of that God has provided you,’ the unbelievers say to the believers, ’What, shall we feed such a one whom, if God willed, He would feed? You are only in manifest error!’

text_ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
text_en_primary: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”
text_en_yusufali: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true?"
text_en_pickthall: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful ?
text_en_arberry: They also say, ’When shall this promise come to pass, if you speak truly?’

text_ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
text_en_primary: They must be awaiting a single Blast, which will seize them while they are ˹entrenched˺ in ˹worldly˺ disputes.
text_en_yusufali: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!
text_en_pickthall: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.
text_en_arberry: They are awaiting only for one Cry to seize them while they are yet disputing,

text_ar: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
text_en_primary: Then they will not be able to make a ˹last˺ will, nor can they return to their own people.
text_en_yusufali: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!
text_en_pickthall: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
text_en_arberry: then they will not be able to make any testament, nor will they return to their people.

text_ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
text_en_primary: The Trumpet will be blown ˹a second time˺, then—behold!—they will rush from the graves to their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
text_en_pickthall: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
text_en_arberry: And the Trumpet shall be blown; then behold, they are sliding down from their tombs unto their Lord.

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
text_en_primary: They will cry, “Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of rest? This must be what the Most Compassionate warned us of; the messengers told the truth!”
text_en_yusufali: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (God) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the apostles!"
text_en_pickthall: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep ? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
text_en_arberry: They say, ’Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping place? This is what the All-merciful promised, and the Envoys spoke truly.’

text_ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
text_en_primary: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will all be brought before Us.
text_en_yusufali: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!
text_en_pickthall: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!
text_en_arberry: ’It was only one Cry; then behold, they are all arraigned before Us.

text_ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be rewarded except for what you used to do.
text_en_yusufali: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.
text_en_pickthall: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.
text_en_arberry: So today no soul shall be wronged anything, and you shall not be recompensed, except according to what you have been doing.

text_ar: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, on that Day the residents of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves.
text_en_yusufali: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,
text_en_arberry: See, the inhabitants of Paradise today are busy in their rejoicing,

text_ar: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
text_en_primary: They and their spouses will be in ˹cool˺ shade, reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches.
text_en_yusufali: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);
text_en_pickthall: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;
text_en_arberry: they and their spouses, reclining upon couches in the shade;

text_ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
text_en_primary: There they will have fruits and whatever they desire.
text_en_yusufali: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;
text_en_pickthall: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
text_en_arberry: therein they have fruits, and they have all that they call for.

text_ar: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: And “Peace!” will be ˹their˺ greeting from the Merciful Lord.
text_en_yusufali: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
text_en_pickthall: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
text_en_arberry: ’Peace!’ -- such is the greeting, from a Lord All-compassionate.

text_ar: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Then the disbelievers will be told,˺ “Step away ˹from the believers˺ this Day, O  wicked ones!
text_en_yusufali: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!
text_en_pickthall: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
text_en_arberry: ’Now keep yourselves apart, you sinners, upon this day!

text_ar: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: Did I not command you, O  Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy,
text_en_yusufali: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-
text_en_pickthall: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
text_en_arberry: Made I not covenant with you, Children of Adam, that you should not serve Satan -- surely he is a manifest foe to you --

text_ar: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path.
text_en_yusufali: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?
text_en_pickthall: But that ye worship Me ? That was the right path.
text_en_arberry: and that you should serve Me? This is a straight path.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
text_en_primary: Yet he already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not have any sense?
text_en_yusufali: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?
text_en_pickthall: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense ?
text_en_arberry: He led astray many a throng of you; did you not understand?

text_ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
text_en_primary: This is the Hell you were warned of.
text_en_yusufali: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
text_en_pickthall: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
text_en_arberry: This is Gehenna, then, the same that you were promised;

text_ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
text_en_primary: Burn in it Today for your disbelief.”
text_en_yusufali: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."
text_en_pickthall: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
text_en_arberry: roast well in it today, for that you were unbelievers!’

text_ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
text_en_primary: On this Day We will seal their mouths, their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to what they used to commit.
text_en_yusufali: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
text_en_pickthall: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
text_en_arberry: Today We set a seal on their mouths, and their hands speak to Us, and their feet bear witness as to what they have been earning.

text_ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Had We willed, We could have easily blinded their eyes, so they would struggle to find their way. How then could they see?
text_en_yusufali: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?
text_en_pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen ?
text_en_arberry: Did We will, We would have obliterated their eyes, then they would race to the path, but how would they see?

text_ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
text_en_primary: And had We willed, We could have transfigured them on the spot, so they could neither progress forward nor turn back.
text_en_yusufali: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).
text_en_pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
text_en_arberry: Did We will, We would have changed them where they were, then they could not go on, nor could they return.

text_ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
text_en_primary: And whoever We grant a long life, We reverse them in development. Will they not then understand?
text_en_yusufali: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
text_en_pickthall: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense ?
text_en_arberry: And to whomsoever We give long life, We bend him over in His constitution; what, do they not understand?

text_ar: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This ˹Book˺ is only a Reminder and a clear Quran
text_en_yusufali: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur’an making things clear:
text_en_pickthall: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
text_en_arberry: We have not taught him poetry; it is not seemly for him. It is only a Remembrance and a Clear Koran,

text_ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
text_en_primary: to warn whoever is ˹truly˺ alive and fulfil the decree ˹of torment˺ against the disbelievers.
text_en_yusufali: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).
text_en_pickthall: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
text_en_arberry: that he may warn whosoever is living, and that the Word may be realized against the unbelievers.

text_ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
text_en_primary: Do they not see that We singlehandedly created for them, among other things, cattle which are under their control?
text_en_yusufali: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-
text_en_pickthall: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,
text_en_arberry: Have they not seen how that We have created for them of that Our hands wrought cattle that they own?

text_ar: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
text_en_primary: And We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to them, so they may ride some and eat others.
text_en_yusufali: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:
text_en_pickthall: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food ?
text_en_arberry: We have subdued them to them, and some of them they ride, and some they eat;

text_ar: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
text_en_primary: And they derive from them other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks?
text_en_yusufali: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
text_en_pickthall: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks ?
text_en_arberry: other uses also they have in them, and beverages. What, will they not be thankful?

text_ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
text_en_primary: Still they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped ˹by them˺.
text_en_yusufali: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than God, (hoping) that they might be helped!
text_en_pickthall: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
text_en_arberry: Yet they have taken, apart from God, gods; haply they might be helped.

text_ar: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
text_en_primary: They cannot help the pagans, even though they serve the idols as dedicated guards.
text_en_yusufali: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).
text_en_pickthall: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.
text_en_arberry: They cannot help them, though they be hosts made ready for them.

text_ar: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
text_en_primary: So do not let their words grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. Indeed, We ˹fully˺ know what they conceal and what they reveal.
text_en_yusufali: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.
text_en_pickthall: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
text_en_arberry: So do not let their saying grieve thee; assuredly We know what they keep secret and what they publish.

text_ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: Do people not see that We have created them from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Us˺?
text_en_yusufali: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!
text_en_pickthall: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed ? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
text_en_arberry: Has not man regarded how that We created him of a sperm-drop? Then lo, he is a manifest adversary.

text_ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: And they argue with Us—forgetting they were created—saying, “Who will give life to decayed bones?”
text_en_yusufali: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"
text_en_pickthall: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away ?
text_en_arberry: And he has struck for Us a similitude and forgotten his creation; he says, ’Who shall quicken the bones when they are decayed?’

text_ar: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “They will be revived by the One Who produced them the first time, for He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of every created being.
text_en_yusufali: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-
text_en_pickthall: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
text_en_arberry: Say: ’He shall quicken them, who originated them the first time; He knows all creation,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹He is the One˺ Who gives you fire from green trees, and—behold!—you kindle ˹fire˺ from them.
text_en_yusufali: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!
text_en_pickthall: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
text_en_arberry: who has made for you out of the green tree fire and lo, from it you kindle.’

text_ar: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
text_en_primary: Can the One Who created the heavens and the earth not ˹easily˺ resurrect these ˹deniers˺?” Yes ˹He can˺! For He is the Master Creator, All-Knowing.
text_en_yusufali: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!
text_en_pickthall: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them ? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,
text_en_arberry: Is not He, who created the heavens and earth, able to create the like of them? Yes indeed; He is the All-creator, the All-knowing.

text_ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
text_en_primary: All it takes, when He wills something ˹to be˺, is simply to say to it: “Be!” And it is!
text_en_yusufali: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!
text_en_pickthall: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
text_en_arberry: His command, when He desires a thing, is to say to it ’Be,’ and it is.

text_ar: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
text_en_primary: So glory be to the One in Whose Hands is the authority over all things, and to Whom ˹alone˺ you will ˹all˺ be returned.
text_en_yusufali: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.
text_en_pickthall: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.
text_en_arberry: So glory be to Him, in whose hand is the dominion of everything, and unto whom you shall be returned.

text_ar: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا
text_en_primary: By those ˹angels˺ lined up in ranks,
text_en_yusufali: By those who range themselves in ranks,
text_en_pickthall: By those who set the ranks in battle order
text_en_arberry: By the rangers ranging

text_ar: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا
text_en_primary: and those who diligently drive ˹the clouds˺,
text_en_yusufali: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
text_en_pickthall: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
text_en_arberry: and the scarers scaring

text_ar: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
text_en_primary: and those who recite the Reminder!
text_en_yusufali: And thus proclaim the Message (of God)!
text_en_pickthall: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
text_en_arberry: and the reciters of a Remembrance,

text_ar: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌۭ
text_en_primary: Surely your God is One!
text_en_yusufali: Verily, verily, your God is one!-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
text_en_arberry: surely your God is One,

text_ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
text_en_primary: ˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, and the Lord of all points of sunrise.
text_en_yusufali: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
text_en_pickthall: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun’s risings.
text_en_arberry: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and of what between them is Lord of the Easts.

text_ar: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration
text_en_yusufali: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
text_en_arberry: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars

text_ar: وَحِفْظًۭا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّارِدٍۢ
text_en_primary: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil.
text_en_yusufali: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
text_en_pickthall: With security from every froward devil.
text_en_arberry: and to preserve against every rebel Satan;

text_ar: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ
text_en_primary: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side,
text_en_yusufali: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
text_en_pickthall: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
text_en_arberry: they listen not to the High Council, for they are pelted from every side,

text_ar: دُحُورًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ وَاصِبٌ
text_en_primary: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment.
text_en_yusufali: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
text_en_pickthall: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
text_en_arberry: rejected, and theirs is an everlasting chastisement,

text_ar: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ
text_en_primary: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare.
text_en_yusufali: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
text_en_pickthall: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame
text_en_arberry: except such as snatches a fragment, and he is pursued by a piercing flame.

text_ar: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
text_en_primary: So ask them ˹O Prophet˺, which is harder to create: them or other marvels of Our creation?
text_en_yusufali: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
text_en_pickthall: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created ? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
text_en_arberry: So ask them for a pronouncement -- Are they stronger in constitution, or those We created? We created them of clinging clay.

text_ar: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
text_en_primary: In fact, you are astonished ˹by their denial˺, while they ridicule ˹you˺.
text_en_yusufali: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
text_en_arberry: Nay, thou marvellest; and they scoff

text_ar: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
text_en_primary: When they are reminded, they are never mindful.
text_en_yusufali: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
text_en_pickthall: And heed not when they are reminded,
text_en_arberry: and, when reminded, do not remember

text_ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
text_en_primary: And whenever they see a sign, they make fun of it,
text_en_yusufali: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
text_en_pickthall: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
text_en_arberry: and, when they see a sign, would scoff;

text_ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
text_en_primary: saying, “This is nothing but pure magic.
text_en_yusufali: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
text_en_pickthall: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
text_en_arberry: and they say, ’This is nothing but manifest sorcery.

text_ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
text_en_primary: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?
text_en_yusufali: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
text_en_pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again) ?
text_en_arberry: What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be raised up?

text_ar: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
text_en_primary: And our forefathers as well?”
text_en_yusufali: "And also our fathers of old?"
text_en_pickthall: And our forefathers ?
text_en_arberry: What, and our fathers, the ancients?’

text_ar: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Say, “Yes! And you will be fully humbled.”
text_en_yusufali: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
text_en_pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’Yes, and in all lowliness.’

text_ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
text_en_primary: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will see ˹it all˺.
text_en_yusufali: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
text_en_pickthall: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
text_en_arberry: For it is only a single scaring, then behold, they are watching

text_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: They will cry, “Oh, woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”
text_en_yusufali: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
text_en_pickthall: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
text_en_arberry: and they say, ’Woe, alas for us! This is the Day of Doom.’

text_ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”
text_en_yusufali: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
text_en_pickthall: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
text_en_arberry: ’This is the Day of Decision, even that you cried lies to.

text_ar: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship
text_en_yusufali: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
text_en_pickthall: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
text_en_arberry: Muster those who did evil, their wives, and that they were serving,

text_ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
text_en_primary: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell.
text_en_yusufali: "Besides God, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
text_en_pickthall: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
text_en_arberry: apart from God, and guide them unto the path of Hell!

text_ar: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
text_en_primary: And detain them, for they must be questioned.”
text_en_yusufali: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
text_en_pickthall: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
text_en_arberry: And halt them, to be questioned:

text_ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”
text_en_yusufali: "’What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?’"
text_en_pickthall: What aileth you that ye help not one another ?
text_en_arberry: "Why help you not one another?"

text_ar: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
text_en_primary: In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive.
text_en_yusufali: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
text_en_arberry: No indeed; but today they resign themselves in submission

text_ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
text_en_primary: They will turn on each other, throwing blame.
text_en_yusufali: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
text_en_pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
text_en_arberry: and advance one upon another, asking each other questions.

text_ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
text_en_primary: The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”
text_en_yusufali: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
text_en_pickthall: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
text_en_arberry: These say, ’Why, you of old would come to us from the right hand.’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own.
text_en_yusufali: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
text_en_pickthall: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
text_en_arberry: Those say, ’No; on the contrary, you were not believers;

text_ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ
text_en_primary: We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people.
text_en_yusufali: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
text_en_pickthall: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
text_en_arberry: we had no authority over you; no, you were an insolent people.

text_ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
text_en_primary: The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺.
text_en_yusufali: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
text_en_pickthall: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
text_en_arberry: So our Lord’s Word is realised against us; we are tasting it.

text_ar: فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
text_en_primary: We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”
text_en_yusufali: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
text_en_pickthall: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
text_en_arberry: Therefore we perverted you, and we ourselves were perverts.’

text_ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
text_en_primary: Surely on that Day they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment.
text_en_yusufali: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
text_en_pickthall: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
text_en_arberry: So all of them on that day are sharers in the chastisement.

text_ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
text_en_primary: That is certainly how We deal with the wicked.
text_en_yusufali: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
text_en_arberry: Even so We do with the sinners;

text_ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
text_en_primary: For whenever it was said to them ˹in the world˺, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah,” they acted arrogantly
text_en_yusufali: For they, when they were told that there is no god except God, would puff themselves up with Pride,
text_en_pickthall: For when it was said unto them, There is no God save Allah, they were scornful
text_en_arberry: for when it was said to them, ’There is no god but God,’ they were ever waxing proud,

text_ar: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
text_en_primary: and argued, “Should we really abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
text_en_yusufali: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
text_en_pickthall: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet ?
text_en_arberry: saying, ’What, shall we forsake our gods for a poet possessed?’

text_ar: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
text_en_primary: In fact, he came with the truth, confirming ˹earlier˺ messengers.
text_en_yusufali: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the apostles (before him).
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
text_en_arberry: ’No indeed; but he brought the truth, and confirmed the Envoys.

text_ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
text_en_primary: You will certainly taste the painful torment,
text_en_yusufali: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
text_en_arberry: Now certainly you shall be tasting the painful chastisement,

text_ar: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: and will only be rewarded for what you used to do.
text_en_yusufali: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
text_en_pickthall: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
text_en_arberry: and not be recompensed, except according to what you were doing.’

text_ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
text_en_primary: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
text_en_yusufali: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of God,-
text_en_pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;
text_en_arberry: Except for God’s sincere servants;

text_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
text_en_primary: They will have a known provision:
text_en_yusufali: For them is a Sustenance determined,
text_en_pickthall: For them there is a known provision,
text_en_arberry: for them awaits a known provision,

text_ar: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
text_en_primary: fruits ˹of every type˺. And they will be honoured
text_en_yusufali: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
text_en_pickthall: Fruits. And they will be honoured
text_en_arberry: fruits -- and they high-honoured

text_ar: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
text_en_primary: in the Gardens of Bliss,
text_en_yusufali: In Gardens of Felicity,
text_en_pickthall: In the Gardens of delight,
text_en_arberry: in the Gardens of Bliss

text_ar: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
text_en_primary: facing each other on thrones.
text_en_yusufali: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
text_en_pickthall: On couches facing one another;
text_en_arberry: upon couches, set face to face,

text_ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
text_en_primary: A drink ˹of pure wine˺ will be passed around to them from a flowing stream:
text_en_yusufali: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
text_en_pickthall: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
text_en_arberry: cup from a spring being passed round to them,
