text_en_yusufali: Hearken ye to your Lord, before there come a Day which there will be no putting back, because of (the Ordainment of) God! that Day there will be for you no place of refuge nor will there be for you any room for denial (of your sins)!
text_en_pickthall: Answer the call of your Lord before there cometh unto you from Allah a Day which there is no averting. Ye have no refuge on that Day, nor have a ye any (power of) refusal.
text_en_arberry: Answer your Lord, before there comes a day from God that cannot be turned back; upon that day you shall have no shelter, no denial.

text_ar: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةًۭ فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورٌۭ
text_en_primary: But if they turn away, We have not sent you ˹O Prophet˺ as a keeper over them. Your duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺. And indeed, when We let someone taste a mercy from Us, they become prideful ˹because˺ of it. But when afflicted with evil because of what their hands have done, then one becomes totally ungrateful.
text_en_yusufali: If then they run away, We have not sent thee as a guard over them. Thy duty is but to convey (the Message). And truly, when We give man a taste of a Mercy from Ourselves, he doth exult thereat, but when some ill happens to him, on account of the deeds which his hands have sent forth, truly then is man ungrateful!
text_en_pickthall: But if they are averse, We have not sent thee as a warder over them. Thine is only to convey (the message). And lo! when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us he exulteth therefor. And if some evil striketh them because of that which their own hands have sent before, then lo! man is an ingrate.
text_en_arberry: But if they turn away, We sent thee not to be a guardian over them. It is for thee only to deliver the Message. And when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if some evil befalls him for that his own hands have forwarded, then surely man is unthankful.

text_ar: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثًۭا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
text_en_primary: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills. He blesses whoever He wills with daughters, and blesses whoever He wills with sons,
text_en_yusufali: To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills (and plans). He bestows (children) male or female according to His Will (and Plan),
text_en_pickthall: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He createth what He will. He bestoweth female (offspring) upon whom He will, and bestoweth male (offspring) upon whom He will;
text_en_arberry: To God belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He will; He gives to whom He will females, and He gives to whom He will males

text_ar: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًۭا وَإِنَٰثًۭا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۭ قَدِيرٌۭ
text_en_primary: or grants both, sons and daughters, ˹to whoever He wills˺, and leaves whoever He wills infertile. He is indeed All-Knowing, Most Capable.
text_en_yusufali: Or He bestows both males and females, and He leaves barren whom He will: for He is full of Knowledge and Power.
text_en_pickthall: Or He mingleth them, males and females, and He maketh barren whom He will. Lo! He is Knower, Powerful.
text_en_arberry: or He couples them, both males and females; and He makes whom He will barren. Surely He is All-knowing, All-powerful.

text_ar: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًۭا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: It is not ˹possible˺ for a human being to have Allah communicate with them, except through inspiration, or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger-angel to reveal whatever He wills by His permission. He is surely Most High, All-Wise.
text_en_yusufali: It is not fitting for a man that God should speak to him except by inspiration, or from behind a veil, or by the sending of a messenger to reveal, with God’s permission, what God wills: for He is Most High, Most Wise.
text_en_pickthall: And it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil, or (that) He sendeth a messenger to reveal what He will by His leave. Lo! He is Exalted, Wise.
text_en_arberry: It belongs not to any mortal that God should speak to him, except by revelation, or from behind a veil, or that He should send a messenger and he reveal whatsoever He will, by His leave; surely He is All-high, All-wise.

text_ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًۭا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُورًۭا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: And so We have sent to you ˹O Prophet˺ a revelation by Our command. You did not know of ˹this˺ Book and faith ˹before˺. But We have made it a light, by which We guide whoever We will of Our servants. And you are truly leading ˹all˺ to the Straight Path—
text_en_yusufali: And thus have We, by Our Command, sent inspiration to thee: thou knewest not (before) what was Revelation, and what was Faith; but We have made the (Qur’an) a Light, wherewith We guide such of Our servants as We will; and verily thou dost guide (men) to the Straight Way,-
text_en_pickthall: And thus have We inspired in thee (Muhammad) a Spirit of Our command. Thou knewest not what the Scripture was, nor what the Faith. But We have made it a light whereby We guide whom We will of Our bondmen. And lo! thou verily dost guide unto a right path,
text_en_arberry: Even so We have revealed to thee a Spirit of Our bidding. Thou knewest not what the Book was, nor belief; but We made it a light, whereby We guide whom We will of Our servants. And thou, surely thou shalt guide unto a straight path --

text_ar: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
text_en_primary: the Path of Allah, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Surely to Allah all matters will return ˹for judgment˺.
text_en_yusufali: The Way of God, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. Behold (how) all affairs tend towards God!
text_en_pickthall: The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Do not all things reach Allah at last ?
text_en_arberry: the path of God, to whom belongs whatsoever is in the heavens, and whatsoever is in the earth. Surely unto God all things come home.

text_ar: حمٓ
text_en_primary: ha-Mĩm.
text_en_yusufali: Ha-Mim
text_en_pickthall: Ha. Mim.
text_en_arberry: Ha Mim

text_ar: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
text_en_primary: By the clear Book!
text_en_yusufali: By the Book that makes things clear,-
text_en_pickthall: By the Scripture which maketh plain,
text_en_arberry: By the Clear Book,

text_ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
text_en_primary: Certainly, We have made it a Quran in Arabic so perhaps you will understand.
text_en_yusufali: We have made it a Qur’an in Arabic, that ye may be able to understand (and learn wisdom).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand.
text_en_arberry: behold, We have made it an Arabic Koran; haply you will understand;

text_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
text_en_primary: And indeed, it is—in the Master Record with Us—highly esteemed, rich in wisdom.
text_en_yusufali: And verily, it is in the Mother of the Book, in Our Presence, high (in dignity), full of wisdom.
text_en_pickthall: And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive.
text_en_arberry: and behold, it is in the Essence of the Book, with Us; sublime indeed, wise.

text_ar: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّسْرِفِينَ
text_en_primary: Should We then turn the ˹Quranic˺ Reminder away from you ˹simply˺ because you have been a transgressing people?
text_en_yusufali: Shall We then take away the Message from you and repel (you), for that ye are a people transgressing beyond bounds?
text_en_pickthall: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk ?
text_en_arberry: Shall We turn away the Remembrance from you, for that you are a prodigal people?

text_ar: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّۢ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹Imagine˺ how many prophets We sent to those ˹destroyed˺ before!
text_en_yusufali: But how many were the prophets We sent amongst the peoples of old?
text_en_pickthall: How many a prophet did We send among the men of old!
text_en_arberry: How many a Prophet We sent among the ancients,

text_ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
text_en_primary: But no prophet ever came to them without being mocked.
text_en_yusufali: And never came there a prophet to them but they mocked him.
text_en_pickthall: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him.
text_en_arberry: but not a Prophet came to them, without they mocked at him;

text_ar: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: So We destroyed those who were far mightier than these ˹Meccans˺. The examples of ˹their˺ predecessors have ˹already˺ been related.
text_en_yusufali: So We destroyed (them)- stronger in power than these;- and (thus) has passed on the Parable of the peoples of old.
text_en_pickthall: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).
text_en_arberry: so We destroyed men stronger in valour than they, and the example of the ancients passed away.

text_ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
text_en_primary: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “The Almighty, All-Knowing did.”
text_en_yusufali: If thou wert to question them, ’Who created the heavens and the earth?’ They would be sure to reply, ’they were created by (Him), the Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge’;-
text_en_pickthall: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;
text_en_arberry: If thou askest them, ’Who created the heavens and earth?’ they will say, ’The All-mighty, the All-knowing created them.’

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for you, and set in it pathways for you so that you may find your way.
text_en_yusufali: (Yea, the same that) has made for you the earth (like a carpet) spread out, and has made for you roads (and channels) therein, in order that ye may find guidance (on the way);
text_en_pickthall: Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way;
text_en_arberry: He who appointed the earth to be a cradle for you, and appointed ways for you therein, that haply you may be guided;

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
text_en_primary: And ˹He is the One˺ Who sends down rain from the sky in perfect measure, with which We give life to a lifeless land. And so will you be brought forth ˹from the grave˺.
text_en_yusufali: That sends down (from time to time) rain from the sky in due measure;- and We raise to life therewith a land that is dead; even so will ye be raised (from the dead);-
text_en_pickthall: And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth;
text_en_arberry: and who sent down out of heaven water in measure; and We revived thereby a land that was dead; even so you shall be brought forth;

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
text_en_primary: And ˹He is the One˺ Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs, and made for you ships and animals to ride
text_en_yusufali: That has created pairs in all things, and has made for you ships and cattle on which ye ride,
text_en_pickthall: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.
text_en_arberry: and who created the pairs, all of them, and appointed for you ships and cattle such as you ride,

text_ar: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
text_en_primary: so that you may sit firmly on their backs, and remember your Lord’s blessings once you are settled on them, saying, “Glory be to the One Who has subjected these for us, for we could have never done so ˹on our own˺.
text_en_yusufali: In order that ye may sit firm and square on their backs, and when so seated, ye may celebrate the (kind) favour of your Lord, and say, "Glory to Him Who has subjected these to our (use), for we could never have accomplished this (by ourselves),
text_en_pickthall: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord’s favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them);
text_en_arberry: that you may be seated on their backs and then remember your Lord’s blessing when you are seated on them, and say, ’Glory be to Him, who has subjected this to us, and we ourselves were not equal to it;

text_ar: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
text_en_primary: And surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return.”
text_en_yusufali: "And to our Lord, surely, must we turn back!"
text_en_pickthall: And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning.
text_en_arberry: surely unto our Lord we are turning.’

text_ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
text_en_primary: Still the pagans have made some of His creation out to be a part of Him. Indeed, humankind is clearly ungrateful.
text_en_yusufali: Yet they attribute to some of His servants a share with Him (in his godhead)! truly is man a blasphemous ingrate avowed!
text_en_pickthall: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.
text_en_arberry: Yet they have assigned to Him a part of His own servants! Man is dearly unthankful.

text_ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍۢ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
text_en_primary: Has He taken ˹angels as His˺ daughters from what He created, and favoured you ˹O pagans˺ with sons?
text_en_yusufali: What! has He taken daughters out of what He himself creates, and granted to you sons for choice?
text_en_pickthall: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons ?
text_en_arberry: Or has He taken to Himself, from that He creates, daughters, and favoured you with sons?

text_ar: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
text_en_primary: Whenever one of them is given the good news of what they attribute to the Most Compassionate, his face grows gloomy, as he suppresses his rage.
text_en_yusufali: When news is brought to one of them of (the birth of) what he sets up as a likeness to (God) Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he is filled with inward grief!
text_en_pickthall: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage.
text_en_arberry: And when any of them is given the good tidings of that he has likened to the All-merciful, his face is darkened, and he chokes inwardly.

text_ar: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹Do they attribute to Him˺ those who are brought up in fineries and are not commanding in disputes?
text_en_yusufali: Is then one brought up among trinkets, and unable to give a clear account in a dispute (to be associated with God)?
text_en_pickthall: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain ?
text_en_arberry: What, one who is reared amid ornaments and, when the time of altercation comes, is not to be seen?

text_ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
text_en_primary: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Most Compassionate, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned!
text_en_yusufali: And they make into females angels who themselves serve God. Did they witness their creation? Their evidence will be recorded, and they will be called to account!
text_en_pickthall: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation ? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.
text_en_arberry: And they have made the angels, who are themselves servants of the All-merciful, females. What, did they witness their creation? Their witness shall be written down, and they shall be questioned.

text_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
text_en_primary: And they argue, “Had the Most Compassionate willed, we would have never worshipped them.” They have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They do nothing but lie.
text_en_yusufali: ("Ah!") they say, "If it had been the will of (God) Most Gracious, we should not have worshipped such (deities)!" Of that they have no knowledge! they do nothing but lie!
text_en_pickthall: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess.
text_en_arberry: They say, ’Had the All-merciful so willed, we would not have served them.’ They have no knowledge of that; they are only conjecturing.

text_ar: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
text_en_primary: Or have We given them a Book ˹for proof˺, before this ˹Quran˺, to which they are holding firm?
text_en_yusufali: What! have We given them a Book before this, to which they are holding fast?
text_en_pickthall: Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur’an) so that they are holding fast thereto ?
text_en_arberry: Or did We bring them a Book aforetime to which they hold?

text_ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
text_en_primary: In fact, they say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are following in their footsteps.”
text_en_yusufali: Nay! they say: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we do guide ourselves by their footsteps."
text_en_pickthall: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints.
text_en_arberry: Nay, but they say, ’We found our fathers upon a community, and we are guided upon their traces.’

text_ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
text_en_primary: Similarly, whenever We sent a warner to a society before you ˹O Prophet˺, its ˹spoiled˺ elite would say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are walking in their footsteps.”
text_en_yusufali: Just in the same way, whenever We sent a Warner before thee to any people, the wealthy ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we will certainly follow in their footsteps."
text_en_pickthall: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints.
text_en_arberry: Even so We sent never before thee any warner into any city, except that its men who lived at ease said, ’We indeed found our fathers upon a community, and we are following upon their traces.’

text_ar: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Each ˹warner˺ asked, “Even if what I brought you is better guidance than what you found your forefathers practicing?” They replied, “We totally reject whatever you have been sent with.”
text_en_yusufali: He said: "What! Even if I brought you better guidance than that which ye found your fathers following?" They said: "For us, we deny that ye (prophets) are sent (on a mission at all)."
text_en_pickthall: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following ? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’What, though I should bring you a better guidance than you found your fathers upon?’ They say, ’We disbelieve in that you were sent with.’

text_ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: So We inflicted punishment upon them. See then what was the fate of the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: So We exacted retribution from them: now see what was the end of those who rejected (Truth)!
text_en_pickthall: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!
text_en_arberry: So We took vengeance upon them; and behold how was the end of them that cried lies.

text_ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Remember, O  Prophet˺ when Abraham declared to his father and his people, “I am totally free of whatever ˹gods˺ you worship,
text_en_yusufali: Behold! Abraham said to his father and his people: "I do indeed clear myself of what ye worship:
text_en_pickthall: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship
text_en_arberry: And when Abraham said to his father and his people, ’Surely I am quit of that you serve,

text_ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
text_en_primary: except the One Who originated me, and He will surely guide me.”
text_en_yusufali: "(I worship) only Him Who made me, and He will certainly guide me."
text_en_pickthall: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.
text_en_arberry: except Him who originated me; and He will guide me.

text_ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةًۭ فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
text_en_primary: And he left this enduring declaration among his descendants, so they may ˹always˺ turn back ˹to Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: And he left it as a Word to endure among those who came after him, that they may turn back (to God).
text_en_pickthall: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.
text_en_arberry: And he made it a word enduring among his posterity; haply so they would return.

text_ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: In fact, I had allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers, until the truth came to them along with a messenger making things clear.
text_en_yusufali: Yea, I have given the good things of this life to these (men) and their fathers, until the Truth has come to them, and an apostle making things clear.
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.
text_en_arberry: Nay, but I gave these and their fathers enjoyment of days, until the truth came unto them, and a manifest Messenger.

text_ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally reject it.”
text_en_yusufali: But when the Truth came to them, they said: "This is sorcery, and we do reject it."
text_en_pickthall: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.
text_en_arberry: And when the truth came to them, they said, ’This is a sorcery, and in it we are unbelievers.’

text_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
text_en_primary: And they exclaimed, “If only this Quran was revealed to a great man from ˹one of˺ the two cities!”
text_en_yusufali: Also, they say: "Why is not this Qur’an sent down to some leading man in either of the two (chief) cities?"
text_en_pickthall: And they say: If only this Qur’an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns ?
text_en_arberry: They say, ’Why was this Koran not sent down upon some man of moment in the two cities?’

text_ar: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
text_en_primary: Is it they who distribute your Lord’s mercy? We ˹alone˺ have distributed their ˹very˺ livelihood among them in this worldly life and raised some of them in rank above others so that some may employ others in service. ˹But˺ your Lord’s mercy is far better than whatever ˹wealth˺ they amass.
text_en_yusufali: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of thy Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in the life of this world: and We raise some of them above others in ranks, so that some may command work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord is better than the (wealth) which they amass.
text_en_pickthall: Is it they who apportion thy Lord’s mercy ? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.
text_en_arberry: What, is it they who divide the mercy of the Lord? We have divided between them their livelihood in the present life, and raised some of them above others in rank, that some of them may take others in servitude; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than that they amass.

text_ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًۭا مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
text_en_primary: Were it not that people might ˹be tempted to˺ become one community ˹of disbelievers˺, We would have supplied the homes of ˹only˺ those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate with silver roofs and ˹silver˺ stairways to ascend,
text_en_yusufali: And were it not that (all) men might become of one (evil) way of life, We would provide, for everyone that blasphemes against (God) Most Gracious, silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stair-ways on which to go up,
text_en_pickthall: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount,
text_en_arberry: And were it not that mankind would be one nation, We would have appointed for those who disbelieve in the All-merciful roofs of silver to their houses, and stairs whereon to mount,

text_ar: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
text_en_primary: as well as ˹silver˺ gates and thrones to recline on,
text_en_yusufali: And (silver) doors to their houses, and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
text_en_pickthall: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,
text_en_arberry: and doors to their houses, and couches whereon to recline,

text_ar: وَزُخْرُفًۭا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
text_en_primary: and ornaments ˹of gold˺. Yet all this is no more than a ˹fleeting˺ enjoyment in this worldly life. ˹But˺ the Hereafter with your Lord is ˹only˺ for those mindful ˹of Him˺.
text_en_yusufali: And also adornments of gold. But all this were nothing but conveniences of the present life: The Hereafter, in the sight of thy Lord is for the Righteous.
text_en_pickthall: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.
text_en_arberry: and ornaments; surely all this is but the enjoyment of the present life, and the world to come with thy Lord is for the godfearing.

text_ar: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَٰنًۭا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: And whoever turns a blind eye to the Reminder of the Most Compassionate, We place at the disposal of each a devilish one as their close associate,
text_en_yusufali: If anyone withdraws himself from remembrance of (God) Most Gracious, We appoint for him an evil one, to be an intimate companion to him.
text_en_pickthall: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;
text_en_arberry: Whoso blinds himself to the Remembrance of the All-merciful, to him We assign a Satan for comrade;

text_ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
text_en_primary: who will certainly hinder them from the ˹Right˺ Way while they think they are ˹rightly˺ guided.
text_en_yusufali: Such (evil ones) really hinder them from the Path, but they think that they are being guided aright!
text_en_pickthall: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided;
text_en_arberry: and they bar them from the way, and they think they are guided,

text_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
text_en_primary: But when such a person comes to Us, one will say ˹to their associate˺, “I wish you were as distant from me as the east is from the west! What an evil associate ˹you were˺!”
text_en_yusufali: At length, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says (to his evil companion): "Would that between me and thee were the distance of East and West!" Ah! evil is the companion (indeed)!
text_en_pickthall: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!
text_en_arberry: till, when he comes to Us, he says, ’Would there had been between me and thee the distance of the two Easts!’ An evil comrade!

text_ar: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹It will be said to both,˺ “Since you all did wrong, sharing in the punishment will be of no benefit to you this Day.”
text_en_yusufali: When ye have done wrong, it will avail you nothing, that Day, that ye shall be partners in Punishment!
text_en_pickthall: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom.
text_en_arberry: It shall not profit you today, since you did evil, that you are partners in the chastisement.

text_ar: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or those clearly astray?
text_en_yusufali: Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or give direction to the blind or to such as (wander) in manifest error?
text_en_pickthall: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest ?
text_en_arberry: What, shalt thou make the deaf to hear, or shalt thou guide the blind and him who is in manifest error?

text_ar: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
text_en_primary: Even if We take you away ˹from this world˺, We will surely inflict punishment upon them.
text_en_yusufali: Even if We take thee away, We shall be sure to exact retribution from them,
text_en_pickthall: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them,
text_en_arberry: Whether We take thee away, We shall take vengeance upon them,

text_ar: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Or if We show you what We threaten them with, We certainly have full power over them.
text_en_yusufali: Or We shall show thee that (accomplished) which We have promised them: for verily We shall prevail over them.
text_en_pickthall: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them.
text_en_arberry: or We show thee a part of that We promised them, surely We have power over them.

text_ar: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: So hold firmly to what has been revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺. You are truly on the Straight Path.
text_en_yusufali: So hold thou fast to the Revelation sent down to thee; verily thou art on a Straight Way.
text_en_pickthall: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path.
text_en_arberry: So hold thou fast unto that which has been revealed unto thee; surely thou art upon a straight path.

text_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌۭ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
text_en_primary: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a glory for you and your people. And you will ˹all˺ be questioned ˹about it˺.
text_en_yusufali: The (Qur’an) is indeed the message, for thee and for thy people; and soon shall ye (all) be brought to account.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.
text_en_arberry: Surely it is a Reminder to thee and to thy people; and assuredly you will be questioned.

text_ar: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةًۭ يُعْبَدُونَ
text_en_primary: Ask ˹the followers of˺ the messengers that We already sent before you if We ˹ever˺ appointed ˹other˺ gods to be worshipped besides the Most Compassionate.
text_en_yusufali: And question thou our apostles whom We sent before thee; did We appoint any deities other than (God) Most Gracious, to be worshipped?
text_en_pickthall: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent ?
text_en_arberry: Ask those of Our Messengers We sent before thee: Have We appointed, apart from the All-merciful, gods to be served?

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of all worlds.”
text_en_yusufali: We did send Moses aforetime, with Our Signs, to Pharaoh and his Chiefs: He said, "I am an apostle of the Lord of the Worlds."
text_en_pickthall: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_arberry: We also sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his Council, and he said, ’Surely, I am the Messenger of the Lord of all Being.’

text_ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
text_en_primary: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them,
text_en_yusufali: But when he came to them with Our Signs, behold they ridiculed them.
text_en_pickthall: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.
text_en_arberry: But when he brought them Our signs, lo, they laughed at them.

text_ar: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
text_en_primary: although every sign We showed them was greater than the one before.
text_en_yusufali: We showed them Sign after Sign, each greater than its fellow, and We seized them with Punishment, in order that they might turn (to Us).
text_en_pickthall: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.
text_en_arberry: And not a sign We showed them, but it was greater than its sister sign; and We seized them with chastisement, that haply they should return.

text_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Then˺ they pleaded, “O ˹mighty˺ magician! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance.”
text_en_yusufali: And they said, "O thou sorcerer! Invoke thy Lord for us according to His covenant with thee; for we shall truly accept guidance."
text_en_pickthall: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
text_en_arberry: And they said, ’Sorcerer, pray to thy Lord for us by the covenant He has made with thee, and surely we shall be right-guided.’

text_ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
text_en_primary: But as soon as We removed the torments from them, they broke their promise.
text_en_yusufali: But when We removed the Penalty from them, behold, they broke their word.
text_en_pickthall: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.
text_en_arberry: But when We removed from them the chastisement, behold, they broke their troth.

text_ar: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
text_en_primary: And Pharaoh called out to his people, boasting, “O my people! Am I not sovereign over Egypt as well as ˹all˺ these streams flowing at my feet? Can you not see?
text_en_yusufali: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Does not the dominion of Egypt belong to me, (witness) these streams flowing underneath my (palace)? What! see ye not then?
text_en_pickthall: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me ? Can ye not then discern ?
text_en_arberry: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people: ’O my people, do I not possess the kingdom of Egypt, and these rivers flowing beneath me? What, do you not see?

text_ar: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌۭ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
text_en_primary: Am I not better than this nobody who can hardly express himself?
text_en_yusufali: "Am I not better than this (Moses), who is a contemptible wretch and can scarcely express himself clearly?
text_en_pickthall: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!
text_en_arberry: Or am I better than this man, who is contemptible and scarcely makes things clear?

text_ar: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌۭ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Why then have no golden bracelets ˹of kingship˺ been granted to him or angels come with him as escorts!”
text_en_yusufali: "Then why are not gold bracelets bestowed on him, or (why) come (not) with him angels accompanying him in procession?"
text_en_pickthall: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him ?
text_en_arberry: Why then have bracelets of gold not been cast on him, or angels not come with him conjoined?’

text_ar: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
text_en_primary: And so he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were truly a rebellious people.
text_en_yusufali: Thus did he make fools of his people, and they obeyed him: truly were they a people rebellious (against God).
text_en_pickthall: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.
text_en_arberry: So he made his people unsteady, and they obeyed him; surely they were an ungodly people.

text_ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
text_en_primary: So when they enraged Us, We inflicted punishment upon them, drowning them all.
text_en_yusufali: When at length they provoked Us, We exacted retribution from them, and We drowned them all.
text_en_pickthall: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.
text_en_arberry: So, when they had angered Us, We took vengeance on them, and We drowned them all together;

text_ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ سَلَفًۭا وَمَثَلًۭا لِّلْءَاخِرِينَ
text_en_primary: And We made them an example and a lesson for those after them.
text_en_yusufali: And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages.
text_en_pickthall: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).
text_en_arberry: and We made them a thing past, and We appointed them for an example to later folk.

text_ar: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
text_en_primary: When the son of Mary was cited as an example ˹in argument˺, your people ˹O Prophet˺ broke into ˹joyful˺ applause.
text_en_yusufali: When (Jesus) the son of Mary is held up as an example, behold, thy people raise a clamour thereat (in ridicule)!
text_en_pickthall: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,
text_en_arberry: And when the son of Mary is cited as an example, behold, thy people turn away from it

text_ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
text_en_primary: They exclaimed, “Which is better: our gods or Jesus?” They cite him only to argue. In fact, they are a people prone to dispute.
text_en_yusufali: And they say, "Are our gods best, or he?" This they set forth to thee, only by way of disputation: yea, they are a contentious people.
text_en_pickthall: And say: Are our gods better, or is he ? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.
text_en_arberry: and say, ’What, are our gods better, or he?’ They cite not him to thee, save to dispute;. nay, but they are a people contentious.

text_ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
text_en_primary: He was only a servant We showed favour to, and made as an example for the Children of Israel.
text_en_yusufali: He was no more than a servant: We granted Our favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel.
text_en_pickthall: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.
text_en_arberry: He is only a servant We blessed, and We made him to be an example to the Children of Israel.

text_ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
text_en_primary: Had We willed, We could have easily replaced you ˹all˺ with angels, succeeding one another on earth.
text_en_yusufali: And if it were Our Will, We could make angels from amongst you, succeeding each other on the earth.
text_en_pickthall: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.
text_en_arberry: Had We willed, We would have appointed angels among you to be successors in the earth.

text_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌۭ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: And his ˹second˺ coming is truly a sign for the Hour. So have no doubt about it, and follow me. This is the Straight Path.
text_en_yusufali: And (Jesus) shall be a Sign (for the coming of) the Hour (of Judgment): therefore have no doubt about the (Hour), but follow ye Me: this is a Straight Way.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.
text_en_arberry: It is knowledge of the Hour; doubt not concerning it, and follow me. This is a straight path.

text_ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: And do not let Satan hinder you, ˹for˺ he is certainly your sworn enemy.
text_en_yusufali: Let not the Evil One hinder you: for he is to you an enemy avowed.
text_en_pickthall: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
text_en_arberry: Let not Satan bar you; he is for you a manifest foe.

text_ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
text_en_primary: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he declared, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me.
text_en_yusufali: When Jesus came with Clear Signs, he said: "Now have I come to you with Wisdom, and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which ye dispute: therefore fear God and obey me.
text_en_pickthall: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah’s Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
text_en_arberry: And when Jesus came with the clear signs he said, ’I have come to you with wisdom, and that I may make clear to you some of that whereon you are at variance; so fear you God and obey you me.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”
text_en_yusufali: "For God, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way."
text_en_pickthall: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
text_en_arberry: Assuredly God is my Lord and your Lord; therefore serve Him; this is a straight path.’

text_ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
text_en_primary: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day!
text_en_yusufali: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day!
text_en_pickthall: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.
text_en_arberry: But the parties among them fell into variance; so woe unto those who did evil, because of the chastisement of a painful day.

text_ar: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
text_en_primary: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺?
text_en_yusufali: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not?
text_en_pickthall: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not ?
text_en_arberry: Are they looking for aught but the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they are not aware?

text_ar: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
text_en_primary: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous,
text_en_yusufali: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous.
text_en_pickthall: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).
text_en_arberry: Friends on that day shall be foes to one another, but the god-fearing.

text_ar: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—
text_en_yusufali: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve,-
text_en_pickthall: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;
text_en_arberry: ’O My servants, today no fear is on you, neither do you sorrow’ --

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹those˺ who believed in Our signs and ˹fully˺ submitted ˹to Us˺.
text_en_yusufali: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam.
text_en_pickthall: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,
text_en_arberry: even those who believed in Our signs, and had surrendered themselves

text_ar: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
text_en_primary: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.”
text_en_yusufali: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
text_en_pickthall: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.
text_en_arberry: ’Enter Paradise, you and your wives, walking with joy!’

text_ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍۢ مِّن ذَهَبٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
text_en_primary: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever.
text_en_yusufali: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their ayes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye).
text_en_pickthall: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
text_en_arberry: There shall be passed around them platters of gold, and cups, therein being whatever the souls desire, and the eyes delight in. ’And therein, you shall dwell forever.

text_ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: That is the Paradise which you will be awarded for what you used to do.
text_en_yusufali: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
text_en_pickthall: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.
text_en_arberry: This is the Paradise that you have been given for an inheritance for the things that you were doing.

text_ar: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ كَثِيرَةٌۭ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
text_en_primary: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from.
text_en_yusufali: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction.
text_en_pickthall: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.
text_en_arberry: Therein you have abundant fruits, whereof you may eat.’

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever.
text_en_yusufali: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye):
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell’s torment.
text_en_arberry: But the evildoers dwell forever in the chastisement of Gehenna

text_ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
text_en_primary: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair.
text_en_yusufali: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed.
text_en_pickthall: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.
text_en_arberry: that is not abated for them and therein they are sore confounded.

text_ar: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
text_en_yusufali: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves.
text_en_pickthall: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.
text_en_arberry: We never wronged them, but they themselves did the wrong.

text_ar: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
text_en_primary: They will cry, “O Malik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”
text_en_yusufali: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide!"
text_en_pickthall: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
text_en_arberry: And they shall call, ’O Malik, let thy Lord have done with us!’ He will say, ’You will surely tarry.’

text_ar: لَقَدْ جِئْنَٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
text_en_primary: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth.
text_en_yusufali: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth.
text_en_pickthall: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.
text_en_arberry: ’We brought you the truth, but most of you were averse to the truth.’

text_ar: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
text_en_primary: Or have they mastered some ˹evil˺ plan? Then We ˹too˺ are surely planning.
text_en_yusufali: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things.
text_en_pickthall: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet) ? Lo! We (also) are determining.
text_en_arberry: Or have they contrived some matter? We too are contriving.

text_ar: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
text_en_primary: Or do they think that We do not hear their ˹evil˺ thoughts and secret talks? Yes ˹We do˺! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording ˹it all˺.
text_en_yusufali: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record.
text_en_pickthall: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences ? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.
text_en_arberry: Or do they think We hear not their secret and what they conspire together? Yes indeed, and Our messengers are present with them writing it down.

text_ar: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌۭ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَٰبِدِينَ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the Most Compassionate ˹really˺ had offspring, I would be the first worshipper.”
text_en_yusufali: Say: "If (God) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship."
text_en_pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).
text_en_arberry: Say: ’If the All-merciful has a son, then I am the first to serve him.

text_ar: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
text_en_primary: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim.
text_en_yusufali: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
text_en_pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
text_en_arberry: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, above that they describe.’

text_ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
text_en_primary: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of.
text_en_yusufali: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
text_en_pickthall: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.
text_en_arberry: Then leave them alone to plunge and play, until they encounter that day of theirs which they are promised.

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
text_en_primary: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing.
text_en_yusufali: It is He Who is God in heaven and God on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge.
text_en_pickthall: And He it is Who in the heaven is God, and in the earth God. He is the Wise, the Knower.
text_en_arberry: And it is He who in heaven is God and in earth is God; He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.

text_ar: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
text_en_primary: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.
text_en_yusufali: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back.
text_en_pickthall: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.
text_en_arberry: Glory be to Him, to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that between them is; with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you shall be returned.

text_ar: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ those ˹objects of worship˺ they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly.
text_en_yusufali: And those whom they invoke besides God have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him).
text_en_pickthall: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.
text_en_arberry: Those they call upon, apart from Him, have no power of intercession, save such as have testified to the truth, and that knowingly.

text_ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
text_en_primary: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺?
text_en_yusufali: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, God: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)?
text_en_pickthall: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away ?
text_en_arberry: If thou askest them, ’Who created you?’ they will say, ’God.’ How then are they perverted?

text_ar: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”
text_en_yusufali: (God has knowledge) of the (Prophet’s) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe!"
text_en_pickthall: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.
text_en_arberry: And for his saying, ’My Lord, surely these are a people who believe not’ --

text_ar: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know.
text_en_yusufali: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know!
text_en_pickthall: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
text_en_arberry: yet pardon them, and say, ’Peace!’ Soon they will know.

text_ar: حمٓ
text_en_primary: ha-Mĩm.
text_en_yusufali: Ha-Mim.
text_en_pickthall: Ha. Mim.
text_en_arberry: Ha Mim

text_ar: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
text_en_primary: By the clear Book!
text_en_yusufali: By the Book that makes things clear;-
text_en_pickthall: By the Scripture that maketh plain
text_en_arberry: By the Clear Book.

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺.
text_en_yusufali: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
text_en_arberry: We have sent it down in a blessed night (We are ever warning)

text_ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
text_en_primary: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained
text_en_yusufali: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,
text_en_pickthall: Whereon every wise command is made clear
text_en_arberry: therein every wise bidding

text_ar: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
text_en_primary: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺
text_en_yusufali: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),
text_en_pickthall: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -
text_en_arberry: determined as a bidding from Us, (We are ever sending)

text_ar: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
text_en_primary: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—
text_en_yusufali: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
text_en_pickthall: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
text_en_arberry: as a mercy from thy Lord (surely He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing)

text_ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
text_en_primary: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.
text_en_yusufali: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.
text_en_pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
text_en_arberry: Lord of the heavens and earth, and all that between them is if you have faith.

text_ar: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.
text_en_yusufali: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.
text_en_pickthall: There is no God save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
text_en_arberry: There is no god but He; He gives life and makes to die; your Lord and the Lord of your fathers, the ancients.

text_ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
text_en_primary: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
text_en_yusufali: Yet they play about in doubt.
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but they play in doubt.
text_en_arberry: Nay, but they are in doubt, playing.

text_ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible,
text_en_yusufali: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
text_en_pickthall: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
text_en_arberry: So be on the watch for a day when heaven shall bring a manifest smoke

text_ar: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment.
text_en_yusufali: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.
text_en_pickthall: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.
text_en_arberry: covering the people; this is a painful chastisement.

text_ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”
text_en_yusufali: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"
text_en_pickthall: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.
text_en_arberry: ’O our Lord, remove Thou from us the chastisement; we are believers.’

text_ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear,
text_en_yusufali: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Apostle explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-
text_en_pickthall: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,
text_en_arberry: How should they have the Reminder, seeing a clear Messenger already came to them,

text_ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
text_en_primary: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”?
text_en_yusufali: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
text_en_pickthall: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman ?
text_en_arberry: then they turned away from him and said, ’A man tutored, possessed!’

text_ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺.
text_en_yusufali: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).
text_en_arberry: ’Behold, We are removing the chastisement a little; behold, you revert!’

text_ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment.
text_en_yusufali: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!
text_en_pickthall: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.
text_en_arberry: Upon the day when We shall assault most mightily, then We shall take Our vengeance.

text_ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
text_en_primary: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them,
text_en_yusufali: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them an apostle most honourable,
text_en_pickthall: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh’s folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,
text_en_arberry: Already before them We tried the people of Pharaoh, and a noble Messenger came unto them,

text_ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you.
text_en_yusufali: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of God: I am to you an apostle worthy of all trust;
text_en_pickthall: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.
text_en_arberry: saying, ’Deliver to me God’s servants; I am for you a faithful Messenger,

text_ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof.
text_en_yusufali: "And be not arrogant as against God: for I come to you with authority manifest.
text_en_pickthall: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
text_en_arberry: and, ’Rise not up against God; behold, I come to you with a clear authority,

text_ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
text_en_primary: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺.
text_en_yusufali: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
text_en_arberry: and I take refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me.

text_ar: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”
text_en_yusufali: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
text_en_pickthall: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.
text_en_arberry: ’But if so be that you believe me not, go you apart from me!’

text_ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
text_en_primary: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”
text_en_yusufali: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."
text_en_pickthall: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
text_en_arberry: And he called to his Lord, saying, ’These are a sinful people.’

text_ar: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued.
text_en_yusufali: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
text_en_pickthall: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,
text_en_arberry: ’Then set thou forth with My servants in a watch of the night; surely you will be followed.

text_ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
text_en_primary: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”
text_en_yusufali: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."
text_en_pickthall: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.
text_en_arberry: And leave the sea becalmed; they are a drowned host.’

text_ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind,
text_en_yusufali: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,
text_en_pickthall: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,
text_en_arberry: They left how many gardens and fountains,

text_ar: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences,
text_en_yusufali: And corn-fields and noble buildings,
text_en_pickthall: And the cornlands and the goodly sites
text_en_arberry: sown fields, and how noble a station,

text_ar: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
text_en_primary: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed.
text_en_yusufali: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
text_en_pickthall: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!
text_en_arberry: and what prosperity they had rejoiced in!

text_ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
text_en_primary: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people.
text_en_yusufali: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!
text_en_pickthall: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;
text_en_arberry: Even so; and We bequeathed them upon another people.

text_ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
text_en_primary: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed.
text_en_yusufali: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).
text_en_pickthall: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
text_en_arberry: Neither heaven nor earth wept for them, nor were they respited;

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
text_en_primary: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
text_en_yusufali: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,
text_en_pickthall: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;
text_en_arberry: and We delivered the Children of Israel from the humbling chastisement,

text_ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
text_en_primary: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor.
text_en_yusufali: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.
text_en_pickthall: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.
text_en_arberry: from Pharaoh; surely he was a high One, of the prodigals;

text_ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others.
text_en_yusufali: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
text_en_pickthall: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.
text_en_arberry: and We chose them, out of a knowledge, above all beings,

text_ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
text_en_primary: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test.
text_en_yusufali: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial
text_en_pickthall: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.
text_en_arberry: and gave them signs wherein there was a manifest trial.

text_ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, these ˹Meccans˺ say,
text_en_yusufali: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:
text_en_pickthall: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:
text_en_arberry: These men do say,

text_ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
text_en_primary: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected.
text_en_yusufali: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
text_en_pickthall: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
text_en_arberry: ’There is nothing but our first death; we shall not be revived.

text_ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
text_en_primary: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”
text_en_yusufali: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
text_en_pickthall: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!
text_en_arberry: Bring us our fathers, if you speak truly!’

text_ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
text_en_primary: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked.
text_en_yusufali: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.
text_en_pickthall: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb’a and those before them ? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.
text_en_arberry: Are they better, or the people of Tubba’ and those before them whom We destroyed? They were surely sinners.

text_ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
text_en_primary: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport.
text_en_yusufali: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:
text_en_pickthall: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
text_en_arberry: We created not the heavens and earth, and all that between them is, in play;

text_ar: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know.
text_en_yusufali: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.
text_en_pickthall: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.
text_en_arberry: We created them not save in truth; but most of them know it not.

text_ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—
text_en_yusufali: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-
text_en_pickthall: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,
text_en_arberry: Surely the Day of Decision shall be their appointed time, all together,

text_ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
text_en_primary: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped,
text_en_yusufali: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
text_en_pickthall: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
text_en_arberry: the day a master shall avail nothing a client, and they shall not be helped,

text_ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
text_en_primary: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: Except such as receive God’s Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
text_en_arberry: save him upon whom God has mercy; He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.

text_ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
text_en_primary: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm
text_en_yusufali: Verily the tree of Zaqqum
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,
text_en_arberry: Lo, the Tree of Ez-Zakkoum

text_ar: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
text_en_primary: will be the food of the evildoer.
text_en_yusufali: Will be the food of the Sinful,-
text_en_pickthall: The food of the sinner!
text_en_arberry: is the food of the guilty,

text_ar: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
text_en_primary: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies
text_en_yusufali: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
text_en_pickthall: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies
text_en_arberry: like molten copper, bubbling in the belly

text_ar: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
text_en_primary: like the boiling of hot water.
text_en_yusufali: Like the boiling of scalding water.
text_en_pickthall: As the seething of boiling water.
text_en_arberry: as boiling water bubbles.

text_ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
text_en_primary: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire.
text_en_yusufali: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!
text_en_pickthall: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,
text_en_arberry: ’Take him, and thrust him into the midst of Hell,

text_ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
text_en_primary: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”
text_en_yusufali: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,
text_en_pickthall: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.
text_en_arberry: then pour over his head the chastisement of boiling water!’

text_ar: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
text_en_primary: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one!
text_en_yusufali: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!
text_en_pickthall: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!
text_en_arberry: ’Taste! Surely thou art the mighty, the noble.

text_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
text_en_primary: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”
text_en_yusufali: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"
text_en_pickthall: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.
text_en_arberry: This is that concerning which you were doubting.’

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place,
