text_en_pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation ? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
text_en_arberry: What, were We wearied by the first creation? No indeed; but they are in uncertainty as to the new creation.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein.
text_en_yusufali: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
text_en_pickthall: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
text_en_arberry: We indeed created man; and We know what his soul whispers within him, and We are nearer to him than the jugular vein.

text_ar: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
text_en_primary: As the two recording-angels—˹one˺ sitting to the right, and ˹the other to˺ the left—note ˹everything˺,
text_en_yusufali: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
text_en_pickthall: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,
text_en_arberry: When the two angels meet together, sitting one on the right, and one on the left,

text_ar: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
text_en_primary: not a word does a person utter without having a ˹vigilant˺ observer ready ˹to write it down˺.
text_en_yusufali: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
text_en_pickthall: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.
text_en_arberry: not a word he utters, but by him is an observer ready.

text_ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
text_en_primary: ˹Ultimately,˺ with the throes of death will come the truth. This is what you were trying to escape!
text_en_yusufali: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
text_en_pickthall: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.
text_en_arberry: And death’s agony comes in truth; that is what thou wast shunning!

text_ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
text_en_primary: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of.
text_en_yusufali: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
text_en_pickthall: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
text_en_arberry: And the Trumpet shall be blown; that is the Day of the Threat.

text_ar: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
text_en_primary: Each soul will come forth with an angel to drive it and another to testify.
text_en_yusufali: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
text_en_pickthall: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.
text_en_arberry: And every soul shall come, and with it a driver and a witness.

text_ar: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
text_en_primary: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”
text_en_yusufali: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
text_en_pickthall: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
text_en_arberry: ’Thou wast heedless of this; therefore We have now removed from thee thy covering, and so thy sight today is piercing.’

text_ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
text_en_primary: And one’s accompanying-angel will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”
text_en_yusufali: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
text_en_pickthall: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
text_en_arberry: And his comrade shall say, ’This is what I have, made ready.’

text_ar: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹It will be said to both angels,˺ “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever,
text_en_yusufali: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of God)!-
text_en_pickthall: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
text_en_arberry: ’Cast, you twain, into Gehenna every froward unbeliever,

text_ar: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
text_en_primary: withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter,
text_en_yusufali: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
text_en_pickthall: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,
text_en_arberry: every hinderer of the good, transgressor, disquieter,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
text_en_primary: who set up another god with Allah. So cast them into the severe punishment.”
text_en_yusufali: "Who set up another god beside God: Throw him into a severe penalty."
text_en_pickthall: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
text_en_arberry: who set up with God another god; therefore, you twain, cast him into the terrible chastisement.’

text_ar: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
text_en_primary: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”
text_en_yusufali: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
text_en_pickthall: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
text_en_arberry: And his comrade shall say, ’Our Lord, I made him not insolent, but he was in far error.’

text_ar: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
text_en_primary: Allah will respond, “Do not dispute in My presence, since I had already given you a warning.
text_en_yusufali: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
text_en_pickthall: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
text_en_arberry: He shall say, ’Dispute not before Me! For I sent you beforehand -- the threat.

text_ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
text_en_primary: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to ˹My˺ creation.”
text_en_yusufali: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
text_en_pickthall: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.
text_en_arberry: The Word is not changed with Me; I wrong not My servants.’

text_ar: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”
text_en_yusufali: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
text_en_pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled ? and it saith: Can there be more to come ?
text_en_arberry: Upon the day We shall say unto Gehenna, ’Art thou filled?’ And it shall say, ’Are there any more to come?’

text_ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
text_en_primary: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off.
text_en_yusufali: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
text_en_pickthall: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
text_en_arberry: And Paradise shall be brought forward to the godfearing, not afar:

text_ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹And it will be said to them,˺ “This is what you were promised, for whoever ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺ and kept up ˹His commandments˺—
text_en_yusufali: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to God) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
text_en_pickthall: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,
text_en_arberry: ’This is that you were promised; it is for every mindful penitent.’

text_ar: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
text_en_primary: who were in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing ˹Him˺, and have come with a heart turning ˹only to Him˺.
text_en_yusufali: "Who feared (God) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
text_en_pickthall: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.
text_en_arberry: Whosoever fears the All-merciful in the Unseen, and comes with a penitent heart:

text_ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
text_en_primary: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”
text_en_yusufali: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
text_en_pickthall: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
text_en_arberry: ’Enter it in peace! This is the Day of Eternity.’

text_ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
text_en_primary: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is ˹even˺ more.
text_en_yusufali: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
text_en_pickthall: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.
text_en_arberry: Therein they shall have whatever they will; and with Us there is yet more.

text_ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
text_en_primary: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, who were far mightier than them. Then ˹when the torment came,˺ they ˹desperately˺ sought refuge in the land. ˹But˺ was there any escape?
text_en_yusufali: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
text_en_pickthall: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came) ?
text_en_arberry: How many a generation We destroyed before them that was stronger in valour than they, then they searched about in the land; was there any asylum?

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
text_en_primary: Surely in this is a reminder for whoever has a ˹mindful˺ heart and lends an attentive ear.
text_en_yusufali: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
text_en_arberry: Surely in that there is a reminder to him who has a heart, or will give ear with a present mind.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days,
text_en_yusufali: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
text_en_pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
text_en_arberry: We created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, and no weariness touched Us.

text_ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
text_en_primary: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset.
text_en_yusufali: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
text_en_pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
text_en_arberry: So be thou patient under what they say, and proclaim thy Lord’s praise before the rising of the sun, and before its setting,

text_ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
text_en_primary: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers.
text_en_yusufali: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
text_en_pickthall: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.
text_en_arberry: and proclaim thy Lord’s praise in the night, and at the ends of the prostrations.

text_ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
text_en_primary: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place,
text_en_yusufali: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
text_en_pickthall: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
text_en_arberry: And listen thou for the day when the caller shall call from a near place.

text_ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
text_en_primary: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺.
text_en_yusufali: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
text_en_pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
text_en_arberry: On the day they hear the Cry in truth, that is the day of coming forth.

text_ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
text_en_primary: It is certainly We Who give life and cause death. And to Us is the final return.
text_en_yusufali: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.
text_en_arberry: It is We who give life, and make to die, and to Us is the homecoming.

text_ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
text_en_primary: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us.
text_en_yusufali: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
text_en_pickthall: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
text_en_arberry: Upon the day when the earth is split asunder from about them as they hasten forth; that is a mustering easy for Us.

text_ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
text_en_primary: We know best what they say. And you ˹O Prophet˺ are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺. So remind with the Quran ˹only˺ those who fear My warning.
text_en_yusufali: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur’an such as fear My Warning!
text_en_pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur’an him who feareth My threat.
text_en_arberry: We know very well what they say; thou art not a tyrant over them. Therefore remind by the Koran him who fears My threat.

text_ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
text_en_primary: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺,
text_en_yusufali: By the (Winds) that scatter broadcast;
text_en_pickthall: By those that winnow with a winnowing
text_en_arberry: By the swift scatterers

text_ar: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
text_en_primary: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain,
text_en_yusufali: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
text_en_pickthall: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
text_en_arberry: and the burden-bearers

text_ar: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
text_en_primary: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease,
text_en_yusufali: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
text_en_pickthall: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
text_en_arberry: and the smooth runners

text_ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
text_en_primary: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command!
text_en_yusufali: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
text_en_pickthall: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
text_en_arberry: and the partitioners,

text_ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
text_en_primary: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
text_en_yusufali: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
text_en_arberry: surely that you are promised is true,

text_ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
text_en_primary: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass.
text_en_yusufali: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
text_en_arberry: and surely the Doom is about to fall!

text_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
text_en_primary: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design!
text_en_yusufali: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
text_en_pickthall: By the heaven full of paths,
text_en_arberry: By heaven with all its tracks

text_ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
text_en_primary: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺.
text_en_yusufali: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
text_en_arberry: surely you speak at variance,

text_ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
text_en_primary: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it.
text_en_yusufali: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
text_en_pickthall: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
text_en_arberry: and perverted therefrom are some.

text_ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
text_en_primary: Condemned are the liars—
text_en_yusufali: Woe to the falsehood-mongers,-
text_en_pickthall: Accursed be the conjecturers
text_en_arberry: Perish the conjecturers

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
text_en_primary: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless.
text_en_yusufali: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
text_en_pickthall: Who are careless in an abyss!
text_en_arberry: who are dazed in perplexity

text_ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
text_en_yusufali: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
text_en_pickthall: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment ?
text_en_arberry: asking, ’When shall be the Day of Doom?’

text_ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.
text_en_yusufali: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
text_en_pickthall: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
text_en_arberry: Upon the day when they shall be tried at the Fire:

text_ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”
text_en_yusufali: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
text_en_pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
text_en_arberry: ’Taste your trial! This is that you were seeking to hasten.’

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs,
text_en_yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
text_en_arberry: Surely the godfearing shall be among gardens and fountains

text_ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺:
text_en_yusufali: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
text_en_pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
text_en_arberry: taking whatsoever their Lord has given them; they were good-doers before that.

text_ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
text_en_primary: they used to sleep only little in the night,
text_en_yusufali: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
text_en_pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night,
text_en_arberry: Little of the night would they slumber,

text_ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
text_en_primary: and pray for forgiveness before dawn.
text_en_yusufali: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
text_en_pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
text_en_arberry: and in the mornings they would ask for forgiveness;

text_ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
text_en_primary: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor.
text_en_yusufali: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
text_en_pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
text_en_arberry: and the beggar and the outcast had a share in their wealth.

text_ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
text_en_primary: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith,
text_en_yusufali: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
text_en_pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
text_en_arberry: In the earth are signs for those having sure faith;

text_ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
text_en_primary: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see?
text_en_yusufali: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
text_en_pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see ?
text_en_arberry: and in your selves; what, do you not see?

text_ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
text_en_primary: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised.
text_en_yusufali: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
text_en_pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
text_en_arberry: And in heaven is your provision, and that you are promised.

text_ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
text_en_primary: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak!
text_en_yusufali: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
text_en_pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
text_en_arberry: So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech.

text_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
text_en_primary: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺?
text_en_yusufali: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
text_en_pickthall: Hath the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad) ?
text_en_arberry: Hast thou received the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?

text_ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”
text_en_yusufali: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
text_en_pickthall: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
text_en_arberry: When they entered unto him, saying ’Peace!’ he said ’Peace! You are a people unknown to me.’

text_ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf,
text_en_yusufali: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
text_en_pickthall: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
text_en_arberry: Then he turned to his household and brought a fattened calf,

text_ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
text_en_primary: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”
text_en_yusufali: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
text_en_pickthall: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat ?
text_en_arberry: and he laid it before them saying, ’Will you not eat?’

text_ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them.
text_en_yusufali: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
text_en_pickthall: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
text_en_arberry: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said, ’Be not afraid!’ And they gave him good tidings of a cunning boy.

text_ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”
text_en_yusufali: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
text_en_pickthall: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
text_en_arberry: Then came forward his wife, clamouring, and she smote her face, and said, ’An old woman, barren!’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
text_en_primary: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”
text_en_yusufali: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
text_en_pickthall: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
text_en_arberry: They said, ’So says thy Lord; He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.’

text_ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O  messengers?”
text_en_yusufali: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
text_en_pickthall: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah) ?
text_en_arberry: Said he, ’And what is your business, envoys?’

text_ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
text_en_primary: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people,
text_en_yusufali: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
text_en_pickthall: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
text_en_arberry: They said, ’We have been sent to a people of sinners,

text_ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay,
text_en_yusufali: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
text_en_pickthall: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
text_en_arberry: to loose upon them stones of clay

text_ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
text_en_primary: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
text_en_yusufali: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
text_en_pickthall: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
text_en_arberry: marked with thy Lord for the prodigal.

text_ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city.
text_en_yusufali: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
text_en_pickthall: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
text_en_arberry: So We brought forth such believers as were in it,

text_ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
text_en_primary: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
text_en_pickthall: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
text_en_arberry: but We found not therein except one house of those that have surrendered themselves.

text_ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
text_en_primary: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment.
text_en_yusufali: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
text_en_pickthall: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
text_en_arberry: And therein We left a sign to those who fear the painful chastisement.

text_ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof,
text_en_yusufali: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
text_en_pickthall: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
text_en_arberry: And also in Moses, when We sent him unto Pharaoh, with a clear authority,

text_ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
text_en_primary: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”
text_en_yusufali: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
text_en_pickthall: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
text_en_arberry: but he turned his back, with his court, saying, ’A sorcerer, or a man possessed!’

text_ar: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy.
text_en_yusufali: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
text_en_pickthall: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
text_en_arberry: So We seized him and his hosts, and We cast them into the sea, and he blameworthy.

text_ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
text_en_primary: And in ˹the story of˺ ’ad ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind.
text_en_yusufali: And in the ’Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
text_en_pickthall: And in (the tribe of) A’ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
text_en_arberry: And also in Ad, when We loosed against them the withering wind

text_ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
text_en_primary: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes.
text_en_yusufali: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
text_en_pickthall: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
text_en_arberry: that left nothing it came upon, but made it as stuff decayed.

text_ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”
text_en_yusufali: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
text_en_pickthall: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
text_en_arberry: And also in Thamood, when it was said to them, ’Take your enjoyment for a while!’

text_ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
text_en_primary: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on.
text_en_yusufali: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
text_en_pickthall: But they rebelled against their Lord’s decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
text_en_arberry: Then they turned in disdain from the commandment of their Lord, and the thunderbolt took them and they themselves beholding

text_ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
text_en_primary: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped.
text_en_yusufali: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
text_en_pickthall: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
text_en_arberry: and they were not able to stand upright, and were not helped.

text_ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
text_en_primary: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people.
text_en_yusufali: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
text_en_pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
text_en_arberry: And the people of Noah before; surely they were an ungodly people.

text_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
text_en_primary: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺.
text_en_yusufali: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of pace.
text_en_pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
text_en_arberry: And heaven -- We built it with might, and We extend it wide.

text_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
text_en_primary: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out!
text_en_yusufali: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
text_en_pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
text_en_arberry: And the earth -- We spread it forth; O excellent Smoothers!

text_ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful.
text_en_yusufali: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
text_en_pickthall: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
text_en_arberry: And of everything created We two kinds; haply you will remember

text_ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: So ˹proclaim, O  Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.
text_en_yusufali: Hasten ye then (at once) to God: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
text_en_pickthall: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
text_en_arberry: Therefore flee unto God! I am a clear warner from Him to you.

text_ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”
text_en_yusufali: And make not another an object of worship with God: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
text_en_pickthall: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
text_en_arberry: And set not up with God another god; I am a clear warner from Him to you.

text_ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
text_en_primary: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”
text_en_yusufali: Similarly, no apostle came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
text_en_pickthall: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
text_en_arberry: Even so not a Messenger came to those before them but they said, ’A sorcerer, or a man possessed!’

text_ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
text_en_primary: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people.
text_en_yusufali: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
text_en_pickthall: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another ? Nay, but they are froward folk.
text_en_arberry: What, have they bequeathed it one to another? Nay, but they are an insolent people.

text_ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
text_en_primary: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed.
text_en_yusufali: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
text_en_pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
text_en_arberry: So turn thou from them; thou wilt not be reproached.

text_ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers.
text_en_yusufali: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
text_en_pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
text_en_arberry: And remind; the Reminder profits the believers.

text_ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
text_en_primary: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me.
text_en_yusufali: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
text_en_pickthall: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
text_en_arberry: I have not created jinn and mankind except to serve Me.

text_ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
text_en_primary: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
text_en_yusufali: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
text_en_pickthall: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed
text_en_arberry: I desire of them no provision, neither do I desire that they should feed Me.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
text_en_primary: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty.
text_en_yusufali: For God is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
text_en_arberry: Surely God is the All-provider, the Possessor of Strength, the Ever-Sure.

text_ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
text_en_primary: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺.
text_en_yusufali: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
text_en_pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
text_en_arberry: The evildoers shall have their portion, like the portion of their fellows; so let them not hasten Me!

text_ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
text_en_primary: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of!
text_en_yusufali: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
text_en_pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
text_en_arberry: So woe to the unbelievers, for that day of theirs that they are promised.

text_ar: وَٱلطُّورِ
text_en_primary: By Mount Ṭûr!
text_en_yusufali: By the Mount (of Revelation);
text_en_pickthall: By the Mount,
text_en_arberry: By the Mount

text_ar: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
text_en_primary: And by the Book written
text_en_yusufali: By a Decree inscribed
text_en_pickthall: And a Scripture inscribed
text_en_arberry: and a Book inscribed

text_ar: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
text_en_primary: on open pages ˹for all to read˺!
text_en_yusufali: In a Scroll unfolded;
text_en_pickthall: On fine parchment unrolled,
text_en_arberry: in a parchment unrolled,

text_ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
text_en_primary: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited!
text_en_yusufali: By the much-frequented Fane;
text_en_pickthall: And the House frequented,
text_en_arberry: by the House inhabited

text_ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
text_en_primary: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺!
text_en_yusufali: By the Canopy Raised High;
text_en_pickthall: And the roof exalted,
text_en_arberry: and the roof uplifted

text_ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
text_en_primary: And by the seas set on fire!
text_en_yusufali: And by the Ocean filled with Swell;-
text_en_pickthall: And the sea kept filled,
text_en_arberry: and the sea swarming,

text_ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—
text_en_yusufali: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass;-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
text_en_arberry: surely thy Lord’s chastisement is about to fall;

text_ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
text_en_primary: none will avert it—
text_en_yusufali: There is none can avert it;-
text_en_pickthall: There is none that can ward it off.
text_en_arberry: there is none to avert it.

text_ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
text_en_primary: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently,
text_en_yusufali: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion.
text_en_pickthall: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
text_en_arberry: Upon the day when heaven spins dizzily

text_ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
text_en_primary: and the mountains will be blown away entirely.
text_en_yusufali: And the mountains will fly hither and thither.
text_en_pickthall: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,
text_en_arberry: and the mountains are in motion,

text_ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—
text_en_yusufali: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood;-
text_en_pickthall: Then woe that day unto the deniers
text_en_arberry: woe that day unto those that cry lies,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
text_en_primary: those who amuse themselves with falsehood!
text_en_yusufali: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles.
text_en_pickthall: Who play in talk of grave matters;
text_en_arberry: such as play at plunging,

text_ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
text_en_primary: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell.
text_en_yusufali: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly.
text_en_pickthall: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
text_en_arberry: the day when they shall be pitched into the fire of Gehenna:

text_ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny.
text_en_yusufali: "This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny!
text_en_pickthall: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
text_en_arberry: ’This is the fire that you cried lies to!

text_ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Is this magic, or do you not see?
text_en_yusufali: "Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see?
text_en_pickthall: Is this magic, or do ye not see ?
text_en_arberry: What, is this magic, or is it you that do not see?

text_ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”
text_en_yusufali: "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
text_en_pickthall: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
text_en_arberry: Roast in it! And bear you patiently, or bear not patiently, equal it is to you; you are only being recompensed for that you were working.’

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss,
text_en_yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness,-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
text_en_arberry: Surely the godfearing shall be in gardens and bliss,

text_ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
text_en_primary: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire.
text_en_yusufali: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
text_en_pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
text_en_arberry: rejoicing in that their Lord has given them; and their Lord shall guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

text_ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
text_en_yusufali: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds."
text_en_pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,
text_en_arberry: ’Eat and drink, with wholesome appetite, for that you were working.

text_ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.
text_en_yusufali: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes.
text_en_pickthall: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
text_en_arberry: Reclining upon couches ranged in rows; and We shall espouse them to wide-eyed houris.

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed.
text_en_yusufali: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds.
text_en_pickthall: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life’s) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.
text_en_arberry: And those who believed, and their seed followed them in belief, We shall join their seed with them, and We shall not defraud them of aught of their work; every man shall be pledged for what he earned.

text_ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
text_en_primary: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire.
text_en_yusufali: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
text_en_pickthall: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
text_en_arberry: And We shall succour them with fruits and flesh such as they desire

text_ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness.
text_en_yusufali: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
text_en_pickthall: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
text_en_arberry: while they pass therein a cup one to another wherein is no idle talk, no cause of sin,

text_ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
text_en_primary: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls.
text_en_yusufali: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them. Youths (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
text_en_pickthall: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
text_en_arberry: and there go round them youths, their own, as if they were hidden pearls.

text_ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
text_en_primary: They will turn to one another inquisitively.
text_en_yusufali: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
text_en_pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
text_en_arberry: They advance one upon another, asking each other questions.

text_ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
text_en_primary: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people.
text_en_yusufali: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people.
text_en_pickthall: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
text_en_arberry: They say, ’We were before among our people, ever going in fear,

text_ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
text_en_primary: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat.
text_en_yusufali: "But God has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind.
text_en_pickthall: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
text_en_arberry: and God was gracious to us, and guarded us against the chastisement of the burning wind;

text_ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
text_en_primary: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”
text_en_yusufali: "Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful!"
text_en_pickthall: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.
text_en_arberry: we were before ever calling upon Him; surely He is the All-benign, the All-compassionate.’

text_ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
text_en_primary: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O  Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed.
text_en_pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
text_en_arberry: Therefore remind! by thy Lord’s blessing thou art not a soothsayer neither possessed.

text_ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
text_en_primary: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”?
text_en_yusufali: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time!"
text_en_pickthall: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time ?
text_en_arberry: Or do they say, ’He is a poet for whom we await Fate’s uncertainty’?

text_ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
text_en_primary: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”
text_en_yusufali: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you!"
text_en_pickthall: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’Await! I shall be awaiting with you.’

text_ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
text_en_primary: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people?
text_en_yusufali: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
text_en_pickthall: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk ?
text_en_arberry: Or do their intellects bid them do this? Or are they an insolent people?

text_ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith.
text_en_yusufali: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith!
text_en_pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it ? Nay, but they will not believe!
text_en_arberry: Or do they say, ’He has invented it?’ Nay, but they do not believe.

text_ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
text_en_primary: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true!
text_en_yusufali: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth!
text_en_pickthall: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.
text_en_arberry: Then let them bring a discourse like it, if they speak truly.

text_ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
text_en_primary: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators?
text_en_yusufali: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
text_en_pickthall: Or were they created out of naught ? Or are they the creators ?
text_en_arberry: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?

text_ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
text_en_primary: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief.
text_en_pickthall: Or did they create the heavens and the earth ? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
text_en_arberry: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Nay, but they have not sure faith.

text_ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺?
text_en_yusufali: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)?
text_en_pickthall: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord ? Or have they been given charge (thereof) ?
text_en_arberry: Or are thy Lord’s treasuries in their keeping? Or are they the registrars?

text_ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
text_en_primary: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof.
text_en_yusufali: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof.
text_en_pickthall: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
text_en_arberry: Or have they a ladder whereon they listen? Then let any of them that has listened bring a clear authority.

text_ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
text_en_primary: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons?
text_en_yusufali: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons?
text_en_pickthall: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons ?
text_en_arberry: Or has He daughters, and they sons?

text_ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
text_en_primary: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt?
text_en_yusufali: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
text_en_pickthall: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt ?
text_en_arberry: Or askest thou them for a wage, and so they are weighed down with debt?

text_ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
text_en_primary: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺?
text_en_yusufali: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?
text_en_pickthall: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down ?
text_en_arberry: Or is the Unseen in their keeping, and so they are writing it down?

text_ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
text_en_primary: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes.
text_en_yusufali: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy God are themselves involved in a Plot!
text_en_pickthall: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger) ? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
text_en_arberry: Or desire they to outwit? The unbelievers, they are the outwitted.

text_ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
text_en_primary: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺!
text_en_yusufali: Or have they a god other than God? Exalted is God far above the things they associate with Him!
text_en_pickthall: Or have they any god beside Allah ? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
text_en_arberry: Or have they a god, other than God? Glory be to God, above that which they associate!

text_ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
text_en_primary: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”
text_en_yusufali: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
text_en_pickthall: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
text_en_arberry: Even if they saw lumps falling from heaven, they would say, ’A massed cloud!’

text_ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
text_en_primary: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—
text_en_yusufali: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-
text_en_pickthall: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
text_en_arberry: Then leave them, till they encounter their day wherein they shall be thunderstruck,

text_ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
text_en_primary: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped.
text_en_yusufali: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.
text_en_pickthall: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
text_en_arberry: the day when their guile shall avail them naught, and they shall not be helped.

text_ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know.
text_en_yusufali: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
text_en_pickthall: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
text_en_arberry: And there surely awaits the evildoers a chastisement beyond even that, but most of them know it not.

text_ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
text_en_primary: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.
text_en_yusufali: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
text_en_pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord’s decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
text_en_arberry: And be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord; surely thou art before Our eyes. And proclaim the praise of thy Lord when thou arisest,

text_ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
text_en_primary: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars.
text_en_yusufali: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!
text_en_pickthall: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
text_en_arberry: and proclaim the praise of thy Lord in the night, and at the declining of the stars.

text_ar: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
text_en_primary: By the stars when they fade away!
text_en_yusufali: By the Star when it goes down,-
text_en_pickthall: By the Star when it setteth,
text_en_arberry: By the Star when it plunges,

text_ar: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
text_en_primary: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray.
text_en_yusufali: Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled.
text_en_pickthall: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;
text_en_arberry: your comrade is not astray, neither errs,

text_ar: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: Nor does he speak of his own whims.
text_en_yusufali: Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire.
text_en_pickthall: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
text_en_arberry: nor speaks he out of caprice.

text_ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ
text_en_primary: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺.
text_en_yusufali: It is no less than inspiration sent down to him:
text_en_pickthall: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,
text_en_arberry: This is naught but a revelation revealed,

text_ar: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
text_en_primary: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power
text_en_yusufali: He was taught by one Mighty in Power,
text_en_pickthall: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,
text_en_arberry: taught him by one terrible in power,

text_ar: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
text_en_primary: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form
text_en_yusufali: Endued with Wisdom: for he appeared (in stately form);
text_en_pickthall: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
text_en_arberry: very strong; he stood poised,

text_ar: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
text_en_primary: while on the highest point above the horizon,
text_en_yusufali: While he was in the highest part of the horizon:
text_en_pickthall: When he was on the uppermost horizon.
text_en_arberry: being on the higher horizon,

text_ar: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
text_en_primary: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close
text_en_yusufali: Then he approached and came closer,
text_en_pickthall: Then he drew nigh and came down
text_en_arberry: then drew near and suspended hung,

text_ar: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less.
text_en_yusufali: And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer;
text_en_pickthall: Till he was (distant) two bows’ length or even nearer,
text_en_arberry: two bows’ length away, or nearer,

text_ar: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
text_en_primary: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺.
text_en_yusufali: So did (God) convey the inspiration to His Servant- (conveyed) what He (meant) to convey.
text_en_pickthall: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.
text_en_arberry: then revealed to his servant that he revealed.

text_ar: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw.
text_en_yusufali: The (Prophet’s) (mind and) heart in no way falsified that which he saw.
text_en_pickthall: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.
text_en_arberry: His heart lies not of what he saw;

text_ar: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
text_en_primary: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw?
text_en_yusufali: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he saw?
text_en_pickthall: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth ?
text_en_arberry: what, will you dispute with him what he sees?

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time
text_en_yusufali: For indeed he saw him at a second descent,
text_en_pickthall: And verily he saw him yet another time
text_en_arberry: Indeed, he saw him another time

text_ar: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
text_en_primary: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—
text_en_yusufali: Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass:
text_en_pickthall: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,
text_en_arberry: by the Lote-Tree of the Boundary

text_ar: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—
text_en_yusufali: Near it is the Garden of Abode.
text_en_pickthall: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.
text_en_arberry: nigh which is the Garden of the Refuge,

text_ar: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
text_en_primary: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours!
text_en_yusufali: Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable!)
text_en_pickthall: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
text_en_arberry: when there covered the Lote-Tree that which covered;

text_ar: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
text_en_primary: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach.
text_en_yusufali: (His) sight never swerved, nor did it go wrong!
text_en_pickthall: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.
text_en_arberry: his eye swerved not; nor swept astray.

text_ar: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs.
text_en_yusufali: For truly did he see, of the Signs of his Lord, the Greatest!
text_en_pickthall: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.
text_en_arberry: Indeed, he saw one of the greatest signs of his Lord.

text_ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
text_en_primary: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lat and ’Uzza,
text_en_yusufali: Have ye seen Lat. and ’Uzza,
text_en_pickthall: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-’Uzza
text_en_arberry: Have you considered El-Lat and El-’Uzza

text_ar: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: and the third one, Manat, as well?
text_en_yusufali: And another, the third (goddess), Manat?
text_en_pickthall: And Manat, the third, the other ?
text_en_arberry: and Manat the third, the other?

text_ar: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
text_en_primary: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters?
text_en_yusufali: What! for you the male sex, and for Him, the female?
text_en_pickthall: Are yours the males and His the females ?
text_en_arberry: What, have you males, and He females?

text_ar: تِلْكَ إِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution!
text_en_yusufali: Behold, such would be indeed a division most unfair!
text_en_pickthall: That indeed were an unfair division!
text_en_arberry: That were indeed an unjust division.

text_ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: These are nothing but names which ye have devised,- ye and your fathers,- for which God has sent down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire!- Even though there has already come to them Guidance from their Lord!
text_en_pickthall: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
text_en_arberry: They are naught but names yourselves have named, and your fathers; God has sent down no authority touching them. They follow only surmise, and what the souls desire; and yet guidance has come to them from their Lord.

text_ar: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
text_en_primary: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire?
text_en_yusufali: Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after?
text_en_pickthall: Or shall man have what he coveteth ?
text_en_arberry: Or shall man have whatever he fancies?

text_ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
text_en_primary: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next.
text_en_yusufali: But it is to God that the End and the Beginning (of all things) belong.
text_en_pickthall: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.
text_en_arberry: And to God belongs the First and the Last.

text_ar: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves.
text_en_yusufali: How many-so-ever be the angels in the heavens, their intercession will avail nothing except after God has given leave for whom He pleases and that he is acceptable to Him.
text_en_pickthall: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.
text_en_arberry: How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession avails not anything, save after that God gives leave to whomsoever He wills and is well-pleased.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
text_en_primary: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female,
text_en_yusufali: Those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
text_en_arberry: Those who do not believe in the world to come name the angels with the names of females.

text_ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
text_en_primary: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth.
text_en_yusufali: But they have no knowledge therein. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails nothing against Truth.
text_en_pickthall: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.
text_en_arberry: They have not any knowledge thereof; they follow only surmise, and surmise avails naught against truth.

text_ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
text_en_primary: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world.
text_en_pickthall: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
text_en_arberry: So turn thou from him who turns away from Our Remembrance, and desires only the present life.

text_ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
text_en_primary: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided.
text_en_yusufali: That is as far as knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth best those who receive guidance.
text_en_pickthall: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.
text_en_arberry: That is their attainment of knowledge. Surely thy Lord knows very well those who have gone astray from His way, and He knows very well those who are guided.

text_ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
text_en_primary: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—
text_en_yusufali: Yea, to God belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: so that He rewards those who do evil, according to their deeds, and He rewards those who do good, with what is best.
text_en_pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.
text_en_arberry: To God belongs whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may recompense those who do evil for what they have done, and recompense those who have done good with the reward most fair.

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous.
text_en_yusufali: Those who avoid great sins and shameful deeds, only (falling into) small faults,- verily thy Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you well when He brings you out of the earth, And when ye are hidden in your mothers’ wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves: He knows best who it is that guards against evil.
text_en_pickthall: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).
text_en_arberry: Those who avoid the heinous sins and indecencies, save lesser offences surely thy Lord is wide in His forgiveness. Very well He knows you, when He produced you from the earth, and when you were yet unborn in your mothers’ wombs; therefore hold not yourselves purified; God knows very well him who is godfearing.

text_ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
text_en_primary: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou one who turns back,
text_en_pickthall: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,
text_en_arberry: Hast thou considered him who turns his back

text_ar: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped?
text_en_yusufali: Gives a little, then hardens (his heart)?
text_en_pickthall: And gave a little, then was grudging ?
text_en_arberry: and gives a little, and then grudgingly?

text_ar: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺?
text_en_yusufali: What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see?
text_en_pickthall: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth ?
text_en_arberry: Does he possess the knowledge of the Unseen, and therefore he sees?

text_ar: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
text_en_primary: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses,
text_en_yusufali: Nay, is he not acquainted with what is in the Books of Moses-
text_en_pickthall: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
text_en_arberry: Or has he not been told of what is in the scrolls of Moses,

text_ar: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
text_en_primary: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺?
text_en_yusufali: And of Abraham who fulfilled his engagements?-
text_en_pickthall: And Abraham who paid his debt:
text_en_arberry: and Abraham, he who paid his debt in full?

text_ar: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another,
text_en_yusufali: Namely, that no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another;
text_en_pickthall: That no laden one shall bear another’s load,
text_en_arberry: That no soul laden bears the load of another,

text_ar: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
text_en_primary: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards,
text_en_yusufali: That man can have nothing but what he strives for;
text_en_pickthall: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,
text_en_arberry: and that a man shall have to his account only as he has laboured,

text_ar: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
text_en_primary: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺,
text_en_yusufali: That (the fruit of) his striving will soon come in sight:
text_en_pickthall: And that his effort will be seen.
