text_en_arberry: and that his labouring shall surely be seen,

text_ar: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
text_en_primary: then they will be fully rewarded,
text_en_yusufali: Then will he be rewarded with a reward complete;
text_en_pickthall: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;
text_en_arberry: then he shall be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense,

text_ar: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
text_en_primary: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺.
text_en_yusufali: That to thy Lord is the final Goal;
text_en_pickthall: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;
text_en_arberry: and that the final end is unto thy Lord,

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
text_en_primary: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness.
text_en_yusufali: That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears;
text_en_pickthall: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,
text_en_arberry: and that it is He who makes to laugh, and that makes to weep,

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
text_en_primary: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death.
text_en_yusufali: That it is He Who granteth Death and Life;
text_en_pickthall: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;
text_en_arberry: and that it is He who makes to die, and that makes to live,

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
text_en_primary: And He created the pairs—males and females—
text_en_yusufali: That He did create in pairs,- male and female,
text_en_pickthall: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
text_en_arberry: and that He Himself created the two kinds, male and female,

text_ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted.
text_en_yusufali: From a seed when lodged (in its place);
text_en_pickthall: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;
text_en_arberry: of a sperm-drop, when it was cast forth,

text_ar: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation.
text_en_yusufali: That He hath promised a Second Creation (Raising of the Dead);
text_en_pickthall: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;
text_en_arberry: and that upon Him rests the second growth,

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes.
text_en_yusufali: That it is He Who giveth wealth and satisfaction;
text_en_pickthall: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;
text_en_arberry: and that it is He who gives wealth and riches,

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius.
text_en_yusufali: That He is the Lord of Sirius (the Mighty Star);
text_en_pickthall: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;
text_en_arberry: and that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius,

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
text_en_primary: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd,
text_en_yusufali: And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) ancient ’Ad (people),
text_en_pickthall: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A’ad,
text_en_arberry: and that He destroyed Ad, the ancient,

text_ar: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
text_en_primary: and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one.
text_en_yusufali: And the Thamud nor gave them a lease of perpetual life.
text_en_pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;
text_en_arberry: and Thamood, and He did not spare them,

text_ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
text_en_primary: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression.
text_en_yusufali: And before them, the people of Noah, for that they were (all) most unjust and most insolent transgressors,
text_en_pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;
text_en_arberry: and the people of Noah before -- certainly they did exceeding evil, and were insolent

text_ar: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
text_en_primary: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down.
text_en_yusufali: And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah).
text_en_pickthall: And Al-Mu’tafikah He destroyed
text_en_arberry: and the Subverted City He also overthrew,

text_ar: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
text_en_primary: How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺!
text_en_yusufali: So that (ruins unknown) have covered them up.
text_en_pickthall: So that there covered them that which did cover.
text_en_arberry: so that there covered it that which covered.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
text_en_primary: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the gifts of thy Lord, (O man,) wilt thou dispute about?
text_en_pickthall: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute ?
text_en_arberry: Then which of thy Lord’s bounties disputest thou?

text_ar: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones.
text_en_yusufali: This is a Warner, of the (series of) Warners of old!
text_en_pickthall: This is a warner of the warners of old.
text_en_arberry: This is a warner, of the warners of old.

text_ar: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْءَازِفَةُ
text_en_primary: The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near.
text_en_yusufali: The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh:
text_en_pickthall: The threatened Hour is nigh.
text_en_arberry: The Imminent is imminent;

text_ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
text_en_primary: None but Allah can disclose it.
text_en_yusufali: No (soul) but God can lay it bare.
text_en_pickthall: None beside Allah can disclose it.
text_en_arberry: apart from God none can disclose it.

text_ar: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
text_en_primary: Do you find this revelation astonishing,
text_en_yusufali: Do ye then wonder at this recital?
text_en_pickthall: Marvel ye then at this statement,
text_en_arberry: Do you then marvel at this discourse,

text_ar: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
text_en_primary: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺,
text_en_yusufali: And will ye laugh and not weep,-
text_en_pickthall: And laugh and not weep,
text_en_arberry: and do you laugh, and do you not weep,

text_ar: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ
text_en_primary: while persisting in heedlessness?
text_en_yusufali: Wasting your time in vanities?
text_en_pickthall: While ye amuse yourselves ?
text_en_arberry: while you make merry?

text_ar: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
text_en_primary: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺!
text_en_yusufali: But fall ye down in prostration to God, and adore (Him)!
text_en_pickthall: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.
text_en_arberry: So bow yourselves before God, and serve Him!

text_ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
text_en_primary: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺.
text_en_yusufali: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
text_en_pickthall: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
text_en_arberry: The Hour has drawn nigh: the moon is split.

text_ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
text_en_primary: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”
text_en_yusufali: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."
text_en_pickthall: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
text_en_arberry: Yet if they see a sign they turn away, and they say ’A continuous sorcery!’

text_ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
text_en_primary: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—
text_en_yusufali: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
text_en_pickthall: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
text_en_arberry: They have cried lies, and followed their caprices; but every matter is settled.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
text_en_primary: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent.
text_en_yusufali: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),
text_en_pickthall: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,
text_en_arberry: And there have come to them such tidings as contain a deterrent --

text_ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
text_en_primary: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺.
text_en_yusufali: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
text_en_pickthall: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
text_en_arberry: a Wisdom far-reaching; yet warnings do not avail.

text_ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
text_en_primary: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller
text_en_yusufali: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,
text_en_pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
text_en_arberry: So turn thou away from them. Upon the day when the Caller shall call unto a horrible thing,

text_ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
text_en_primary: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts,
text_en_yusufali: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
text_en_pickthall: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
text_en_arberry: abasing their eyes, they shall come forth from the tombs as if they were scattered grasshoppers,

text_ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
text_en_primary: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”
text_en_yusufali: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.
text_en_pickthall: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
text_en_arberry: running with outstretched necks to the Caller. The unbelievers shall say, ’This is a hard day!’

text_ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
text_en_primary: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated.
text_en_yusufali: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their apostle): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.
text_en_pickthall: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
text_en_arberry: The people of Noah cried lies before them; they cried lies to Our servant, and said, ’A man possessed!’ And he was rejected.

text_ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
text_en_primary: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”
text_en_yusufali: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
text_en_pickthall: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
text_en_arberry: And so he called unto his Lord, saying, ’I am vanquished; do Thou succour me!’

text_ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain,
text_en_yusufali: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.
text_en_pickthall: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
text_en_arberry: Then We opened the gates of heaven unto water torrential,

text_ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
text_en_primary: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set.
text_en_yusufali: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.
text_en_pickthall: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.
text_en_arberry: and made the earth to gush with fountains, and the waters met for a matter decreed.

text_ar: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
text_en_primary: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails,
text_en_yusufali: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm- fibre:
text_en_pickthall: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,
text_en_arberry: And We bore him upon a well-planked vessel well-caulked

text_ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
text_en_primary: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied.
text_en_yusufali: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!
text_en_pickthall: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
text_en_arberry: running before Our eyes-a recompense for him denied.

text_ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
text_en_yusufali: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?
text_en_pickthall: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth ?
text_en_arberry: And We left it for a sign. Is there any that will remember?

text_ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
text_en_primary: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!
text_en_yusufali: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?
text_en_pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
text_en_arberry: How then were My chastisement and My warnings?

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
text_en_yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
text_en_pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur’an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth ?
text_en_arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

text_ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
text_en_primary: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!
text_en_yusufali: The ’Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?
text_en_pickthall: (The tribe of) A’ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
text_en_arberry: Ad cried lies. How then were My chastisement and My warnings?

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery,
text_en_yusufali: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
text_en_arberry: We loosed against them a wind clamorous in a day of ill fortune continuous,

text_ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees.
text_en_yusufali: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).
text_en_pickthall: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm- trees.
text_en_arberry: plucking up men as if they were stumps of uprooted palm-trees.

text_ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
text_en_primary: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!
text_en_yusufali: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
text_en_pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
text_en_arberry: How then were My chastisement and My warnings?

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
text_en_yusufali: But We have indeed made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
text_en_pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur’an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth ?
text_en_arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

text_ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
text_en_primary: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺,
text_en_yusufali: The Thamud (also) rejected (their) Warners.
text_en_pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings
text_en_arberry: Thamood cried lies to the warnings

text_ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
text_en_primary: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane.
text_en_yusufali: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!
text_en_pickthall: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow ? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
text_en_arberry: and said, ’What, shall we follow a mortal, one out of ourselves? Then indeed we should be in error and insanity!

text_ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
text_en_primary: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”
text_en_yusufali: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"
text_en_pickthall: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us ? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
text_en_arberry: Has the Reminder been cast upon him alone among us? Nay, rather he is an impudent liar.’

text_ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
text_en_primary: ˹It was revealed to salih,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is.
text_en_yusufali: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!
text_en_pickthall: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.
text_en_arberry: ’They shall surely know tomorrow who is the impudent liar.

text_ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
text_en_primary: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience.
text_en_yusufali: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
text_en_arberry: They shall send the She-camel as a trial for them; so watch thou them and keep patience.

text_ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
text_en_primary: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”
text_en_yusufali: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one’s right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).
text_en_pickthall: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.
text_en_arberry: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them, each drink for each in turn.

text_ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
text_en_primary: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺.
text_en_yusufali: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).
text_en_pickthall: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
text_en_arberry: Then they called their comrade, and he took in hand, and hamstrung her.

text_ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
text_en_primary: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!
text_en_yusufali: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
text_en_pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
text_en_arberry: How then were My chastisement and My warnings?

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders.
text_en_yusufali: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.
text_en_arberry: We loosed against them one Cry, and they were as the wattles of a pen-builder.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
text_en_yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
text_en_pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur’an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth ?
text_en_arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

text_ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
text_en_primary: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings.
text_en_yusufali: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.
text_en_pickthall: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
text_en_arberry: The people of Lot cried lies to the warnings.

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
text_en_primary: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn
text_en_yusufali: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut’s household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
text_en_arberry: We loosed against them a squall of pebbles except the folk of Lot; We delivered them at the dawn --

text_ar: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
text_en_primary: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks.
text_en_yusufali: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.
text_en_pickthall: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
text_en_arberry: a blessing from Us; even so We recompense him who is thankful.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
text_en_primary: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings.
text_en_yusufali: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.
text_en_pickthall: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.
text_en_arberry: He had warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warnings.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
text_en_primary: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”
text_en_yusufali: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
text_en_pickthall: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
text_en_arberry: Even his guests they had solicited of him; so We obliterated their eyes, saying, ’Taste now My chastisement and My warnings!’

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
text_en_primary: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment.
text_en_yusufali: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
text_en_pickthall: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
text_en_arberry: In the morning early there came upon them a settled chastisement:

text_ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
text_en_primary: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”
text_en_yusufali: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
text_en_pickthall: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!
text_en_arberry: ’Taste now My chastisement and My warnings!’

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
text_en_yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
text_en_pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur’an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth ?
text_en_arberry: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
text_en_primary: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh.
text_en_yusufali: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from God).
text_en_pickthall: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh
text_en_arberry: The warnings came also to Pharaoh’s folk.

text_ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful.
text_en_yusufali: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.
text_en_pickthall: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.
text_en_arberry: They cried lies to Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with the seizing of One mighty, omnipotent.

text_ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
text_en_primary: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books?
text_en_yusufali: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?
text_en_pickthall: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures ?
text_en_arberry: What, are your unbelievers better than those? Or have you an immunity in the Scrolls?

text_ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
text_en_primary: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”?
text_en_yusufali: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?
text_en_pickthall: Or say they: We are a host victorious ?
text_en_arberry: Or do they say, ’We are a congregation that shall be succoured?’

text_ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
text_en_primary: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee.
text_en_yusufali: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
text_en_pickthall: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.
text_en_arberry: Certainly the host shall be routed, and turn their backs.

text_ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
text_en_primary: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter.
text_en_yusufali: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).
text_en_arberry: Nay, but the Hour is their tryst, and the Hour is very calamitous and bitter.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes.
text_en_yusufali: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
text_en_arberry: Surely the sinners are in error and insanity!

text_ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
text_en_primary: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”
text_en_yusufali: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"
text_en_pickthall: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
text_en_arberry: The day when they are dragged on their faces into the Fire: ’Taste now the touch of Sakar!’

text_ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
text_en_arberry: Surely We have created everything in measure.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
text_en_primary: Our command done in the blink of an eye.
text_en_yusufali: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.
text_en_pickthall: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.
text_en_arberry: Our commandment is but one word, as the twinkling of an eye.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful?
text_en_yusufali: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?
text_en_pickthall: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth ?
text_en_arberry: We have destroyed the likes of you; is there any that will remember?

text_ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
text_en_primary: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records.
text_en_yusufali: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):
text_en_pickthall: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,
text_en_arberry: Every thing that they have done is in the Scrolls,

text_ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
text_en_primary: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺.
text_en_yusufali: Every matter, small and great, is on record.
text_en_pickthall: And every small and great thing is recorded.
text_en_arberry: and everything, great and small, is inscribed.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers,
text_en_yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
text_en_arberry: Surely the godfearing shall dwell amid gardens and a river

text_ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
text_en_primary: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.
text_en_yusufali: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
text_en_pickthall: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
text_en_arberry: in a sure abode, in the presence of a King Omnipotent.

text_ar: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
text_en_primary: The Most Compassionate
text_en_yusufali: (God) Most Gracious!
text_en_pickthall: The Beneficent
text_en_arberry: The All-merciful

text_ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
text_en_primary: taught the Quran,
text_en_yusufali: It is He Who has taught the Qur’an.
text_en_pickthall: Hath made known the Qur’an.
text_en_arberry: has taught the Koran.

text_ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
text_en_primary: created humanity,
text_en_yusufali: He has created man:
text_en_pickthall: He hath created man.
text_en_arberry: He created man

text_ar: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
text_en_primary: ˹and˺ taught them speech.
text_en_yusufali: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).
text_en_pickthall: He hath taught him utterance.
text_en_arberry: and He has taught him the Explanation.

text_ar: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ
text_en_primary: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision.
text_en_yusufali: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;
text_en_pickthall: The sun and the moon are made punctual.
text_en_arberry: The sun and the moon to a reckoning,

text_ar: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
text_en_primary: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺.
text_en_yusufali: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) bow in adoration.
text_en_pickthall: The stars and the trees adore.
text_en_arberry: and the stars and the trees bow themselves;

text_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
text_en_primary: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺
text_en_yusufali: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),
text_en_pickthall: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
text_en_arberry: and heaven -- He raised it up, and set the Balance.

text_ar: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
text_en_primary: so that you do not defraud the scales.
text_en_yusufali: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.
text_en_pickthall: That ye exceed not the measure,
text_en_arberry: (Transgress not in the Balance,

text_ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
text_en_primary: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure.
text_en_yusufali: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
text_en_pickthall: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
text_en_arberry: and weigh with justice, and skimp not in the Balance.)

text_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
text_en_primary: He laid out the earth for all beings.
text_en_yusufali: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
text_en_pickthall: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
text_en_arberry: And earth -- He set it down for all beings,

text_ar: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
text_en_primary: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks,
text_en_yusufali: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);
text_en_pickthall: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
text_en_arberry: therein fruits, and palm-trees with sheaths,

text_ar: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
text_en_primary: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants.
text_en_yusufali: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
text_en_pickthall: Husked grain and scented herb.
text_en_arberry: and grain in the blade, and fragrant herbs.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
text_en_primary: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery,
text_en_yusufali: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,
text_en_pickthall: He created man of clay like the potter’s,
text_en_arberry: He created man of a clay like the potter’s,

text_ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
text_en_primary: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire.
text_en_yusufali: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke:
text_en_pickthall: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.
text_en_arberry: and He created the jinn of a smokeless fire.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
text_en_primary: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests.
text_en_yusufali: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests:
text_en_pickthall: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
text_en_arberry: Lord of the Two Easts, Lord of the Two Wests,

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
text_en_primary: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water,
text_en_yusufali: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:
text_en_pickthall: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.
text_en_arberry: He let forth the two seas that meet together,

text_ar: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
text_en_primary: yet between them is a barrier they never cross.
text_en_yusufali: Between them is a Barrier which they do not transgress:
text_en_pickthall: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).
text_en_arberry: between them a barrier they do not overpass.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
text_en_primary: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral.
text_en_yusufali: Out of them come Pearls and Coral:
text_en_pickthall: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.
text_en_arberry: From them come forth the pearl and the coral.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
text_en_primary: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains.
text_en_yusufali: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains:
text_en_pickthall: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.
text_en_arberry: His too are the ships that run, raised up in the sea like land-marks.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ
text_en_primary: Every being on earth is bound to perish.
text_en_yusufali: All that is on earth will perish:
text_en_pickthall: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;
text_en_arberry: All that dwells upon the earth is perishing,

text_ar: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
text_en_primary: Only your Lord Himself,
text_en_yusufali: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
text_en_pickthall: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.
text_en_arberry: yet still abides the Face of thy Lord, majestic, splendid.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
text_en_primary: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about.
text_en_yusufali: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!
text_en_pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
text_en_arberry: Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth implore Him; every day He is upon some labour.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
text_en_primary: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O  two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺!
text_en_yusufali: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!
text_en_pickthall: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
text_en_arberry: We shall surely attend to you at leisure, you weight and you weight!

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
text_en_primary: O  assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority.
text_en_yusufali: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!
text_en_pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
text_en_arberry: O tribe of jinn and of men, if you are able to pass through the confines of heaven and earth, pass through them! You shall not pass through except with an authority.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
text_en_primary: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another.
text_en_yusufali: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have:
text_en_pickthall: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.
text_en_arberry: Against you shall be loosed a flame of fire, and molten brass; and you shall not be helped.

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?
text_en_arberry: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
text_en_primary: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil!
text_en_yusufali: When the sky is rent asunder, and it becomes red like ointment:
text_en_pickthall: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -
text_en_arberry: And when heaven is split asunder, and turns crimson like red leather --

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
text_en_primary: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
text_en_yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
text_en_pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ? -
text_en_arberry: O which of our Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?

text_ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

text_en_yusufali: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
text_en_pickthall: On lined couches,
text_en_arberry: upon close-wrought couches

text_ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
text_en_primary: reclining face to face.
text_en_yusufali: Reclining on them, facing each other.
text_en_pickthall: Reclining therein face to face.
text_en_arberry: reclining upon them, set face to face,

text_ar: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
text_en_primary: They will be waited on by eternal youths
text_en_yusufali: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
text_en_pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths
text_en_arberry: immortal youths going round about them

text_ar: بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: with cups, pitchers, and a drink ˹of pure wine˺ from a flowing stream,
text_en_yusufali: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
text_en_pickthall: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
text_en_arberry: with goblets, and ewers, and a cup from a spring

text_ar: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
text_en_primary: that will cause them neither headache nor intoxication.
text_en_yusufali: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
text_en_pickthall: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
text_en_arberry: (no brows throbbing, no intoxication)

text_ar: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹They will also be served˺ any fruit they choose
text_en_yusufali: And with fruits, any that they may select:
text_en_pickthall: And fruit that they prefer
text_en_arberry: and such fruits as they shall choose,

text_ar: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
text_en_primary: and meat from any bird they desire.
text_en_yusufali: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
text_en_pickthall: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
text_en_arberry: and such flesh of fowl as they desire,

text_ar: وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ
text_en_primary: And ˹they will have˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes,
text_en_yusufali: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
text_en_pickthall: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
text_en_arberry: and wide-eyed houris

text_ar: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
text_en_primary: like pristine pearls,
text_en_yusufali: Like unto Pearls well-guarded.
text_en_pickthall: Like unto hidden pearls,
text_en_arberry: as the likeness of hidden pearls,

text_ar: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹all˺ as a reward for what they used to do.
text_en_yusufali: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
text_en_pickthall: Reward for what they used to do.
text_en_arberry: a recompense for that they laboured.

text_ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
text_en_primary: There they will never hear any idle or sinful talk—
text_en_yusufali: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
text_en_pickthall: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
text_en_arberry: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, no cause of sin,

text_ar: إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا
text_en_primary: only good and virtuous speech.
text_en_yusufali: Only the saying, "Peace! Peace".
text_en_pickthall: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
text_en_arberry: only the saying ’Peace, Peace!’

text_ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
text_en_primary: And the people of the right—how ˹blessed˺ will they be!
text_en_yusufali: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
text_en_pickthall: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand ?
text_en_arberry: The Companions of the Right (O Companions of the Right!)

text_ar: فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be˺ amid thornless lote trees,
text_en_yusufali: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
text_en_pickthall: Among thornless lote-trees
text_en_arberry: mid thornless lote-trees

text_ar: وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
text_en_primary: clusters of bananas,
text_en_yusufali: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
text_en_pickthall: And clustered plantains,
text_en_arberry: and serried acacias,

text_ar: وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ
text_en_primary: extended shade,
text_en_yusufali: In shade long-extended,
text_en_pickthall: And spreading shade,
text_en_arberry: and spreading shade

text_ar: وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ
text_en_primary: flowing water,
text_en_yusufali: By water flowing constantly,
text_en_pickthall: And water gushing,
text_en_arberry: and outpoured waters,

text_ar: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: abundant fruit—
text_en_yusufali: And fruit in abundance.
text_en_pickthall: And fruit in plenty
text_en_arberry: and fruits abounding

text_ar: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: never out of season nor forbidden—
text_en_yusufali: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
text_en_pickthall: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
text_en_arberry: unfailing, unforbidden,

text_ar: وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
text_en_primary: and elevated furnishings.
text_en_yusufali: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
text_en_pickthall: And raised couches;
text_en_arberry: and upraised couches.

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We will have perfectly created their mates,
text_en_yusufali: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
text_en_arberry: Perfectly We formed them, perfect,

text_ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
text_en_primary: making them virgins,
text_en_yusufali: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
text_en_pickthall: And made them virgins,
text_en_arberry: and We made them spotless virgins,

text_ar: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا
text_en_primary: loving and of equal age,
text_en_yusufali: Beloved (by nature), equal in age,-
text_en_pickthall: Lovers, friends,
text_en_arberry: chastely amorous,

text_ar: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
text_en_primary: for the people of the right,
text_en_yusufali: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
text_en_pickthall: For those on the right hand;
text_en_arberry: like of age for the Companions of the Right.

text_ar: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹who will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations
text_en_yusufali: A (goodly) number from those of old,
text_en_pickthall: A multitude of those of old
text_en_arberry: A throng of the ancients

text_ar: وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
text_en_primary: and a multitude from later generations.
text_en_yusufali: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
text_en_pickthall: And a multitude of those of later time.
text_en_arberry: and a throng of the later folk.

text_ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
text_en_primary: And the people of the left—how ˹miserable˺ will they be!
text_en_yusufali: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
text_en_pickthall: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand ?
text_en_arberry: The Companions of the Left (O Companions of the Left!)

text_ar: فِى سَمُومٍۢ وَحَمِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be˺ in scorching heat and boiling water,
text_en_yusufali: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
text_en_pickthall: In scorching wind and scalding water
text_en_arberry: mid burning winds and boiling waters

text_ar: وَظِلٍّۢ مِّن يَحْمُومٍۢ
text_en_primary: in the shade of black smoke,
text_en_yusufali: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
text_en_pickthall: And shadow of black smoke,
text_en_arberry: and the shadow of a smoking blaze

text_ar: لَّا بَارِدٍۢ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
text_en_primary: neither cool nor refreshing.
text_en_yusufali: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
text_en_pickthall: Neither cool nor refreshing.
text_en_arberry: neither cool, neither goodly;

text_ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, before this ˹torment˺ they were spoiled by luxury,
text_en_yusufali: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
text_en_pickthall: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
text_en_arberry: and before that they lived at ease,

text_ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
text_en_primary: and persisted in the worst of sin.
text_en_yusufali: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
text_en_pickthall: And used to persist in the awful sin.
text_en_arberry: and persisted in the Great Sin,

text_ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
text_en_primary: They used to ask ˹mockingly˺, “When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?
text_en_yusufali: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
text_en_pickthall: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
text_en_arberry: ever saying, ’What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be raised up?

text_ar: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
text_en_primary: And our forefathers as well?”
text_en_yusufali: "(We) and our fathers of old?"
text_en_pickthall: And also our forefathers ?
text_en_arberry: What, and our fathers, the ancients?’

text_ar: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Most certainly, earlier and later generations
text_en_yusufali: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
text_en_pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
text_en_arberry: Say: ’The ancients, and the later folk

text_ar: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
text_en_primary: will surely be gathered ˹together˺ for the appointed Day.
text_en_yusufali: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
text_en_pickthall: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
text_en_arberry: shall be gathered to the appointed time of a known day.

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
text_en_primary: Then you, O  misguided deniers,
text_en_yusufali: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
text_en_pickthall: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
text_en_arberry: Then you erring ones, you that cried lies,

text_ar: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍۢ مِّن زَقُّومٍۢ
text_en_primary: will certainly eat from ˹the fruit of˺ the trees of Zaqqûm,
text_en_yusufali: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
text_en_pickthall: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
text_en_arberry: you shall eat of a tree called Zakkoum,

text_ar: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
text_en_primary: filling up ˹your˺ bellies with it.
text_en_yusufali: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
text_en_pickthall: And will fill your bellies therewith;
text_en_arberry: and you shall fill therewith your bellies

text_ar: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
text_en_primary: Then on top of that you will drink boiling water—
text_en_yusufali: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
text_en_pickthall: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
text_en_arberry: and drink on top of that boiling water

text_ar: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ
text_en_primary: and you will drink ˹it˺ like thirsty camels do.”
text_en_yusufali: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
text_en_pickthall: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
text_en_arberry: lapping it down like thirsty camels.’

text_ar: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: This will be their accommodation on the Day of Judgment.
text_en_yusufali: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
text_en_pickthall: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
text_en_arberry: This shall be their hospitality on the Day of Doom.

text_ar: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
text_en_primary: It is We Who created you. Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺?
text_en_yusufali: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
text_en_pickthall: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth ?
text_en_arberry: We created you; therefore why will you not believe?

text_ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ
text_en_primary: Have you considered what you ejaculate?
text_en_yusufali: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
text_en_pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye emit ?
text_en_arberry: Have you considered the seed you spill?

text_ar: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
text_en_primary: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so?
text_en_yusufali: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
text_en_pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator ?
text_en_arberry: Do you yourselves create it, or are We the Creators?

text_ar: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
text_en_primary: We have ordained death for ˹all of˺ you, and We cannot be prevented
text_en_yusufali: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
text_en_pickthall: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
text_en_arberry: We have decreed among you Death; We shall not be outstripped;

text_ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: from transforming and recreating you in forms unknown to you.
text_en_yusufali: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
text_en_pickthall: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
text_en_arberry: that We may exchange the likes of you, and make you to grow again in a fashion you know not.

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful?
text_en_yusufali: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
text_en_pickthall: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect ?
text_en_arberry: You have known the first growth; so why will you not remember?

text_ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ
text_en_primary: Have you considered what you sow?
text_en_yusufali: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
text_en_pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate ?
text_en_arberry: Have you considered the soil you till?

text_ar: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ
text_en_primary: Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who do so?
text_en_yusufali: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
text_en_pickthall: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer ?
text_en_arberry: Do you yourselves sow it, or are We the Sowers?

text_ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
text_en_primary: If We willed, We could simply reduce this ˹harvest˺ to chaff, leaving you to lament,
text_en_yusufali: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
text_en_pickthall: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
text_en_arberry: Did We will, We would make it broken orts, and you would remain bitterly jesting --

text_ar: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
text_en_primary: “We have truly suffered a ˹great˺ loss.
text_en_yusufali: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
text_en_pickthall: Lo! we are laden with debt!
text_en_arberry: ’We are debt-loaded;

text_ar: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
text_en_primary: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”
text_en_yusufali: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but we are deprived!
text_en_arberry: nay, we have been robbed!’

text_ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ
text_en_primary: Have you considered the water you drink?
text_en_yusufali: See ye the water which ye drink?
text_en_pickthall: Have ye observed the water which ye drink ?
text_en_arberry: Have you considered the water you drink?

text_ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
text_en_primary: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds, or is it We Who do so?
text_en_yusufali: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
text_en_pickthall: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder ?
text_en_arberry: Did you send it down from the clouds, or did We send it?

text_ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًۭا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
text_en_primary: If We willed, We could make it salty. Will you not then give thanks?
text_en_yusufali: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
text_en_pickthall: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks ?
text_en_arberry: Did We will, We would make it bitter; so why are you not thankful?

text_ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ
text_en_primary: Have you considered the fire you kindle?
text_en_yusufali: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
text_en_pickthall: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
text_en_arberry: Have you considered the fire you kindle?

text_ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
text_en_primary: Is it you who produce its trees, or is it We Who do so?
text_en_yusufali: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
text_en_pickthall: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower ?
text_en_arberry: Did you make its timber to grow, or did We make it?

text_ar: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَٰهَا تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَمَتَٰعًۭا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ
text_en_primary: We have made it ˹as˺ a reminder ˹of the Hellfire˺ and a provision for the travellers.
text_en_yusufali: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
text_en_pickthall: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
text_en_arberry: We Ourselves made it for a reminder, and a boon to the desert-dwellers.

text_ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
text_en_primary: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.
text_en_yusufali: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
text_en_pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
text_en_arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

text_ar: ۞ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
text_en_primary: So I do swear by the positions of the stars—
text_en_yusufali: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
text_en_pickthall: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
text_en_arberry: No! I swear by the fallings of the stars

text_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌۭ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
text_en_primary: and this, if only you knew, is indeed a great oath—
text_en_yusufali: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
text_en_pickthall: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
text_en_arberry: (and that is indeed a mighty oath, did you but know it)

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: that this is truly a noble Quran,
text_en_yusufali: That this is indeed a qur’an Most Honourable,
text_en_pickthall: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur’an
text_en_arberry: it is surely a noble Koran

text_ar: فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مَّكْنُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: in a well-preserved Record,
text_en_yusufali: In Book well-guarded,
text_en_pickthall: In a Book kept hidden
text_en_arberry: in a hidden Book

text_ar: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ
text_en_primary: touched by none except the purified ˹angels˺.
text_en_yusufali: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
text_en_pickthall: Which none toucheth save the purified,
text_en_arberry: none but the purified shall touch,

text_ar: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds.
text_en_yusufali: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_pickthall: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
text_en_arberry: a sending down from the Lord of all Being.

text_ar: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ
text_en_primary: How can you then take this message lightly,
text_en_yusufali: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
text_en_pickthall: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
text_en_arberry: What, do you hold this discourse in disdain,

text_ar: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ
text_en_primary: and repay ˹Allah for˺ your provisions with denial?
text_en_yusufali: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
text_en_pickthall: And make denial thereof your livelihood ?
text_en_arberry: and do you make it your living to cry lies?

text_ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ
text_en_primary: Why then ˹are you helpless˺ when the soul ˹of a dying person˺ reaches ˹their˺ throat,
text_en_yusufali: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
text_en_pickthall: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
text_en_arberry: Why, but when the soul leaps to the throat of the dying

text_ar: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍۢ تَنظُرُونَ
text_en_primary: while you are looking on?
text_en_yusufali: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
text_en_pickthall: And ye are at that moment looking
text_en_arberry: and that hour you are watching

text_ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
text_en_primary: And We are nearer to such a person than you, but you cannot see.
text_en_yusufali: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
text_en_pickthall: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
text_en_arberry: (And We are nigher him than you, but you do not see Us)

text_ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ
text_en_primary: Now, if you are not subject to Our Will ˹as you claim˺,
text_en_yusufali: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
text_en_pickthall: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
text_en_arberry: why, if you are not at Our disposal,

text_ar: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
text_en_primary: bring that soul back, if what you say is true.
text_en_yusufali: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
text_en_pickthall: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful ?
text_en_arberry: do you not bring back his soul, if you speak truly?

text_ar: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
text_en_primary: So, if the deceased is one of those brought near ˹to Us˺,
text_en_yusufali: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to God,
text_en_pickthall: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
text_en_arberry: Then, if he be of those brought nigh the Throne,

text_ar: فَرَوْحٌۭ وَرَيْحَانٌۭ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: then ˹such a person will have˺ serenity, fragrance, and a Garden of Bliss.
text_en_yusufali: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
text_en_pickthall: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
text_en_arberry: there shall be repose and ease, and a Garden of Delight;

text_ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
text_en_primary: And if the deceased is one of the people of the right,
text_en_yusufali: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
text_en_pickthall: And if he is of those on the right hand,
text_en_arberry: and if he be a Companion of the Right:

text_ar: فَسَلَٰمٌۭ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
text_en_primary: then ˹they will be told,˺ “Greetings to you from the people of the right.”
text_en_yusufali: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
text_en_pickthall: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
text_en_arberry: ’Peace be upon thee, Companion of the Right!’

text_ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
text_en_primary: But if such person is one of the misguided deniers,
text_en_yusufali: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
text_en_pickthall: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
text_en_arberry: But if he be of them that cried lies, and went astray,

text_ar: فَنُزُلٌۭ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: then their accommodation will be boiling water ˹to drink˺
text_en_yusufali: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
text_en_pickthall: Then the welcome will be boiling water
text_en_arberry: there shall be a hospitality of boiling water

text_ar: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
text_en_primary: and burning in Hellfire.
text_en_yusufali: And burning in Hell-Fire.
text_en_pickthall: And roasting at hell-fire.
text_en_arberry: and the roasting in Hell.

text_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, this is the absolute truth.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! this is certain truth.
text_en_arberry: Surely this is the truth of certainty.

text_ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
text_en_primary: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.
text_en_yusufali: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
text_en_pickthall: Therefor Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
text_en_arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

text_ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
text_en_primary: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah, for He is the Almighty, All-Wise.
text_en_yusufali: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth,- let it declare the Praises and Glory of God: for He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
text_en_pickthall: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
text_en_arberry: All that is in the heavens and the earth magnifies God; He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.

text_ar: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
text_en_primary: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death. And He is Most Capable of everything.
text_en_yusufali: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: It is He Who gives Life and Death; and He has Power over all things.
text_en_pickthall: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.
text_en_arberry: To Him belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth; He gives life, and He makes to die, and He is powerful over everything.

text_ar: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
text_en_primary: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and Most Near, and He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.
text_en_yusufali: He is the First and the Last, the Evident and the Immanent: and He has full knowledge of all things.
text_en_pickthall: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.
text_en_arberry: He is the First and the Last, the Outward and the Inward; He has knowledge of everything.

text_ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
text_en_primary: He is the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, For Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
text_en_yusufali: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in Six Days, and is moreover firmly established on the Throne (of Authority). He knows what enters within the earth and what comes forth out of it, what comes down from heaven and what mounts up to it. And He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And God sees well all that ye do.
text_en_pickthall: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
text_en_arberry: It is He that created the heavens and the earth in six days then seated Himself upon the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes forth from it, -- what comes down from heaven, and what goes up unto it. He is with you wherever you are; and God sees the things you do.

text_ar: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
text_en_primary: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And to Allah all matters are returned.
text_en_yusufali: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: and all affairs are referred back to God.
text_en_pickthall: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.
text_en_arberry: To Him belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and unto Him all matters are returned.

text_ar: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
text_en_primary: He merges the night into day and the day into night. And He knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart.
text_en_yusufali: He merges Night into Day, and He merges Day into Night; and He has full knowledge of the secrets of (all) hearts.
text_en_pickthall: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts.
text_en_arberry: He makes the night to enter into the day and makes the day to enter into the night. He knows the thoughts within the breasts.

text_ar: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
text_en_primary: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and donate from what He has entrusted you with. So those of you who believe and donate will have a mighty reward.
text_en_yusufali: Believe in God and His apostle, and spend (in charity) out of the (substance) whereof He has made you heirs. For, those of you who believe and spend (in charity),- for them is a great Reward.
text_en_pickthall: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward.
text_en_arberry: Believe in God and His Messenger, and expend of that unto which He has made you successors. And those of you who believe and expend shall have a mighty wage.

text_ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger is inviting you to have faith in your Lord, although He has already taken your covenant, if you will ever believe.
text_en_yusufali: What cause have ye why ye should not believe in God?- and the Apostle invites you to believe in your Lord, and has indeed taken your Covenant, if ye are men of Faith.
text_en_pickthall: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers ?
text_en_arberry: How is it with you, that you believe not in God seeing that the Messenger is calling you to believe in your Lord, and He has taken compact with you, if you are believers?

text_ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: He is the One Who sends down clear revelations to His servant to bring you out of darkness and into light. For indeed Allah is Ever Gracious and Most Merciful to you.
text_en_yusufali: He is the One Who sends to His Servant Manifest Signs, that He may lead you from the depths of Darkness into the Light and verily God is to you most kind and Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful.
text_en_arberry: It is He who sends down upon His servant signs, clear signs, that He may bring you forth from the shadows into the light. Surely God is to you All-gentle, All-compassionate.

text_ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّۭا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
text_en_primary: And why should you not spend in the cause of Allah, while Allah is the ˹sole˺ inheritor of the heavens and the earth? Those of you who donated and fought before the victory ˹over Mecca˺ are unparalleled. They are far greater in rank than those who donated and fought afterwards. Yet Allah has promised each a fine reward. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
text_en_yusufali: And what cause have ye why ye should not spend in the cause of God?- For to God belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Not equal among you are those who spent (freely) and fought, before the Victory, (with those who did so later). Those are higher in rank than those who spent (freely) and fought afterwards. But to all has God promised a goodly (reward). And God is well acquainted with all that ye do.
text_en_pickthall: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth ? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
text_en_arberry: How is it with you, that you expend not in the way of God, and to God belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Not equal is he among you who spent, and who fought before the victory; those are mightier in rank than they who spent and fought afterwards; and unto each God has promised the reward most fair; and God is aware of the things you do.
