text_en_pickthall: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.
text_en_arberry: and whosoever is in the earth, all together, so that then it might deliver him.

text_ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
text_en_primary: But no! There will certainly be a raging Flame
text_en_yusufali: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
text_en_pickthall: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
text_en_arberry: Nay, verily it is a furnace

text_ar: نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ
text_en_primary: ripping off scalps.
text_en_yusufali: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
text_en_pickthall: Eager to roast;
text_en_arberry: snatching away the scalp,

text_ar: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
text_en_primary: It will summon whoever turned their backs ˹on Allah˺ and turned away ˹from the truth˺,
text_en_yusufali: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
text_en_pickthall: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),
text_en_arberry: calling him who drew back and turned away,

text_ar: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: and gathered and hoarded ˹wealth˺.
text_en_yusufali: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
text_en_pickthall: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.
text_en_arberry: who amassed and hoarded.

text_ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
text_en_primary: Indeed, humankind was created impatient:
text_en_yusufali: Truly man was created very impatient;-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! man was created anxious,
text_en_arberry: Surely man was created fretful,

text_ar: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا
text_en_primary: distressed when touched with evil,
text_en_yusufali: Fretful when evil touches him;
text_en_pickthall: Fretful when evil befalleth him
text_en_arberry: when evil visits him, impatient,

text_ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
text_en_primary: and withholding when touched with good—
text_en_yusufali: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
text_en_pickthall: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;
text_en_arberry: when good visits him, grudging,

text_ar: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
text_en_primary: except those who pray,
text_en_yusufali: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
text_en_pickthall: Save worshippers.
text_en_arberry: save those that pray

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
text_en_primary: consistently performing their prayers;
text_en_yusufali: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
text_en_pickthall: Who are constant at their worship
text_en_arberry: and continue at their prayers,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
text_en_primary: and who give the rightful share of their wealth
text_en_yusufali: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
text_en_pickthall: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
text_en_arberry: those in whose wealth is a right known

text_ar: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
text_en_primary: to the beggar and the poor;
text_en_yusufali: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
text_en_pickthall: For the beggar and the destitute;
text_en_arberry: for the beggar and the outcast,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment;
text_en_yusufali: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
text_en_pickthall: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
text_en_arberry: who confirm the Day of Doom

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
text_en_primary: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—
text_en_yusufali: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
text_en_pickthall: And those who are fearful of their Lord’s doom -
text_en_arberry: and go in fear of the chastisement of their Lord

text_ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—
text_en_yusufali: For their Lord’s displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
text_en_arberry: (from their Lord’s chastisement none feels secure)

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
text_en_primary: and those who guard their chastity
text_en_yusufali: And those who guard their chastity,
text_en_pickthall: And those who preserve their chastity
text_en_arberry: and guard their private parts

text_ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
text_en_primary: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame,
text_en_yusufali: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
text_en_pickthall: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;
text_en_arberry: save from their wives and what their right hands own, then not being blameworthy

text_ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
text_en_primary: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors.
text_en_yusufali: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
text_en_pickthall: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;
text_en_arberry: (but whoso seeks after more than that, they are the transgressors),

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹The faithful are˺ also those who are true to their trusts and covenants;
text_en_yusufali: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
text_en_pickthall: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,
text_en_arberry: and who preserve their trusts and their covenant,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
text_en_primary: and who are honest in their testimony;
text_en_yusufali: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
text_en_pickthall: And those who stand by their testimony
text_en_arberry: and perform their witnessings,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
text_en_primary: and who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers.
text_en_yusufali: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
text_en_pickthall: And those who are attentive at their worship.
text_en_arberry: and who observe their prayers.

text_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ
text_en_primary: These will be in Gardens, held in honour.
text_en_yusufali: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
text_en_pickthall: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.
text_en_arberry: Those shall be in Gardens, high-honoured.

text_ar: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
text_en_primary: So what is the matter with the disbelievers that they rush ˹head-long˺ towards you ˹O Prophet˺,
text_en_yusufali: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
text_en_pickthall: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,
text_en_arberry: What ails the unbelievers, running with outstretched necks

text_ar: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
text_en_primary: from the right and the left, in groups ˹to mock you˺?
text_en_yusufali: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
text_en_pickthall: On the right and on the left, in groups ?
text_en_arberry: towards thee on the right hand and on the left hand in knots?

text_ar: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?
text_en_yusufali: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
text_en_pickthall: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight ?
text_en_arberry: What, is every man of them eager to be admitted to a Garden of Bliss?

text_ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from.
text_en_yusufali: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.
text_en_arberry: Not so; for We have created them of what they know.

text_ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
text_en_primary: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable
text_en_yusufali: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
text_en_pickthall: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting- places of the planets that We verily are Able
text_en_arberry: No! I swear by the Lord of the Easts and Wests, surely We are able

text_ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
text_en_primary: of replacing them with ˹others˺ better than them, and We cannot be prevented ˹from doing so˺.
text_en_yusufali: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
text_en_pickthall: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.
text_en_arberry: to substitute a better than they; We shall not be outstripped.

text_ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
text_en_primary: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—
text_en_yusufali: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
text_en_pickthall: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,
text_en_arberry: Then leave them alone to plunge and play until they encounter that day of theirs which they are promised,

text_ar: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
text_en_primary: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺,
text_en_yusufali: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
text_en_pickthall: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,
text_en_arberry: the day they shall come forth from the tombs hastily, as if they were hurrying unto a waymark,

text_ar: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
text_en_primary: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of.
text_en_yusufali: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
text_en_pickthall: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
text_en_arberry: humbled their eyes, overspreading them abasement. That is the day which they were promised.

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
text_en_yusufali: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.
text_en_arberry: We sent Noah to his people, saying, ’Warn thy people, ere there come on them a painful chastisement.’

text_ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
text_en_primary: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning:
text_en_yusufali: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
text_en_pickthall: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
text_en_arberry: He said, ’O my people, I am unto you a clear warner,

text_ar: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
text_en_primary: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me.
text_en_yusufali: "That ye should worship God, fear Him and obey me:
text_en_pickthall: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,
text_en_arberry: saying, "Serve God, and fear Him, and obey you me,

text_ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”
text_en_yusufali: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by God is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
text_en_pickthall: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
text_en_arberry: nd He will forgive you your sins, and defer you to a stated term; God’s term, when it comes, cannot be deferred, did you but know."’

text_ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
text_en_primary: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night,
text_en_yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
text_en_pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
text_en_arberry: He said; ’My Lord, I have called my people by night and by day,

text_ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا
text_en_primary: but my calls only made them run farther away.
text_en_yusufali: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
text_en_pickthall: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;
text_en_arberry: but my calling has only increased them in flight.

text_ar: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
text_en_primary: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly.
text_en_yusufali: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
text_en_arberry: And whenever I called them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, and wrapped them in their garments, and persisted, and waxed very proud.

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا
text_en_primary: Then I certainly called them openly,
text_en_yusufali: "So I have called to them aloud;
text_en_pickthall: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,
text_en_arberry: Then indeed I called them openly;

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
text_en_primary: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately,
text_en_yusufali: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
text_en_pickthall: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
text_en_arberry: then indeed I spoke publicly unto them, and I spoke unto them secretly,

text_ar: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
text_en_primary: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving.
text_en_yusufali: "Saying, ’Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
text_en_pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
text_en_arberry: and I said, "Ask you forgiveness of your Lord; surely He is ever All-forgiving,

text_ar: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا
text_en_primary: He will shower you with abundant rain,
text_en_yusufali: "’He will send rain to you in abundance;
text_en_pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
text_en_arberry: and He will loose heaven upon you in torrents

text_ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا
text_en_primary: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers.
text_en_yusufali: "’Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
text_en_pickthall: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
text_en_arberry: and will succour you with wealth and sons, and will appoint for you gardens, and will appoint for you rivers.

text_ar: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
text_en_primary: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah,
text_en_yusufali: "’What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in God,-
text_en_pickthall: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity
text_en_arberry: What ails you, that you look not for majesty in God,

text_ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
text_en_primary: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺?
text_en_yusufali: "’Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
text_en_pickthall: When He created you by (divers) stages ?
text_en_arberry: seeing He created you by stages?

text_ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
text_en_primary: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other,
text_en_yusufali: "’See ye not how God has created the seven heavens one above another,
text_en_pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
text_en_arberry: Have you not regarded how God created seven heavens one upon another,

text_ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
text_en_primary: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp?
text_en_yusufali: "’And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
text_en_pickthall: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp ?
text_en_arberry: and set the moon therein for a light and the sun for a lamp?

text_ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا
text_en_primary: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant.
text_en_yusufali: "’And God has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
text_en_pickthall: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,
text_en_arberry: And God caused you to grow out of the earth,

text_ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا
text_en_primary: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺.
text_en_yusufali: "’And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
text_en_pickthall: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.
text_en_arberry: then He shall return you into it, and bring you forth.

text_ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا
text_en_primary: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you
text_en_yusufali: "’And God has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
text_en_pickthall: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you
text_en_arberry: And God has laid the earth for you as a carpet,

text_ar: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا
text_en_primary: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”
text_en_yusufali: "’That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.’"
text_en_pickthall: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.
text_en_arberry: that thereof you may thread ways, ravines."

text_ar: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss,
text_en_yusufali: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
text_en_pickthall: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
text_en_arberry: Noah said, ’My Lord, they have rebelled against me, and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in loss,

text_ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا
text_en_primary: and who have devised a tremendous plot,
text_en_yusufali: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
text_en_pickthall: And they have plotted a mighty plot,
text_en_arberry: and have devised a mighty device

text_ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
text_en_primary: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwa’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’
text_en_yusufali: "And they have said (to each other), ’Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa’, neither Yaguth nor Ya’uq, nor Nasr’;-
text_en_pickthall: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa’, nor Yaghuth and Ya’uq and Nasr.
text_en_arberry: and have said, "Do not leave your gods, and do not leave Wadd, nor Suwa’, Yaghuth, Ya’uq, neither Nasr."

text_ar: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا
text_en_primary: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”
text_en_yusufali: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong- doers but in straying (from their mark)."
text_en_pickthall: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.
text_en_arberry: And they have led many astray. Increase Thou not the evildoers save in error!’

text_ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
text_en_primary: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah.
text_en_yusufali: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of God- none to help them.
text_en_pickthall: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
text_en_arberry: And because of their transgressions they were drowned, and admitted into a Fire, for they found not, apart from God, any to help them.

text_ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
text_en_primary: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.
text_en_yusufali: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
text_en_pickthall: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
text_en_arberry: And Noah said, ’My Lord, leave not upon the earth of the unbelievers even one.

text_ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
text_en_primary: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers.
text_en_yusufali: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
text_en_pickthall: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
text_en_arberry: Surely, if Thou leavest them, they will lead Thy servants astray, and will beget none but unbelieving libertines.

text_ar: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
text_en_primary: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
text_en_yusufali: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
text_en_pickthall: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
text_en_arberry: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whosoever enters my house as a believer, and the believers, men and women alike; and do Thou not increase the evildoers save in ruin!’

text_ar: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation.
text_en_yusufali: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur’an). They said, ’We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
text_en_pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur’an,
text_en_arberry: Say: ’It has been revealed to me that a company of the jinn gave ear, then they said, "We have indeed heard a Koran wonderful,

text_ar: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
text_en_primary: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺.
text_en_yusufali: ’It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.
text_en_pickthall: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.
text_en_arberry: guiding to rectitude. We believe in it, and we will not associate with our Lord anyone.

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring,
text_en_yusufali: ’And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
text_en_pickthall: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,
text_en_arberry: He -- exalted be our Lord’s majesty! has not taken to Himself either consort or a son.

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
text_en_primary: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah.
text_en_yusufali: ’There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against God;
text_en_pickthall: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.
text_en_arberry: The fool among us spoke against God outrage,

text_ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
text_en_primary: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah.
text_en_yusufali: ’But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against God.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -
text_en_arberry: and we had thought that men and jinn would never speak against God a lie.

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
text_en_primary: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness.
text_en_yusufali: ’True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.
text_en_pickthall: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);
text_en_arberry: But there were certain men of mankind who would take refuge with certain men of the jinn, and they increased them in vileness,

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
text_en_primary: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺.
text_en_yusufali: ’And they (came to) think as ye thought, that God would not raise up any one (to Judgment).
text_en_pickthall: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -
text_en_arberry: and they thought, even as you also thought, that God would never raise up anyone.

text_ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars.
text_en_yusufali: ’And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
text_en_pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur’an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.
text_en_arberry: And we stretched towards heaven, but we found it filled with terrible guards and meteors.

text_ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
text_en_primary: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them.
text_en_yusufali: ’We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
text_en_pickthall: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
text_en_arberry: We would sit there on seats to hear; but any listening now finds a meteor in wait for him.

text_ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
text_en_primary: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right.
text_en_yusufali: ’And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.
text_en_pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.
text_en_arberry: And so we know not whether evil is intended for those in the earth, or whether their Lord intends for them rectitude.

text_ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
text_en_primary: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions.
text_en_yusufali: ’There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.
text_en_pickthall: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.
text_en_arberry: And some of us are the righteous, and some of us are otherwise; we are sects differing.

text_ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺.
text_en_yusufali: ’But we think that we can by no means frustrate God throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
text_en_pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
text_en_arberry: Indeed, we thought that we should never be able to frustrate God in the earth, neither be able to frustrate Him by flight.

text_ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
text_en_primary: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged.
text_en_yusufali: ’And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.
text_en_pickthall: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.
text_en_arberry: When we heard the guidance, we believed in it; and whosoever believes in his Lord, he shall fear neither paltriness nor vileness.

text_ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
text_en_primary: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance.
text_en_yusufali: ’Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to God), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
text_en_pickthall: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.
text_en_arberry: And some of us have surrendered, and some of us have deviated. Those who have surrendered sought rectitude;

text_ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
text_en_primary: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”
text_en_yusufali: ’But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire’-
text_en_pickthall: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.
text_en_arberry: but as for those who have deviated, they have become firewood for Gehenna!"’

text_ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
text_en_primary: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—
text_en_yusufali: (And God’s Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.
text_en_pickthall: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
text_en_arberry: Would they but go straight on the way, We would give them to drink of water copious,

text_ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
text_en_primary: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment.
text_en_yusufali: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.
text_en_pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
text_en_arberry: that We might try them therein. And whosoever turns away from the Remembrance of his Lord, He will thrust him into chastisement rigorous.

text_ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
text_en_primary: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him.
text_en_yusufali: "And the places of worship are for God (alone): So invoke not any one along with God;
text_en_pickthall: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.
text_en_arberry: The places of worship belong to God; so call not, along with God, upon anyone.

text_ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
text_en_primary: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him.
text_en_yusufali: "Yet when the Devotee of God stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."
text_en_pickthall: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.
text_en_arberry: When the servant of God stood calling on Him, they were wellnigh upon him in swarms.

text_ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”
text_en_yusufali: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."
text_en_pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’I call only upon my Lord, and I do not associate with Him anyone.

text_ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
text_en_primary: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”
text_en_yusufali: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."
text_en_pickthall: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’Surely I possess no power over you, either for hurt or for rectitude.’

text_ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
text_en_primary: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him.
text_en_yusufali: Say: "No one can deliver me from God (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,
text_en_pickthall: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
text_en_arberry: Say: ’From God shall protect me not anyone, and I shall find, apart from Him, no refuge,

text_ar: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
text_en_primary: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever.
text_en_yusufali: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from God and His Messages: for any that disobey God and His Apostle,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."
text_en_pickthall: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.
text_en_arberry: excepting a Deliverance from God and His Messages. And whoso rebels against God and His messenger, for him there awaits the Fire of Gehenna; therein they shall dwell forever.’

text_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
text_en_primary: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower.
text_en_yusufali: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
text_en_pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
text_en_arberry: Until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in numbers.

text_ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
text_en_primary: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it.
text_en_yusufali: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
text_en_pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
text_en_arberry: Say: ’I do not know whether that which you are promised is nigh, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a space;

text_ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
text_en_primary: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone,
text_en_yusufali: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-
text_en_pickthall: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,
text_en_arberry: Knower He of the Unseen, and He discloses not His Unseen to anyone,

text_ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
text_en_primary: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them
text_en_yusufali: "Except an apostle whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,
text_en_pickthall: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him
text_en_arberry: save only to such a Messenger as He is well-pleased with; then He despatches before him and behind him watchers,

text_ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
text_en_primary: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
text_en_yusufali: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."
text_en_pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
text_en_arberry: that He may know they have delivered the Messages of their Lord; and He encompasses all that is with them, and He has numbered everything in numbers.’

text_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
text_en_primary: O you wrapped ˹in your clothes˺!
text_en_yusufali: O thou folded in garments!
text_en_pickthall: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!
text_en_arberry: O thou enwrapped in thy robes,

text_ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—
text_en_yusufali: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-
text_en_pickthall: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -
text_en_arberry: keep vigil the night, except a little

text_ar: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
text_en_primary: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less,
text_en_yusufali: Half of it,- or a little less,
text_en_pickthall: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof
text_en_arberry: (a half of it, or diminish a little,

text_ar: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
text_en_primary: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way.
text_en_yusufali: Or a little more; and recite the Qur’an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.
text_en_pickthall: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur’an in measure,
text_en_arberry: or add a little), and chant the Koran very distinctly;

text_ar: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
text_en_primary: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation.
text_en_yusufali: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.
text_en_pickthall: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.
text_en_arberry: Behold, We shall cast upon thee a weighty word;

text_ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
text_en_primary: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation.
text_en_yusufali: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.
text_en_arberry: surely the first part of the night is heavier in tread, more upright in speech,

text_ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺.
text_en_yusufali: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
text_en_pickthall: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.
text_en_arberry: surely in the day thou hast long business.

text_ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.
text_en_yusufali: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
text_en_pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
text_en_arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord, and devote thyself unto Him very devoutly.

text_ar: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs.
text_en_yusufali: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
text_en_pickthall: Lord of the East and the West; there is no God save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -
text_en_arberry: Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He; so take Him for a Guardian.

text_ar: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously.
text_en_yusufali: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
text_en_pickthall: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
text_en_arberry: And bear thou patiently what they say, and forsake them graciously.

text_ar: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
text_en_primary: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while.
text_en_yusufali: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
text_en_pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
text_en_arberry: Leave Me to those who cry lies, those prosperous ones, and respite them a little,

text_ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire,
text_en_yusufali: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
text_en_pickthall: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
text_en_arberry: for with Us there are fetters, and a furnace,

text_ar: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
text_en_primary: choking food, and a painful punishment ˹in store for them˺
text_en_yusufali: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
text_en_pickthall: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
text_en_arberry: and food that chokes, and a painful chastisement,

text_ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
text_en_primary: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand.
text_en_yusufali: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
text_en_pickthall: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
text_en_arberry: upon the day when the earth and the mountains shall quake and the mountains become a slipping heap of sand.

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
text_en_primary: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
text_en_yusufali: We have sent to you, (O men!) an apostle, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent an apostle to Pharaoh.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.
text_en_arberry: Surely We have sent unto you a Messenger as a witness over you, even as We sent to Pharaoh a Messenger,

text_ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a stern grip.
text_en_yusufali: But Pharaoh disobeyed the apostle; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.
text_en_pickthall: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.
text_en_arberry: but Pharaoh rebelled against the Messenger, so We seized him remorselessly.

text_ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
text_en_primary: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey?
text_en_yusufali: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (God), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-
text_en_pickthall: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
text_en_arberry: If therefore you disbelieve, how will you guard yourselves against a day that shall make the children grey-headed?

text_ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
text_en_primary: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled.
text_en_yusufali: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.
text_en_pickthall: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.
text_en_arberry: Whereby heaven shall be split, and its promise shall be performed.

text_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
text_en_primary: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!
text_en_pickthall: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.
text_en_arberry: Surely this is a Reminder; so let him who will take unto his Lord a way.

text_ar: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
text_en_primary: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
text_en_yusufali: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But God doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur’an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of God’s bounty; yet others fighting in God’s Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur’an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to God a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in God’s Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of God: for God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two- thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur’an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah’s bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
text_en_arberry: Thy Lord knows that thou keepest vigil nearly two-thirds of the night, or a half of it, or a third of it, and a party of those with thee; and God determines the night and the day. He knows that you will not number it, and He has turned towards you. Therefore recite of the Koran so much as is feasible. He knows that some of you are sick, and others journeying in the land, seeking the bounty of God, and others fighting in the way of God. So recite of it so much as is feasible. And perform the prayer, and pay the alms, and lend to God a good loan. Whatever good you shall forward to your souls’ account, you shall find it with God as better, and mightier a wage. And ask God’s forgiveness; God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.

text_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
text_en_primary: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺!
text_en_yusufali: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
text_en_pickthall: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,
text_en_arberry: O thou shrouded in thy mantle,

text_ar: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
text_en_primary: Arise and warn ˹all˺.
text_en_yusufali: Arise and deliver thy warning!
text_en_pickthall: Arise and warn!
text_en_arberry: arise, and warn!

text_ar: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
text_en_primary: Revere your Lord ˹alone˺.
text_en_yusufali: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
text_en_pickthall: Thy Lord magnify,
text_en_arberry: Thy Lord magnify

text_ar: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
text_en_primary: Purify your garments.
text_en_yusufali: And thy garments keep free from stain!
text_en_pickthall: Thy raiment purify,
text_en_arberry: thy robes purify

text_ar: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
text_en_primary: ˹Continue to˺ shun idols.
text_en_yusufali: And all abomination shun!
text_en_pickthall: Pollution shun!
text_en_arberry: and defilement flee!

text_ar: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
text_en_primary: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺.
text_en_yusufali: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
text_en_pickthall: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!
text_en_arberry: Give not, thinking to gain greater

text_ar: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
text_en_primary: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord.
text_en_yusufali: But, for thy Lord’s (Cause), be patient and constant!
text_en_pickthall: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!
text_en_arberry: and be patient unto thy Lord.

text_ar: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
text_en_primary: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded,
text_en_yusufali: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
text_en_pickthall: For when the trumpet shall sound,
text_en_arberry: For when the Trump is sounded

text_ar: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
text_en_primary: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—
text_en_yusufali: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
text_en_pickthall: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,
text_en_arberry: that day will be a harsh day,

text_ar: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ
text_en_primary: far from easy for the disbelievers.
text_en_yusufali: Far from easy for those without Faith.
text_en_pickthall: Not of ease, for disbelievers.
text_en_arberry: for the unbelievers not easy.

text_ar: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا
text_en_primary: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself,
text_en_yusufali: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
text_en_pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,
text_en_arberry: Leave Me with him whom I created alone,

text_ar: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا
text_en_primary: and granted him abundant wealth,
text_en_yusufali: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
text_en_pickthall: And then bestowed upon him ample means,
text_en_arberry: and appointed for him ample wealth

text_ar: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا
text_en_primary: and children always by his side,
text_en_yusufali: And sons to be by his side!-
text_en_pickthall: And sons abiding in his presence
text_en_arberry: and sons standing before him,

text_ar: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا
text_en_primary: and made life very easy for him.
text_en_yusufali: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
text_en_pickthall: And made (life) smooth for him.
text_en_arberry: and made all things smooth for him;

text_ar: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
text_en_primary: Yet he is hungry for more.
text_en_yusufali: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
text_en_pickthall: Yet he desireth that I should give more.
text_en_arberry: then he is eager that I should do more.

text_ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا
text_en_primary: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations.
text_en_yusufali: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
text_en_pickthall: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
text_en_arberry: Nay! He is forward unto Our signs;

text_ar: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
text_en_primary: I will make his fate unbearable,
text_en_yusufali: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
text_en_pickthall: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.
text_en_arberry: and I shall constrain him to a hard ascent.

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
text_en_primary: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺.
text_en_yusufali: For he thought and he plotted;-
text_en_pickthall: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -
text_en_arberry: Lo! He reflected, and determined --

text_ar: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
text_en_primary: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined!
text_en_yusufali: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
text_en_pickthall: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!
text_en_arberry: death seize him, how he determined!

text_ar: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
text_en_primary: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined!
text_en_yusufali: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
text_en_pickthall: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -
text_en_arberry: Again, death seize him, how he determined!

text_ar: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
text_en_primary: Then he re-contemplated ˹in frustration˺,
text_en_yusufali: Then he looked round;
text_en_pickthall: Then looked he,
text_en_arberry: Then he beheld,

text_ar: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
text_en_primary: then frowned and scowled,
text_en_yusufali: Then he frowned and he scowled;
text_en_pickthall: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.
text_en_arberry: then he frowned, and scowled,

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
text_en_primary: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly,
text_en_yusufali: Then he turned back and was haughty;
text_en_pickthall: Then turned he away in pride
text_en_arberry: then he retreated, and waxed proud.

text_ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
text_en_primary: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients.
text_en_yusufali: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
text_en_pickthall: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;
text_en_arberry: He said, ’This is naught but a trumped-up sorcery;

text_ar: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
text_en_primary: This is no more than the word of a man.”
text_en_yusufali: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
text_en_pickthall: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.
text_en_arberry: ’this is nothing but mortal speech.’

text_ar: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
text_en_primary: Soon I will burn him in Hell!
text_en_yusufali: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
text_en_pickthall: Him shall I fling unto the burning.
text_en_arberry: I shall surely roast him in Sakar;

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
text_en_primary: And what will make you realize what Hell is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
text_en_pickthall: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -
text_en_arberry: and what will teach thee what is Sakar?

text_ar: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
text_en_primary: It does not let anyone live or die,
text_en_yusufali: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
text_en_pickthall: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught
text_en_arberry: It spares not, neither leaves alone

text_ar: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ
text_en_primary: scorching the skin.
text_en_yusufali: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
text_en_pickthall: It shrivelleth the man.
text_en_arberry: scorching the flesh;

text_ar: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
text_en_primary: It is overseen by nineteen ˹keepers˺.
text_en_yusufali: Over it are Nineteen.
text_en_pickthall: Above it are nineteen.
text_en_arberry: over it are nineteen.

text_ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
text_en_primary: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity.
text_en_yusufali: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth God intend by this ?" Thus doth God leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
text_en_pickthall: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude ? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
text_en_arberry: We have appointed only angels to be masters of the Fire, and their number We have appointed only as a trial for the unbelievers, that those who were given the Book may have certainty, and that those who believe may increase in belief, and that those who were given the Book and those who believe may not be in-doubt, and that those in whose hearts there is sickness, and the unbelievers, may say, ’What did God intend by this as a similitude?’ So God leads astray whomsoever He will, and He guides whomsoever He will; and none knows the hosts of thy Lord but He. And it is naught but a Reminder to mortals.

text_ar: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
text_en_primary: But no! By the moon,
text_en_yusufali: Nay, verily: By the Moon,
text_en_pickthall: Nay, by the Moon
text_en_arberry: Nay! By the moon

text_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
text_en_primary: and the night as it retreats,
text_en_yusufali: And by the Night as it retreateth,
text_en_pickthall: And the night when it withdraweth
text_en_arberry: and the night when it retreats

text_ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
text_en_primary: and the day as it breaks!
text_en_yusufali: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
text_en_pickthall: And the dawn when it shineth forth,
text_en_arberry: and the dawn when it is white,

text_ar: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
text_en_primary: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—
text_en_yusufali: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
text_en_pickthall: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)
text_en_arberry: surely it is one of the greatest things

text_ar: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
text_en_primary: a warning to humankind,
text_en_yusufali: A warning to mankind,-
text_en_pickthall: As a warning unto men,
text_en_arberry: as a warner to mortals.

text_ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
text_en_primary: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind.
text_en_yusufali: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
text_en_pickthall: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.
text_en_arberry: to whoever of you desires to go forward or lag behind.

text_ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
text_en_primary: Every soul will be detained for what it has done,
text_en_yusufali: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
text_en_pickthall: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;
text_en_arberry: Every soul shall be pledged for what it has earned,

text_ar: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
text_en_primary: except the people of the right,
text_en_yusufali: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
text_en_pickthall: Save those who will stand on the right hand.
text_en_arberry: save the Companions of the Right;

text_ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
text_en_primary: who will be in Gardens, asking one another
text_en_yusufali: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
text_en_pickthall: In gardens they will ask one another
text_en_arberry: in Gardens they will question

text_ar: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
text_en_primary: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺:
text_en_yusufali: And (ask) of the Sinners:
text_en_pickthall: Concerning the guilty:
text_en_arberry: concerning the sinners,

text_ar: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
text_en_primary: “What has landed you in Hell?”
text_en_yusufali: "What led you into Hell Fire?"
text_en_pickthall: What hath brought you to this burning ?
text_en_arberry: ’What thrusted you into Sakar?’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
text_en_primary: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed,
text_en_yusufali: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
text_en_pickthall: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
text_en_arberry: They shall say, ’We were not of those who prayed, and

text_ar: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
text_en_primary: nor did we feed the poor.
text_en_yusufali: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
text_en_pickthall: Nor did we feed the wretched.
text_en_arberry: we fed not the needy,

text_ar: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
text_en_primary: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others,
text_en_yusufali: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
text_en_pickthall: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,
text_en_arberry: and we plunged along with the plungers,

text_ar: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: and deny the Day of Judgment,
text_en_yusufali: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
text_en_pickthall: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
text_en_arberry: and we cried lies to the Day of Doom,

text_ar: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
text_en_primary: until the inevitable came to us.”
text_en_yusufali: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
text_en_pickthall: Till the Inevitable came unto us.
text_en_arberry: till the Certain came to us.’ --

text_ar: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
text_en_primary: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them.
text_en_yusufali: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
text_en_pickthall: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.
text_en_arberry: Then the intercession of the intercessors shall not profit them.

text_ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
text_en_primary: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder,
text_en_yusufali: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
text_en_pickthall: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,
text_en_arberry: What ails them, that they turn away from the Reminder,

text_ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: as if they were spooked zebras
text_en_yusufali: As if they were affrighted asses,
text_en_pickthall: As they were frightened asses
text_en_arberry: as if they were startled asses

text_ar: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
text_en_primary: fleeing from a lion?
text_en_yusufali: Fleeing from a lion!
text_en_pickthall: Fleeing from a lion ?
text_en_arberry: fleeing -- before a lion?

text_ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
text_en_primary: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺.
text_en_yusufali: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).
text_en_arberry: Nay, every man of them desires to be -- given -- scrolls unrolled.

text_ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
text_en_primary: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter.
text_en_yusufali: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
text_en_pickthall: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.
text_en_arberry: No indeed; but they do not fear the Hereafter.

text_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder.
text_en_yusufali: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
text_en_pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.
text_en_arberry: No indeed; surely it is a Reminder;

text_ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.
text_en_yusufali: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
text_en_pickthall: So whosoever will may heed.
text_en_arberry: so whoever wills shall remember it.

text_ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
text_en_primary: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive.
text_en_yusufali: But none will keep it in remembrance except as God wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
text_en_pickthall: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.
text_en_arberry: And they will not remember, except that God wills; He is worthy to be feared, -- worthy to forgive.

text_ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
text_en_primary: I do swear by the Day of Judgment!
text_en_yusufali: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;
text_en_pickthall: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
text_en_arberry: No! I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

text_ar: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
text_en_primary: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul!
text_en_yusufali: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
text_en_pickthall: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
text_en_arberry: No! I swear by the reproachful soul.

text_ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
text_en_primary: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones?
text_en_yusufali: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?
text_en_pickthall: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones ?
text_en_arberry: What, does man reckon We shall not gather his bones?

text_ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
text_en_primary: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips.
text_en_yusufali: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.
text_en_pickthall: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!
text_en_arberry: Yes indeed; We are able to shape again his fingers.

text_ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
text_en_primary: Still people want to deny what is yet to come,
text_en_yusufali: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
text_en_pickthall: But man would fain deny what is before him.
text_en_arberry: Nay, but man desires to continue on as a libertine,

text_ar: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
text_en_primary: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
text_en_yusufali: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
text_en_pickthall: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection ?
text_en_arberry: asking, ’When shall be the Day of Resurrection?’

text_ar: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
text_en_primary: But when the sight is stunned,
text_en_yusufali: At length, when the sight is dazed,
text_en_pickthall: But when sight is confounded
text_en_arberry: But when the sight is dazed

text_ar: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
text_en_primary: and the moon is dimmed,
text_en_yusufali: And the moon is buried in darkness.
text_en_pickthall: And the moon is eclipsed
text_en_arberry: and the moon is eclipsed,

text_ar: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
text_en_primary: and the sun and the moon are brought together,
text_en_yusufali: And the sun and moon are joined together,-
text_en_pickthall: And sun and moon are united,
text_en_arberry: and the sun and moon are brought together,

text_ar: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
text_en_primary: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”
text_en_yusufali: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"
text_en_pickthall: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
text_en_arberry: upon that day man shall say, ’Whither to flee?’

text_ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
text_en_primary: But no! There will be no refuge.
text_en_yusufali: By no means! No place of safety!
text_en_pickthall: Alas! No refuge!
text_en_arberry: No indeed; not a refuge!

text_ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
text_en_primary: On that Day all will end up before your Lord.
text_en_yusufali: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.
text_en_pickthall: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.
text_en_arberry: Upon that day the recourse shall be to thy Lord.

text_ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
text_en_primary: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind.
text_en_yusufali: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.
text_en_pickthall: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
text_en_arberry: Upon that day man shall be told his former deeds and his latter;

text_ar: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: In fact, people will testify against their own souls,
text_en_yusufali: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,
text_en_pickthall: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
text_en_arberry: nay, man shall be a clear proof against himself,

text_ar: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: despite the excuses they come up with.
text_en_yusufali: Even though he were to put up his excuses.
text_en_pickthall: Although he tender his excuses.
text_en_arberry: even though he offer his excuses.

text_ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
text_en_primary: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran.
text_en_yusufali: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur’an) to make haste therewith.
text_en_pickthall: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.
text_en_arberry: Move not thy tongue with it to hasten it;

text_ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
text_en_primary: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it.
text_en_yusufali: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
text_en_pickthall: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
text_en_arberry: Ours it is to gather it, and to recite it.

text_ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
text_en_primary: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺.
text_en_yusufali: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
text_en_pickthall: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;
text_en_arberry: So, when We recite it, follow thou its recitation.

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
text_en_primary: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺.
text_en_yusufali: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):
text_en_pickthall: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.
text_en_arberry: Then Ours it is to explain it.

text_ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
text_en_primary: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world,
text_en_yusufali: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
text_en_arberry: No indeed; but you love the hasty world,

text_ar: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
text_en_primary: and neglect the Hereafter.
text_en_yusufali: And leave alone the Hereafter.
text_en_pickthall: And neglect the Hereafter.
text_en_arberry: and leave be the Hereafter.

text_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
text_en_primary: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright,
text_en_yusufali: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
text_en_pickthall: That day will faces be resplendent,
text_en_arberry: Upon that day faces shall be radiant,

text_ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: looking at their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: Looking towards their Lord;
text_en_pickthall: Looking toward their Lord;
text_en_arberry: gazing upon their Lord;

text_ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: And ˹other˺ faces will be gloomy,
text_en_yusufali: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,
text_en_pickthall: And that day will other faces be despondent,
text_en_arberry: and upon that day faces shall be scowling,

text_ar: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: anticipating something devastating to befall them.
text_en_yusufali: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;
text_en_pickthall: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.
text_en_arberry: thou mightest think the Calamity has been wreaked on them.

text_ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
text_en_primary: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺,
text_en_yusufali: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
