text_en_arberry: No indeed; when it reaches the clavicles

text_ar: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
text_en_primary: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”
text_en_yusufali: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"
text_en_pickthall: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now) ?
text_en_arberry: and it is said, ’Who is an enchanter?’

text_ar: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
text_en_primary: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart,
text_en_yusufali: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;
text_en_pickthall: And he knoweth that it is the parting;
text_en_arberry: and he thinks that it is the parting

text_ar: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
text_en_primary: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺.
text_en_yusufali: And one leg will be joined with another:
text_en_pickthall: And agony is heaped on agony;
text_en_arberry: and leg is intertwined with leg,

text_ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
text_en_primary: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺.
text_en_yusufali: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!
text_en_pickthall: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
text_en_arberry: upon that day unto thy Lord shall be the driving.

text_ar: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
text_en_primary: This denier neither believed nor prayed,
text_en_yusufali: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-
text_en_pickthall: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
text_en_arberry: For he confirmed it not, and did not pray,

text_ar: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
text_en_primary: but persisted in denial and turned away,
text_en_yusufali: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!
text_en_pickthall: But he denied and flouted.
text_en_arberry: but he cried it lies, and he turned away,

text_ar: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
text_en_primary: then went to their own people, walking boastfully.
text_en_yusufali: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!
text_en_pickthall: Then went he to his folk with glee.
text_en_arberry: then he went to his household arrogantly.

text_ar: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
text_en_primary: Woe to you, and more woe!
text_en_yusufali: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
text_en_pickthall: Nearer unto thee and nearer,
text_en_arberry: Nearer to thee and nearer

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: Again, woe to you, and even more woe!
text_en_yusufali: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
text_en_pickthall: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
text_en_arberry: then nearer to thee and nearer!

text_ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
text_en_primary: Do people think they will be left without purpose?
text_en_yusufali: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?
text_en_pickthall: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless ?
text_en_arberry: What, does man reckon he shall be left to roam at will?

text_ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted?
text_en_yusufali: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
text_en_pickthall: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth ?
text_en_arberry: Was he not a sperm-drop spilled?

text_ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
text_en_primary: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form,
text_en_yusufali: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (God) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.
text_en_pickthall: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
text_en_arberry: Then he was a blood-clot, and He created and formed,

text_ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: producing from it both sexes, male and female.
text_en_yusufali: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.
text_en_pickthall: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
text_en_arberry: and He made of him two kinds, male and female.

text_ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
text_en_primary: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life?
text_en_yusufali: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
text_en_pickthall: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life ?
text_en_arberry: What, is He not able to quicken the dead?

text_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
text_en_primary: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning?
text_en_yusufali: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
text_en_pickthall: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered ?
text_en_arberry: Has there come on man a while of time when he was a thing unremembered?

text_ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
text_en_primary: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see.
text_en_yusufali: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
text_en_arberry: We created man of a sperm-drop, a mingling, and We made him hearing, seeing.

text_ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
text_en_primary: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful.
text_en_yusufali: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
text_en_arberry: Surely We guided him upon the way whether he be thankful or unthankful.

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
text_en_primary: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire.
text_en_yusufali: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
text_en_arberry: Surely We have prepared for the unbelievers chains, fetters, and a Blaze.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
text_en_primary: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—
text_en_yusufali: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
text_en_arberry: Surely the pious shall drink of a cup whose mixture is camphor,

text_ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will.
text_en_yusufali: A Fountain where the Devotees of God do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
text_en_pickthall: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
text_en_arberry: a fountain whereat drink the servants of God, making it to gush forth plenteously.

text_ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror,
text_en_yusufali: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
text_en_pickthall: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
text_en_arberry: They fulfil their vows, and fear a day whose evil is upon the wing;

text_ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
text_en_primary: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive,
text_en_yusufali: And they feed, for the love of God, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
text_en_pickthall: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
text_en_arberry: they give food, for the love of Him, to the needy, the orphan, the captive:

text_ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
text_en_primary: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you.
text_en_yusufali: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of God alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
text_en_pickthall: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
text_en_arberry: ’We feed you only for the Face of God; we desire no recompense from you, no thankfulness;

text_ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”
text_en_yusufali: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
text_en_pickthall: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
text_en_arberry: for we fear from our Lord a frowning day, inauspicious.

text_ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
text_en_primary: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy,
text_en_yusufali: But God will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
text_en_pickthall: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
text_en_arberry: So God has guarded them from the evil of that day, and has procured them radiancy and gladness,

text_ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk.
text_en_yusufali: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
text_en_pickthall: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
text_en_arberry: and recompensed them for their patience with a Garden, and silk;

text_ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold.
text_en_yusufali: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun’s (excessive heat) nor (the moon’s) excessive cold.
text_en_pickthall: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
text_en_arberry: therein they shall recline upon couches, therein they shall see neither sun nor bitter cold;

text_ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach.
text_en_yusufali: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
text_en_pickthall: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
text_en_arberry: near them shall be its shades, and its clusters hung meekly down,

text_ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
text_en_primary: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—
text_en_yusufali: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
text_en_pickthall: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
text_en_arberry: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver, and goblets of crystal,

text_ar: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired.
text_en_yusufali: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
text_en_pickthall: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
text_en_arberry: crystal of silver that they have measured -- very exactly.

text_ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
text_en_primary: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger
text_en_yusufali: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
text_en_pickthall: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
text_en_arberry: And therein they shall be given to drink a cup whose mixture is ginger,

text_ar: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: from a spring there, called Salsabil.
text_en_yusufali: A fountain there, called Salsabil.
text_en_pickthall: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
text_en_arberry: therein a fountain whose name is called Salsabil.

text_ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
text_en_primary: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls.
text_en_yusufali: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
text_en_pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
text_en_arberry: Immortal youths shall go about them; when thou seest them, thou supposest them scattered pearls,

text_ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
text_en_primary: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom.
text_en_yusufali: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
text_en_pickthall: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
text_en_arberry: when thou seest them then thou seest bliss and a great kingdom.

text_ar: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
text_en_primary: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
text_en_yusufali: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
text_en_pickthall: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
text_en_arberry: Upon them shall be green garments of silk and brocade; they are adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord shall give them to drink a pure draught.

text_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
text_en_primary: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”
text_en_yusufali: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
text_en_pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
text_en_arberry: Behold, this is a recompense for you, and your striving is thanked.’

text_ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages.
text_en_yusufali: It is We Who have sent down the Qur’an to thee by stages.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur’an, a revelation;
text_en_arberry: Surely We have sent down the Koran on thee, a sending down;

text_ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
text_en_primary: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
text_en_pickthall: So submit patiently to thy Lord’s command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
text_en_arberry: so be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord, and obey not one of them, sinner or unbeliever.

text_ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening,
text_en_yusufali: And celebrate the name or thy Lord morning and evening,
text_en_pickthall: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
text_en_arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord at dawn and in the evening

text_ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
text_en_primary: and prostrate before Him during part of the night,
text_en_yusufali: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
text_en_pickthall: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
text_en_arberry: and part of the night; bow down before Him and magnify Him through the long night.

text_ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them.
text_en_yusufali: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
text_en_arberry: Surely these men love the hasty world, and leave be behind them a heavy day.

text_ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
text_en_primary: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others.
text_en_yusufali: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
text_en_pickthall: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
text_en_arberry: We created them, and We strengthened their joints; and, when We will, We shall exchange their likes.

text_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
text_en_primary: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
text_en_arberry: Surely this is a Reminder; so he who will, takes unto his Lord a way.

text_ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
text_en_primary: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
text_en_yusufali: But ye will not, except as God wills; for God is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
text_en_pickthall: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
text_en_arberry: But you will not unless God wills; surely God is ever All-knowing, All-wise.

text_ar: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
text_en_primary: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
text_en_yusufali: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
text_en_pickthall: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
text_en_arberry: For He admits into His mercy whomsoever He will; as for the evildoers, He has prepared for them a painful chastisement.

text_ar: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
text_en_primary: By those ˹winds˺ sent forth successively,
text_en_yusufali: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man’s profit);
text_en_pickthall: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
text_en_arberry: By the loosed ones successively

text_ar: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
text_en_primary: and those blowing violently,
text_en_yusufali: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
text_en_pickthall: By the raging hurricanes,
text_en_arberry: storming tempestuously

text_ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
text_en_primary: and those scattering ˹rainclouds˺ widely!
text_en_yusufali: And scatter (things) far and wide;
text_en_pickthall: By those which cause earth’s vegetation to revive;
text_en_arberry: by the scatterers scattering

text_ar: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
text_en_primary: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺,
text_en_yusufali: Then separate them, one from another,
text_en_pickthall: By those who winnow with a winnowing,
text_en_arberry: and the severally severing

text_ar: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
text_en_primary: and those delivering revelation,
text_en_yusufali: Then spread abroad a Message,
text_en_pickthall: By those who bring down the Reminder,
text_en_arberry: and those hurling a reminder

text_ar: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
text_en_primary: ending excuses and giving warnings.
text_en_yusufali: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
text_en_pickthall: To excuse or to warn,
text_en_arberry: excusing or warning,

text_ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
text_en_primary: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass.
text_en_yusufali: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
text_en_pickthall: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.
text_en_arberry: surely that which you are promised is about to fall!

text_ar: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
text_en_primary: So when the stars are put out,
text_en_yusufali: Then when the stars become dim;
text_en_pickthall: So when the stars are put out,
text_en_arberry: When the stars shall be extinguished,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
text_en_primary: and the sky is torn apart,
text_en_yusufali: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
text_en_pickthall: And when the sky is riven asunder,
text_en_arberry: when heaven shall be split

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
text_en_primary: and the mountains are blown away,
text_en_yusufali: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
text_en_pickthall: And when the mountains are blown away,
text_en_arberry: when the mountains shall be scattered

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
text_en_primary: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—
text_en_yusufali: And when the apostles are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
text_en_pickthall: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -
text_en_arberry: and when the Messengers’ time is set,

text_ar: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
text_en_primary: for which Day has all this been set?
text_en_yusufali: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
text_en_pickthall: For what day is the time appointed ?
text_en_arberry: to what day shall they be delayed?

text_ar: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
text_en_primary: For the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision!
text_en_yusufali: For the Day of Sorting out.
text_en_pickthall: For the Day of Decision.
text_en_arberry: To the Day of Decision.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
text_en_primary: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
text_en_pickthall: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
text_en_arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Day of Decision?

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers?
text_en_yusufali: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
text_en_pickthall: Destroyed We not the former folk,
text_en_arberry: Did We not destroy the ancients,

text_ar: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
text_en_primary: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them.
text_en_yusufali: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
text_en_pickthall: Then caused the latter folk to follow after ?
text_en_arberry: and then follow them with the later folk?

text_ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
text_en_primary: This is how We deal with the wicked.
text_en_yusufali: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
text_en_pickthall: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
text_en_arberry: So We serve the sinners.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: Did We not create you from a humble fluid,
text_en_yusufali: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
text_en_pickthall: Did We not create you from a base fluid
text_en_arberry: Did We not create you of a mean water,

text_ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
text_en_primary: placing it in a secure place
text_en_yusufali: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
text_en_pickthall: Which We laid up in a safe abode
text_en_arberry: that We laid within a sure lodging

text_ar: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
text_en_primary: until an appointed time?
text_en_yusufali: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
text_en_pickthall: For a known term ?
text_en_arberry: till a known term decreed?

text_ar: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
text_en_primary: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so!
text_en_yusufali: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
text_en_pickthall: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
text_en_arberry: We determined; excellent determiners are We.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
text_en_primary: Have We not made the earth a lodging
text_en_yusufali: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
text_en_pickthall: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
text_en_arberry: Made We not the earth to be a housing

text_ar: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
text_en_primary: for the living and the dead,
text_en_yusufali: The living and the dead,
text_en_pickthall: Both for the living and the dead,
text_en_arberry: for the living and for the dead?

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
text_en_primary: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink?
text_en_yusufali: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
text_en_pickthall: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein ?
text_en_arberry: Set We not therein soaring mountains? Sated you with sweetest water?

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny!
text_en_yusufali: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
text_en_pickthall: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;
text_en_arberry: Depart to that you cried was lies!

text_ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
text_en_primary: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns,
text_en_yusufali: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
text_en_pickthall: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,
text_en_arberry: Depart to a triple-massing shadow

text_ar: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
text_en_primary: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames.
text_en_yusufali: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
text_en_pickthall: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
text_en_arberry: unshading against the blazing flame

text_ar: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles,
text_en_yusufali: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,
text_en_arberry: that shoots sparks like dry faggots,

text_ar: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
text_en_primary: and ˹as dark˺ as black camels.”
text_en_yusufali: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
text_en_pickthall: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.
text_en_arberry: sparks like to golden herds.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
text_en_primary: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak,
text_en_yusufali: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
text_en_pickthall: This is a day wherein they speak not,
text_en_arberry: This is the day they shall not speak

text_ar: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
text_en_primary: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses.
text_en_yusufali: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
text_en_pickthall: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.
text_en_arberry: neither be given leave, and excuse themselves.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺.
text_en_yusufali: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
text_en_pickthall: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
text_en_arberry: ’This is the Day of Decision; We have joined you with the ancients;

text_ar: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
text_en_primary: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”
text_en_yusufali: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
text_en_pickthall: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
text_en_arberry: if you have a trick, try you now to trick Me!’

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs
text_en_yusufali: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
text_en_arberry: Truly the godfearing shall dwell amid shades and fountains,

text_ar: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
text_en_primary: and any fruit they desire.
text_en_yusufali: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
text_en_pickthall: And fruits such as they desire.
text_en_arberry: and such fruits as their hearts desire:

text_ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
text_en_yusufali: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart’s content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
text_en_pickthall: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.
text_en_arberry: ’Eat and drink, with wholesome appetite, for that you were working.’

text_ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers.
text_en_yusufali: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
text_en_pickthall: Thus do We reward the good.
text_en_arberry: Even so do We recompense the good-doers.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
text_en_primary: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”
text_en_yusufali: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
text_en_pickthall: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
text_en_arberry: ’Eat and take your joy a little; you are sinners!’

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
text_en_primary: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow.
text_en_yusufali: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
text_en_pickthall: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
text_en_arberry: When it is said to them, ’Prostrate yourselves!’ they prostrate not.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
text_en_yusufali: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!

text_ar: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in?
text_en_yusufali: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
text_en_pickthall: In what statement, after this, will they believe ?
text_en_arberry: In what discourse after this will they believe?

text_ar: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
text_en_primary: What are they asking one another about?
text_en_yusufali: Concerning what are they disputing?
text_en_pickthall: Whereof do they question one another ?
text_en_arberry: Of what do they question one another?

text_ar: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
text_en_primary: About the momentous news,
text_en_yusufali: Concerning the Great News,
text_en_pickthall: (It is) of the awful tidings,
text_en_arberry: Of the mighty tiding

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
text_en_primary: over which they disagree.
text_en_yusufali: About which they cannot agree.
text_en_pickthall: Concerning which they are in disagreement.
text_en_arberry: whereon they are at variance.

text_ar: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: But no! They will come to know.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but they will come to know!
text_en_arberry: No indeed; they shall soon know!

text_ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: Again, no! They will come to know.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, again, but they will come to know!
text_en_arberry: Again, no indeed; they shall soon know!

text_ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
text_en_primary: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺,
text_en_yusufali: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,
text_en_pickthall: Have We not made the earth an expanse,
text_en_arberry: Have We not made the earth as a cradle

text_ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
text_en_primary: and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs,
text_en_yusufali: And the mountains as pegs?
text_en_pickthall: And the high hills bulwarks ?
text_en_arberry: and the mountains as pegs?

text_ar: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
text_en_primary: and created you in pairs,
text_en_yusufali: And (have We not) created you in pairs,
text_en_pickthall: And We have created you in pairs,
text_en_arberry: And We created you in pairs,

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
text_en_primary: and made your sleep for rest,
text_en_yusufali: And made your sleep for rest,
text_en_pickthall: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
text_en_arberry: and We appointed your sleep for a rest;

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
text_en_primary: and made the night as a cover,
text_en_yusufali: And made the night as a covering,
text_en_pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
text_en_arberry: and We appointed night for a garment,

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
text_en_primary: and made the day for livelihood,
text_en_yusufali: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
text_en_pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
text_en_arberry: and We appointed day for a livelihood.

text_ar: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
text_en_primary: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺,
text_en_yusufali: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
text_en_pickthall: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
text_en_arberry: And We have built above you seven strong ones,

text_ar: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
text_en_primary: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp,
text_en_yusufali: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
text_en_pickthall: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
text_en_arberry: and We appointed a blazing lamp

text_ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
text_en_primary: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water,
text_en_yusufali: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
text_en_pickthall: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
text_en_arberry: and have sent down out of the rainclouds water cascading

text_ar: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
text_en_primary: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants,
text_en_yusufali: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
text_en_pickthall: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
text_en_arberry: that We may bring forth thereby grain and plants,

text_ar: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
text_en_primary: and dense orchards?
text_en_yusufali: And gardens of luxurious growth?
text_en_pickthall: And gardens of thick foliage.
text_en_arberry: and gardens luxuriant.

text_ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
text_en_primary: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—
text_en_yusufali: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
text_en_arberry: Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,

text_ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
text_en_primary: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds.
text_en_yusufali: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
text_en_pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
text_en_arberry: the day the Trumpet is blown, and you shall come in troops,

text_ar: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
text_en_primary: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates,
text_en_yusufali: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
text_en_pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
text_en_arberry: and heaven is opened, and become gates,

text_ar: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
text_en_primary: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage.
text_en_yusufali: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
text_en_pickthall: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
text_en_arberry: and the mountains are set in motion, and become a vapour.

text_ar: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
text_en_primary: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush
text_en_yusufali: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,
text_en_arberry: Behold, Gehenna has become an ambush,

text_ar: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
text_en_primary: as a home for the transgressors,
text_en_yusufali: For the transgressors a place of destination:
text_en_pickthall: A home for the rebellious.
text_en_arberry: for the insolent a resort,

text_ar: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
text_en_primary: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages.
text_en_yusufali: They will dwell therein for ages.
text_en_pickthall: They will abide therein for ages.
text_en_arberry: therein to tarry for ages,

text_ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
text_en_primary: There they will not taste any coolness or drink,
text_en_yusufali: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
text_en_pickthall: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
text_en_arberry: tasting therein neither coolness nor any drink

text_ar: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
text_en_primary: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—
text_en_yusufali: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
text_en_pickthall: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
text_en_arberry: save boiling water and pus

text_ar: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
text_en_primary: a fitting reward.
text_en_yusufali: A fitting recompense (for them).
text_en_pickthall: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).
text_en_arberry: for a suitable recompense.

text_ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
text_en_primary: For they never expected any reckoning,
text_en_yusufali: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
text_en_pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
text_en_arberry: They indeed hoped not for a reckoning,

text_ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
text_en_primary: and totally rejected Our signs.
text_en_yusufali: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
text_en_pickthall: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
text_en_arberry: and they cried loud lies to Our signs;

text_ar: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
text_en_primary: And We have everything recorded precisely.
text_en_yusufali: And all things have We preserved on record.
text_en_pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
text_en_arberry: and everything We have numbered in a Book.

text_ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
text_en_primary: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”
text_en_yusufali: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
text_en_pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
text_en_arberry: ’Taste! We shall increase you not save in chastisement.’

text_ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
text_en_primary: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—
text_en_yusufali: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart’s) desires;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
text_en_arberry: Surely for the godfearing awaits a place of security,

text_ar: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
text_en_primary: Gardens, vineyards,
text_en_yusufali: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;
text_en_pickthall: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,
text_en_arberry: gardens and vineyards

text_ar: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
text_en_primary: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,
text_en_yusufali: Companions of equal age;
text_en_pickthall: And maidens for companions,
text_en_arberry: and maidens with swelling breasts, like of age,

text_ar: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
text_en_primary: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺,
text_en_yusufali: And a cup full (to the brim).
text_en_pickthall: And a full cup.
text_en_arberry: and a cup overflowing.

text_ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
text_en_primary: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—
text_en_yusufali: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
text_en_pickthall: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
text_en_arberry: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, no cry of lies,

text_ar: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
text_en_primary: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord,
text_en_yusufali: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
text_en_pickthall: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
text_en_arberry: for a recompense from thy Lord, a gift, a reckoning,

text_ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
text_en_primary: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him
text_en_yusufali: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (God) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
text_en_pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
text_en_arberry: Lord of the heavens and earth, and all that between them is, the All-merciful of whom they have no power to speak.

text_ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
text_en_primary: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true.
text_en_yusufali: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (God) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
text_en_pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
text_en_arberry: Upon the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in ranks they shall speak not, save him to whom the All-merciful has given leave, and who speaks aright.

text_ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
text_en_primary: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
text_en_pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
text_en_arberry: That is the true day; so whosoever wills takes unto his Lord a resort.

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
text_en_primary: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
text_en_yusufali: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (metre) dust!"
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
text_en_arberry: Lo, We have warned you of a nigh chastisement, upon the day when a man shall behold what his hands have forwarded, and the unbeliever shall say, ’O would that I were dust!’

text_ar: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
text_en_primary: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly,
text_en_yusufali: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
text_en_pickthall: By those who drag forth to destruction,
text_en_arberry: By those that pluck out vehemently

text_ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
text_en_primary: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently,
text_en_yusufali: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
text_en_pickthall: By the meteors rushing,
text_en_arberry: and those that draw out violently,

text_ar: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
text_en_primary: and those gliding ˹through heavens˺ swiftly,
text_en_yusufali: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
text_en_pickthall: By the lone stars floating,
text_en_arberry: by those that swim serenely

text_ar: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
text_en_primary: and those taking the lead vigorously,
text_en_yusufali: Then press forward as in a race,
text_en_pickthall: By the angels hastening,
text_en_arberry: and those that outstrip suddenly

text_ar: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
text_en_primary: and those conducting affairs ˹obediently˺!
text_en_yusufali: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
text_en_pickthall: And those who govern the event,
text_en_arberry: by those that direct an affair!

text_ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
text_en_primary: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass,
text_en_yusufali: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
text_en_pickthall: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
text_en_arberry: Upon the day when the first blast shivers

text_ar: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
text_en_primary: followed by a second Blast.
text_en_yusufali: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):
text_en_pickthall: And the second followeth it,
text_en_arberry: and the second blast follows it,

text_ar: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
text_en_primary: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺,
text_en_yusufali: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
text_en_pickthall: On that day hearts beat painfully
text_en_arberry: hearts upon that day shall be athrob

text_ar: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: with their eyes downcast.
text_en_yusufali: Cast down will be (their owners’) eyes.
text_en_pickthall: While eyes are downcast
text_en_arberry: and their eyes shall be humbled.

text_ar: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
text_en_primary: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state,
text_en_yusufali: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
text_en_pickthall: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
text_en_arberry: They shall say, ’What, are we being restored as we were before?

text_ar: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
text_en_primary: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”
text_en_yusufali: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
text_en_pickthall: Even after we are crumbled bones ?
text_en_arberry: What, when we are bones old and wasted?’

text_ar: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”
text_en_yusufali: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
text_en_pickthall: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
text_en_arberry: They shall say, ’That then were a losing return!’

text_ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast,
text_en_yusufali: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
text_en_pickthall: Surely it will need but one shout,
text_en_arberry: But it shall be only a single scare,

text_ar: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
text_en_primary: and at once they will be above ground.
text_en_yusufali: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
text_en_pickthall: And lo! they will be awakened.
text_en_arberry: and behold, they are awakened.

text_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺?
text_en_yusufali: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
text_en_pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses ?
text_en_arberry: Hast thou received the story of Moses?

text_ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
text_en_primary: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa,
text_en_yusufali: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
text_en_pickthall: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
text_en_arberry: When his Lord called to him in the holy valley, Towa:

text_ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
text_en_primary: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.
text_en_yusufali: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
text_en_pickthall: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
text_en_arberry: ’Go to Pharaoh; he has waxed insolent.

text_ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
text_en_primary: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself,
text_en_yusufali: "And say to him, ’Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
text_en_pickthall: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace) ?
text_en_arberry: And say, "Hast thou the will to purify thyself;

text_ar: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
text_en_primary: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”
text_en_yusufali: "’And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?’"
text_en_pickthall: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
text_en_arberry: and that I should guide thee to thy Lord, then thou shalt fear?"’

text_ar: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: Then Moses showed him the great sign,
text_en_yusufali: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
text_en_pickthall: And he showed him the tremendous token.
text_en_arberry: So he showed him the great sign,

text_ar: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
text_en_primary: but he denied and disobeyed ˹Allah˺,
text_en_yusufali: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);
text_en_pickthall: But he denied and disobeyed,
text_en_arberry: but he cried lies, and rebelled,

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
text_en_primary: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺.
text_en_yusufali: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against God).
text_en_pickthall: Then turned he away in haste,
text_en_arberry: then he turned away hastily,

text_ar: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
text_en_primary: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out,
text_en_yusufali: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
text_en_pickthall: Then gathered he and summoned
text_en_arberry: then he mustered

text_ar: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
text_en_primary: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”
text_en_yusufali: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
text_en_pickthall: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
text_en_arberry: and proclaimed, and he said, ’I am your Lord, the Most High!’

text_ar: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next.
text_en_yusufali: But God did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
text_en_pickthall: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
text_en_arberry: So God seized him with the chastisement of the Last World and the First.

text_ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (God).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
text_en_arberry: Surely in that is a lesson for him who fears!

text_ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it,
text_en_yusufali: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (God) hath constructed it:
text_en_pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built ?
text_en_arberry: What, are you stronger in constitution or the heaven He built?

text_ar: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
text_en_primary: raising it high and forming it flawlessly.
text_en_yusufali: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
text_en_pickthall: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
text_en_arberry: He lifted up its vault, and levelled it,

text_ar: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight.
text_en_yusufali: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
text_en_pickthall: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
text_en_arberry: and darkened its night, and brought forth its forenoon;

text_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
text_en_primary: As for the earth, He spread it out as well,
text_en_yusufali: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
text_en_pickthall: And after that He spread the earth,
text_en_arberry: and the earth-after that He spread it out,

text_ar: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: bringing forth its water and pastures
text_en_yusufali: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
text_en_pickthall: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
text_en_arberry: therefrom brought forth its waters and its pastures,

text_ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—
text_en_yusufali: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
text_en_pickthall: And He made fast the hills,
text_en_arberry: and the mountains He set firm,

text_ar: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
text_en_primary: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals.
text_en_yusufali: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
text_en_pickthall: A provision for you and for your cattle.
text_en_arberry: an enjoyment for you and your flocks.

text_ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—
text_en_yusufali: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
text_en_pickthall: But when the great disaster cometh,
text_en_arberry: Then, when the Great Catastrophe comes

text_ar: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
text_en_primary: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving,
text_en_yusufali: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
text_en_pickthall: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
text_en_arberry: upon the day when man shall remember what he has striven,

text_ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
text_en_primary: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—
text_en_yusufali: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
text_en_pickthall: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
text_en_arberry: and Hell is advanced for whoever sees,

text_ar: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
text_en_primary: then as for those who transgressed
text_en_yusufali: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
text_en_pickthall: Then, as for him who rebelled
text_en_arberry: then as for him who was insolent

text_ar: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
text_en_primary: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world,
text_en_yusufali: And had preferred the life of this world,
text_en_pickthall: And chose the life of the world,
text_en_arberry: and preferred the present life,

text_ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
text_en_primary: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home.
text_en_yusufali: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! hell will be his home.
text_en_arberry: surely Hell shall be the refuge.

text_ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
text_en_primary: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires,
text_en_yusufali: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord’s (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
text_en_pickthall: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
text_en_arberry: But as for him who feared the Station of his Lord and forbade the soul its caprice,

text_ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
text_en_primary: Paradise will certainly be ˹their˺ home.
text_en_yusufali: Their abode will be the Garden.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
text_en_arberry: surely Paradise shall be the refuge.

text_ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”
text_en_yusufali: They ask thee about the Hour,-’When will be its appointed time?
text_en_pickthall: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port ?
text_en_arberry: They will question thee concerning the Hour, when it shall berth.

text_ar: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
text_en_primary: But it is not for you to tell its time.
text_en_yusufali: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
text_en_pickthall: Why (ask they) ? What hast thou to tell thereof ?
text_en_arberry: What art thou about, to mention it?

text_ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
text_en_primary: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺.
text_en_yusufali: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
text_en_pickthall: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
text_en_arberry: Unto thy Lord is the final end of it.

text_ar: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it.
text_en_yusufali: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
text_en_pickthall: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
text_en_arberry: Thou art only the warner of him who fears it.

text_ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning.
text_en_yusufali: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
text_en_pickthall: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
text_en_arberry: It shall be as if; on the day they see it, they have but tarried for an evening, or its forenoon.

text_ar: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
text_en_primary: He frowned and turned ˹his attention˺ away,
text_en_yusufali: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away,
text_en_pickthall: He frowned and turned away
text_en_arberry: He frowned and turned away

text_ar: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
text_en_primary: ˹simply˺ because the blind man came to him ˹interrupting˺.
text_en_yusufali: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
text_en_pickthall: Because the blind man came unto him.
text_en_arberry: that the blind man came to him.

text_ar: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
text_en_primary: You never know ˹O Prophet˺, perhaps he may be purified,
text_en_yusufali: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
text_en_pickthall: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
text_en_arberry: And what should teach thee? Perchance he would cleanse him,

text_ar: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder.
text_en_yusufali: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
text_en_pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him ?
text_en_arberry: or yet remember, and the Reminder profit him.

text_ar: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: As for the one who was indifferent,
text_en_yusufali: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
text_en_pickthall: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
text_en_arberry: But the self-sufficient,

text_ar: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
text_en_primary: you gave him your ˹undivided˺ attention,
text_en_yusufali: To him dost thou attend;
text_en_pickthall: Unto him thou payest regard.
text_en_arberry: to him thou attendest

text_ar: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
text_en_primary: even though you are not to blame if he would not be purified.
text_en_yusufali: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
text_en_pickthall: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
text_en_arberry: though it is not thy concern, if he does not cleanse himself.

text_ar: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
text_en_primary: But as for the one who came to you, eager ˹to learn˺,
text_en_yusufali: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
text_en_pickthall: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
text_en_arberry: And he who comes to thee eagerly

text_ar: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
text_en_primary: being in awe ˹of Allah˺,
text_en_yusufali: And with fear (in his heart),
text_en_pickthall: And hath fear,
text_en_arberry: and fearfully,

text_ar: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
text_en_primary: you were inattentive to him.
text_en_yusufali: Of him wast thou unmindful.
text_en_pickthall: From him thou art distracted.
text_en_arberry: to him thou payest no heed.

text_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: But no! This ˹revelation˺ is truly a reminder.
text_en_yusufali: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
text_en_arberry: No indeed; it is a Reminder

text_ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
text_en_pickthall: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
text_en_arberry: (and whoso wills, shall remember it)

text_ar: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: It is ˹written˺ on pages held in honour—
text_en_yusufali: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
text_en_pickthall: On honoured leaves
text_en_arberry: upon pages high-honoured,

text_ar: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
text_en_primary: highly esteemed, purified—
text_en_yusufali: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,
text_en_pickthall: Exalted, purified,
text_en_arberry: uplifted, purified,

text_ar: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: by the hands of angel-scribes,
text_en_yusufali: (Written) by the hands of scribes-
text_en_pickthall: (Set down) by scribes
text_en_arberry: by the hands of scribes

text_ar: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: honourable and virtuous.
text_en_yusufali: Honourable and Pious and Just.
text_en_pickthall: Noble and righteous.
text_en_arberry: noble, pious

text_ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: Condemned are ˹disbelieving˺ humans! How ungrateful they are ˹to Allah˺!
text_en_yusufali: Woe to man! What hath made him reject God;
text_en_pickthall: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!
text_en_arberry: Perish Man! How unthankful he is!

text_ar: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
text_en_primary: From what substance did He create them?
text_en_yusufali: From what stuff hath He created him?
text_en_pickthall: From what thing doth He create him ?
text_en_arberry: Of what did He create him?

text_ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development.
text_en_yusufali: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
text_en_pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
text_en_arberry: Of a sperm-drop He created him, and determined him,

text_ar: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: Then He makes the way easy for them,
text_en_yusufali: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
text_en_pickthall: Then maketh the way easy for him,
text_en_arberry: then the way eased for him,

text_ar: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: then causes them to die and be buried.
text_en_yusufali: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
text_en_pickthall: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
text_en_arberry: then makes him to die, and buries him,

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: Then when He wills, He will resurrect them.
text_en_yusufali: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
text_en_pickthall: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
text_en_arberry: then, when He wills, He raises him.

text_ar: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: But no! They have failed to comply with what He ordered.
text_en_yusufali: By no means hath he fulfilled what God hath commanded him.
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
text_en_arberry: No indeed! Man has not accomplished His bidding.

text_ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
text_en_primary: Let people then consider their food:
text_en_yusufali: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
text_en_pickthall: Let man consider his food:
text_en_arberry: Let Man consider his nourishment.

text_ar: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
text_en_primary: how We pour down rain in abundance
text_en_yusufali: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
text_en_pickthall: How We pour water in showers
text_en_arberry: We poured out the rains abundantly,

text_ar: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
text_en_primary: and meticulously split the earth open ˹for sprouts˺,
text_en_yusufali: And We split the earth in fragments,
text_en_pickthall: Then split the earth in clefts
text_en_arberry: then We split the earth in fissures

text_ar: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
text_en_primary: causing grain to grow in it,
text_en_yusufali: And produce therein corn,
text_en_pickthall: And cause the grain to grow therein
text_en_arberry: and therein made the grains to grow

text_ar: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
text_en_primary: as well as grapes and greens,
text_en_yusufali: And Grapes and nutritious plants,
text_en_pickthall: And grapes and green fodder
text_en_arberry: and vines, and reeds,

text_ar: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
text_en_primary: and olives and palm trees,
text_en_yusufali: And Olives and Dates,
text_en_pickthall: And olive-trees and palm-trees
text_en_arberry: and olives, and palms,

text_ar: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
text_en_primary: and dense orchards,
text_en_yusufali: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
text_en_pickthall: And garden-closes of thick foliage
text_en_arberry: and dense-tree’d gardens,

text_ar: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
text_en_primary: and fruit and fodder—
text_en_yusufali: And fruits and fodder,-
text_en_pickthall: And fruits and grasses:
text_en_arberry: and fruits, and pastures,

text_ar: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
text_en_primary: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals.
text_en_yusufali: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
text_en_pickthall: Provision for you and your cattle.
text_en_arberry: an enjoyment for you and your flocks.

text_ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
text_en_primary: Then, when the Deafening Blast comes to pass—
text_en_yusufali: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
text_en_pickthall: But when the Shout cometh
text_en_arberry: And when the Blast shall sound,

text_ar: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
text_en_primary: on that Day every person will flee from their own siblings,
text_en_yusufali: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
text_en_pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
text_en_arberry: upon the day when a man shall flee from his brother,

text_ar: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
text_en_primary: and ˹even˺ their mother and father,
text_en_yusufali: And from his mother and his father,
text_en_pickthall: And his mother and his father
text_en_arberry: his mother, his father,

text_ar: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
text_en_primary: and ˹even˺ their spouse and children.
text_en_yusufali: And from his wife and his children.
text_en_pickthall: And his wife and his children,
text_en_arberry: his consort, his sons,

text_ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
text_en_primary: For then everyone will have enough concern of their own.
text_en_yusufali: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
text_en_pickthall: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
text_en_arberry: every man that day shall have business to suffice him.

text_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright,
text_en_yusufali: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
text_en_pickthall: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
text_en_arberry: Some faces on that day shall shine

text_ar: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: laughing and rejoicing,
text_en_yusufali: Laughing, rejoicing.
text_en_pickthall: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;
text_en_arberry: laughing, joyous;

text_ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: while ˹other˺ faces will be dusty,
text_en_yusufali: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
text_en_pickthall: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
text_en_arberry: some faces on that day shall be dusty

text_ar: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
text_en_primary: cast in gloom—
text_en_yusufali: Blackness will cover them:
text_en_pickthall: Veiled in darkness,
text_en_arberry: o’erspread with darkness --

text_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
text_en_primary: those are the disbelievers, the ˹wicked˺ sinners.
text_en_yusufali: Such will be the Rejecters of God, the doers of iniquity.
text_en_pickthall: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
text_en_arberry: those -- they are the unbelievers, the libertines.

text_ar: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
text_en_primary: When the sun is put out,
text_en_yusufali: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
text_en_pickthall: When the sun is overthrown,
text_en_arberry: When the sun shall be darkened,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the stars fall down,
text_en_yusufali: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
text_en_pickthall: And when the stars fall,
text_en_arberry: when the stars shall be thrown down,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the mountains are blown away,
text_en_yusufali: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
text_en_pickthall: And when the hills are moved,
text_en_arberry: when the mountains shall be set moving,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
text_en_primary: and when pregnant camels are left untended,
text_en_yusufali: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
text_en_pickthall: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
text_en_arberry: when the pregnant camels shall be neglected,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when wild beasts are gathered together,
text_en_yusufali: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
text_en_pickthall: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
text_en_arberry: when the savage beasts shall be mustered,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the seas are set on fire,
text_en_yusufali: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
text_en_pickthall: And when the seas rise,
text_en_arberry: when the seas shall be set boiling,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺,
text_en_yusufali: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);
text_en_pickthall: And when souls are reunited,
text_en_arberry: when the souls shall be coupled,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
text_en_primary: and when baby girls, buried alive, are asked
text_en_yusufali: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -
text_en_pickthall: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
text_en_arberry: when the buried infant shall be asked

text_ar: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
text_en_primary: for what crime they were put to death,
text_en_yusufali: For what crime she was killed;
text_en_pickthall: For what sin she was slain,
text_en_arberry: for what sin she was slain,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open,
text_en_yusufali: When the scrolls are laid open;
text_en_pickthall: And when the pages are laid open,
text_en_arberry: when the scrolls shall be unrolled,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the sky is stripped away,
text_en_yusufali: When the world on High is unveiled;
text_en_pickthall: And when the sky is torn away,
text_en_arberry: when heaven shall be stripped off;

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up,
text_en_yusufali: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
text_en_pickthall: And when hell is lighted,
text_en_arberry: when Hell shall be set blazing,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
text_en_primary: and when Paradise is brought near—
text_en_yusufali: And when the Garden is brought near;-
text_en_pickthall: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
text_en_arberry: when Paradise shall be brought nigh,

text_ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
text_en_primary: ˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along.
text_en_yusufali: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
text_en_pickthall: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
text_en_arberry: then shall a soul know what it has produced.

text_ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
text_en_primary: I do swear by the receding stars
text_en_yusufali: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
text_en_pickthall: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
text_en_arberry: No! I swear by the slinkers,

text_ar: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
text_en_primary: which travel and hide,
text_en_yusufali: Go straight, or hide;
text_en_pickthall: The stars which rise and set,
text_en_arberry: the runners, the sinkers,

text_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
text_en_primary: and the night as it falls
text_en_yusufali: And the Night as it dissipates;
text_en_pickthall: And the close of night,
text_en_arberry: by the night swarming,

text_ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
text_en_primary: and the day as it breaks!
text_en_yusufali: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
text_en_pickthall: And the breath of morning
text_en_arberry: by the dawn sighing,

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel,
text_en_yusufali: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
text_en_pickthall: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
text_en_arberry: truly this is the word of a noble Messenger

text_ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne,
text_en_yusufali: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
text_en_pickthall: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
text_en_arberry: having power, with the Lord of the Throne secure,

text_ar: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: obeyed there ˹in heaven˺, and trustworthy.
text_en_yusufali: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
text_en_pickthall: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;
text_en_arberry: obeyed, moreover trusty.

text_ar: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: And your fellow man is not insane.
