text_en_yusufali: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
text_en_pickthall: And your comrade is not mad.
text_en_arberry: Your companion is not possessed;

text_ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
text_en_primary: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon,
text_en_yusufali: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
text_en_pickthall: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
text_en_arberry: he truly saw him on the clear horizon;

text_ar: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
text_en_primary: and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen.
text_en_yusufali: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
text_en_pickthall: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
text_en_arberry: he is not niggardly of the Unseen.

text_ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil.
text_en_yusufali: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
text_en_pickthall: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
text_en_arberry: And it is not the word of an accursed Satan;

text_ar: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
text_en_primary: So what ˹other˺ path would you take?
text_en_yusufali: When whither go ye?
text_en_pickthall: Whither then go ye ?
text_en_arberry: where then are you going?

text_ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—
text_en_yusufali: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
text_en_pickthall: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
text_en_arberry: It is naught but a Reminder unto all beings,

text_ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
text_en_primary: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way.
text_en_yusufali: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
text_en_pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
text_en_arberry: for whosoever of you who would go straight;

text_ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds.
text_en_yusufali: But ye shall not will except as God wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
text_en_pickthall: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
text_en_arberry: but will you shall not, unless God wills, the Lord of all Being.

text_ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
text_en_primary: When the sky splits open,
text_en_yusufali: When the Sky is cleft asunder;
text_en_pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
text_en_arberry: When heaven is split open,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the stars fall away,
text_en_yusufali: When the Stars are scattered;
text_en_pickthall: When the planets are dispersed,
text_en_arberry: when the stars are scattered,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the seas burst forth,
text_en_yusufali: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
text_en_pickthall: When the seas are poured forth,
text_en_arberry: when the seas swarm over,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
text_en_primary: and when the graves spill out,
text_en_yusufali: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-
text_en_pickthall: And the sepulchres are overturned,
text_en_arberry: when the tombs are overthrown,

text_ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
text_en_primary: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind.
text_en_yusufali: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
text_en_pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
text_en_arberry: then a soul shall know its works, the former and the latter.

text_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
text_en_primary: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous,
text_en_yusufali: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
text_en_pickthall: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
text_en_arberry: O Man! What deceived thee as to thy generous Lord

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
text_en_primary: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design,
text_en_yusufali: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
text_en_pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee ?
text_en_arberry: who created thee and shaped thee and wrought thee in symmetry

text_ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
text_en_primary: moulding you in whatever form He willed?
text_en_yusufali: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
text_en_pickthall: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
text_en_arberry: and composed thee after what form He would?

text_ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment,
text_en_yusufali: Day! nit ye do reject Right and Judgment!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
text_en_arberry: No indeed; but you cry lies to the Doom;

text_ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
text_en_primary: while you are certainly observed by vigilant,
text_en_yusufali: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! there are above you guardians,
text_en_arberry: yet there are over you watchers

text_ar: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
text_en_primary: honourable angels, recording ˹everything˺.
text_en_yusufali: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
text_en_pickthall: Generous and recording,
text_en_arberry: noble, writers

text_ar: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
text_en_primary: They know whatever you do.
text_en_yusufali: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
text_en_pickthall: Who know (all) that ye do.
text_en_arberry: who know whatever you do.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss,
text_en_yusufali: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
text_en_arberry: Surely the pious shall be in bliss,

text_ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: and the wicked will be in Hell,
text_en_yusufali: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
text_en_pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
text_en_arberry: and the libertines shall be in a fiery furnace

text_ar: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: burning in it on Judgment Day,
text_en_yusufali: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
text_en_pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
text_en_arberry: roasting therein on the Day of Doom,

text_ar: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
text_en_primary: and they will have no escape from it.
text_en_yusufali: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
text_en_pickthall: And will not be absent thence.
text_en_arberry: nor shall they ever be absent from it.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
text_en_pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
text_en_arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Day of Doom?

text_ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is?
text_en_yusufali: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
text_en_pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
text_en_arberry: Again, what shall teach thee what is the Day of Doom?

text_ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
text_en_primary: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺.
text_en_yusufali: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with God.
text_en_pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah’s.
text_en_arberry: A day when no soul shall possess aught to succour another soul; that day the Command shall belong unto God.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe to the defrauders!
text_en_yusufali: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the defrauders:
text_en_arberry: Woe to the stinters who,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
text_en_primary: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people,
text_en_yusufali: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
text_en_pickthall: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
text_en_arberry: when they measure against the people, take full measure

text_ar: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
text_en_primary: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers.
text_en_yusufali: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
text_en_pickthall: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
text_en_arberry: but, when they measure for them or weigh for them, do skimp.

text_ar: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
text_en_primary: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected
text_en_yusufali: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
text_en_pickthall: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
text_en_arberry: Do those not think that they shall be raised up

text_ar: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: for a tremendous Day—
text_en_yusufali: On a Mighty Day,
text_en_pickthall: Unto an Awful Day,
text_en_arberry: unto a mighty day

text_ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
text_en_primary: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds?
text_en_yusufali: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
text_en_pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds ?
text_en_arberry: a day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of all Being?

text_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
text_en_primary: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjin ˹in the depths of Hell˺—
text_en_yusufali: Day! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
text_en_arberry: No indeed; the Book of the libertines is in Sijjin;

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
text_en_primary: and what will make you realize what Sijjin is?—
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
text_en_pickthall: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
text_en_arberry: and what shall teach thee what is Sijjin?

text_ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
text_en_primary: a fate ˹already˺ sealed.
text_en_yusufali: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.
text_en_pickthall: A written record.
text_en_arberry: A book inscribed.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
text_en_primary: Woe on that Day to the deniers—
text_en_yusufali: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
text_en_arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: those who deny Judgment Day!
text_en_yusufali: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
text_en_pickthall: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
text_en_arberry: who cry lies to the Day of Doom;

text_ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
text_en_primary: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor.
text_en_yusufali: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
text_en_pickthall: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
text_en_arberry: and none cries lies to it but every guilty aggressor.

text_ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
text_en_primary: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”
text_en_yusufali: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
text_en_pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
text_en_arberry: When our signs are recited to him, he says, ’Fairy-tales of the ancients!’

text_ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
text_en_primary: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit!
text_en_yusufali: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
text_en_arberry: No indeed; but that they were earning has rusted upon their hearts.

text_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
text_en_primary: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
text_en_arberry: No indeed; but upon that day they shall be veiled from their Lord,

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
text_en_primary: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell,
text_en_yusufali: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
text_en_pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
text_en_arberry: then they shall roast in Hell.

text_ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
text_en_primary: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”
text_en_yusufali: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
text_en_pickthall: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
text_en_arberry: Then it shall be said to them, ’This is that you cried lies to.’

text_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
text_en_primary: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—
text_en_yusufali: Day, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in ’Illiyin.
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in ’Illiyin -
text_en_arberry: No indeed; the book of the pious is in Illiyun;

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
text_en_primary: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what ’Illiyun is?
text_en_pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what ’Illiyin is! -
text_en_arberry: and what shall teach thee what is Illiyun?

text_ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
text_en_primary: a fate ˹already˺ sealed,
text_en_yusufali: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,
text_en_pickthall: A written record,
text_en_arberry: A book inscribed,

text_ar: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
text_en_primary: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: To which bear witness those Nearest (to God).
text_en_pickthall: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
text_en_arberry: witnessed by those brought nigh.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
text_en_primary: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss,
text_en_yusufali: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
text_en_arberry: Surely the pious shall be in bliss,

text_ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around.
text_en_yusufali: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
text_en_pickthall: On couches, gazing,
text_en_arberry: upon couches gazing;

text_ar: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
text_en_primary: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight.
text_en_yusufali: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
text_en_pickthall: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
text_en_arberry: thou knowest in their faces the radiancy of bliss

text_ar: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
text_en_primary: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine,
text_en_yusufali: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
text_en_pickthall: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
text_en_arberry: as they are given to drink of a wine sealed

text_ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
text_en_primary: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺.
text_en_yusufali: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
text_en_pickthall: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
text_en_arberry: whose seal is musk -- so after that let the strivers strive --

text_ar: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
text_en_primary: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnim—
text_en_yusufali: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
text_en_pickthall: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
text_en_arberry: and whose mixture is Tasnim,

text_ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
text_en_primary: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink.
text_en_yusufali: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to God.
text_en_pickthall: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
text_en_arberry: a fountain at which do drink those brought nigh.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers,
text_en_yusufali: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
text_en_arberry: Behold, the sinners were laughing at the believers,

text_ar: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
text_en_primary: wink to one another whenever they passed by,
text_en_yusufali: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
text_en_pickthall: And wink one to another when they passed them;
text_en_arberry: when them passed them by winking at one another,

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
text_en_primary: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people.
text_en_yusufali: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
text_en_pickthall: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
text_en_arberry: and when they returned to their people they returned blithely,

text_ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
text_en_primary: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
text_en_yusufali: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
text_en_pickthall: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
text_en_arberry: and when they saw them they said, ’Lo, these men are astray!’

text_ar: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
text_en_primary: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers.
text_en_yusufali: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
text_en_pickthall: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
text_en_arberry: Yet they were not sent as watchers over them.

text_ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
text_en_primary: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers,
text_en_yusufali: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
text_en_pickthall: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
text_en_arberry: So today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers,

text_ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
text_en_primary: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on.
text_en_yusufali: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
text_en_pickthall: On high couches, gazing.
text_en_arberry: upon couches gazing.

text_ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
text_en_primary: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
text_en_yusufali: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
text_en_pickthall: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do ?
text_en_arberry: Have the unbelievers been rewarded what they were doing?

text_ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
text_en_primary: When the sky bursts open,
text_en_yusufali: When the sky is rent asunder,
text_en_pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder
text_en_arberry: When heaven is rent asunder

text_ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
text_en_primary: obeying its Lord as it must,
text_en_yusufali: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
text_en_pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
text_en_arberry: and gives ear to its Lord, and is fitly disposed;

text_ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
text_en_primary: and when the earth is flattened out,
text_en_yusufali: And when the earth is flattened out,
text_en_pickthall: And when the earth is spread out
text_en_arberry: when earth is stretched out

text_ar: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
text_en_primary: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty,
text_en_yusufali: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
text_en_pickthall: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
text_en_arberry: and casts forth what is in it, and voids itself,

text_ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
text_en_primary: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺.
text_en_yusufali: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
text_en_pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
text_en_arberry: and gives ear to its Lord, and is fitly disposed!

text_ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
text_en_primary: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences.
text_en_yusufali: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
text_en_pickthall: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
text_en_arberry: O Man! Thou art labouring unto thy Lord laboriously, and thou shalt encounter Him.

text_ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
text_en_primary: As for those who are given their record in their right hand,
text_en_yusufali: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
text_en_pickthall: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
text_en_arberry: Then as for him who is given his book in his right hand,

text_ar: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: they will have an easy reckoning,
text_en_yusufali: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
text_en_pickthall: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
text_en_arberry: he shall surely receive an easy reckoning

text_ar: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
text_en_primary: and will return to their people joyfully.
text_en_yusufali: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
text_en_pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy.
text_en_arberry: and he will return to his family joyfully.

text_ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
text_en_primary: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs,
text_en_yusufali: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
text_en_pickthall: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
text_en_arberry: But as for him who is given his book behind his back,

text_ar: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
text_en_primary: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction,
text_en_yusufali: Soon will he cry for perdition,
text_en_pickthall: He surely will invoke destruction
text_en_arberry: he shall call for destruction

text_ar: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
text_en_primary: and will burn in the blazing Fire.
text_en_yusufali: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
text_en_pickthall: And be thrown to scorching fire.
text_en_arberry: and he shall roast at a Blaze.

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
text_en_primary: For they used to be prideful among their people,
text_en_yusufali: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
text_en_pickthall: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
text_en_arberry: He once lived among his family joyfully;

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
text_en_primary: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
text_en_pickthall: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
text_en_arberry: he surely thought he would never revert.

text_ar: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
text_en_primary: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them.
text_en_yusufali: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
text_en_arberry: Yes indeed; his Lord had sight of him.

text_ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
text_en_primary: So, I do swear by the twilight!
text_en_yusufali: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
text_en_pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
text_en_arberry: No! I swear by the twilight

text_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
text_en_primary: And by the night and whatever it envelops!
text_en_yusufali: The Night and its Homing;
text_en_pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
text_en_arberry: and the night and what it envelops

text_ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
text_en_primary: And by the moon when it waxes full!
text_en_yusufali: And the Moon in her fullness:
text_en_pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full,
text_en_arberry: and the moon when it is at the full,

text_ar: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
text_en_primary: You will certainly pass from one state to another.
text_en_yusufali: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
text_en_pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
text_en_arberry: you shall surely ride stage after stage.

text_ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
text_en_primary: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe,
text_en_yusufali: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
text_en_pickthall: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
text_en_arberry: Then what ails them, that they believe not,

text_ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
text_en_primary: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺?
text_en_yusufali: And when the Qur’an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
text_en_pickthall: And, when the Qur’an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah) ?
text_en_arberry: and when the Koran is recited to them they do not bow?

text_ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
text_en_primary: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial.
text_en_yusufali: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
text_en_arberry: Nay, but the unbelievers are crying lies,

text_ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
text_en_primary: But Allah knows best whatever they hide.
text_en_yusufali: But God has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
text_en_pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
text_en_arberry: and God knows very well what they are secreting.

text_ar: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
text_en_primary: So give them good news of a painful punishment.
text_en_yusufali: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
text_en_pickthall: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
text_en_arberry: So give them good tidings of a painful chastisement,

text_ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
text_en_primary: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward.
text_en_yusufali: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
text_en_pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
text_en_arberry: except those that believe, and do righteous deeds -- theirs shall be a wage unfailing.

text_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
text_en_primary: By the sky full of constellations,
text_en_yusufali: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
text_en_pickthall: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
text_en_arberry: By heaven of the constellations,

text_ar: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
text_en_primary: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺,
text_en_yusufali: By the promised Day (of Judgment);
text_en_pickthall: And by the Promised Day.
text_en_arberry: by the promised day,

text_ar: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
text_en_primary: and the witness and what is witnessed!
text_en_yusufali: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
text_en_pickthall: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
text_en_arberry: by the witness and the witnessed,

text_ar: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
text_en_primary: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—
text_en_yusufali: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
text_en_pickthall: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
text_en_arberry: slain were the Men of the Pit,

text_ar: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
text_en_primary: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—
text_en_yusufali: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel:
text_en_pickthall: Of the fuel-fed fire,
text_en_arberry: the fire abounding in fuel,

text_ar: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
text_en_primary: when they sat around it,
text_en_yusufali: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
text_en_pickthall: When they sat by it,
text_en_arberry: when they were seated over it

text_ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
text_en_primary: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers,
text_en_yusufali: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
text_en_pickthall: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
text_en_arberry: and were themselves witnesses of what they did with the believers.

text_ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
text_en_primary: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—
text_en_yusufali: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in God, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
text_en_pickthall: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
text_en_arberry: They took revenge on them only because they believed in the All-mighty, the Al-laudable,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
text_en_primary: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things.
text_en_yusufali: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And God is Witness to all things.
text_en_pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
text_en_arberry: God to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and God is Witness over everything.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
text_en_primary: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning.
text_en_yusufali: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
text_en_arberry: Those who persecute the believers, men and women, and then have not repented, there awaits them the chastisement of Gehenna, and there awaits them the chastisement of the burning.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
text_en_primary: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph.
text_en_yusufali: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
text_en_arberry: Those who believe, and do righteous deeds, for them await gardens underneath which rivers flow; that is the great triumph.

text_ar: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
text_en_primary: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe.
text_en_yusufali: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
text_en_arberry: Surely thy Lord’s assault is terrible.

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
text_en_primary: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺.
text_en_yusufali: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
text_en_arberry: Surely it is He who originates, and brings again,

text_ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
text_en_primary: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—
text_en_yusufali: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
text_en_pickthall: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
text_en_arberry: and He is the All-forgiving, the All-loving,

text_ar: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
text_en_primary: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious,
text_en_yusufali: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
text_en_pickthall: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
text_en_arberry: Lord of the Throne, the All-glorious,

text_ar: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
text_en_primary: Doer of whatever He wills.
text_en_yusufali: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
text_en_pickthall: Doer of what He will.
text_en_arberry: Performer of what He desires.

text_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
text_en_primary: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—
text_en_yusufali: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
text_en_pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
text_en_arberry: Hast thou received the story of the hosts,

text_ar: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
text_en_primary: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd?
text_en_yusufali: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud?
text_en_pickthall: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud ?
text_en_arberry: Pharaoh and Thamood?

text_ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
text_en_primary: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial.
text_en_yusufali: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
text_en_arberry: Nay, but the unbelievers still cry lies,

text_ar: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
text_en_primary: But Allah encompasses them from all sides.
text_en_yusufali: But God doth encompass them from behind!
text_en_pickthall: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
text_en_arberry: and God is behind them, encompassing.

text_ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
text_en_primary: In fact, this is a glorious Quran,
text_en_yusufali: Day, this is a Glorious Qur’an,
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur’an.
text_en_arberry: Nay, but it is a glorious Koran,

text_ar: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
text_en_primary: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet.
text_en_yusufali: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!
text_en_pickthall: On a guarded tablet.
text_en_arberry: in a guarded tablet.

text_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
text_en_primary: By the heaven and the nightly star!
text_en_yusufali: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
text_en_pickthall: By the heaven and the Morning Star
text_en_arberry: By heaven and the night-star!

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
text_en_primary: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
text_en_pickthall: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
text_en_arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the night-star?

text_ar: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
text_en_primary: ˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness.
text_en_yusufali: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-
text_en_pickthall: - The piercing Star!
text_en_arberry: The piercing star!

text_ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
text_en_primary: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺.
text_en_yusufali: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
text_en_pickthall: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
text_en_arberry: Over every soul there is a watcher.

text_ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
text_en_primary: Let people then consider what they were created from!
text_en_yusufali: Now let man but think from what he is created!
text_en_pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created.
text_en_arberry: So let man consider of what he was created;

text_ar: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
text_en_primary: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid,
text_en_yusufali: He is created from a drop emitted-
text_en_pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid
text_en_arberry: he was created of gushing water

text_ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
text_en_primary: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage.
text_en_yusufali: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
text_en_pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
text_en_arberry: issuing between the loins and the breast-bones.

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
text_en_primary: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺
text_en_yusufali: Surely (God) is able to bring him back (to life)!
text_en_pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
text_en_arberry: Surely He is able to bring him back

text_ar: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
text_en_primary: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed.
text_en_yusufali: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,
text_en_pickthall: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
text_en_arberry: upon the day when the secrets are tried,

text_ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
text_en_primary: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper.
text_en_yusufali: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
text_en_pickthall: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
text_en_arberry: and he shall have no strength, no helper.

text_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
text_en_primary: By the sky with its recurring cycles,
text_en_yusufali: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),
text_en_pickthall: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
text_en_arberry: By heaven of the returning rain,

text_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
text_en_primary: and the earth with its sprouting plants!
text_en_yusufali: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-
text_en_pickthall: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
text_en_arberry: by earth splitting with verdure,

text_ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
text_en_primary: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word,
text_en_yusufali: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
text_en_pickthall: Lo! this (Qur’an) is a conclusive word,
text_en_arberry: surely it is a decisive word;

text_ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
text_en_primary: and is not to be taken lightly.
text_en_yusufali: It is not a thing for amusement.
text_en_pickthall: It is no pleasantry.
text_en_arberry: it is no merriment.

text_ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
text_en_primary: They are certainly devising ˹evil˺ plans,
text_en_yusufali: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
text_en_arberry: They are devising guile,

text_ar: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
text_en_primary: but I too am planning.
text_en_yusufali: And I am planning a scheme.
text_en_pickthall: And I plot a plot (against them).
text_en_arberry: and I am devising guile.

text_ar: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
text_en_primary: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
text_en_pickthall: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
text_en_arberry: So respite the unbelievers; delay with them awhile.

text_ar: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
text_en_primary: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,
text_en_yusufali: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
text_en_pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
text_en_arberry: Magnify the Name of thy Lord the Most High

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
text_en_primary: Who created and ˹perfectly˺ fashioned ˹all˺,
text_en_yusufali: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
text_en_pickthall: Who createth, then disposeth;
text_en_arberry: who created and shaped,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
text_en_primary: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly,
text_en_yusufali: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
text_en_pickthall: Who measureth, then guideth;
text_en_arberry: who determined and guided,

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
text_en_primary: and Who brings forth ˹green˺ pasture,
text_en_yusufali: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,
text_en_pickthall: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,
text_en_arberry: who brought forth the pasturage

text_ar: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
text_en_primary: then reduces it to withered chaff.
text_en_yusufali: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
text_en_pickthall: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
text_en_arberry: then made it a blackening wrack.

text_ar: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O  Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺,
text_en_yusufali: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
text_en_pickthall: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
text_en_arberry: We shall make thee recite, to forget not

text_ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
text_en_primary: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden.
text_en_yusufali: Except as God wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
text_en_pickthall: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
text_en_arberry: save what God wills; surely He knows what is spoken aloud and what is hidden.

text_ar: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease.
text_en_yusufali: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
text_en_pickthall: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
text_en_arberry: We shall ease thee unto the Easing.

text_ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
text_en_pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
text_en_arberry: Therefore remind, if the Reminder profits,

text_ar: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
text_en_primary: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺.
text_en_yusufali: The admonition will be received by those who fear (God):
text_en_pickthall: He will heed who feareth,
text_en_arberry: and he who fears shall remember,

text_ar: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
text_en_primary: But it will be shunned by the most wretched,
text_en_yusufali: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
text_en_pickthall: But the most hapless will flout it,
text_en_arberry: but the most wretched shall flout it,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: who will burn in the greatest Fire,
text_en_yusufali: Who will enter the Great Fire,
text_en_pickthall: He who will be flung to the great Fire
text_en_arberry: even he who shall roast in the Great Fire,

text_ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
text_en_primary: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die.
text_en_yusufali: In which they will then neither die nor live.
text_en_pickthall: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
text_en_arberry: then he shall neither die therein, nor live.

text_ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
text_en_primary: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves,
text_en_yusufali: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
text_en_pickthall: He is successful who groweth,
text_en_arberry: Prosperous is he who has cleansed himself,

text_ar: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
text_en_primary: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray.
text_en_yusufali: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
text_en_pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
text_en_arberry: and mentions the Name of his Lord, and prays.

text_ar: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
text_en_primary: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world,
text_en_yusufali: Day (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
text_en_pickthall: But ye prefer the life of the world
text_en_arberry: Nay, but you prefer the present life;

text_ar: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting.
text_en_yusufali: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
text_en_pickthall: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
text_en_arberry: and the world to come is better, and more enduring.

text_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
text_en_primary: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—
text_en_yusufali: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
text_en_pickthall: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
text_en_arberry: Surely this is in the ancient scrolls,

text_ar: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
text_en_primary: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
text_en_yusufali: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
text_en_pickthall: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
text_en_arberry: the scrolls of Abraham and Moses.

text_ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
text_en_primary: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺?
text_en_yusufali: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
text_en_pickthall: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming ?
text_en_arberry: Hast thou received the story of the Enveloper?

text_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
text_en_primary: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast,
text_en_yusufali: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
text_en_pickthall: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
text_en_arberry: Faces on that day humbled,

text_ar: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted,
text_en_yusufali: Labouring (hard), weary,-
text_en_pickthall: Toiling, weary,
text_en_arberry: labouring, toilworn,

text_ar: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
text_en_primary: burning in a scorching Fire,
text_en_yusufali: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
text_en_pickthall: Scorched by burning fire,
text_en_arberry: roasting at a scorching fire,

text_ar: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: left to drink from a scalding spring.
text_en_yusufali: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
text_en_pickthall: Drinking from a boiling spring,
text_en_arberry: watered at a boiling fountain,

text_ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
text_en_primary: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub,
text_en_yusufali: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari’
text_en_pickthall: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
text_en_arberry: no food for them but cactus thorn

text_ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
text_en_primary: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger.
text_en_yusufali: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
text_en_pickthall: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
text_en_arberry: unfattening, unappeasing hunger.

text_ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss,
text_en_yusufali: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
text_en_pickthall: In that day other faces will be calm,
text_en_arberry: Faces on that day jocund,

text_ar: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving,
text_en_yusufali: Pleased with their striving,-
text_en_pickthall: Glad for their effort past,
text_en_arberry: with their striving well-pleased,

text_ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: in an elevated Garden,
text_en_yusufali: In a Garden on high,
text_en_pickthall: In a high Garden
text_en_arberry: in a sublime Garden,

text_ar: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
text_en_primary: where no idle talk will be heard.
text_en_yusufali: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
text_en_pickthall: Where they hear no idle speech,
text_en_arberry: hearing there no babble;

text_ar: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: In it will be a running spring,
text_en_yusufali: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
text_en_pickthall: Wherein is a gushing spring,
text_en_arberry: therein a running fountain,

text_ar: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: along with thrones raised high,
text_en_yusufali: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
text_en_pickthall: Wherein are couches raised
text_en_arberry: therein uplifted couches

text_ar: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: and cups set at hand,
text_en_yusufali: Goblets placed (ready),
text_en_pickthall: And goblets set at hand
text_en_arberry: and goblets set forth

text_ar: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up,
text_en_yusufali: And cushions set in rows,
text_en_pickthall: And cushions ranged
text_en_arberry: and cushions arrayed

text_ar: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
text_en_primary: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out.
text_en_yusufali: And rich carpets (all) spread out.
text_en_pickthall: And silken carpets spread.
text_en_arberry: and carpets outspread.

text_ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
text_en_primary: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created;
text_en_yusufali: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
text_en_pickthall: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created ?
text_en_arberry: What, do they not consider how the camel was created,

text_ar: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
text_en_primary: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺;
text_en_yusufali: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
text_en_pickthall: And the heaven, how it is raised ?
text_en_arberry: how heaven was lifted up,

text_ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
text_en_primary: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up;
text_en_yusufali: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
text_en_pickthall: And the hills, how they are set up ?
text_en_arberry: how the mountains were hoisted,

text_ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
text_en_primary: and the earth—how it was levelled out?
text_en_yusufali: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
text_en_pickthall: And the earth, how it is spread ?
text_en_arberry: how the earth was outstretched?

text_ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
text_en_primary: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O  Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
text_en_pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
text_en_arberry: Then remind them! Thou art only a reminder;

text_ar: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
text_en_primary: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺.
text_en_yusufali: Thou art not one to manage (men’s) affairs.
text_en_pickthall: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
text_en_arberry: thou art not charged to oversee them.

text_ar: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
text_en_primary: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief,
text_en_yusufali: But if any turn away and reject God,-
text_en_pickthall: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
text_en_arberry: But he who turns his back, and disbelieves,

text_ar: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
text_en_primary: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment.
text_en_yusufali: God will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
text_en_pickthall: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
text_en_arberry: God shall chastise him with the greatest chastisement.

text_ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
text_en_primary: Surely to Us is their return,
text_en_yusufali: For to Us will be their return;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! unto Us is their return
text_en_arberry: Truly, to Us is their return;

text_ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
text_en_primary: then surely with Us is their reckoning.
text_en_yusufali: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
text_en_pickthall: And Ours their reckoning.
text_en_arberry: then upon Us shall rest their reckoning.

text_ar: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
text_en_primary: By the dawn,
text_en_yusufali: By the break of Day
text_en_pickthall: By the Dawn
text_en_arberry: By the dawn

text_ar: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
text_en_primary: and the ten nights,
text_en_yusufali: By the Nights twice five;
text_en_pickthall: And ten nights,
text_en_arberry: and ten nights,

text_ar: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
text_en_primary: and the even and the odd,
text_en_yusufali: By the even and odd (contrasted);
text_en_pickthall: And the Even and the Odd,
text_en_arberry: by the even and the odd,

text_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
text_en_primary: and the night when it passes!
text_en_yusufali: And by the Night when it passeth away;-
text_en_pickthall: And the night when it departeth,
text_en_arberry: by the night when it journeys on!

text_ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
text_en_primary: Is all this ˹not˺ a sufficient oath for those who have sense?
text_en_yusufali: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?
text_en_pickthall: There surely is an oath for thinking man.
text_en_arberry: Is there in that an oath for a mindful man?

text_ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
text_en_primary: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the ’Ad (people),-
text_en_pickthall: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A’ad,
text_en_arberry: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with Ad,

text_ar: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
text_en_primary: ˹the people˺ of Iram—with ˹their˺ great stature,
text_en_yusufali: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,
text_en_pickthall: With many-columned Iram,
text_en_arberry: Iram of the pillars,

text_ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
text_en_primary: unmatched in any other land;
text_en_yusufali: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?
text_en_pickthall: The like of which was not created in the lands;
text_en_arberry: the like of which was never created in the land,

text_ar: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
text_en_primary: and Thamûd who carved ˹their homes into˺ the rocks in the ˹Stone˺ Valley;
text_en_yusufali: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-
text_en_pickthall: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;
text_en_arberry: and Thamood, who hollowed the rocks in the valley,

text_ar: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
text_en_primary: and the Pharaoh of mighty structures?
text_en_yusufali: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?
text_en_pickthall: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,
text_en_arberry: and Pharaoh, he of the tent-pegs,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
text_en_primary: They all transgressed throughout the land,
text_en_yusufali: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
text_en_pickthall: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
text_en_arberry: who all were insolent in the land

text_ar: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
text_en_primary: spreading much corruption there.
text_en_yusufali: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).
text_en_pickthall: And multiplied iniquity therein ?
text_en_arberry: and worked much corruption therein?

text_ar: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
text_en_primary: So your Lord unleashed on them a scourge of punishment.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
text_en_pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
text_en_arberry: Thy Lord unloosed on them a scourge of chastisement;

text_ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
text_en_primary: ˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant.
text_en_yusufali: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
text_en_arberry: surely thy Lord is ever on the watch.

text_ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
text_en_primary: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”
text_en_yusufali: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
text_en_pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
text_en_arberry: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him, and honours him, and blesses him, then he says, ’My Lord has honoured me.’

text_ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
text_en_primary: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”
text_en_yusufali: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
text_en_pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
text_en_arberry: But when he tries him and stints for him his provision, then he says, ’My Lord has despised me.’

text_ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
text_en_primary: Absolutely not! In fact, you are not ˹even˺ gracious to the orphan,
text_en_yusufali: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
text_en_arberry: No indeed; but you honour not the orphan,

text_ar: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
text_en_primary: nor do you urge one another to feed the poor.
text_en_yusufali: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
text_en_pickthall: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
text_en_arberry: and you urge not the feeding of the needy,

text_ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
text_en_primary: And you devour ˹others’˺ inheritance greedily,
text_en_yusufali: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,
text_en_pickthall: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
text_en_arberry: and you devour the inheritance greedily,

text_ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
text_en_primary: and love wealth fervently.
text_en_yusufali: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!
text_en_pickthall: And love wealth with abounding love.
text_en_arberry: and you love wealth with an ardent love

text_ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
text_en_primary: Enough! When the earth is entirely crushed over and over,
text_en_yusufali: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,
text_en_arberry: No indeed! When the earth is ground to powder,

text_ar: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
text_en_primary: and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank,
text_en_yusufali: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
text_en_pickthall: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
text_en_arberry: and thy Lord comes, and the angels rank on rank,

text_ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then?
text_en_yusufali: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
text_en_pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him) ?
text_en_arberry: and Gehenna is brought out, upon that day man will remember; and how shall the Reminder be for him?

text_ar: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
text_en_primary: They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”
text_en_yusufali: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"
text_en_pickthall: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
text_en_arberry: He shall say, ’O would that I had forwarded for my life!’

text_ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
text_en_primary: On that Day He will punish ˹them˺ severely, like no other,
text_en_yusufali: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
text_en_pickthall: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
text_en_arberry: Upon that day none shall chastise as He chastises,

text_ar: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
text_en_primary: and bind ˹them˺ tightly, like no other.
text_en_yusufali: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
text_en_pickthall: None bindeth as He then will bind.
text_en_arberry: none shall bind as He binds.

text_ar: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
text_en_primary: ˹Allah will say to the righteous,˺ “O tranquil soul!
text_en_yusufali: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
text_en_pickthall: But ah! thou soul at peace!
text_en_arberry: ’O soul at peace,

text_ar: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
text_en_primary: Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺.
text_en_yusufali: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
text_en_pickthall: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
text_en_arberry: return unto thy Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing!

text_ar: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
text_en_primary: So join My servants,
text_en_yusufali: "Enter thou, then, among My devotees!
text_en_pickthall: Enter thou among My bondmen!
text_en_arberry: Enter thou among My servants!

text_ar: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
text_en_primary: and enter My Paradise.”
text_en_yusufali: "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!
text_en_pickthall: Enter thou My Garden!
text_en_arberry: Enter thou My Paradise!’

text_ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
text_en_primary: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—
text_en_yusufali: I do call to witness this City;-
text_en_pickthall: Nay, I swear by this city -
text_en_arberry: No! I swear by this land,

text_ar: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
text_en_primary: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—
text_en_yusufali: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
text_en_pickthall: And thou art an indweller of this city -
text_en_arberry: and thou art a lodger in this land;

text_ar: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
text_en_primary: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child!
text_en_yusufali: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
text_en_pickthall: And the begetter and that which he begat,
text_en_arberry: by the begetter, and that he begot,

text_ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle.
text_en_yusufali: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
text_en_pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
text_en_arberry: indeed, We created man in trouble.

text_ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
text_en_primary: Do they think that no one has power over them,
text_en_yusufali: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
text_en_pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him ?
text_en_arberry: What, does he think none has power over him,

text_ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
text_en_primary: boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”?
text_en_yusufali: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
text_en_pickthall: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
text_en_arberry: saying, ’I have consumed wealth abundant’?

text_ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
text_en_primary: Do they think that no one sees them?
text_en_yusufali: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
text_en_pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him ?
text_en_arberry: What, does he think none has seen him?

text_ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
text_en_primary: Have We not given them two eyes,
text_en_yusufali: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
text_en_pickthall: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
text_en_arberry: Have We not appointed to him two eyes,

text_ar: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
text_en_primary: a tongue, and two lips;
text_en_yusufali: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
text_en_pickthall: And a tongue and two lips,
text_en_arberry: and a tongue, and two lips,

text_ar: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
text_en_primary: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺?
text_en_yusufali: And shown him the two highways?
text_en_pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways ?
text_en_arberry: and guided him on the two highways?

text_ar: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
text_en_primary: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺!
text_en_yusufali: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
text_en_pickthall: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
text_en_arberry: Yet he has not assaulted the steep;

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
text_en_primary: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
text_en_pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
text_en_arberry: and what shall teach thee what is the steep?

text_ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
text_en_primary: It is to free a slave,
text_en_yusufali: (It is:) freeing the bondman;
text_en_pickthall: (It is) to free a slave,
text_en_arberry: The freeing of a slave,

text_ar: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: or to give food in times of famine
text_en_yusufali: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
text_en_pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger.
text_en_arberry: or giving food upon a day of hunger

text_ar: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
text_en_primary: to an orphaned relative
text_en_yusufali: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
text_en_pickthall: An orphan near of kin,
text_en_arberry: to an orphan near of kin

text_ar: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: or to a poor person in distress,
text_en_yusufali: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
text_en_pickthall: Or some poor wretch in misery,
text_en_arberry: or a needy man in misery;

text_ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
text_en_primary: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion.
text_en_yusufali: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
text_en_pickthall: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
text_en_arberry: then that he become of those who believe and counsel each other to be steadfast, and counsel each other to be merciful.

text_ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
text_en_primary: These are the people of the right.
text_en_yusufali: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
text_en_pickthall: Their place will be on the right hand.
text_en_arberry: Those are the Companions of the Right Hand.

text_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
text_en_primary: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left.
text_en_yusufali: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
text_en_pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
text_en_arberry: And those who disbelieve in Our signs, they are the Companions of the Left Hand;

text_ar: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
text_en_primary: The Fire will be sealed over them.
text_en_yusufali: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
text_en_pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them.
text_en_arberry: over them is a Fire covered down.

text_ar: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: By the sun and its brightness,
text_en_yusufali: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
text_en_pickthall: By the sun and his brightness,
text_en_arberry: By the sun and his morning brightness

text_ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: and the moon as it follows it,
text_en_yusufali: By the Moon as she follows him;
text_en_pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him,
text_en_arberry: and by the moon when she follows him,

text_ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
text_en_primary: and the day as it unveils it,
text_en_yusufali: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun’s) glory;
text_en_pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him,
text_en_arberry: and by the day when it displays him

text_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: and the night as it conceals it!
text_en_yusufali: By the Night as it conceals it;
text_en_pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
text_en_arberry: and by the night when it enshrouds him!

text_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it,
text_en_yusufali: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;
text_en_pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
text_en_arberry: By the heaven and That which built it

text_ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it!
text_en_yusufali: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:
text_en_pickthall: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
text_en_arberry: and by the earth and That which extended it!

text_ar: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
text_en_primary: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it,
text_en_yusufali: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;
text_en_pickthall: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
text_en_arberry: By the soul, and That which shaped it

text_ar: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it!
text_en_yusufali: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
text_en_pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
text_en_arberry: and inspired it to lewdness and godfearing!

text_ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
text_en_primary: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul,
text_en_yusufali: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
text_en_pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
text_en_arberry: Prosperous is he who purifies it,

text_ar: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
text_en_primary: and doomed is the one who corrupts it!
text_en_yusufali: And he fails that corrupts it!
text_en_pickthall: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
text_en_arberry: and failed has he who seduces it.

text_ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
text_en_primary: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance,
text_en_yusufali: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
text_en_pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
text_en_arberry: Thamood cried lies in their insolence

text_ar: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
text_en_primary: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺.
text_en_yusufali: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
text_en_pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth
text_en_arberry: when the most wretched of them uprose,

text_ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
text_en_primary: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”
text_en_yusufali: But the Apostle of God said to them: "It is a She-camel of God! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
text_en_pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
text_en_arberry: then the Messenger of God said to them, ’The She-camel of God; let her drink!’

text_ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
text_en_primary: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground.
text_en_yusufali: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
text_en_pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
text_en_arberry: But they cried him lies, and hamstrung her, so their Lord crushed them for their sin, and leveled them:

text_ar: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
text_en_primary: He has no fear of consequences.
text_en_yusufali: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
text_en_pickthall: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
text_en_arberry: and He fears not the issue thereof.

text_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
text_en_primary: By the night when it covers,
text_en_yusufali: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
text_en_pickthall: By the night enshrouding
text_en_arberry: By the night enshrouding

text_ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
text_en_primary: and the day when it shines!
text_en_yusufali: By the Day as it appears in glory;
text_en_pickthall: And the day resplendent
text_en_arberry: and the day in splendour

text_ar: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female!
text_en_yusufali: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
text_en_pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,
text_en_arberry: and That which created the male and the female,

text_ar: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
text_en_primary: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
text_en_arberry: surely your striving is to diverse ends.

text_ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
text_en_primary: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺,
text_en_yusufali: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (God),
text_en_pickthall: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
text_en_arberry: As for him who gives and is godfearing

text_ar: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward,
text_en_yusufali: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
text_en_pickthall: And believeth in goodness;
text_en_arberry: and confirms the reward most fair,

text_ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease.
text_en_yusufali: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
text_en_pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
text_en_arberry: We shall surely ease him to the Easing.

text_ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺,
text_en_yusufali: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
text_en_pickthall: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
text_en_arberry: But as for him who is a miser, and self-sufficient,

text_ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward,
text_en_yusufali: And gives the lie to the best,-
text_en_pickthall: And disbelieveth in goodness;
text_en_arberry: and cries lies to the reward most fair,

text_ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
text_en_primary: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship.
text_en_yusufali: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
text_en_pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
text_en_arberry: We shall surely ease him to the Hardship;

text_ar: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
text_en_primary: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺.
text_en_yusufali: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
text_en_pickthall: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
text_en_arberry: his wealth shall not avail him when he perishes.

text_ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
text_en_primary: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance.
text_en_yusufali: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
text_en_arberry: Surely upon Us rests the guidance,

text_ar: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
text_en_primary: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next.
text_en_yusufali: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
text_en_arberry: and to Us belong the Last and the First.

text_ar: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
text_en_primary: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire,
text_en_yusufali: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
text_en_pickthall: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
text_en_arberry: Now I have warned you of a Fire that flames,

text_ar: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
text_en_primary: in which none will burn except the most wretched—
text_en_yusufali: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
text_en_pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure,
text_en_arberry: whereat none but the most wretched shall be roasted,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
text_en_primary: who deny and turn away.
text_en_yusufali: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
text_en_pickthall: He who denieth and turneth away.
text_en_arberry: even he who cried lies, and turned away;

text_ar: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
text_en_primary: But the righteous will be spared from it—
text_en_yusufali: But those most devoted to God shall be removed far from it,-
text_en_pickthall: Far removed from it will be the righteous
text_en_arberry: and from which the most godfearing shall be removed,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
text_en_primary: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves,
text_en_yusufali: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
text_en_pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
text_en_arberry: even he who gives his wealth. to purify himself

text_ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: not in return for someone’s favours,
text_en_yusufali: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
text_en_pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
text_en_arberry: and confers no favour on any man for recompense,
