text_ar: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
text_en_primary: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High.
text_en_yusufali: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
text_en_pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
text_en_arberry: only seeking the Face of his Lord the Most High;

text_ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
text_en_primary: They will certainly be pleased.
text_en_yusufali: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
text_en_pickthall: He verily will be content.
text_en_arberry: and he shall surely be satisfied.

text_ar: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
text_en_primary: By the morning sunlight,
text_en_yusufali: By the Glorious Morning Light,
text_en_pickthall: By the morning hours
text_en_arberry: By the white forenoon

text_ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
text_en_primary: and the night when it falls still!
text_en_yusufali: And by the Night when it is still,-
text_en_pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest,
text_en_arberry: and the brooding night!

text_ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
text_en_primary: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺.
text_en_yusufali: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
text_en_pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
text_en_arberry: Thy Lord has neither forsaken thee nor hates thee

text_ar: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
text_en_primary: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one.
text_en_yusufali: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
text_en_pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
text_en_arberry: and the Last shall be better for thee than the First.

text_ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased.
text_en_yusufali: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
text_en_pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
text_en_arberry: Thy Lord shall give thee, and thou shalt be satisfied.

text_ar: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
text_en_primary: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you?
text_en_yusufali: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
text_en_pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee) ?
text_en_arberry: Did He not find thee an orphan, and shelter thee?

text_ar: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
text_en_primary: Did He not find you unguided then guided you?
text_en_yusufali: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
text_en_pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee) ?
text_en_arberry: Did He not find thee erring, and guide thee?

text_ar: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
text_en_primary: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs?
text_en_yusufali: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
text_en_pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee) ?
text_en_arberry: Did He not find thee needy, and suffice thee?

text_ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
text_en_primary: So do not oppress the orphan,
text_en_yusufali: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
text_en_pickthall: Therefor the orphan oppress not,
text_en_arberry: As for the orphan, do not oppress him,

text_ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
text_en_primary: nor repulse the beggar.
text_en_yusufali: Nor repulse the petitioner (unheard);
text_en_pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
text_en_arberry: and as for the beggar, scold him not;

text_ar: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
text_en_primary: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord.
text_en_yusufali: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
text_en_pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
text_en_arberry: and as for thy Lord’s blessing, declare it.

text_ar: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
text_en_primary: Have We not uplifted your heart for you ˹O Prophet˺,
text_en_yusufali: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
text_en_pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
text_en_arberry: Did We not expand thy breast for thee

text_ar: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
text_en_primary: relieved you of the burden
text_en_yusufali: And removed from thee thy burden
text_en_pickthall: And eased thee of the burden
text_en_arberry: and lift from thee thy burden,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
text_en_primary: which weighed so heavily on your back,
text_en_yusufali: The which did gall thy back?-
text_en_pickthall: Which weighed down thy back;
text_en_arberry: the burden that weighed down thy back?

text_ar: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
text_en_primary: and elevated your renown for you?
text_en_yusufali: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
text_en_pickthall: And exalted thy fame ?
text_en_arberry: And exalted for you your esteem?

text_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
text_en_primary: So, surely with hardship comes ease.
text_en_yusufali: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
text_en_pickthall: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
text_en_arberry: So truly with hardship comes ease,

text_ar: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
text_en_primary: Surely with ˹that˺ hardship comes ˹more˺ ease.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;
text_en_arberry: truly with hardship comes ease.’

text_ar: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
text_en_primary: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺,
text_en_yusufali: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
text_en_pickthall: So when thou art relieved, still toil
text_en_arberry: So when thou art empty, labour,

text_ar: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
text_en_primary: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope.
text_en_yusufali: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
text_en_pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord.
text_en_arberry: and let thy Lord be thy Quest.

text_ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
text_en_primary: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺,
text_en_yusufali: By the Fig and the Olive,
text_en_pickthall: By the fig and the olive,
text_en_arberry: By the fig and the olive

text_ar: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
text_en_primary: and Mount Sinai,
text_en_yusufali: And the Mount of Sinai,
text_en_pickthall: By Mount Sinai,
text_en_arberry: and the Mount Sinai

text_ar: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
text_en_primary: and this secure city ˹of Mecca˺!
text_en_yusufali: And this City of security,-
text_en_pickthall: And by this land made safe;
text_en_arberry: and this land secure!

text_ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We created humans in the best form.
text_en_yusufali: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
text_en_pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature
text_en_arberry: We indeed created Man in the fairest stature

text_ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
text_en_primary: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺,
text_en_yusufali: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
text_en_pickthall: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
text_en_arberry: then We restored him the lowest of the low --

text_ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
text_en_primary: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward.
text_en_yusufali: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
text_en_pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
text_en_arberry: save those who believe, and do righteous deeds; they shall have a wage unfailing.

text_ar: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment?
text_en_yusufali: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
text_en_pickthall: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment ?
text_en_arberry: What then shall cry thee lies as to the Doom?

text_ar: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
text_en_primary: Is Allah not the most just of all judges?
text_en_yusufali: Is not God the wisest of judges?
text_en_pickthall: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges ?
text_en_arberry: Is not God the justest of judges?

text_ar: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
text_en_primary: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—
text_en_yusufali: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
text_en_pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
text_en_arberry: Recite: In the Name of thy Lord who created,

text_ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
text_en_primary: created humans from a clinging clot.
text_en_yusufali: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
text_en_pickthall: Createth man from a clot.
text_en_arberry: created Man of a blood-clot.

text_ar: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
text_en_primary: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,
text_en_yusufali: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
text_en_pickthall: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
text_en_arberry: Recite: And thy Lord is the Most Generous,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
text_en_primary: Who taught by the pen—
text_en_yusufali: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-
text_en_pickthall: Who teacheth by the pen,
text_en_arberry: who taught by the Pen,

text_ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
text_en_primary: taught humanity what they knew not.
text_en_yusufali: Taught man that which he knew not.
text_en_pickthall: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
text_en_arberry: taught Man that he knew not.

text_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds
text_en_yusufali: Day, but man doth transgress all bounds,
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
text_en_arberry: No indeed; surely Man waxes insolent,

text_ar: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: once they think they are self-sufficient.
text_en_yusufali: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
text_en_pickthall: That he thinketh himself independent!
text_en_arberry: for he thinks himself self-sufficient.

text_ar: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺.
text_en_yusufali: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
text_en_arberry: Surely unto thy Lord is the Returning.

text_ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
text_en_primary: Have you seen the man who prevents
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou one who forbids-
text_en_pickthall: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
text_en_arberry: What thinkest thou? He who forbids

text_ar: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
text_en_primary: a servant ˹of Ours˺ from praying?
text_en_yusufali: A votary when he (turns) to pray?
text_en_pickthall: A slave when he prayeth ?
text_en_arberry: a servant when he prays --

text_ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: What if this ˹servant˺ is ˹rightly˺ guided,
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
text_en_pickthall: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
text_en_arberry: What thinkest thou? If he were upon guidance

text_ar: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
text_en_primary: or encourages righteousness?
text_en_yusufali: Or enjoins Righteousness?
text_en_pickthall: Or enjoineth piety ?
text_en_arberry: or bade to godfearing --

text_ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
text_en_primary: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away?
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
text_en_pickthall: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah’s guidance) and is froward ?
text_en_arberry: What thinkest thou? If he cries lies, and turns away -

text_ar: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
text_en_primary: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺?
text_en_yusufali: Knoweth he not that God doth see?
text_en_pickthall: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth ?
text_en_arberry: Did he not know that God sees?

text_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
text_en_primary: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—
text_en_yusufali: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
text_en_arberry: No indeed; surely, if he gives not over, We shall seize him by the forelock,

text_ar: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: a lying, sinful forelock.
text_en_yusufali: A lying, sinful forelock!
text_en_pickthall: The lying, sinful forelock -
text_en_arberry: a lying, sinful forelock.

text_ar: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
text_en_primary: So let him call his associates.
text_en_yusufali: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
text_en_pickthall: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
text_en_arberry: So let him call on his concourse!

text_ar: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
text_en_primary: We will call the wardens of Hell.
text_en_yusufali: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
text_en_pickthall: We will call the guards of hell.
text_en_arberry: We shall call on the guards of Hell.

text_ar: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
text_en_primary: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺.
text_en_yusufali: Day, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to God)!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
text_en_arberry: No indeed; do thou not obey him, and bow thyself, and draw nigh.

text_ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory.
text_en_yusufali: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
text_en_arberry: Behold, We sent it down on the Night of Power;

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
text_en_primary: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
text_en_pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
text_en_arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Night of Power?

text_ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
text_en_primary: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.
text_en_yusufali: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
text_en_pickthall: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
text_en_arberry: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months;

text_ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
text_en_primary: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter.
text_en_yusufali: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by God’s permission, on every errand:
text_en_pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
text_en_arberry: in it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, upon every command.

text_ar: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
text_en_primary: It is all peace until the break of dawn.
text_en_yusufali: Peace!...This until the rise of morn!
text_en_pickthall: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
text_en_arberry: Peace it is, till the rising of dawn.

text_ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
text_en_primary: The disbelievers from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist ˹from disbelief˺ until the clear proof came to them:
text_en_yusufali: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence,-
text_en_pickthall: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,
text_en_arberry: The unbelievers of the People of the Book and the idolaters would never leave off; till the Clear Sign came to them,

text_ar: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
text_en_primary: a messenger from Allah, reciting scrolls of ˹utmost˺ purity,
text_en_yusufali: An apostle from God, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy:
text_en_pickthall: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages
text_en_arberry: a Messenger from God, reciting pages purified,

text_ar: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: containing upright commandments.
text_en_yusufali: Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.
text_en_pickthall: Containing correct scriptures.
text_en_arberry: therein true Books.

text_ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
text_en_primary: It was not until this clear proof came to the People of the Book that they became divided ˹about his prophethood˺—
text_en_yusufali: Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence.
text_en_pickthall: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.
text_en_arberry: And they scattered not, those that were given the Book, excepting after the Clear Sign came to them.

text_ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
text_en_primary: even though they were only commanded to worship Allah ˹alone˺ with sincere devotion to Him in all uprightness, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. That is the upright Way.
text_en_yusufali: And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship God, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight.
text_en_pickthall: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.
text_en_arberry: They were commanded only to serve God, making the religion His sincerely, men of pure faith, and to perform the prayer, and pay the alms -- that is the religion of the True.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there forever. They are the worst of ˹all˺ beings.
text_en_yusufali: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.
text_en_pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.
text_en_arberry: The unbelievers of the People of the Book and the idolaters shall be in the Fire of Gehenna, therein dwelling forever; those are the worst of creatures.

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, those who believe and do good—they are the best of ˹all˺ beings.
text_en_yusufali: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures.
text_en_pickthall: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.
text_en_arberry: But those who believe, and do righteous deeds, those are the best of creatures;

text_ar: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
text_en_primary: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is ˹only˺ for those in awe of their Lord.
text_en_yusufali: Their reward is with God: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; God well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher.
text_en_pickthall: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
text_en_arberry: their recompense is with their Lord-Gardens of Eden, underneath which rivers flow, therein dwelling for ever and ever. God is well-pleased with them, and they are well-pleased with Him; that is for him who fears his Lord.

text_ar: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
text_en_primary: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking,
text_en_yusufali: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
text_en_pickthall: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
text_en_arberry: When earth is shaken with a mighty shaking

text_ar: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
text_en_primary: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents,
text_en_yusufali: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
text_en_pickthall: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
text_en_arberry: and earth brings forth her burdens,

text_ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
text_en_primary: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—
text_en_yusufali: And man cries (distressed): ’What is the matter with her?’-
text_en_pickthall: And man saith: What aileth her ?
text_en_arberry: and Man says., ’What ails her?’

text_ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
text_en_primary: on that Day the earth will recount everything,
text_en_yusufali: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
text_en_pickthall: That day she will relate her chronicles,
text_en_arberry: upon that day she shall tell her tidings

text_ar: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
text_en_primary: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺.
text_en_yusufali: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
text_en_pickthall: Because thy Lord inspireth her.
text_en_arberry: for that her Lord has inspired her.

text_ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
text_en_primary: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds.
text_en_yusufali: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
text_en_pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
text_en_arberry: Upon that day men shall issue in scatterings to see their works,

text_ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.
text_en_yusufali: Then shall anyone who has done an atom’s weight of good, see it!
text_en_pickthall: And whoso doeth good an atom’s weight will see it then,
text_en_arberry: and whoso has done an atom’s weight of good shall see it,

text_ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
text_en_primary: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
text_en_yusufali: And anyone who has done an atom’s weight of evil, shall see it.
text_en_pickthall: And whoso doeth ill an atom’s weight will see it then.
text_en_arberry: and whoso has done an atom’s weight of evil shall see it.

text_ar: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
text_en_primary: ’ By the galloping, panting horses,
text_en_yusufali: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
text_en_pickthall: By the snorting courses,
text_en_arberry: By the snorting chargers,

text_ar: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
text_en_primary: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺,
text_en_yusufali: And strike sparks of fire,
text_en_pickthall: Striking sparks of fire
text_en_arberry: by the strikers of fire,

text_ar: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
text_en_primary: launching raids at dawn,
text_en_yusufali: And push home the charge in the morning,
text_en_pickthall: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
text_en_arberry: by the dawn-raiders

text_ar: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
text_en_primary: stirring up ˹clouds of˺ dust,
text_en_yusufali: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
text_en_pickthall: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
text_en_arberry: blazing a trail of dust,

text_ar: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
text_en_primary: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines!
text_en_yusufali: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
text_en_pickthall: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
text_en_arberry: cleaving there with a host!

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
text_en_primary: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—
text_en_yusufali: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
text_en_pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
text_en_arberry: Surely Man is ungrateful to his Lord,

text_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
text_en_primary: and they certainly attest to this—
text_en_yusufali: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
text_en_pickthall: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
text_en_arberry: and surely he is a witness against that!

text_ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
text_en_primary: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains.
text_en_yusufali: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
text_en_pickthall: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
text_en_arberry: Surely he is passionate in his love for good things.

text_ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
text_en_primary: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out,
text_en_yusufali: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
text_en_pickthall: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
text_en_arberry: Knows he not that when that which is in the tombs is over-thrown,

text_ar: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
text_en_primary: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—
text_en_yusufali: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
text_en_pickthall: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
text_en_arberry: and that which is in the breasts is brought out --

text_ar: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
text_en_primary: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day.
text_en_yusufali: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day.?
text_en_pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
text_en_arberry: surely on that day their Lord shall be aware of them!

text_ar: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
text_en_primary: The Striking Disaster!
text_en_yusufali: The (Day) of Noise and Clamour:
text_en_pickthall: The Calamity!
text_en_arberry: The Clatterer!

text_ar: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
text_en_primary: What is the Striking Disaster?
text_en_yusufali: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?
text_en_pickthall: What is the Calamity ?
text_en_arberry: What is the Clatterer?

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
text_en_primary: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
text_en_pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
text_en_arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Clatterer?

text_ar: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
text_en_primary: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths,
text_en_yusufali: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,
text_en_pickthall: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
text_en_arberry: The day that men shall be like scattered moths,

text_ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
text_en_primary: and the mountains will be like carded wool.
text_en_yusufali: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
text_en_pickthall: And the mountains will become as carded wool.
text_en_arberry: and the mountains shall be like plucked wool-tufts.

text_ar: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
text_en_primary: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺,
text_en_yusufali: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,
text_en_pickthall: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
text_en_arberry: Then he whose deeds weigh heavy in the Balance

text_ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
text_en_primary: they will be in a life of bliss.
text_en_yusufali: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
text_en_pickthall: He will live a pleasant life.
text_en_arberry: shall inherit a pleasing life,

text_ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
text_en_primary: And as for those whose scale is light,
text_en_yusufali: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-
text_en_pickthall: But as for him whose scales are light,
text_en_arberry: but he whose deeds weigh light in the Balance

text_ar: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: their home will be the abyss.
text_en_yusufali: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.
text_en_pickthall: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,
text_en_arberry: shall plunge in the womb of the Pit.

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
text_en_primary: And what will make you realize what that is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee what this is?
text_en_pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
text_en_arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Pit?

text_ar: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
text_en_primary: ˹It is˺ a scorching Fire.
text_en_yusufali: (It is) a Fire Blazing fiercely!
text_en_pickthall: Raging Fire.
text_en_arberry: A blazing Fire!

text_ar: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
text_en_primary: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺,
text_en_yusufali: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
text_en_pickthall: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
text_en_arberry: Gross rivalry diverts you,

text_ar: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
text_en_primary: until you end up in ˹your˺ graves.
text_en_yusufali: Until ye visit the graves.
text_en_pickthall: Until ye come to the graves.
text_en_arberry: even till you visit the tombs.

text_ar: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: But no! You will soon come to know.
text_en_yusufali: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
text_en_arberry: No indeed; but soon you shall know.

text_ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
text_en_primary: Again, no! You will soon come to know.
text_en_yusufali: Again, ye soon shall know!
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
text_en_arberry: Again, no indeed; but soon you shall know.

text_ar: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
text_en_primary: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺.
text_en_yusufali: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
text_en_pickthall: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
text_en_arberry: No indeed; did you know with the knowledge of certainty,

text_ar: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
text_en_primary: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire.
text_en_yusufali: Ye shall certainly see Hell-Fire!
text_en_pickthall: For ye will behold hell-fire.
text_en_arberry: you shall surely see Hell;

text_ar: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
text_en_primary: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
text_en_yusufali: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
text_en_pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
text_en_arberry: Again, you shall surely see it with the eye of certainty

text_ar: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
text_en_primary: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures.
text_en_yusufali: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
text_en_pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
text_en_arberry: then you shall be questioned that day concerning true bliss.

text_ar: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
text_en_primary: By the ˹passage of˺ time!
text_en_yusufali: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages),
text_en_pickthall: By the declining day,
text_en_arberry: By the afternoon!

text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
text_en_primary: Surely humanity is in ˹grave˺ loss,
text_en_yusufali: Verily Man is in loss,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! man is a state of loss,
text_en_arberry: Surely Man is in the way of loss,

text_ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
text_en_primary: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance.
text_en_yusufali: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.
text_en_pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.
text_en_arberry: save those who believe, and do righteous deeds, and counsel each other unto the truth, and counsel each other to be steadfast.

text_ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
text_en_primary: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer,
text_en_yusufali: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
text_en_pickthall: Woe unto every slandering traducer,
text_en_arberry: Woe unto every backbiter, slanderer,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
text_en_primary: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺,
text_en_yusufali: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,
text_en_pickthall: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
text_en_arberry: who has gathered riches and counted them over

text_ar: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
text_en_primary: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal!
text_en_yusufali: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
text_en_pickthall: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
text_en_arberry: thinking his riches have made him immortal!

text_ar: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
text_en_primary: Not at all! Such a person will certainly be tossed into the Crusher.
text_en_yusufali: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
text_en_pickthall: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
text_en_arberry: No indeed; he shall be thrust into the Crusher;

text_ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
text_en_primary: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?
text_en_yusufali: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
text_en_pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
text_en_arberry: and what shall teach thee what is the Crusher;

text_ar: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
text_en_primary: ˹It is˺ Allah’s kindled Fire,
text_en_yusufali: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) God kindled (to a blaze),
text_en_pickthall: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
text_en_arberry: The Fire of God kindled

text_ar: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
text_en_primary: which rages over the hearts.
text_en_yusufali: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:
text_en_pickthall: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
text_en_arberry: roaring over the hearts

text_ar: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
text_en_primary: It will be sealed over them,
text_en_yusufali: It shall be made into a vault over them,
text_en_pickthall: Lo! it is closed in on them
text_en_arberry: covered down upon them,

text_ar: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
text_en_primary: ˹tightly secured˺ with long braces.
text_en_yusufali: In columns outstretched.
text_en_pickthall: In outstretched columns.
text_en_arberry: in columns outstretched.

text_ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
text_en_primary: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant?
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
text_en_pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant ?
text_en_arberry: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with the Men of the Elephant?

text_ar: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
text_en_primary: Did He not frustrate their scheme?
text_en_yusufali: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
text_en_pickthall: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
text_en_arberry: Did He not make their guile to go astray?

text_ar: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
text_en_primary: For He sent against them flocks of birds,
text_en_yusufali: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
text_en_pickthall: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
text_en_arberry: And He loosed upon them birds in flights,

text_ar: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
text_en_primary: that pelted them with stones of baked clay,
text_en_yusufali: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
text_en_pickthall: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
text_en_arberry: hurling against them stones of baked clay

text_ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
text_en_primary: leaving them like chewed up straw.
text_en_yusufali: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
text_en_pickthall: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle) ?
text_en_arberry: and He made them like green blades devoured.

text_ar: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
text_en_primary: ˹At least˺ for ˹the favour of˺ making Quraysh habitually secure—
text_en_yusufali: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,
text_en_pickthall: For the taming of Qureysh.
text_en_arberry: For the composing of Koraish,

text_ar: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
text_en_primary: secure in their trading caravan ˹to Yemen˺ in the winter and ˹Syria˺ in the summer—
text_en_yusufali: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
text_en_pickthall: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
text_en_arberry: their composing for the winter and summer caravan!

text_ar: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
text_en_primary: let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House,
text_en_yusufali: Let them adore the Lord of this House,
text_en_pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
text_en_arberry: So let them serve the Lord of this House

text_ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
text_en_primary: Who has fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear.
text_en_yusufali: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
text_en_pickthall: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
text_en_arberry: who has fed them against hunger and secured them from fear.

text_ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
text_en_primary: Have you seen the one who denies the ˹final˺ Judgment?
text_en_yusufali: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?
text_en_pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion ?
text_en_arberry: Hast thou seen him who cries lies to the Doom?

text_ar: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
text_en_primary: That is the one who repulses the orphan,
text_en_yusufali: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),
text_en_pickthall: That is he who repelleth the orphan,
text_en_arberry: That is he who repulses the orphan

text_ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
text_en_primary: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
text_en_yusufali: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.
text_en_pickthall: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.
text_en_arberry: and urges not the feeding of the needy.

text_ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
text_en_primary: So woe to those ˹hypocrites˺ who pray
text_en_yusufali: So woe to the worshippers
text_en_pickthall: Ah, woe unto worshippers
text_en_arberry: So woe to those that pray

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
text_en_primary: yet are unmindful of their prayers;
text_en_yusufali: Who are neglectful of their prayers,
text_en_pickthall: Who are heedless of their prayer;
text_en_arberry: and are heedless of their prayers,

text_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
text_en_primary: those who ˹only˺ show off,
text_en_yusufali: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
text_en_pickthall: Who would be seen (at worship)
text_en_arberry: to those who make display

text_ar: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
text_en_primary: and refuse to give ˹even the simplest˺ aid.
text_en_yusufali: But refuse (to supply) (even) neighbourly needs.
text_en_pickthall: Yet refuse small kindnesses!
text_en_arberry: and refuse charity.

text_ar: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
text_en_primary: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness.
text_en_yusufali: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
text_en_arberry: Surely We have given thee abundance;

text_ar: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
text_en_primary: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺.
text_en_yusufali: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
text_en_pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
text_en_arberry: so pray unto thy Lord and sacrifice.

text_ar: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
text_en_primary: Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺.
text_en_yusufali: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
text_en_pickthall: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
text_en_arberry: Surely he that hates thee, he is the one cut off.

text_ar: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O you disbelievers!
text_en_yusufali: Say : O ye that reject Faith!
text_en_pickthall: Say: O disbelievers!
text_en_arberry: Say: ’O unbelievers,

text_ar: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
text_en_primary: I do not worship what you worship,
text_en_yusufali: I worship not that which ye worship,
text_en_pickthall: I worship not that which ye worship;
text_en_arberry: I serve not what you serve

text_ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
text_en_primary: nor do you worship what I worship.
text_en_yusufali: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
text_en_pickthall: Nor worship ye that which I worship.
text_en_arberry: and you are not serving what I serve,

text_ar: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
text_en_primary: I will never worship what you worship,
text_en_yusufali: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,
text_en_pickthall: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.
text_en_arberry: nor am I serving what you have served,

text_ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
text_en_primary: nor will you ever worship what I worship.
text_en_yusufali: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
text_en_pickthall: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
text_en_arberry: neither are you serving what I serve

text_ar: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
text_en_primary: You have your way, and I have my Way.”
text_en_yusufali: To you be your Way, and to me mine.
text_en_pickthall: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.
text_en_arberry: To you your religion, and to me my religion!’

text_ar: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
text_en_primary: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺,
text_en_yusufali: When comes the Help of God, and Victory,
text_en_pickthall: When Allah’s succour and the triumph cometh
text_en_arberry: When comes the help of God, and victory,

text_ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
text_en_primary: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds,
text_en_yusufali: And thou dost see the people enter God’s Religion in crowds,
text_en_pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
text_en_arberry: and thou seest men entering God’s religion in throngs,

text_ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
text_en_primary: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
text_en_yusufali: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
text_en_pickthall: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
text_en_arberry: then proclaim the praise of thy Lord, and seek His forgiveness; for He turns again unto men.

text_ar: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
text_en_primary: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish!
text_en_yusufali: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
text_en_pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
text_en_arberry: Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and perish he!

text_ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
text_en_primary: Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him.
text_en_yusufali: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
text_en_pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
text_en_arberry: His wealth avails him not, neither what he has earned;

text_ar: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ
text_en_primary: He will burn in a flaming Fire,
text_en_yusufali: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
text_en_pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
text_en_arberry: he shall roast at a flaming fire

text_ar: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
text_en_primary: and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling,
text_en_yusufali: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
text_en_pickthall: And his wife, the wood-carrier,
text_en_arberry: and his wife, the carrier of the firewood,

text_ar: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
text_en_primary: around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre.
text_en_yusufali: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
text_en_pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
text_en_arberry: upon her neck a rope of palm-fibre.

text_ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is Allah—One ˹and Indivisible˺;
text_en_yusufali: Say: He is God, the One and Only;
text_en_pickthall: Say: He is Allah, the One!
text_en_arberry: Say: ’He is God, One,

text_ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
text_en_primary: Allah—the Sustainer ˹needed by all˺.
text_en_yusufali: God, the Eternal, Absolute;
text_en_pickthall: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!
text_en_arberry: God, the Everlasting Refuge,

text_ar: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
text_en_primary: He has never had offspring, nor was He born.
text_en_yusufali: He begetteth not, nor is He begotten;
text_en_pickthall: He begetteth not nor was begotten.
text_en_arberry: who has not begotten, and has not been begotten,

text_ar: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
text_en_primary: And there is none comparable to Him.”
text_en_yusufali: And there is none like unto Him.
text_en_pickthall: And there is none comparable unto Him.
text_en_arberry: and equal to Him is not any one.’

text_ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak
text_en_yusufali: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
text_en_pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
text_en_arberry: Say: ’I take refuge with the Lord of the Daybreak

text_ar: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
text_en_primary: from the evil of whatever He has created,
text_en_yusufali: From the mischief of created things;
text_en_pickthall: From the evil of that which He created;
text_en_arberry: from the evil of what He has created,

text_ar: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
text_en_primary: and from the evil of the night when it grows dark,
text_en_yusufali: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads;
text_en_pickthall: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,
text_en_arberry: from the evil of darkness when it gathers,

text_ar: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
text_en_primary: and from the evil of those ˹witches casting spells by˺ blowing onto knots,
text_en_yusufali: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts;
text_en_pickthall: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,
text_en_arberry: from the evil of the women who blow on knots,

text_ar: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
text_en_primary: and from the evil of an envier when they envy.”
text_en_yusufali: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy.
text_en_pickthall: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.
text_en_arberry: from the evil of an envier when he envies.’

text_ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
text_en_primary: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind,
text_en_yusufali: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind,
text_en_pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
text_en_arberry: Say: ’I take refuge with the Lord of men,

text_ar: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
text_en_primary: the Master of humankind,
text_en_yusufali: The King (or Ruler) of Mankind,
text_en_pickthall: The King of mankind,
text_en_arberry: the King of men,

text_ar: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
text_en_primary: the God of humankind,
text_en_yusufali: The God (or judge) of Mankind,-
text_en_pickthall: The God of mankind,
text_en_arberry: the God of men,

text_ar: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
text_en_primary: from the evil of the lurking whisperer—
text_en_yusufali: From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper),-
text_en_pickthall: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,
text_en_arberry: from the evil of the slinking whisperer

text_ar: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
text_en_primary: who whispers into the hearts of humankind—
text_en_yusufali: (The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind,-
text_en_pickthall: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,
text_en_arberry: who whispers in the breasts of men

text_ar: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
text_en_primary: from among jinn and humankind.”
text_en_yusufali: Among Jinns and among men.
text_en_pickthall: Of the jinn and of mankind.
text_en_arberry: of jinn and men.’
